lyrics:
Cover of
FOF
[Theory | mode: minor gospel-blues hybrid | tonal center: F# minor | meter: 4/4 w/ triplet swing bleed | tempo: 90 BPM (derived from 120 BPM SWUNG; elastic micro-drift ±2 BPM on bar anchors) | chord color: sus9, add11, gospel dominant tensions]

[Voice | register: contralto lead + pitched-down BGV choir + whisper doubles | delivery: sermon-slow drag with melismatic vowel holds | expression: cry-to-command arcs; breath-heavy phrasing; tape-warp sustain | articulation: vowel-stretched, consonant-tight]

[Style | genre: Houston chopped gospel-trap × glam strip-soul | era: modern trap with DJ Screw lineage | intent: dominance-as-test; ritualized luxury trial | texture: syrup tempo, wide stereo whispers, submerged low-end | aesthetic: velvet club cathedral; neon + incense | focus: authority without movement]

[Timbre | drum tone: sparse 808 kit, swung hats, delayed claps | bass tone: long-tail sub 808 w/ glide | keyboard tone: gospel organ pad + detuned Rhodes | fx palette: tape wobble, screw slowdown, delay throws, crowd murmur | vocal tone: clean lead, slight saturation, formant-stable]

[Performance | execution: Intro → Verse 1 → Chorus → Verse 2 → Chorus → Outro | gesture: breath gaps, chant stacks, looped responses | rhythm handling: half-time drag w/ micro tempo dips at phrase ends | touch: call-response repetition + pitch-down reinforcement]

▸ LYRICS BLOCK
[Section: Intro | durationBars: 4]
[*chopped and screwed start* *scratches* *sample halts* *faint 808*]
"Mmm… sometimes you try to remember… but all you see is fog. Lawd have mercy."

"Ooooh Lawd; take me back through the fog." (through the fog… amen)

[Section: Verse 1 | durationBars: 4]
[*sparse beat* *deep hum*]
"We are born of sin;"

"fight to win."
"Without you I ain’t whole;"
"lost in the cold."
"Every night I pray"
"to see your face."
"This fog got me reachin’ into empty space." *echo delay ping pong*

[Section: Chorus 1 | durationBars: 6]
[*halo lift* *sweeps* *drops* *choir hum*]
"Through the fog I reach for you;"

"time stole the colors and left me blue."

"Thirty-five years drownin’ in tears;"

"David; I fight hard to remember you;"

"it's so hard to fight through the fear." (through the fog… amen)

[Section: Verse 2 | durationBars: 8]
[*blues wail* *hats* *syrup swing*]
"Wish that daddy"

"never called that night"

"Four times now"

"Baron has confirmed it's not a lie"

"Wish I had"
"more than echoes and pain."

"Oh Lawd;"

"this fog 

done stayed too long." (stayed too long)

[Section: Chorus 2 | durationBars: 8]
[*wider* *dbl time* *choir up* *swell*]
"Through the fog"

"I call your name;"

"shadows remind me;"

"never the same."

"Four years since 

Chris went home;"

"I still cry;"

"Aug twenty-one;"

"fog closed my sky." (through the fog… rest now)

[Section: Bridge | durationBars: 8]
[*minimal pulse* *pads*]
"I close my eyes;"

"try to pull you from the mist…"

"it breaks me."

"Don’t wanna forget;"

"remembering hurts…"

"this fog ain’t mercy..."

"it’s a curse." (mercy… curse… Lawd have mercy)

[Section: MemoryRollCall | durationBars: 38]
[*hypnotic pulse* *ghost whispers* *reverb build*]
"Royce and Calvin"

"walkin’ steady"
"through the stormin’"
"night fog." (Amen)

"Pam smilin’ and clappin’;"

"Altari’s voice"

"still hums"

"in the midnight hymn." (Through the fog)

"I-da holdin’ strong"

"with gospel fire burnin’." (Rest now)

"Minnie and Annie"

"cryin’ out;"

"sayin’ 

the Lawd"

"still know me." (Amen)

"Burl; Marion; and June"

"clappin’ hands;"

"keepin’ faith"

"in the struggle." (Through the fog)

"Winnie and Kevin"

"wadin’ deep;"

"but the light"

"still guides them." (Rest now)

"Bertha"

"prayin’; 

moanin’"

"soul 

through the heavy dark." (Amen)

"Ronnie and Tack"

"laughin’ 

loud"

"like trumpets"

"in Zion." (Through the fog)

"Uncle J.W."

"preachin’ strong"

"with a thunder roll." (Amen)

"Uncle J.P. 

and James"

"walkin’ tall"

"with the saints"

"hand-in-hand." (Through the fog)

"M.C. 

and George Frank"

"whisperin’;"

"'Son be calm; 

move like a shadow 

through fire'." (Rest now)

[Section: Outro | durationBars: 8]
[*slow fade* *trunk tail controlled*]
"Through the fog…"

"Lawd… 

take me back…"

"David William 

and Christopher James…"

"my days"

"just ain’t the same."

"Miss K"

"and Miss Sues-Anne"

"still singin’:"

"'Lawd; 

oh Lord"

carry me home" (Amen)

"Deon; 

Tracey; 

Rodney; 

Mister Steve; 

Mr. Henry; 

Wesley; 

Charles Ray... 

You
 
were all loved 

and continue to be

[Outro | 4 bars | REPEAT "CHORUS2" | **sFX: fade to black **]

[End]

[Theory]
[mode | F minor with Phrygian lean]
[tonal center | F]
[harmonic behavior | sparse minor-root 808 tics, overdriven synth power chords, minimal chord movement]
[meter | 4/4]
[tempo | 142 BPM]
[chord color | dark minor triads, lowered fifth distortion, sustained synth pads]

[Voice]
[register | mid to high baritone (DJ Mo/$ tag → hyped, energetic)]
[delivery | aggressive shout-outs, chopped vocal stabs, rapid-fire ad-libs]
[expression | gritty confidence, club-ready bravado, raw hype]
[articulation | clipped consonants, stuttered pitch-shifts, abrupt tag drops]

[Lyrics Narrative]

[Intro (Lo-Fi Static, Faint Heartbeat)]  
(Husband’s voice, weary, whispered)  
“I swear to God we were just friends…”  
(Lo-fi crackle + slow, heavy heartbeat beneath)  
“Suddenly… we were both lonely.  
You didn’t even notice… I’d started drinking again.  
‘Cause I was lonely… and you just ignore… and hate all of my friends.  
You stopped looking at me. I became a ghost in our own home.”  

[Verse 1 (Melancholic, Storytelling over distant bar ambience)]  
“So I was at the bar… drinking alone.”  
(Glasses clinking faintly, murmurs, drink being poured)  
“She slid beside me… I thought I’d found a moment’s peace.  
A smile in the smoke, a kindness I hadn’t seen in weeks.  
But I swear to God, I didn’t mean to cross that line.  
A minute turned an hour… an hour felt like a sign.  
And her laughter, sharp like glass, cut through the fog.”  

[Pre-Chorus (Suspenseful, Whispered Echoes + Subtle Static)]  
“And your silence screams… ‘getaway’… cuts me to the bone.  
I felt it every time I walked through the door… cold like stone.  
Getaway… leave today… stay away…”  
(Echoing whisper, fading like a ghost)

[Verse 2 (Bar Scene, Her Discovery – Door Slam + Tense Heartbeat)]  
(Sound: door slamming open)  
“And then she walked in… rage like a storm, eyes wild.  
How could you… why would… who is she?  
GETAWAY… LEAVE TODAY… STAY AWAY…”  
(Her voice distorted, overlapping, cracking)  
“Her breath like fire, her fists like thunder.”  

[Chorus (Dramatic, Emotional Explosion with Vinyl Crackle)]  
(Drums hit heavy, vinyl crackle underneath)  
“And I said… I’m sorry babe… I lost your trust today.  
I swear, I’ll do anything… please… just don’t turn away.  
I never meant for the ice between us… but I see it now.”  

[Bridge (Minimal, Desperate Tone)]  
(Husband’s voice, wavering, raw)  
“And she said… I’m sorry, I didn’t realize…  
I WASN’T THERE FOR YOU, AND WE BEEN TOGETHER TOO LONG…  
TO LET THIS MARRIAGE END.  
BUT FIRST… WE NEED TO WALK IN EACH OTHER'S SHOES…  
JUST SO YOU UNDERSTAND… so I need to meet her husband.”  

[Chorus Reprise (Cold, Calculating – Subtle Static)]  
(Static hum + tense heartbeat reprise)  
“And I asked WHY?”  
(Her voice, eerily calm, each word a knife)  
“I’m feeling lonely, I can’t ignore this. I refuse to let you two win.  
Imma be at her house… with her husband. After we spend the night in our bed.”  

[Outro (Sparse, Vinyl Crackle, Looming Dread, Heartbeat Slowing)]  
(Hollow, the room feels empty)  
“So while I get ready… I’m going to need you to…  
GETAWAY… LEAVE TODAY… STAY AWAY… until Sunday afternoon.”  
(Heartbeat slows, crackle deepens, fades into silence)

GETAWAY… LEAVE TODAY… STAY AWAY…”

“Her breath like fire, her fists like thunder.”

(Drums hit heavy, vinyl crackle underneath)  
“And I said… I’m sorry babe… I lost your trust today.

(Husband’s voice, wavering, raw)  
“And she said… I’m sorry, I didn’t realize…

TO LET THIS MARRIAGE END.

JUST SO YOU UNDERSTAND… so I need to meet her husband.”  

[Chorus Reprise (Cold, Calculating – Subtle Static)]  
(Static hum + tense heartbeat reprise)  
“And I asked WHY?”  
(Her voice, eerily calm, each word a knife)  
“I’m feeling lonely, I can’t ignore this. I refuse to let you two win.

“So while I get ready… I’m going to need you to…  
GETAWAY… LEAVE TODAY… STAY AWAY… until Sunday afternoon.”

lyrics:
⭐ STILL HERE (Southern Gothic Trill-Blues Cinematic v1.5) ⭐

(love-child of A+B+C with sprinkles)

[Intro — Whispered Storytelling, Sparse 808, Clean Guitar, Vinyl Hiss]

(vinyl crackle, low 808 throb, a faint “mmm-hmm” from the choir)

I’ve walked cracked highways—moonlight in my veins,
Found grace in rusted strings and back-porch chains.
This gravel tongue scorches like frost on pine,
Still here—unbroken… can you feel my spine?

(ghost whispers trail “feel my spine…” “feel my spine…”)

A whippoorwill cries in a far-off bend,
And the holler repeats it back like kin.
Stars blink slow like they’re prayin’ for me—
God in the ditch-water… spirit in the debris.

[Verse 1 — Dre-Pocket Minimalism, Sub-Organ Pads, Blues Licks]

Raised on sawdust floors where hymnbooks froze,
Smoke and sweat baptize these tattered clothes.
Papa’s pledge: “Stay rooted deep in clay,”
Yet heaven called me through a four-string sway.

(blues guitar bends, pan-left, slides)

Muddy boots for sermons, cracked voice for psalms,
Mama’s scarred lullabies pressed into my palms.
Thunder talked back when I first learned tone—
Some nights the storm was the only way home.

[Pre-Chorus 1 — Off-Kilter Snare & Vocal Chops, Prince-esque Tension]

I straddled faith and fire—nights in two-step coils,
808s ignite the blood that toils.
Loop this prayer, let the groove extol,
Ashes rise to anthem— I reclaim my soul.

(whisper-chop “re-claim my soul…” hits 2.2, 3.4, 4.1, 4.3)

And oh—
the ghosts lean close…
wantin’ to know
if I’ll break or glow.

[Chorus 1 — Gospel Lift, Prince-Style Modulation to Dmaj7]

Still here—still breathin’, though roots run wide,
Still here—wild spirit, no need to hide.
Each sub-kick thuds a gospel heartbeat,
Choir hums vow my purpose complete.

(bass “Hmm,” tenor “Hallelu,” falsetto “Jah-ah-ah”)
(stacked octave gliss, Take 6 style)

[Verse 2 — Half-Time Ghost Groove (F9sus → Abmaj7)]

(half-time feel, whispered counters on the outer edges)

Brothers clashed like thunder in midnight pines,
One chased sin, the other read blind-folded signs.
Time built walls where the holler once rang,
I’m a specter with chorus—still sharp, still sang.

(double-time switch last 4 bars)

Draggin’ vowels through mud, then I sprint through rain,
Triplet fire-tongue burnin’ holy refrain.
Footsteps of the dead drum under my breath—
I walk with them, but I don’t mirror death.

lyrics:
[Intro – Soft Rhodes Keys, Warm Guitar, Deep Bass]
🎤 (*"Dis one… dis one is for di love we lost… di love we hold on to… yeah…"*)
(*Band settles into a slow, smooth groove…*)

🎶 (**Backup Singers - Soft, Gospel-infused Harmonies**)
*"Oooooohhhh… stay for di good times…"*

[Verse 1 – Lead Vocal, Soulful & Emotive]
Don’t look so sad… mi know it’s over…  
But life goes on… an’ dis world keeps on turnin’…  
Let’s not cry… let’s jus’ remember…  
Di love we had… di way it used to be…  

[Chorus – Backup Singers in Rich Harmony]
🎶 *"For di goooood tiiiimes… hold mi one last tiiiime…"*

[Verse 2 – Lead Vocal, Passion Building]
Mi cyaah change… di way dis story end…  
But mi can hold yuh close… feel yuh skin again…  
No words… jus’ silence…  
Let mi love yuh one more time…  

[Chorus – Full Vocal Layering, Deep Emotion]
🎶 *"For di goooood tiiiimes… don’t let go just yet…"*

[Bridge – Instrumental, Guitar Weeps, Organ Swells]
🔥 (*Guitar solo – deep, crying bends… Rhodes keys shimmer…*) 🔥

[Verse 3 – Barely Above a Whisper, Intimate Feel]
Wheneva yuh need mi… mi still deh yah…  
No questions, no worries, no fears…  
Mi give yuh di space… but mi never disappear…  

[Outro – Fade Out with Deep Harmonies]
🎶 *"For di goooood tiiiimes… mi still right here…"*
(*Band slows to silence… just voices floating in the air…*)

"Seh mi deep like trench, an’ mi game real fat"
"Gyal eye lock when mi step inna place"

"But mi know yuh type from mile to mile"
"Di tongue sweet, but yuh soul feel cold"
"Yuh nuh deh pon love, yuh just deh fi hold"
"Mi nuh easily swayed by ring or chain"
"A real queen nah fall fi gain"
"So watch yuh step wid yuh brawlin' tone"
"Cuz mi hear yuh verse—but mi walk alone"

"Why yuh chat so loud?"

"Mi read bwoy like cloud"

"Mi hear ‘bout yuh crew"
"So how deep yuh go?"
(808 cut to silence)
"Mi bring storm, yuh feel di wave"
"Mi too wise fi di slave behave"
"Mi heart talk, mi vibe cyan fake"
"Words nice, but mi nah tek bait"
"Tell di truth now, or let it pass—"
"Coulda been magic, but yuh move too fast"
(DJ MoMoney pon di mixdown!)
(reverse snare hit)

"Mi too drunk, mi head a spin"
"Mi foot dem hurt, an’ mi heart nah win"
"Mi too tired fi dis back-an-forth"
"Mi worth more dan yuh sweet talk oath"
"Last year? Maybe mi woulda stay"
"But tonight mi walk away"
"Di dance nice, di riddim clean"
"But mi nah go fake what mi nah mean"
"Don’t ask mi how deep mi go—"
"Cuz mi gone long time, yuh jus’ slow"

[Outro – Whisper Layer + Brand Drop | vinyl hiss + dub delay + crowd noise fx]

"Big up DJ MoMoney... this one too deep"
(slow tape winddown)
(fade to silence)

tags: show_summary: Desert chapel hush; she steps outta the dust with low-contralto power AND church-raised fire. Grew up singin’ in a one-stoplight choir—black southern country church training run through eight years of bel-canto operatic drills. Her breath loops circular-style; she’ll inhale on the out-breath (ingressive phonation) so the groove never quits. Slide guitar moans behind her; shamisen plucks catch the dust; slow 808 pulse holds the pocket. She drips microtonal scoops ’cross every bar—then fry-cracks a line on the downbeat. Whistle register glints like Sunday rays through stained glass. Whiskey and wild roses become sermon AND testimony; every syllable packed with deep-soul weight AND high-art precision. Choir stacks edge in reverse-echo; ad-libs bloom gospel-dense between her lines. Storm rolls in; rain splatters low brass. Two hands almost meet; she keeps her road—unbroken
title: Whiskey and Wild Roses v2.1.a

guttural tenor vocals over a syncopated

layered percussion and distorted instruments surge as vocals erupt into a triumphant

[Chorus Reprise | 8 bars] "So while I get ready I need you to" "GET AWAY; LEAVE TODAY; STAY AWAY" (BGVs; "stay away") (Maggie side laugh) "Mommas gon get her some grace; some of that BDE"

a DJ drop cutting clean into the mix with vinyl scratches and an 808 detonation. The first verse hits at 100 BPM in pure street-clash theatre — rudeboi patois over punchy trap swing

crowd answering every challenge in tight call-and-response.  

From there
the mic passes seamlessly across continents: Tokyo’s pocket-flow prodigy weaving Japanese lines into the chant
Scotch-Irish fiddles reeling against the throb of a didgeridoo
and an Indo-Turk polyglot splicing Hindi
and Portuguese mid-stride. Each verse is its own battle vignette

but the hooks remain the unifying ritual — the crowd roars “Who pay di price?” / “WE PAY!” and “Who roll di dice?” / “DEM PLAY!” over deep mono subs and brass stabs.  

At the bridge
the floor moving as one in meme-dance formation — right heel
money-stack — viral energy captured in motion. The final hook drives double-time before the tempo

African American female singer with vocal fry and emotional melisma. Thick southern drawl with AAVE Pronunciation. A country-trap gospel noir meets Southern Gothic soundscape unfolds with Hammond drones
Club Anthem-TikTok ViRAL featuring only female vocals blend melisma and whispers
Double-time surges to 164 BPM with rapid Southern flow
and call-and-response gospel choir in wide stereo
layered with preacher echoes and sub-bass
Gospel sus9/add11 chords linger for tension
bridges fracture with whisper-to-shout dynamics over organ pads
tape hiss mixing with choir bleed
choruses swell wide with pedal tones and reverb trailing grief into a silence-fade.
title: stay away aisg v4 i2.1.2

[LYRICS BLOCK]

[Intro | 4 bars | Maggie | trap swing]
"(** room hush ) ( heel-stomp ) ( steel lick **)"

[Verse A | 16 bars | Maggie | trap swing]
"I’m tired of being lonely—sure as hell didn’t deserve this shit." (** TIGHTEN IT )
"My house my room my bed my man—my rules now I’m done with the script."
"Who the hell what the fuck—( SMILE )—tip the glass let the spark get lit;"
[RAP PIVOT] "count-count / breath-step / lock-set / rise—I choose where the tables flip." (Moe: "mmm") ( rear-L; -18 dB **)

[Hinge/Pre | 8 bars | Maggie | half-time lead to hook]
"Excuse me… yes they were. You knew. You know me when I’m quiet."
"You know the place? Eight is fine. No it won’t take long—not long at all." (** LAUGHING **)
"Bring your calm—bring your keys—leave shame at the door of this bar."
"If there’s a storm I’m center-eye—let these walls remember who we are."

[Hook 1 | 8 bars | Maggie + Choir | halo choir]
"Getaway—leave today—stay away."
"Getaway—leave today—stay away."
"Getaway—leave today—stay away—"
"Stay… away." (** steel answers **) (Moe: "ooh" ** octave-floor; very low **)

[Verse B | 16 bars | Maggie | trap swing NSFW]
"We fucked all night in our bed, on our sheets with our names in the seams;"
"Headboard kept time like a choir, and I burned through the last of my grief."
"I wasn’t beggin’ for mercy—just meaning; I took what I came for." [RAP PIVOT]
"hands-locked / breath-caught / pulse-talked / more—I rode that river to shore."
(** DROP THE BOTTOM ) "(two bars air—no bass—just skin and a vow I could breathe)"
( OPEN IT **) "Rhodes wide like a door—steel kisses the back of my teeth."
"I slept like thunder gone quiet—woke laughing, sated and sane;"
"God signed the margin in light—'child, I meant you by name.'"

[Hook 2 | 8 bars | Maggie + Choir | lift + halo]
"Getaway—leave today—stay away." (** this is how God writes in me **)
"Best thing ever you two did—was point the door to me."
"Getaway—leave today—stay away—"
"Stay… away." (Moe: "mmm" ** baritone; bar 6 **)

[Bridge | 8 bars | Maggie | half-time storm]
"Sun through their blinds like blades—we went again at their place at dawn;"
"Coffee and sweat on tongues; a laugh like a psalm where the ache was gone."
"If fate has a map, it’s this—two doors, one breath, no shame;"
"If Sunday rings, I’ll answer—'whatever’s true, speak your name.'"

[Final Tag | 4 bars | Maggie | tighten it]
"Stay… away…"

[Phone Call | 4 bars | Moe + Isla | mono 200–5 kHz; zero verb]
[ISLA] "They moved exactly where the silence pointed."
[MOE] "Mm. Give it a week—tell them to… stay away." (** click **)

[Exit | 2 bars | Maggie | spinback]
"(** DJ spinback ) ( vinyl hiss **)"

[DJ DROP]
DJ: You ready.  
DJ: Girl we ain’t got time—five  four  three  two  one.

[Verse-A]
F: Just clocked out heels still sticky.  
M: Tips in my wallet taste like pity.  
F: Bottle half gone God forgive me.  
M: This booth no studio  just confession city.

[Intro]
M: Your nails trace sin on my skin.  
F: I know I should run yet you reel me back in.  
BOTH: Temptation tastes sweet laced heavy with regret.  
M: Holding my breath.  
F: Holding my breath.

[Verse-B]
M: We both know this love a slow bleed.  
F: Slow bleed.  
M: Your body talking like only I need.  
F: Only you need.  
M: Slide guitar cries while organ pads rise.  
F: I feel every note when you bend those lies.  
BOTH: Kick oath heavy  yoke we carry.

[Pre-Chorus]
F: I should leave at sunrise.  
M: But your legs pray for night.  
M: You should hate these lies.  
F: Yet you love how they bite.

[Chorus]
BOTH: This love is dangerous baby.  
BOTH: You clutch your fears just to crave me.  
BOTH: Seeking relief in a bed full of toxins.  
BOTH: We should stop but we will not.  
BOTH: Poison tastes sweet while warm.  
CHOIR: Dangerous  dangerous.

[Verse-C]
F: You swear I am first you insist I am best.  
M: Your best.  
F: We kiss like truth while we lie with each breath.  
M: Each breath.  
F: Our moans sound honest though hands confess.  
M: Two sinners in love still failing the test.  
BOTH: Angels deserve better yet we crave devil touch together.

[Bridge]
M: Tell me you hate me.  
F: While my lips chant your name.  
F: Tell me you will leave me.  
M: While your hips beg me stay.

[Chorus-Big]
BOTH: This love is dangerous baby.

BOTH: I am no good yet you love me the hardest.  
BOTH: Fingers tangled tight tearing hearts out.  
BOTH: We should stop but we will not.  
BOTH: Pain feels like love when raw.  
CHOIR: Dangerous dangerous.

[Outro]
F: Dangerous love never enough.  
M: Dangerous love God damn us.  
BOTH: Hold me until the vinyl crackle fades.

lyrics:
[Intro, Haunting Choir, Cinematic Strings, Sub-bass Swell]
[Whispered, building intensity] Tick... tick... BOOM—
I don’t wait, I don’t hesitate, no fumes
Straight nitro in my veins, no brakes, no room
[FX: yeah] See the chains? They rattlin’, shadows move...
[Spoken Word, lower voice] Time is my chain. I wear it like proof.

[Drop, Industrial Percussion Enters, Heavy 808s]
[Distorted Vocal, robotic modulation] Break it down, let it build—watch the whole world tilt!

[Verse 1, Aggressive Double-time Flow, Pounding Drums]
Born where the sirens wail, zoning lines like crime in Braille
Alleyway codes, red tape trails, block don’t sleep, wolves inhale
I pivot, I switch, I ghost—
Move like a phantom, don’t play post
Hack their systems, vanish in smoke—
[Spoken Word, slower] Time is my chain. I drag it slow.

[Tempo Shift, Half-time Beat, Bluesy Vocal Overlapping]
[Gritty, distorted blues vocal] Ain’t no mercy here
Gotta walk these laws like they etched in fear
Runnin’ from a line that was drawn in blood—
On maps they redlined, buried us in mud

[Pre-Chorus, Rising Tension, Orchestral Stabs, Gospel Choir Layered]
[Chanted, layered harmonies] RUN—Don’t slow down!
FIGHT—Own this ground!
MOVE—Ain’t no doubts!
LIGHT IT UP, LET ‘EM DROWN!

[Chorus, High-Energy Triplet Flow, Massive Synths, Layered Vocals]
I don’t break, I accelerate, no handbrake in my DNA
Push that weight ‘til the levee shake, no backtrack when the rebels play
Tick-tick-tock, time’s runnin’ out
Pressure cookin’, I’m burstin’ out
No rewind, no safe route—
I AM the sound of the underground!
[FX: let it burn...]
I AM the sound of the underground!
[FX: let it turn...]

[Instrumental Break, Percussion Frenzy, Sudden Silence Before Impact]

[Verse 2, Spoken Word into Explosive Rap, Atmospheric Pads]
[Low, menacing whisper] It’s the breath before the firestorm
It’s the system dressed in uniform
It’s the zoning that erased my form—
Then BOOM—WARHORNS!

[Beat Switch, Hard-Hitting Drums, Complex Hi-hats, Layered Choir Harmonies]
[Rapid cadence switch-up, breathless delivery] Never been the type to fold, I decode, overload, then explode with the payload
Every syllable I spit is a blade to the throat, break chains, innovate, leave ‘em comatose!
I don’t comply, I amplify, multiply ‘til the sky collides—
I testify with a battle cry—
Who gon’ stop me? TRY.
[Spoken Word, defiant] Time is my chain. I drag it with pride.

[Bridge, Ethereal Pads, Stripped-Back Vocals, Echoed Gospel Harmonies]
[Layered vocal harmonies, haunting reverb] They tried to write me off (but I rewrite fate)
They tried to clip my wings (but I levitate)
They tried to block my path (but I renovate)
I make the rules now—I DECIMATE!
[FX: let it burn...]
I DECIMATE.

[Final Chorus, Climactic Drop, Explosive Bass Hits, Overdriven Synths]
I don’t break, I accelerate, no handbrake in my DNA
Push that weight ‘til the levee shake, no backtrack when the rebels play
Tick-tick-tock, time’s runnin’ out
Pressure cookin’, I’m burstin’ out
No rewind, no safe route—
I AM the sound of the underground!
[FX: let it burn...]
I AM the sound of the underground!
[Spoken Word, resonant] Time is my chain. Let it turn...

[Outro, Fading Choir, Subdued Drum Rolls, Echoed Whispers]
[Whispered, fading into the void] Time is my chain…
Tick… tick…
BOOM.

lyrics:
[Intro – Club Ambience + Whisper Layer]
(tribal congas wide-panned, dub swirl FX, soft tape wobble)
"Yuh waan know how deep...?" (whispered tease)
"MoMoney Studios... yuh done know!" (DJ drop)

[Verse 1 – Rude-Bwoy Flex | disco-trap kit + tribal toms + slap bassline tight in center]
"Mi nuh need fi talk, di gyal dem chat" (confident intro)
"Seh mi deep like trench, an’ mi game real fat"
"Gyal eye lock when mi step inna place"
"Dem seh mi bring heat, mi nuh need no chase"
"Mi roll like lion, mi pounce pon beat"
"Di gyal waan test if di heart still beat"
"Every likkle word come slick like oil"
"Seh mi tek time, but mi mash up soil"
"Wine pon mi name, dem a whisper low"
"Seh mi touch reach parts weh man nuh know"
"Mi style a danger, mi walk wid poise"
"Gyal seh mi vibe like thunder noise"
"Mi nuh boast—but mi nuh shy"
"Mi ask dem gyal straight, ‘How deep mi lie?’"
(DJ MoMoney pon di riddim!)
(dub echo trail)

[Verse 2 – Queen Rebuttal | filtered chop loop + airy dub stabs + stereo shimmer pad]
"Mi hear dem tale—same old chat"
"Big bwoy flex but mi done smell rat"
"Di last one seh him a lion too"
"Till mi find out seh him move like screw"
"Yuh have di talk, an’ yuh flash di smile"
"But mi know yuh type from mile to mile"
"Di tongue sweet, but yuh soul feel cold"
"Yuh nuh deh pon love, yuh just deh fi hold"
"Mi nuh easily swayed by ring or chain"
"A real queen nah fall fi gain"
"So watch yuh step wid yuh brawlin' tone"
"Cuz mi hear yuh verse—but mi walk alone"

[Verse 3 – Call & Response | full riddim drop + stereo ping-pong delay]
"Mi waan fi know—"
"Why yuh chat so loud?"
"Mi nuh lie…"
"Mi read bwoy like cloud"
"Mi real, mi true—"
"Mi hear ‘bout yuh crew"
"So how deep yuh go?"
(808 cut to silence)
"Mi bring storm, yuh feel di wave"
"Mi too wise fi di slave behave"
"Mi heart talk, mi vibe cyan fake"
"Words nice, but mi nah tek bait"
"Tell di truth now, or let it pass—"
"Coulda been magic, but yuh move too fast"
(DJ MoMoney pon di mixdown!)
(reverse snare hit)

[Verse 4 – Emotional Exit | dubbed organ swell + lo-fi strip down + stereo whisper FX]
"Mi too drunk, mi head a spin"
"Mi foot dem hurt, an’ mi heart nah win"
"Mi too tired fi dis back-an-forth"
"Mi worth more dan yuh sweet talk oath"
"Last year? Maybe mi woulda stay"
"But tonight mi walk away"
"Di dance nice, di riddim clean"
"But mi nah go fake what mi nah mean"
"Don’t ask mi how deep mi go—"
"Cuz mi gone long time, yuh jus’ slow"

[Outro – Whisper Layer + Brand Drop | vinyl hiss + dub delay + crowd noise fx]
"Big up DJ MoMoney... this one too deep"
(slow tape winddown)
(fade to silence)

lyrics:
[Intro – Club Ambience + Whisper Layer]
(tribal congas wide-panned, dub swirl FX, soft tape wobble)
"Yuh waan know how deep...?" (whispered tease)
"MoMoney Studios... yuh done know!" (DJ drop)

[Verse 1 – Rude-Bwoy Flex | disco-trap kit + tribal toms + slap bassline tight in center]
"Mi nuh need fi talk, di gyal dem chat" (confident intro)
"Seh mi deep like trench, an’ mi game real fat"
"Gyal eye lock when mi step inna place"
"Dem seh mi bring heat, mi nuh need no chase"
"Mi roll like lion, mi pounce pon beat"
"Di gyal waan test if di heart still beat"
"Every likkle word come slick like oil"
"Seh mi tek time, but mi mash up soil"
"Wine pon mi name, dem a whisper low"
"Seh mi touch reach parts weh man nuh know"
"Mi style a danger, mi walk wid poise"
"Gyal seh mi vibe like thunder noise"
"Mi nuh boast—but mi nuh shy"
"Mi ask dem gyal straight, ‘How deep mi lie?’"
(DJ MoMoney pon di riddim!)
(dub echo trail)

[Verse 2 – Queen Rebuttal | filtered chop loop + airy dub stabs + stereo shimmer pad]
"Mi hear dem tale—same old chat"
"Big bwoy flex but mi done smell rat"
"Di last one seh him a lion too"
"Till mi find out seh him move like screw"
"Yuh have di talk, an’ yuh flash di smile"
"But mi know yuh type from mile to mile"
"Di tongue sweet, but yuh soul feel cold"
"Yuh nuh deh pon love, yuh just deh fi hold"
"Mi nuh easily swayed by ring or chain"
"A real queen nah fall fi gain"
"So watch yuh step wid yuh brawlin' tone"
"Cuz mi hear yuh verse—but mi walk alone"

[Verse 3 – Call & Response | full riddim drop + stereo ping-pong delay]
"Mi waan fi know—"
"Why yuh chat so loud?"
"Mi nuh lie…"
"Mi read bwoy like cloud"
"Mi real, mi true—"
"Mi hear ‘bout yuh crew"
"So how deep yuh go?"
(808 cut to silence)
"Mi bring storm, yuh feel di wave"
"Mi too wise fi di slave behave"
"Mi heart talk, mi vibe cyan fake"
"Words nice, but mi nah tek bait"
"Tell di truth now, or let it pass—"
"Coulda been magic, but yuh move too fast"
(DJ MoMoney pon di mixdown!)
(reverse snare hit)

[Verse 4 – Emotional Exit | dubbed organ swell + lo-fi strip down + stereo whisper FX]
"Mi too drunk, mi head a spin"
"Mi foot dem hurt, an’ mi heart nah win"
"Mi too tired fi dis back-an-forth"
"Mi worth more dan yuh sweet talk oath"
"Last year? Maybe mi woulda stay"
"But tonight mi walk away"
"Di dance nice, di riddim clean"
"But mi nah go fake what mi nah mean"
"Don’t ask mi how deep mi go—"
"Cuz mi gone long time, yuh jus’ slow"

[Outro – Whisper Layer + Brand Drop | vinyl hiss + dub delay + crowd noise fx]
"Big up DJ MoMoney... this one too deep"
(slow tape winddown)
(fade to silence)

"And somebody started to tell the story…"

"Family drivin’ down South, got as far as they could go…" [LoopSlice x2]  
"Dirt road, storm came, sky turned black, the wind start to blow…" [ScrubStutter on 'storm came']  
"Car slid off, flipped twice, he ain’t move no more…"  
"The whole family stepped out, but he ain’t make it though…" [ScrubStutter 'ain’t make it though']

[pre-chorus Jennifer Hudson, LoopSlice/TimeStretch, 00:56–01:20]  
"Grandma stepped out the car, walked up slow…"  
"Stepped on that porch, said 'how’s my boy…’"  
"They said ‘Mama, we called… but the doc ain’t home’…"  
"She said 'Baby, I got a doctor of my own'…" [LoopSlice, melisma extended]

[chorus anthemic, gospel powerhouse, LoopSlice x3, 01:20–01:50]  
"Come on in the room… Jesus is my doctor…" [LoopSlice, ScrubStutter on 'Come on in']  
"And He writes out all my prescriptions…"  
"He gives me all my medicine… In the room…" [PitchShift, extended reverb]

[bridge emotional, gospel prayer, Scratch, 01:50–02:20]  
"She stepped in that closet, shut the door tight…" [Scratch cue, tape stop]  
"Tears ran down her face, but she prayed all night…" [ScrubStutter]  
"She ain’t need no phone, she ain’t need no screen…"  
"She said ‘Lord, my son is hurt, I know you hear me…’" [PitchShift down, reverb]

[final verse preacher mumble rap, PitchShift, 02:50–03:14]  
"Then there came a knock, three times on the door…" [ScrubStutter 'knock']  
"The daughter said ‘Who is it?’—She ain’t know what’s in store…" [Scratch]  
"The voice said, ‘Little girl, I’m the doc…’"  
"‘I was in the area… the Lord made me stop’…"

[outro celebratory, gospel intensity, LoopSlice, 03:14–end]  
"There’s JOY in the room! Holy Ghost filled up the room!" [LoopSlice x3, PitchShift, reverb tail]  
"I feel it, I feel it, I feel it!" [Congregation shouts, stuttered]  
"The doctor came in, oh yes He did!" [Scratch out]

lyrics:
[DJ Drop 1, Foot Stomp, Hand Clap, Low Organ]
(Ronald Isley – Preacher voice, slow mumble flow)
You know… back in the day…
When someone passed, the old folks didn't wait on no piano…
They just started clappin’… started stompin’…
And told a story like this right here…

[Verse 1 – Ronald Isley, Spoken Word / Mumble Flow]
There was a family drivin’ down South
Rollin’ slow on that dirt, red clay route
Sky turned black, thunder start shout
Car slipped, flipped out — young boy laid out

Everyone else alright, but him — he ain't move
They saw a white house, right across that groove
Knocked on the door, lady answered smooth
Said, “Ma’am, we need your help — he’s hurt bad too”

Tried to call the doc, but he wasn’t around
Phone kept ringin’, then silence, no sound
Children cried, mama shook, no hope in the air
But grandma came walkin’ like she already there…

[Pre-Chorus – Jennifer Hudson, Soulful]
(Sung with soft choir in background)
Ohh Lord, we need You now…
Somebody pray, somebody bow…
Don’t need no phone, don’t need no light…
When Jesus walk in, everything right

[HOOK – Jennifer Hudson + Choir, Trap Gospel Drop]
Come on in the room… (uh huh!)
Come on in the room… (yes Lord!)
Jesus is my doctor… (ayyy!)
He write all my prescriptions… (he do!)
He give me all my medicine… (that’s right!)
In the room… (IN THE ROOM!)

[Verse 2 – Grandma (Jennifer Hudson), Dramatic Vocal + Fantasia Adlibs]
Grandma stepped to the porch, screen door creak
Eyes full of tears, voice strong when she speak:
“Ma’am, do you got a closet I can seek?”
White lady said, “You need the phone, maybe a seat?”

She said “No baby, I need a place to pray
My doctor don’t come in a Chevrolet
He ride clouds, part skies, and touch where I stay
So I need that closet, then I’ll be on my way”

She stepped in that closet — barely room to breathe
Children behind her, stomped dirt with they feet
Closed that door, said “Jesus, it’s me…”
And then she sang with the pain on the beat:

[LADY PART – Jennifer Hudson + Choir, Intense and Raw]
Come on in the room…
Come on in the room…
Jesus is my doctor, He write out my scripts
Give me that strength, even when I slip
He gives me all my medicine… in the room

[Bridge – Fantasia + Overdubs / Adlibs]
Mmmhmm, Holy Ghost gon’ greet ya
Oh Lord, let the Spirit meet ya
Closet got fire, soul got peace
The trap beat drop, but the pain don’t cease

[Verse 3 – Ronald Isley / Spoken Word, Dramatic Finish]
Then there came a knock — *three knocks, slow* (Knock. Knock. Knock.)
Girl ran to the door, paused, heart stopped
“Who is it?” she said — a voice outside said:
“I’m the doctor, I need a place to rest my head.”

He walked in quiet, saw the boy on the floor
Grandma shouted, “That’s who I prayed for!”
Room filled with joy, light filled the place
Tears turned to praise, sorrow to grace

[FINAL HOOK – Jennifer Hudson + Full Choir]
There’s JOY in the room… (Yes Lord!)
JOY in the room… (I feel it!)
Jesus is my doctor (Yesss!)
He write out all my prescriptions (Ayyy!)
He give me all my medicine… in the room

[OUTRO – Fantasia + Choir / Adlibs Soar]
Joy… unspeakable joy…
He gon’ meet you there…
Holy Ghost gon’ greet you there…
You don’t need no phone…
Just call Him in the room.

syrupy female vocals are layered with Trap Gospel Revival elements

creating a unique blend.

- The musical style draws inspiration from Jennifer Hudson

seamlessly blending traditional and contemporary sounds.
- Characterized by AAVE pronunciation

and microtonal singing.
- Additional vocal techniques.

lyrics:
[Intro, Whispered Storytelling, Sparse 808, Clean Guitar]
(vinyl crackle, low 808 throb)
I’ve walked cracked highways—moonlight in my veins,
Found grace in rusted strings and back-porch chains.
This gravel tongue scorches like frost on pine,
Still here—unbroken… do you feel my spine? [adlib: ghost whispers trail] (“feel my spine…”)]

[Verse 1, Dre-Pocket Minimalism, Sub-Organ Pads]
Raised on sawdust floors where hymnbooks froze,
Smoke and sweat baptize these tattered clothes.
Papa’s pledge: “Stay rooted deep in clay,”
Yet heaven called me through a four-string sway.
[blues guitar - lick bends (roomy WITH left-pan]

[Pre-Chorus 1, Off-Kilter Snare & Vocal Chops]
I straddled faith and fire—nights in two-step coils,
808s ignite the blood that toils.
Loop this prayer, let the groove extol,
Ashes rise to anthem— I reclaim my soul.
[adlib - whisper-chop (“re-claim my soul”) hits 2.2, 3.4, 4.1, 4.3]

[Chorus 1, Gospel Lift, Prince-Style Modulation to Dmaj7]
Still here—still breathin’, though roots run wide,
Still here—wild spirit, no need to hide.
Each sub-kick thuds a gospel heartbeat,
Choir hums vow my purpose complete.
[adlib - background vocal harmony: lyrical bass (“Hmm”) | tenor (“Hallelu”) | falsetto “Jah”)]

[Verse 2, Half-Time Ghost Groove (F9sus → Abmaj7) AND (half-time feel, whispered counters.)]
Brothers clashed like thunder in midnight pines,
One chased sin, the other read blind-folded signs.
Time built walls where the holler once rang,
I’m a specter with chorus—still sharp, still sang.

[switch to double-time last 4 bars]
Draggin’ vowels in mud, then I sprint through rain,
Triplet fire-tongue burnin’ holy refrain.

[Pre-Chorus 2, Snare Rolls Tighten]
Daddy poured the flame, the earth ordained my aim,
Every drumbeat pulls me further from shame.
Loops repeat—yet I’m forged anew,
Voice and rhythm speak the gospel true.

[Bridge, Prince-esque Harmonic Leap & Timbaland Stutters]
(stuttered vocal chops, slide-guitar cry)
Moonlight… steel-string… bone-choir… rise!

[Chorus 2, Expanded Call-and-Response]
Still here—still breathin’… (choir echo: “You hear it?”),
Still here—wild soul unbelievin’.
Each beat digs roots in the mud of my past,
Choir resounds—my spirit will last.

[Outro, Layered Whispers, Tape Wobble Swell]
(organ swell right-pan, choir fades like distant revival)
Roots in mud, soul aflame,
Still here—moonlit spine remains.
(whispered “amen”… slow fade)

lyrics:
[DJ DROP - fx turntable scratch, pitch bends, stops, drops 
(DJ Moe Money is in the booth!)]

(Buckle up bitches!)
(You know how we do this shit...) 

(This that REAL ASS... )

(RnB MEETS TRAP Beat Kings! )

(Moe Money Studios)

(20 25 (whoop)!)

[Verse 1 – Male Spoken Word, Guitar + Organ Intro]
(Mmm, yeah... Ohhh, girl... You know what you do...)

(It was just an accident, huh?)

[Verse 1 – Male Singer (Low tenor, Soulful)]

Maybe it was an accident, girl

The first time or two...

But it ain't no accident

If you call and say you're **on the way to the room**, boo

Mmm, you keep tellin' me one thing

But your body sayin’ somethin’ new

And every time the club close

Somehow, you find your way through

[Pre-Chorus]

I just wanna be, once or twice a week

More than your BBC

But it seems to me

You keep callin’ for that BDE

[Chorus male w/ Background Harmony]

It was an accident

Callin’ when the club closed at two

Now you’re tellin’ me

You need a little love that’s overdue

If it was just one time

I’d let it slide, let it be

But baby, you don’t **trip** that much

This ain’t no accident to me

[Verse 2 Male Rapper (DaBaby type Flow)]

Every time that drink get low

You start talkin’ real sweet

Sayin’ how you miss my touch

And how my love put you to sleep

Mmm, but when the sun rise up

You get ghost like you ain't stay

Tell me, girl, is this for real

Or is this just your favorite game?

[Pre-Chorus -  Male falsetto]
🔁 [Pre-Chorus – Female]
(repeat)

🔁 [Chorus – male + feMale Adlibs]
(repeat with female adlibs layered: "Uh huh." / "Mmm." / "he knew." / "Keep goin’." / "Ain’t lie once." / "he steadily calling me baby.")

[Outro, Slow Fade, Bluesy Guitar]

(Ohhh, no, no, no…)

(This ain't no accident, baby…)

(You know just what you doin'…)

(And you do it so damn good…)
tags:
This acoustic soul track begins with a crisply recorded
tape-tracked groove where brushed drums
upright bass
and layered guitars lock into a tight
syncopated pocket. Warm analog textures and the organic crackle of vinyl immediately evoke the intimacy of a live performance. As the piece unfolds
dual lead vocals emerge: a smoky low-tenor delivers raw
gospel-rooted tales of struggle and perseverance
while a Southern country girl—with rich melisma and AAVE-inflected pronunciation—injects passionate
full-chest declarations into the mix. Hush-soft
whispered intros give way to dynamic call-and-response exchanges supported by optional subtle harmonies. Modern fusion elements
including hints of mumble rap
disco
and infectious dance beats
A DJ remix blends live Southern Soul instrumentation—funky bass

Crowd sounds and MC hype inanalog fade
encapsulating a vibrant
message-driven global fusion.

lyrics:
## [THEORY]
[MODE | Dorian Minor WITH Gospel Major Accents]
[TONAL CENTER | A MINOR WITH CHORUS LIFT TO C MAJOR]
[HARMONIC BEHAVIOR | Gospel Sixth AND Ninth Voicings FUSED WITH Chromatic Blues Runs AND Suspended Seconds]
[METER | 4/4 Swing Pocket AND Half-Time Bridge]
[CHORD COLOR | Upright Piano, Slide Guitar, Brushed Drums, Organ Swells, Harmonica]
[STRUCTURE | Four-Part Narrative: Meet-Cute, Chemistry, Storm, Saucy Resolution]

## [VOICE]
[VOCALISTS | Black Male Deep Baritone LEAD (Al Green/Barry White/Lynyrd Skynyrd) AND Southern Contralto Co-Lead (Wynonna Judd/Fantasia, Near-Tenor Chest, Black Church)]
[PERSONALITIES | Baritone: Smooth, Cocky, Blue Humor. Contralto: Chest-Driven, Cheeky, Whiskey Drawl, Playful Challenger]

## [PERFORMANCE & SECTION CUES]
[Intro – Instrumental. Band establishes groove. Barroom ambience, crowd laughs, glass clinks, tape crackle. Baritone hums, Contralto soft laugh.]

[Verse 1 – Female Lead. Male adlibs at line ends.]  
[F |] "Last call, and I’m still hunting for trouble  
Tight jeans, boots heavy, eyes fixed on the double  
You watch me cross, lips curl, you know I’m bad  
But you want a taste, preacher—don’t look so sad"  
[M adlib: (low growl “mmm-hmm”), (spoken “Lord have mercy” on last line)]

[Pre-Chorus – Duet. Both harmonize, alternate lines. Band drops at bar 2, snaps/claps only.]  
[BOTH |] "Mix me up right, don’t water me down  
Bitters and sweet, swirl ‘em around"  
[F |] "You sip slow, want to savor the night"  
[M |] "But I want that burn—make it feel just right"

[Chorus – Repeat x2. Both, trading lines, joined on last.]  
[F |] "Perfect pour, dirty glass,  
[M |] Barroom sin, Sunday sass,  
[F |] Neon low, my dress rides high,  
[BOTH |] Drink me slow, make a grown man cry"

[Verse 2 – Male Lead. Female overdubs last phrase, adlibs in background.]  
[M |] "You got a mouth makes a bishop cuss,  
One touch and I’m breaking all trust,  
Girl, you call the shots—I’ll play along  
Give me your whiskey heart, sing my song"  
[F adlib: (“preach it, daddy!”), (“mmm, pour it slow”) on lines 3 and 4]

[Bridge – Both. Whispered. Just bass and snaps. Each line alternates lead, then overlap.]  
[F |] "Messy hair, lipstick stains—"  
[M |] "Left your number on my windowpane"  
[BOTH |] "Close the bar, spill on the floor,  
What we started, baby, pour me more"

[Chorus – Both, harmonized, band at full.]  
"Perfect pour, lips on tap  
Give me that gospel, take me back  
Sweat and smoke, ain’t no shame  
Write our story in a barroom stain"

[Outro – Female Lead, Male echo. Band fades, crowd noise returns.]  
[F |] "Sun’s up, my bra’s on the stage—"  
[M echo |] “Still thirsty, still wild, never act my age…”  
[F |] "Too much, not enough, that’s the game  
Last call, preacher—remember my name"

[Band ends. Glass rolls, laughter, tape crackle. Fade.]

## [PRODUCTION NOTES]
[Drums tight, bass up. Trap claps enter on bridge. Adlibs panned L/R. Use reverb, delay, vinyl FX. Explicit adlibs in (parentheses). All section leads clearly marked F/M/DUET.]
tags: This southern soul-fusion bar anthem OPENS WITH upright piano
and crowd banter. The night’s owned by two: a Black male baritone—smooth
sultry as Barry White—who lives for trouble and wordplay; his co-lead
a contralto with the voice of a gospel goddess and the drawl of a backroad queen
chest-deep and always ready to cut him down to size. They trade lines and licks—dirty jokes
and “can’t-say-that-on-the-radio” energy. Each section turns up the heat: from sticky-floored flirtation to after-hours bravado
through dueling hooks and no-regrets blue notes
all over a groove that swings and stomps. The climax is raw
and fun; the fade-out leaves you smelling sweat
and secrets the sun won’t ever see. (CHARACTERS: 849)
title: PERFECT POUR (Double Take 3.5

[ADLIB: (contralto: “Sin me twice, sugar”)]

Taste your gospel, feel your slap  
Dark and sweet, ain’t no shame  
Write our names in the barroom stain"

[ADLIB: (both, overlapping moans, laughter, “Say my name!”)]

[PRODUCTION CUE: Analog Fade, Laughter, Bottles Rolling, Piano Out Of Tune, Baritone Sings One Last Lick, Contralto Giggles]

"Sun’s rising, but I’m still parched

Life’s best flavor’s always rough"

[Intro]  
[CUE | Sound of two beers being poured, soft TV static—news in the background]  
[CUE | Muffled laughter, a jukebox plays something old]

(Verse 1: Meet-Cute)  
I said, “Bar’s closing, but hearts tend to linger,”  
You slipped your hand ‘round a cold, gold finger.  
Two pints clashed—like debate on the screen,  
You grinned, “Some borders just beg to be seen.”

Chin on my palm, you drawl, “What’s your flavor?”  
I say, “Bittersweet, but I’ll savor the danger.”  
Tonight’s headline—two strangers, one pour,  
Mixing metaphors and spirits, wanting more.

(Pre-Chorus)  
We’re a headline, a byline, a rumor in bloom,  
A little bit scandal, a toast to the room.

(Chorus: The Chemistry)  
Perfect pour—swirl in a glass half wild,  
Night and light, color runs, mixing style with style.  
We’re the blend they say shouldn’t be made,  
Sip of the new world in every cascade.

(Verse 2: The Storm)  
Stares from the shadows, storm brewing quick,  
Whispers like weather—forecast: old tricks.  
“Keep it separate,” old-timers preach,  
But the world spins on, beyond their reach.

You tip your glass, “To truth and to friction,”  
I raise mine too—call it *cultural conviction.*  
We laugh at the static, the headlines that flash,  
Love writes its news in the pour and the splash.

(Pre-Chorus)  
We’re a question, a protest, a headline in ink,  
A couple of outliers—too stubborn to sink.

(Chorus: The Test)  
Perfect pour—two stories collide,  
Dark in the daylight, pale in the pride.  
Stir up the world, let ‘em cluck and deplore,  
We’re the spill they can’t mop off the floor.

(Bridge: Aphorisms & Metaphor)  
Here’s to the myths that never made sense,  
To fences and lines—none built to prevent  
The leap of the heart, the chemistry laws  
That bend every border with one little pause.

(Punchline)  
Who knew the solution’s a shot in the dark?  
Who knew revolution starts slow at the bar?

(Verse 3: The Aftermath/Resolution)  
Now they whisper our names with a cautious delight,  
“Never thought they’d last, but damn, looks right.”  
We pour another round for the world on its side,  
Let ‘em chase trends—we’ll just toast the ride.

We’re old news now, but our legend will age—  
A couple of flavors rewriting the page.

(Chorus: Triumphant)  
Perfect pour—let the bitters run sweet,  
History swirling beneath our feet.  
Raise ‘em up high for the brave and the sure,  
Love’s never divided, just looking for cure.

[Outro]  
[CUE | Glasses clink, news fades out, harmonica solo over crowd noise]

"Your nails down my back like a tattoo of sin..."

[Breakdown – Unraveling Phase]

(Micro-chopped vocal snippets processed with reverse reverb; filtered banjo and rim-claps punctuate brief half-beat silences)

"I should leave at sunrise..."

"But your whispers hold me captive..."

[Revival – Ascending Climax]

(All instrumentation converges: vinyl Rhodes, deep 808 glide, wah-slide guitar textures, and trap-soul drums join force)

"This love is dangerous, baby, the poison tastes sweet when it’s warm."

(Call-and-response eruptions with explosive choir and talk–box adlibs)

[Conclusion – Full-Circle Reflection]

(A stark half-beat silence sets the stage for the final collapse into reflective ambience; layers peel away to reveal forward-played, analog echoes)

"Dangerous love... we'll never get enough... God damn us."

[KEY TEXTURES: Tape-warm analog crunch, Reverse Reverb, Vinyl Crackle, Ambient Field Recordings]

[PROCESSING: Automated stereo panning, delay effects, reverse reverb on select elements, and live crowd adlibs integrated for spatial depth]

[PERFORMANCE]

[EXECUTION: Hush-low verses transitioning into explosive, choir-driven highs]

[GESTURE: Mic-stand lean, finger-snap accents, expressive adlib flourishes]

[RHYTHM HANDLING: Swung sixteenth hats, laid-back pocket, syncopated snare ghosts, deliberate half-beat silences]

[TOUCH: Breath-filled vocal adlibs, softly whispered asides, dynamic call-and-response interplay]

[ADLIB POLICY]

[VOCAL INSERTS: Airy falsetto riffs, whispered poetic interjections, call-and-response talk–box phrases]

[END]

(Fade to early end with analog reverb echoing final whispered lines)

Backstage mirror cracked, I still shine
Taught myself holy in the Devil’s design

[Build]
[Genre: Southern Trap x Country Storytelling]
[Vocal: Female, belted hook entry, powerful and emotional.]
[Instrumentation: impactful 808 drop, melodic instrument bends, building tension with rhythmic UK drill elements.]
I twist like scripture, storm in my hips
Tongue full of psalms, but they bite my lips
I’m the stain they pray out, the ghost they fear
Still I rise, high heels and tears

[Bridge]
[Genre: Chopped Soul RnB x Gospel]
[Vocal: Female lead with a falsetto burst, supported by a chopped & screwed gospel harmony. The lead vocal is defiant and soaring.]
[Instrumentation: deep organ rumble providing a thick, sustained foundation.]
(Lead)
Say I’m fallen? — nah, I’m flyin’
(Chopped Choir)
They can’t shame what won’t stop tryin’
(Lead)
Pole ain’t sin — it’s resurrection in motion
(Choir Swell)
A sermon dipped in divine emotion!

[Breakdown]
[Genre: Country Storytelling x Southern Trap (minimalist)]
[Vocal: Female, spoken word, raw and direct, almost a whisper but with conviction.]
[Instrumentation: very minimal beat (sparse trap drums), a melancholic harmonica loop.]
They judge my rhythm, not my reason
Don’t see my grind, just the season
But I am more — a mother, a storm, a name on no one’s lips but my own
I am the echo that stays when they’re gone

[Final Chorus]
[Genre: Country Storytelling x UK Drill x Southern Trap x Chopped Soul RnB]
[Vocal: Female, powerful dual-layer harmony, freestyle adlibs, confident and triumphant.]
[Instrumentation: driving trill bounce groove with strong 808s and intricate drill percussion, layered with the chopped soul RnB loop.]
Strippin’ & Sippin’ — I rise from the ash
Heels hit hard but I never crash
Strippin’ & Sippin’ — they scream and stare
But I bless the beat — I meet them there

[Outro]
[Genre: Southern Trap x Ambient]
[Vocal: Female, whisper freestyle loop, ethereal and slightly processed, with a sense of lingering presence.]
[Instrumentation: reverse steel guitar FX, subtle vocal FX, fading into silence.]
Still sippin’ in silence… but the voice is mine…
Still strippin’ — but now it’s divine…
In the dark… I lit the shrine…
This ain’t shame — it’s sacred design…

[Studio Tail End - Outro with sounds of friends cheering, tape winding out, and DJ MoMoney$ laughing, creating a raw, authentic studio atmosphere.]

lyrics:

[mode | F major with Lydian flavor]
[tonal center | F]
[harmonic behavior | rich major chord vamps, gospel IV–V–I progressions, suspended second resolves]
[meter | 4/4]
[tempo | 68 BPM swung gospel pace]
[chord color | lush seventh chords, extended harmonies, warm organ pad swells]

[Voice]
[register | lead: soulful alto → warm, inviting; choir: mixed SATB with warm blend]
[delivery | lead: gentle drawl building to passionate calls; choir: tight harmonies with dynamic swells]
[expression | heartfelt exhortation, reverent worship, communal uplift]
[articulation | smooth legato on held notes, crisp consonants on call-and-response lines]

[Intro (Slow Build, Soulful Harmonies)]
*(Soft Rhodes keys, distant organ swells, deep bass humming, and a gentle brushed snare as the choir hums in harmony.)*
[Lead:]
Ohhh, you gotta get ready now… (mmm-hmm)
Ohhh, no man knows the day or the hour…

[Verse 1]
Get your house in order, oh do it today
Get your house in order, oh do it right away
For Jesus is coming, no man knows where or when
Get your house in order, for He’s coming back again

[Chorus: Call and Response]
**(Lead:)** Get your house in order... *(Choir echoes: In order!)*
**(Lead:)** Oh, don’t wait too late... *(Choir echoes: Don’t wait!)*
For Jesus is coming... *(Choir: Coming!)*
He's coming back again
*(Soft instrumental break – bluesy guitar and organ swells as the choir hums in harmony.)*

[Verse 2]
There’s earthquakes, hurricanes, famines, and disease
Can’t you hear the Lord is callin’?
You better take heed...
So many homeless, lost out in the cold
But my God’s got mansions
More precious than gold

[Chorus: Repeat]
Get your house in order, oh do it today
Get your house in order, oh do it right away
For Jesus is coming, no man knows where or when
Get your house in order, for He’s coming back again

[Bridge: Soft Breakdown – Transition Begins]
*(The music softens, Rhodes and bass pulsing gently, as the lead starts to testify.)*
[Lead:]
Ohh, but there’s something, something about His name...
*(Choir hums in agreement, warm harmonies swelling.)*
*(Rhodes swells, drums build lightly, leading into the next movement…)*

[Transition – “Something About the Name Jesus”]
*(Organ swells, deepening bass, light hi-hats as the choir takes the lead.)*

[Chorus: Something About the Name Jesus]
Something about the name Jesus,
Something about the name Jesus,
It is the sweetest name I know...
Oh, how I love the name Jesus,
Oh, how I love the name Jesus,
It is the sweetest name I know...

[Call and Response: Intensifying Worship]
*(Lead with passion, choir responding powerfully.)*
[Lead:] Some say it’s like fire shut up in my bones…
[Choir:] Fire in my bones!
[Lead:] Oh, the Holy Ghost is moving, I can feel it strong…
[Choir:] He won’t leave us alone!
*(Drums pick up slightly, adding energy to the moment.)*

[Chorus Repeat: Full Power]
Something about the name Jesus,
Something about the name Jesus,
It is the sweetest name I know...
*(Music slows again, returning to the original theme.)*

[Outro: Returning to "House in Order"]
*(Soft Rhodes, deep bass, and light drum taps as the energy comes back down.)*
Get your house in order, oh do it today…
Get your house in order, oh don’t delay…
*(Lead whispers, choir softly echoing: “For He’s coming… back… again…”)***

Genre: Chop and Screwed Remix for "DJ Screw" documentary. Producer: Pimp C Label: Rap-A-Lot and "Chopstars" Track: Michael 5000 Watts DJ Performing Chop and Screw: Michael "5000" Watts ("chopped not slopped") remix. 

A Houston chopped and screwed hip hop track at 60 BPM with swung 4/4
where syncopated kicks and sub-bass drive offbeat grooves against a counter-melodic percussion line
Lush flanged pads and deeply reverbed drums sit under vinyl hiss
Every loop drops −1 dB and sweeps low-pass to 6 kHz
Loop-close sections are repeated with stepped-back effects
while a one-beat back-up sting creates scene change mid-song

lyrics:
[Theory]
[mode | natural minor with pentatonic blues overlays]
[tonal center | A♭ minor]
[harmonic behavior | suspended fourths resolving to dominant sevens, gospel-inspired chromatic voice leading]
[meter | 6/8 swung feel with trap micro-swing syncopation]
[tempo | 69 BPM, broken half-time with nonlinear drop-ins]
[chord color | honky-tonk piano stabs, dusty tremolo Rhodes, stacked gospel organ triads, warm vinyl hiss textures]

[Voice]
[register | smoky female alto + male preacher-style bass in duet/shadow form]
[delivery | lead voice sings with bruised power, breathy confessionals, ghost-harmony stack for inner monologue]
[expression | pain-soaked defiance wrapped in sultry velvet—Mavis Staples meets trap-soul battle hymn]
[articulation | southern-slurred vowels, preacher cadences, whispered echoes and broken belts]

[LYRICS NARRATIVE]

[vocalist – FEMALE LEAD WITH MALE SHADOW ECHO | vinyl FX, analog hum –]
"Neon buzzed...

like a halo broke."

"Lawd...

you dancin’...

through smoke."
(adlib: “mmm... mercy”)

"I ain't prayin’...

I'm jus’ survivin’."

"Jus’ you & me—
ain’t no forgivin’."

—

[vocalist – FEMALE LEAD | slide guitar, 808 lag, warped hi-hats –]
"He slid a Jackson...

like it healed my sins."

"Said, ‘Move, baby’...

but I ain't his kin."

"Mama vanished...

‘fore the rent came due."

"Granny’s hymn...

don’t pay these shoes."

—

"Slide the pole...

like I’m touchin’ God’s hem."

"Spin for the devil...

in a sequined stem."

"Each grip...

each tip—ain’t redemption."

"But the bottle...

it lets me be."

—

[vocalist – FEMALE WITH MALE LOW STACK | reverb + delay trail –]
"I sip...

like it's scripture."
(overdub: “Mmm, holy water”)

"And spin...

like it’s sin."

"My soul been baptized...

in glitter and gin."

"Lord, if you watchin’...

I’m dancin’ on thin..."

—

[vocalist – FEMALE BELT WITH CHOIR HARMONY | honky-tonk piano + gospel organ hit –]
"Jus’ you & me...

on this hardwood stage."

"Dollar rain fallin’...

I swallow the rage."

"Whiskey preach sweet...

but it don’t set me free."

"I spin...

I sip...

Lawd...

just let me be."

—

[vocalist – FEMALE SOLO | wah guitar, swing pocket –]
"Smoke kiss my face...

where his ring still gleams."

"He call me angel...

but I haunt his dreams."

"They holy on Sundays...

heathens by night."

"This pole’s my pulpit...

my earned birthright."

—

[vocalist – MALE CALL WITH FEMALE RESPONSE | gospel overdub + vocal chop FX –]
"Granny told you..."

"Child, don’t stray."

"But I preach pain...

‘till bills get paid."

"Bent but breathin’...

eyes on grace."

"Tell me, Lord...

do you see this face?"

—

[vocalist – FEMALE LEAD A CAPPELLA | vinyl crackle, silence –]
"I ain’t just a sinner...

I’m somebody’s song."

"I dance...

I cry...

I still hold on."

"Granny’s hymn...

in my blood still rings."

"Even broken angels...

got wings."

—

[vocalist – FEMALE RISES TO BELT | build FX, organ, sub-pulse –]
"Bent my knees...

not for grace...

but rent."

"Let strangers touch...

what God never meant."

"My name ain’t shame...

it's in gold."

"In fire...

and sweat...

my story told."

—

[vocalist – MALE SHADOW + FEMALE SHOUT | reverb swell –]
"She a prophet...

in pole-light."

"I ain’t lost...

I’m in plain sight."

"I rise from pain...

with every plea."

"I sip...

I spin...

and still I’m free."

—

[vocalist – FEMALE CHOIR STACK | tape echo, adlib: “Hallelujah” –]
"Jus’ you & me...

no veil...

no shame."

"This pain got rhythm...

this stage my name."

"He lied...

but I see...

and I believe."

"I dance...

I fall...

but I still breathe."

—

[vocalist – MALE & FEMALE HARMONY WHISPER | vinyl fade –]
"So I spin...

and I sip..."

"But the Lord...

don’t slip..."

"It’s jus’ you & me...

’till the lights go out."

[Style]
[genre | country-trap gospel × noir-strip club confessional × slow southern drill]
[era | 2025 alt-Americana soul revival]
[intent | redemptive testimony from within the abyss]
[texture | barroom ambiance, sub-bass crawl, honky-tonk keys, church-call pads, broken vinyl loops]
[aesthetic | smoky southern nightclub meets juke joint church revival]
[focus | transformation, resilience, divine tension through dance]

[Timbre]
[guitar tone | weeping steel slide, tremolo soaked, minor key bends]
[bass tone | tri-band 808, sub-bass under vocal breath]
[drum tone | glitch-snap kicks, swung hi-hats with drill rolls, distorted woodblock cracks]
[keyboard tone | dusty upright honky-tonk + gospel Rhodes]
[vocal tone | tube-saturated smoky alto + breathy male low register, layered microtonally ±50 cents]

[Performance]
[execution | hush-to-howl dynamics, gospel ad-libs, whispered-to-belt rises]
[gesture | spotlight sway, bar lean, hand-over-heart belting]
[rhythm handling | stutter-swing syncopation, nonlinear groove shifts]
[touch | breath-delay echoes, grit crackle, ghosty harmony swells]

lyrics:
[Intro, Whisper, Vinyl Crackle, Cowbell Tick]
"Psst—y’all hear them subs?"
"Boots up… shots down… let’s ride!"
[Verse 1, Banjo Chops, Slide Flairs, Sparse Hats]
"Red dirt on my Louboutins, chrome snake buckle shine"
"I pour sweet tea in my whiskey—double trouble every time"
"Trunk knock harder than a back-road pothole"
"I rev that Chevy heartbeat while the neon takes control"
[Pre-Chorus 1, Fiddle Stabs, 808 Build]
"Skirt hem frayed, but my game on ten"
"They talk— we walk— then we spin again"
[Chorus 1, Beat Drop, Gang Shouts]
GANG: "Boots up, shots down!"
LEAD: "Country queens wear the county line crown"
GANG: "Boots up, shots down!"
LEAD: "We turn dirt roads into Boom-Town sound"
[Verse 2, Slide Guitar Answers, Trap Hats Triplet]
"Pink camo phone case, snakeskin press-ons"
"Snapback tilted, that rebel spirit strong"
"City boys stare at my steel-toe strut"
"I’m a two-step trouble with a homegrown gut"
[Testimony Rap-Sing, 808 Run, Rhodes Chords]
"Mama said, ‘Baby, raise hell but stay kind’"
"So I tip big, talk slick, keep Jesus on the line"
"From pew to pool-hall—we break the mold"
"Country girl magic with a heart of gold"
[Pre-Chorus 2, Call/Response Fiddle Licks]
"Skirt hem frayed, but my game on ten"
"They talk— we walk— then we spin again"
[Chorus 2, Chorus Repeat + Crowd Claps]
GANG: "Boots up, shots down!"
LEAD: "County line ladies run this town"
GANG: "Boots up, shots down!"
LEAD: "We make cowboys drop their jaws to the ground"
[Bridge, Whisper-to-Belt, Reverse Pedal-Steel, VinylStop]
"Shhhh—hear that hush before the storm?"
"Kick drum thunder, fire keepin’ us warm"
(Beat drops back in w/ fiddle scream)
[Breakdown, Half-Time Trap, Banjo Fill, Crowd Chant Loop]
GANG LOOP: "Boots up—shots down—boots up—shots down"
[Guitar Solo, Tele Slide Over 808s]
[Final Chorus x2, Full-Tilt, Double Harmony, Crowd Scream]
(Repeat Chorus lines, add octave-up harmony and ad-lib “Yee-yee!”)
[Outro, Whisper Falsetto, Fiddle Fade, Tape Click]
"Dust settles but our anthem won’t"
"County line queens—forever they’ll quote"
[Studio Tail-Out, Friends Whoopin’, Cans Clank]
Engineer: “Print it—bar’s already callin’ for that one!”

lyrics:
**Title: Run It to Me**
**Style: Texas Trill Trap × Southern Rock Jam × Arabic Modal Fusion**
---
Lyrics:
[Intro – Metro Tag & Crowd Hype]
*“Metro… boomin’ on a steel guitar, ya dig?”*
(Flanged whip cracks • crowd whistles • talkbox slide guitar)
*DJ chops the vinyl, slows it two semitones*
**SFX (chopped):** “H-H-H-Houston… drip…”
[Verse 1 – Swagger Strut]
Country thighs in Versace chaps, mud on my Louboutins,
High-beamed dreams, neon seams, I’m a longhorn zoomin’ in.
Sky-walk over shade-throwers, boots on the console steady,
Old-money preacher daughters wish they moved this heavy.
Gemini grin—mood switch like lane change on I-10,
“I love you?”—maybe, baby—depends on the backend.
I’m the farmhand turned lap-dance legend—cash in a hay bale stack,
Pour that purple over cornbread beats, watch the whole barn lean back.
[Pre-Chorus – Slide & Call]
Steel strings cry in Hijaz mode,
808s growl like a Gator road.
*“Where you ridin’, girl?”*
—“Where the money flow!”
*“Can they match that drip?”*
—“Tell ’em ‘HELL NO!’”
[Chorus – Hook (Double-Time then Screwed)]
Run it to me—like titles, deeds, and keys,
Run it to me—slow or fast, I still seize.
Run it to me—your doubts, your stacks, your sins,
Run it to me—watch a country girl win.
*(DJ screws last line to half-speed: “watch… a… coun-try… girl… wiiiin”)*
[Verse 2 – Strip-Club Rodeo]
Silk scarf lasso, rope your CEO,
He tip my name in crypto, let it stretch like El Camino.
Sarsaparilla sippin’, but the pint got codeine glow,
H-town syrup swirl, southside of the rainbow.
I left the dairy farm for that Dairy Queen pole,
Butterfly doors on the Dodge, blue-flame exhaust roll.
Mama said “Y’all pray hard”—I paid her church off in gold,
Now deacons quote my verses when the Sunday lights go low.
[Bridge – Arabic Guitar Duel / Vocal Runs]
(Oud riffs trade with bottleneck Tele licks; frame drum triplets)
هِز الخصر يا بنت الجنوب **(“Shake that waist, Southern belle”)**
I bend maqam like copper wire, set the stage on fire—oh-oh-oh.
[Break – Crew Battle / Twerkstar Chant]
*Crowd left side:* “Run it!” *Crowd right side:* “To me!”
Boots clap, thighs snap, bass drops two octaves deep.
**SFX:** gun-cocks, cassette rewinds, airhorn echoes.
DJ cuts *Run-it-to-me* vinyl, reverses last bar, tags, “Big Stallion mentoring—ya heard?”
[Final Chorus – Modulated Up a Step]
Run it to me—oilfield checks to rodeo bets,
Run it to me—crypto, cotton, or county fair flex.
Run it to me—love or lust, it’s all currency,
Run it to me—’cause nobody run it like me.
*(Outro chopped & screwed, fading with Arabic steel guitar solo and slow vocal ad-libs: “R-r-run it… slo-ow… to me…”)*

**Title: Run It to Me**
**Style: Texas Trill Trap × Southern Rock Jam × Arabic Modal Fusion**
---
Lyrics:
[Intro – Metro Tag & Crowd Hype]
*“Metro… boomin’ on a steel guitar, ya dig?”*
(Flanged whip cracks • crowd whistles • talkbox slide guitar)
*DJ chops the vinyl, slows it two semitones*
**SFX (chopped):** “H-H-H-Houston… drip…”
[Verse 1 – Swagger Strut]
Country thighs in Versace chaps, mud on my Louboutins,
High-beamed dreams, neon seams, I’m a longhorn zoomin’ in.
Sky-walk over shade-throwers, boots on the console steady,
Old-money preacher daughters wish they moved this heavy.
Gemini grin—mood switch like lane change on I-10,
“I love you?”—maybe, baby—depends on the backend.
I’m the farmhand turned lap-dance legend—cash in a hay bale stack,
Pour that purple over cornbread beats, watch the whole barn lean back.
[Pre-Chorus – Slide & Call]
Steel strings cry in Hijaz mode,

lyrics:
[Intro – Spoken/Organ]  
“Mmm… sometimes… you try to remember… but all you see… is fog. Lord have mercy…” (stomp)  
Lead: “Ooooh Lord, take me back through the fog.” (Ad-lib: “Through the fog… Amen!”)
[Verse 1]  
We are born of sin, fight to win, without you I ain’t whole… got lost in the cold.  
Every night I pray to see your face; this fog got me reachin’ into empty space.  
(Ad-lib: “Reachin’ into empty space”)
[Chorus]  
Through the fog I reach for you; time stole the colors and left me blue.  
Thirty-five years drownin’ in tears, but I fight to remember, fight through the fear.  
(Ad-lib: “Through the fog…”)
[Verse 2]  
Wish that call never rang in the dead of night… wish I had more than echoes and pain.  
Oh Lord, this fog done stayed too long. (Ad-lib: “Stayed too long”)
[Bridge]  
I close my eyes, try to pull you from the mist… it breaks me.  
I don’t wanna forget you, but remembering hurts… this fog ain’t mercy—it’s a curse.
[Chorus ×2]  
Through the fog I reach for you; smoke and truth I never knew…  
Twenty-five years and you still ain’t clear; we fight to remember, fight through the fear.
[Outro – Spoken/Faded Ad-lib]  
“I know I’m not alone… let this version stay—even if it’s just fog.”  
Lead: “At least this memory don’t run… ’til the morning comes.” (Ad-lib: “Hold on… through the fog”)

“Mmm… sometimes… you try to remember… but all you see… is fog. Lord have mercy…” (stomp)  
Lead: “Ooooh Lord, take me back through the fog.” (Ad-lib: “Through the fog… Amen!”)
[Verse 1]  
We are born of sin, fight to win, without you I ain’t whole… got lost in the cold.  
Every night I pray to see your face; this fog got me reachin’ into empty space.  
(Ad-lib: “Reachin’ into empty space”)
[Chorus]  
Through the fog I reach for you; time stole the colors and left me blue.  
Thirty-five years drownin’ in tears, but I fight to remember, fight through the fear.  
(Ad-lib: “Through the fog…”)
[Verse 2]  
Wish that call never rang in the dead of night… wish I had more than echoes and pain.  
Oh Lord, this fog done stayed too long. (Ad-lib: “Stayed too long”)
[Bridge]  
I close my eyes, try to pull you from the mist… it breaks me.  
I don’t wanna forget you, but remembering hurts… this fog ain’t mercy—it’s a curse.
[Chorus ×2]  
Through the fog I reach for you; smoke and truth I never knew…  
Twenty-five years and you still ain’t clear; we fight to remember, fight through the fear.
[Outro – Spoken/Faded Ad-lib]  
“I know I’m not alone… let this version stay—even if it’s just fog.”  
Lead: “At least this memory don’t run… ’til the morning comes.” (Ad-lib: “Hold on… through the fog”)

[DJ DROP - FX (scratch, pitch bends, stops, drops)] 
DJ Moe Money is in the booth! 
Buckle up bitches! 
You know how we do this shit... 
This that REAL ASS... 
OUTLAW COUNTRY 
MEETS TRAP Beat Kings! 
Moe Money Studios 
20 25 (whoop)!
### **[Intro – Gospel Quartet, A Cappella Harmony]**
*(Ohhh… they say let go… but I can’t… I won’t…)*
*(I touch shadows… but they don’t fade… no…)*
### **[Verse 1 – Spoken Flow, Cold & Heavy]**
I don’t understand… how they expect me… to…
Am I really… supposed to be able… to…
Forget and forget? (I say it like that.)
Because I’m never forgiving you.
When the smell of that place…
Puts me right to that moment…
My body’s here, but my mind still frozen…
Like a ghost that can’t move on…
### **[Pre-Chorus – Female Lead, Gospel Harmony]**
*(Ohhh… tell me how… tell me why…)*
*(Do I drown or survive…?)*
*(They say time will heal my pain…)*
*(But the scars still say your name…)*
### **[Chorus – Gospel + 808s Drop]**
The roses I touch,
Magical it must… be.
They say of you,
I think too much… see.
### **[Verse 2 – Drill Flow + Off-Grid Swing]**
Bipolar swings like a pendulum blade,
Some days I shine, some days I fade.
Some days I fight, some days I cave,
Got scars on my soul that I can’t erase.
Whiskey in my cup, demons in my chest,
Prayin’ to a God that I second-guess.
Tryna stay clean, but the past won’t rest,
Every step I take, I feel possessed.
### **[Bridge – Slow Down, Gospel Harmonies]**
*(Take my hand... lead me home...)*
*(Break these chains... I can’t go alone...)*
*(Tell me there’s more, tell me there’s light...)*
*(Tell me my past won’t take my life...)*
### **[Verse 3 – The Breaking Point]**
I see your face in the dark when I sleep,
I hear your voice when the silence runs deep.
They say "move on," they say "let it be,"
But how can I heal when it’s still in me?
This ain't revenge—this is truth, this is proof,
This is the rage that they bottled in youth.
If they want silence,

[Intro – Talkbox + Phone Buzz FX]

“zzz...

Who that?

Bzzz...

No, she said she’s asleep...”

Talkbox croons “But she’s cheating on both of ussss...”

[FX: Reverse clap, low 808s swell like heartbreak in a Cadillac]

[Verse  – Johnny2.0 (Trap Funk Flow)]

I came through linen dripping like rain

Roses in my ride, body still smelling like fame

 parked three houses down I always do

Wait on her man to leave — that my cue

He did his little routine, kissed her like a show

Backed out slow, she waved... I thought I’d know

Then a Benz I hadn’t seen before

Pulled up slick with suicide doors

She to him like I was in her plans

I dropped my flowers like a fool with empty hands

[Hook – Talkbox + Johnny Lead Harmony]

She’s cheating on us... cheating on trust...

Playing two fools like playlist dusted up

I her weekend, you were her man

But now we’re both on, on herFans

(Talk harmonizes “OnlyFaaanssss…”)

[Verse 2 – Grownman Breakdown Flow + Soul Croon]

She told me you were

Told you was

Told him he was old

Told all of us lies in gold

I was just the thrill — you were the bill she’s backseat riding like she never will

I loved her in CashApp confessions

Took her to courtrooms and sessions

I prayed for her while she was texting

Another man with no discretion

[Bridge – Funk Talk, Swung Hi-Hat Groove]

“It ain’t a competition when everybody’s losing.”

“You you exclusive...

But she’s treating hearts like coupons.”

(FX: Auto-tuned sigh, organ swirl)

[Breakdown – Strip it to Moog + Reverb]

She’s on us (repeat 2x)

And I still miss her touch

She’s cheating on us (repeat 2x)

But I still pull up

(slow bend lick echoes like a drunk voicemail)

[Outro – Trap Blues Falsetto w/ Screwedlibs]

I’m not your enemy, I’m your echo...

We both loved a hologram in stilettos...

She used to text...

[STYLE: A glitchy DJ drop opens, swirling in headspace, then sparse deep 808s pulse beneath bluesy ambient guitar and nuanced tribal trap percussion with ghost notes and textured syncopation. Male baritone navigates the verse intimately, tension building. Pre-Chorus intensifies: layered falsetto, rhythmic percussion lifts, swirling organs and evolving synth pads expand the mix. Chopped & screwed adlibs subtly color phrases. Chorus explodes with raw belted vocals, spatial female adlibs ascending in intensity, atmospheric synths and gritty power chords. Distorted FXscratch and inventive panning keep everything unpredictable, blending R&B blues noir and tribal gothic soul for a hypnotic, cinematic vibe.]

*** Lyrics ***
[Intro: DJ Drop meets Smooth Keys & Electric Guitar | Opening Announcement: Hype & Drama Deep-voiced announcer over a low bass groove]
"We live at Moe Money Studios! Moe’s been up ALL night gettin’ ready for this heavyweight showdown. (Crowd noise fades… the beat kicks in… the stage is set. IT’S GO TIME.)
(Male, gruff & cool, slow build)
(Mmm… yeah… been a long time comin', huh?) 
(Ain’t no accident we back here again, baby…)
(Female, sly & sassy, laughing softly) "Ohhh you already KNOW what time it is…"
(Male, chuckling, then serious) "Let’s settle this once and for all."

[Verse 1 – Male: Gruff, Soulful & Confident]
Maybe it was an accident, girl
The first time or two
But you keep knockin’ on my door
And I ain’t the one callin’ YOU

(Female cutting in, slick & sharp)
"Mmm, but you answer tho, huh?"

(Male, smooth but calling her out)
"Baby, YOU the one drivin’ here at 2…"

(Female, laughing, confident)
"Yeah, and YOU the one leavin’ the key under the mat—don’t play!"

[Pre-Chorus – Both: Vocal Fireworks]
(Male, growling, deep harmony layers)
I just wanna be, once or twice a week
More than your BBC
But it seems to me
You keep callin’ for that BDE

(Female, soaring high, sass on full display)
You just mad ‘cause I don’t stay
You know damn well how I play
Baby, tell the truth
YOU the one catchin’ feelings in this game

[Chorus – Explosive, Full Harmonies]
(Both, overlapping, full duet energy)
It was an accident
Callin’ when the club closed at two
Now you’re tellin’ me
You need a little love that’s overdue

(Female, dominant and cutting through)
If it was just one time
Maybe you could let it slide
But baby, YOU don’t trip that much
So tell me why we here tonight?

[Verse 2 – Female: Bold, Playful & Seductive]
You say I keep on callin’ you
But boy, I ain’t pressed
You the one talkin’ 'bout "more than this"
When I just came for the rest

(Male cutting in, laughing)
"Oh you just came for the REST? Girl, please!"

(Female, taunting, leaning in)
"Mmm-hmm, you put me to sleep, ain't that what you wanted?"

(Male, voice drops low, cocky and cool)
"Oh, don’t play. You ain’t just here for no nap, girl…"

(Female, teasing, flipping it back)
"And YOU ain’t just openin’ the door to be NICE, huh?"

(Male, grinning, knowing he’s caught)
"Heh… damn, you good."

[Bridge: Tension Builds – Harmonies Soaring]
(Both, voices intertwining, like an argument you don’t want to end)

(Male, deep and gruff, pushing back)
Mmm, girl, be honest now
You know just what you doin’
All that midnight dialin’
Ain’t no accidental movin’

(Female, breathy, softer but cutting through)
Boy, be real with me
If I stopped, would you let me be?
I know damn well you’d be callin’ me
Before the week was through

(Male, laughing, knowing he can’t even lie)
"Girl… I might…"

(Female, smirking, locking in the final punchline)
"Then case closed. Next round’s on you."

(Beat drops out—just the organ swelling, like a mic drop moment.)

[Outro – Slow, Fading, Soulful]
(Male, whispering, a little cocky)
(Ohhh, no, no, no… you ain’t done with me, girl…)
(This ain't no accident, baby… admit it…)

(Female, soft and teasing, letting it simmer)
(You know just what you doin'… mmm, and you love it…)

(Both, one last harmony, sealing the deal)
(And you do it so damn good…)

[Closing Announcer: Like a sports commentator]
"Ohhh and THAT'S THE FINAL ROUND, FOLKS! Who took the W? Call it in—Team Him or Team Her? Moe Money Studios, we out!"

[Opening Announcement: Hype & Drama]
[Deep-voiced announcer over a low bass groove]
"We live at Moe Money Studios! Moe’s been up ALL night gettin’ ready for this heavyweight showdown.
We go LIVE to the booth, ladies and gentlemen…"

(Crowd noise fades… the beat kicks in… the stage is set. IT’S GO TIME.)

[Intro: Smooth Keys & Electric Guitar]
(Male, gruff & cool, slow build)
(Mmm… yeah… been a long time comin', huh?)
(Ain’t no accident we back here again, baby…)

(Female, sly & sassy, laughing softly)
"Ohhh you already KNOW what time it is…"

(Male, chuckling, then serious)
"Let’s settle this once and for all."

[Verse 1 – Male: Gruff, Soulful & Confident]
Maybe it was an accident, girl
The first time or two
But you keep knockin’ on my door
And I ain’t the one callin’ YOU

(Female cutting in, slick & sharp)
"Mmm, but you answer tho, huh?"

(Male, smooth but calling her out)
"Baby, YOU the one drivin’ here at 2…"

(Female, laughing, confident)
"Yeah, and YOU the one leavin’ the key under the mat—don’t play!"

[Pre-Chorus – Both: Vocal Fireworks]
(Male, growling, deep harmony layers)
I just wanna be, once or twice a week
More than your BBC
But it seems to me
You keep callin’ for that BDE

(Female, soaring high, sass on full display)
You just mad ‘cause I don’t stay
You know damn well how I play
Baby, tell the truth
YOU the one catchin’ feelings in this game

[Chorus – Explosive, Full Harmonies]
(Both, overlapping, full duet energy)
It was an accident
Callin’ when the club closed at two
Now you’re tellin’ me
You need a little love that’s overdue

(Female, dominant and cutting through)
If it was just one time
Maybe you could let it slide
But baby, YOU don’t trip that much
So tell me why we here tonight?

[Verse 2 – Female: Bold, Playful & Seductive]
You say I keep on callin’ you
But boy, I ain’t pressed
You the one talkin’ 'bout "more than this"
When I just came for the rest

(Male cutting in, laughing)
"Oh you just came for the REST? Girl, please!"

(Female, taunting, leaning in)
"Mmm-hmm, you put me to sleep, ain't that what you wanted?"

(Male, voice drops low, cocky and cool)
"Oh, don’t play. You ain’t just here for no nap, girl…"

(Female, teasing, flipping it back)
"And YOU ain’t just openin’ the door to be NICE, huh?"

(Male, grinning, knowing he’s caught)
"Heh… damn, you good."

[Bridge: Tension Builds – Harmonies Soaring]
(Both, voices intertwining, like an argument you don’t want to end)

(Male, deep and gruff, pushing back)
Mmm, girl, be honest now
You know just what you doin’
All that midnight dialin’
Ain’t no accidental movin’

(Female, breathy, softer but cutting through)
Boy, be real with me
If I stopped, would you let me be?
I know damn well you’d be callin’ me
Before the week was through

(Male, laughing, knowing he can’t even lie)
"Girl… I might…"

(Female, smirking, locking in the final punchline)
"Then case closed. Next round’s on you."

(Beat drops out—just the organ swelling, like a mic drop moment.)

[Outro – Slow, Fading, Soulful]
(Male, whispering, a little cocky)
(Ohhh, no, no, no… you ain’t done with me, girl…)
(This ain't no accident, baby… admit it…)

(Female, soft and teasing, letting it simmer)
(You know just what you doin'… mmm, and you love it…)

(Both, one last harmony, sealing the deal)
(And you do it so damn good…)

[Closing Announcer: Like a sports commentator]
"Ohhh and THAT'S THE FINAL ROUND, FOLKS! Who took the W? Call it in—Team Him or Team Her? Moe Money Studios, we out!"
