lyrics:
[STYLE:
Tone - Polished yet brooding maturely defiant,
Groove - Slow-paced trap rhythm fused with funk-inspired bassline,
Instruments - Moog synthesizer | harmonized Talkbox vocals | style synths | pitch-shifted guitar riffs,
FX - [distorted hi-hats] | [filtered vocal sample] | [“I love” ringtone snippet] | [vinyl crackle overlay] | 
Energy: Relaxed precise | groovy yet melancholic]

[Intro – Talkbox + Phone Buzz FX]
“Bzzz...
Who that?
Bzzz...
Naw, she said she asleep...”
Talkbox croons: “But she cheatin’ on both of ussss...”

[FX: Reverse clap, low 808s swell like heartbreak in a Cadillac]

[Verse 1 – Johnny V2.0 (Trap Funk Flow)]
I came through clean, linen drippin’ like rain
Roses in my ride, body still smellin’ like fame
I parked three houses down like I always do
Waited on her man to leave — that’s my cue
He did his lil’ routine, kissed her like a show
Backed out slow, she waved... I thought I know

Then a Benz I ain’t seen before
Pulled up slick with suicide doors
She ran to him like I was never in her plans
I dropped my flowers like a fool with empty hands

[Hook – Talkbox + Johnny Lead Harmony]
She’s cheatin’ on us... cheatin’ on trust...
Playin’ two fools like a playlist dusted up
I was her weekend, you was her man
But now we both on read, left on her OnlyFans

(Talkbox harmonizes “OnlyFaaanssss…”)

[Verse 2 – Grownman Breakdown Flow + Soul Croon]
She told me you was cold
Told you I was bold
Told him he was old
Told all of us lies in gold
I was just the thrill — you the bill
Now she backseat ridin’ like she never will

I loved her in cashapp confessions
Took her to courtrooms and confessions
I prayed for her while she textin’
Another man with no discretion

[Bridge – Funk Talk, Swung Hi-Hat Groove]
“It ain’t no competition when everybody losin’.”

“You think you exclusive...
But she treatin’ hearts like coupons.”
(FX: Auto-tuned sigh, organ swirl)

[Breakdown – Strip it to Moog + Reverb]
She’s cheatin’ on us (repeat 2x)
And I still miss her touch
She’s cheatin’ on us (repeat 2x)
But I still might pull up

(slow bend guitar lick echoes like a drunk voicemail)

[Outro – Trap Blues Falsetto w/ Screwed Adlibs]
I ain’t your enemy, I’m your echo...
We both loved a hologram in stilettos...
She used to text "I love you"
But that was a group text, bro…

(FX: Talkbox “Damn.” + voicemail beep)

lyrics:
[Title: Two Truths Version – "Barstool Revival"]
[Style: Imagine “Johnny Taylor x Z-Ro Séance Cut”
Tone: Betrayal, confession, gospel-slick
Energy: Half-lean, half-mean
Instrumentation: Moaning organ, tremolo guitar, slow-chopped 808s under live soul band
FX: [vinyl hiss], [screw swirl], [crowd murmurs], [ghost laugh reverb]]


[Intro – Choir Pads + Z-Ro Slowtalk Overlay]
(Whispered) “She said God forgives...
but she don’t.
So I wrote this song in a hotel towel.”
Organ wheezes. Jukebox coughs. Somebody light a Black & Mild.

[Verse 1 – Z-Ro Confession / Johnny Harmony Adlibs]
Z-Ro:
I caught her smile in his front seat mirror
Swore I wouldn't cry but my hands got clearer
Cups don’t judge when your faith go missing
Pastor lied too — he was in the same kitchen

Johnny (sung like a ghost):
“That’s yo’ pain talkin’ baby…”

Z-Ro:
Burned my receipts with her cousin's name
But I kept the panties — just for shame

[Hook – Two Truths Format, Call & Response]
Z-Ro (spoken/sung):
Truth one: I loved her whole and wrong.
Truth two: She made leavin’ look like home.
Johnny (harmony):
“Ooooooohhhh lawd... she made leavin’ look like home”

Clap if your love got repo’d
Moan if your trust on E
We don’t heal — we re-drink it
'Cause honesty don’t come free

[Verse 2 – Johnny Takes Over / Z-Ro Echo Adlibs]
Johnny:
I laid hands on her hips, not her soul
Paid bills and missed signs I ain’t wanna know
Her voicemail had two men and a prayer
And I ain’t none of ‘em — but I still care

Z-Ro (echoed):
“Still care... that’s the dumbest part.”

[Bridge – Slow Sermon + Ghost Choir FX]
[Organ swell, FX: ghostly moans looped like choir pads]
Z-Ro (spoken):

“I ain’t no preacher, but I know the Book.
And in mine, ‘forgiveness’ only show up after the last drink.”
Johnny (faint harmonies):
“Mmmm… sweet denial tastes like apple pie…”

[Chopped Breakdown – Screw & Slide]
“She took my last prayer… and my car keys.”
(Repeat 2x, slowed, screwed)
“She took my last prayer… and my car keys.”

Slide guitar bends like a man beggin’ not to answer the phone.
808s rumble like old shame.

[Outro – No Chorus Return, Just Gospel Descent]
Johnny & Z-Ro (duet, cracked falsetto + baritone):
I don’t need no choir to testify
Just leave my barstool turned toward the sky
If I ain’t forgave her — I tried
But God, I’m still that fool inside

[FX: Final moan fades, then... silence so heavy it answers itself.]

lyrics:
*** Lyrics: ***
[Intro - DJ DROP - FX (scratch, pitch bends, stops, drops)
“Yo, it’s DJ Mo Money, Mo/$ on the decks!”
“Country girl meets Mo City trap beat kings—right here, right now!”
“Fuck We Damn Near LIVE at Mo Money Studios ya'll
— fellas its twenty twenty-five, let’s go, bitches!”
(Crowd: Cheers, off-mic laughs, room noise)]
"Saddle dust on these city streets"
"Watch me shine, watch me eat"
"Who said a girl can’t run this beat"
(Yeah)
"Real hot girl shit"
(Saddle up, let's ride)
(Giddy up)
"This beat’s got the city on fire"
(Yeehaw, let’s get it)
(Ah-huh)
(Let’s go)
(Boots up!)
(Now hush—let it ride)
"Yeah, yeah, let's go"

[Verse 1: female cipher queen dynamically flips vocal delivery techniques while maintaining pocket presence]
"Big buckle on my waist, neon on my name"
"Boots so loud, they got cows feelin’ shame"
"Mama said don’t chase those cowboy games"
"But I turn that lasso into diamond chains"
"He slide in my DMs talkin’ queen of the hay"
"I ghost him quicker than I cash my pay"
"Bass in the barn, that crowd on mute"
"Boots on the porch, just me and my truth"
"Country heart, city wit—can’t clone this blend"
"I’m that wild-card girl, flexin’ 'til the end"
(Whoop)
(Laughter)

[Chorus (Mis-timed clap, quick laugh left in, Crowd Adlibs]
"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Who’s got the boots to ball"
(Crowd: "We do!")
"Thick like syrup, I stick on the drawl"
"Raise your cup if you heard this y’all"
(Let’s go!)
"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Heads turn, let ‘em fall in line"
"Spin that bag, I don’t need his co-sign"
"Wave your hats, let the spotlight shine"

[Verse 2:]
"Moonshine sippin’ out a Yeti with gold"
"Grandpa’s truck, still ain’t been sold"
"They wanna wife me for the farm and the land"
"But I’m buyin’ out deeds, got my own brand"
"Mama warned don’t trust his rodeo smile"
"But I walked in the ring, made the judges wild"
"Hat tip, crowd flip, I bend that scene"
"Bass knock, boots drop, I’m the real country queen"
"Farm girls mad, that’s free promo"
"Catch me dancin’ in the city solo"
(Off-mic whistle)
(Her Voice cracks on "promo," keep it)

[Bridge:]
"Heard girl, you can’t—since age thirteen"
"Now I’m headline news in these boots money green"
"Tried to box me in—no roof, no wall"
"Country flex—watch me, no filter at all"
[Breath, near whisper]"Phone blowin’ up, county boys in a trance"
[Shaky sigh, tape wobble]
"But I’m just out here givin’ every girl a chance"

[Chorus (Final):[
"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Who’s got the boots to ball"
(Let’s go)
"From hayloft to high-rise, watch me run it all"
"Thick as trouble, sweet as the county drawl"
"Country booty call"
(Crowd, wave them hats, let the barn lights fall)
"I’m the headline, read it on the wall"
"Boss talk, one glance—y’all know who to call"
(Late cheer, stray harmony on "call")

[Outro: band drops out slowly as vocalist goes acapella using gospel infused, melasma and microtonal vocal runs]
"Kick dust, blow a kiss, tip the brim"
"Who’s the queen, say my name again"
"Bass fades, I wink, camera flash"
"Roll out solo, let the rumors dash"
(Boots up!)
(Country girl signed out)
"Now watch ‘em all try to copy the route"

Dobro Textures: R 25%; Amp Sim → Room Reverb.

Accordion: L 20%; Plate Reverb → Phasing.

“Yo, it’s DJ Mo Money, Mo/$ on the decks!”
“Country girl meets Mo City trap beat kings—right here, right now!”
“Fuck We Damn Near LIVE at Mo Money Studios ya'll
— fellas its twenty twenty-five, let’s go, bitches!”
(Crowd: Cheers, off-mic laughs, room noise)]
"Saddle dust on these city streets"
"Watch me shine, watch me eat"
"Who said a girl can’t run this beat"
(Yeah)
"Real hot girl shit"
(Saddle up, let's ride)
(Giddy up)
"This beat’s got the city on fire"
(Yeehaw, let’s get it)
(Ah-huh)
(Let’s go)
(Boots up!)
(Now hush—let it ride)
"Yeah, yeah, let's go"

[Verse 1: female cipher queen dynamically flips vocal delivery techniques while maintaining pocket presence]
"Big buckle on my waist, neon on my name"
"Boots so loud, they got cows feelin’ shame"
"Mama said don’t chase those cowboy games"
"But I turn that lasso into diamond chains"
"He slide in my DMs talkin’ queen of the hay"
"I ghost him quicker than I cash my pay"
"Bass in the barn, that crowd on mute"
"Boots on the porch, just me and my truth"
"Country heart, city wit—can’t clone this blend"
"I’m that wild-card girl, flexin’ 'til the end"
(Whoop)
(Laughter)

[Chorus (Mis-timed clap, quick laugh left in, Crowd Adlibs]
"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Who’s got the boots to ball"
(Crowd: "We do!")
"Thick like syrup, I stick on the drawl"
"Raise your cup if you heard this y’all"
(Let’s go!)
"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Heads turn, let ‘em fall in line"
"Spin that bag, I don’t need his co-sign"
"Wave your hats, let the spotlight shine"

"Moonshine sippin’ out a Yeti with gold"
"Grandpa’s truck, still ain’t been sold"
"They wanna wife me for the farm and the land"
"But I’m buyin’ out deeds, got my own brand"
"Mama warned don’t trust his rodeo smile"
"But I walked in the ring, made the judges wild"
"Hat tip, crowd flip, I bend that scene"
"Bass knock, boots drop, I’m the real country queen"
"Farm girls mad, that’s free promo"
"Catch me dancin’ in the city solo"
(Off-mic whistle)

"Heard girl, you can’t—since age thirteen"
"Now I’m headline news in these boots money green"
"Tried to box me in—no roof, no wall"
"Country flex—watch me, no filter at all"
[Breath, near whisper]"Phone blowin’ up, county boys in a trance"
[Shaky sigh, tape wobble]
"But I’m just out here givin’ every girl a chance"

"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Who’s got the boots to ball"
(Let’s go)
"From hayloft to high-rise, watch me run it all"
"Thick as trouble, sweet as the county drawl"
"Country booty call"
(Crowd, wave them hats, let the barn lights fall)
"I’m the headline, read it on the wall"
"Boss talk, one glance—y’all know who to call"

"Kick dust, blow a kiss, tip the brim"

"Bass fades, I wink, camera flash"
"Roll out solo, let the rumors dash"

"Now watch ‘em all try to copy the route"

lyrics:
[Intro - Vocals: Bare | Lead Vocals: Male Baritone (fx - Distant) | Backup Vocals: 3 Part Harmonies (Hummed)]
Choir: Hmm-mmm, Lord, Lord… why won’t You take this weight?
Lead Baritone: Ohhh Lord… I been runnin’… but it’s still there… still there… (spoken, with ache)
Choir (Swelling Harmonies): Ooohhh… Lord, still there…

[Verse 1 - Vocals: Layered | Lead Vocals: Male Baritone | Backup Vocals: 3 Part Harmonies (Call-and-Response)]
Lead Baritone: Woke up shakin’ in the middle of the night
Choir (Tenors and Bass): Mmm-mmm, here it come, here it come…
Lead Baritone: Saw Your face in the bottle, but it still ain’t right
Second Tenor: No, no, no… it ain’t right…
Lead Baritone: I hear the shots in my head like a drum
Bass (Deep, Resonant): Boom, boom, boom…
Lead Baritone: Ain’t no war outside, but inside, it don’t stop
Choir (Full Harmony Swells): Nooo, Lord, it don’t stop…

[Pre-Chorus - Vocals: Layered | Lead Vocals: Male Baritone | Backup Vocals: Choir - Gentle Swells]
Lead Baritone: I tell myself, “Boy, you just need some sleep”
Second Tenor (Soft Echo): Mmm-hmm, go to sleep, go to sleep…
Lead Baritone: But the past got a key to the lock on me
Choir (Full Harmony Builds): Ooohhh, it got me tight!

[Chorus - Vocals: Full Choir | Lead Vocals: Unison | Backup Vocals: Dynamic Harmonies (Stomps & Claps)]
Choir: Three years of denial, thirty in the dark
Bass (Echoing): Thirty in the dark…
Choir: Every love I lost left a hole in my heart
First Tenor (Soaring): Ohhh, my heart…
Choir: I say I’m fine, but that’s a lie I keep
I run, I drink, but the ghosts don’t leave
(All - Clapping Rhythm): Clap-clap-CLAP clap clap…

[Post-Chorus - Vocals: Swelling Choir | Lead Vocals: First Tenor (Wailing) | Backup Vocals: Baritone (Soft Echoes)]
First Tenor (Soaring Ad-lib): Ohhh, shame don’t let me go…
Baritone (Soft Echo): Ohhh, fear don’t let me grow…

[Verse 2 - Vocals: Groove-Driven | Lead Vocals: Second Tenor (Solo) | Backup Vocals: Bass Hums (Deep) | Choir (Call-and-Response)]
Second Tenor (Solo): Hands shake, don’t know if it’s fear or the drink
Bass (Deep, Resonant Humming): Mmm, heavy hands, heavy hands…
Second Tenor: Every mirror got eyes, don’t wanna see what they think
Baritone (Calling Out): Nooo, Lord, don’t make me look…
Choir (Whispers): That’s him, that’s him… lost it all, lost it all…
Second Tenor: Used to wear my name proud, now I keep my head down
Choir (Harmony Swells): Mmm, shame, shame, shame…

[Bridge - Vocals: Stripped-Back | Lead Vocals: Choir (Soft, Intimate) | Backup Vocals: First Tenor (Gentle Response)]
Choir: They said, “You need help”
First Tenor (Gentle): Nooo, not me…
Choir: But the truth is a fire burnin’ underneath
Second Tenor and Bass (Together, Swelling): Ohhh, it burns, it burns!

[Chorus - Vocals: Full Choir | Lead Vocals: Unison | Backup Vocals: Intensified (Stomps & Claps)]
Choir: Three years of denial, thirty in the dark
Bass (Echoing): Thirty in the dark…
Choir: Every love I lost left a hole in my heart
Tenors (Echoing, Soaring): My heart, my heart…
Choir: I say I’m fine, but that’s a lie I keep
I run, I drink, but the ghosts don’t leave
(All - Clapping Rhythm Intensified): Clap-clap-CLAP clap clap…

[Outro - Vocals: Fading Harmonies | Lead Vocals: Baritone (Humming) | Backup Vocals: First Tenor (Soft, Pleading)]
Baritone (Humming Low): Hmm-mmm, Lord, Lord…
First Tenor (Soft, Pleading): Maybe I ain’t alone in this long midnight ride
Choir (Fading Hums): Hmm-mmm, Lord, Lord… can You hear me now?

Choir: Hmm-mmm, Lord, Lord… why won’t You take this weight?
Lead Baritone: Ohhh Lord… I been runnin’… but it’s still there… still there… (spoken, with ache)
Choir (Swelling Harmonies): Ooohhh… Lord, still there…

[Verse 1 - Vocals: Layered | Lead Vocals: Male Baritone | Backup Vocals: 3 Part Harmonies (Call-and-Response)]
Lead Baritone: Woke up shakin’ in the middle of the night
Choir (Tenors and Bass): Mmm-mmm, here it come, here it come…
Lead Baritone: Saw Your face in the bottle, but it still ain’t right
Second Tenor: No, no, no… it ain’t right…
Lead Baritone: I hear the shots in my head like a drum
Bass (Deep, Resonant): Boom, boom, boom…
Lead Baritone: Ain’t no war outside, but inside, it don’t stop
Choir (Full Harmony Swells): Nooo, Lord, it don’t stop…

[Pre-Chorus - Vocals: Layered | Lead Vocals: Male Baritone | Backup Vocals: Choir - Gentle Swells]
Lead Baritone: I tell myself, “Boy, you just need some sleep”
Second Tenor (Soft Echo): Mmm-hmm, go to sleep, go to sleep…
Lead Baritone: But the past got a key to the lock on me
Choir (Full Harmony Builds): Ooohhh, it got me tight!

[Chorus - Vocals: Full Choir | Lead Vocals: Unison | Backup Vocals: Dynamic Harmonies (Stomps & Claps)]
Choir: Three years of denial, thirty in the dark
Bass (Echoing): Thirty in the dark…
Choir: Every love I lost left a hole in my heart
First Tenor (Soaring): Ohhh, my heart…
Choir: I say I’m fine, but that’s a lie I keep
I run, I drink, but the ghosts don’t leave
(All - Clapping Rhythm): Clap-clap-CLAP clap clap…

[Post-Chorus - Vocals: Swelling Choir | Lead Vocals: First Tenor (Wailing) | Backup Vocals: Baritone (Soft Echoes)]
First Tenor (Soaring Ad-lib): Ohhh, shame don’t let me go…
Baritone (Soft Echo): Ohhh, fear don’t let me grow…

[Verse 2 - Vocals: Groove-Driven | Lead Vocals: Second Tenor (Solo) | Backup Vocals: Bass Hums (Deep) | Choir (Call-and-Response)]
Second Tenor (Solo): Hands shake, don’t know if it’s fear or the drink
Bass (Deep, Resonant Humming): Mmm, heavy hands, heavy hands…
Second Tenor: Every mirror got eyes, don’t wanna see what they think
Baritone (Calling Out): Nooo, Lord, don’t make me look…
Choir (Whispers): That’s him, that’s him… lost it all, lost it all…
Second Tenor: Used to wear my name proud, now I keep my head down
Choir (Harmony Swells): Mmm, shame, shame, shame…

[Bridge - Vocals: Stripped-Back | Lead Vocals: Choir (Soft, Intimate) | Backup Vocals: First Tenor (Gentle Response)]
Choir: They said, “You need help”
First Tenor (Gentle): Nooo, not me…
Choir: But the truth is a fire burnin’ underneath
Second Tenor and Bass (Together, Swelling): Ohhh, it burns, it burns!

[Chorus - Vocals: Full Choir | Lead Vocals: Unison | Backup Vocals: Intensified (Stomps & Claps)]
Choir: Three years of denial, thirty in the dark
Bass (Echoing): Thirty in the dark…
Choir: Every love I lost left a hole in my heart
Tenors (Echoing, Soaring): My heart, my heart…
Choir: I say I’m fine, but that’s a lie I keep
I run, I drink, but the ghosts don’t leave
(All - Clapping Rhythm Intensified): Clap-clap-CLAP clap clap…

[Outro - Vocals: Fading Harmonies | Lead Vocals: Baritone (Humming) | Backup Vocals: First Tenor (Soft, Pleading)]
Baritone (Humming Low): Hmm-mmm, Lord, Lord…
First Tenor (Soft, Pleading): Maybe I ain’t alone in this long midnight ride
Choir (Fading Hums): Hmm-mmm, Lord, Lord… can You hear me now?
tags: Gospel track reimagined in Houston Trill style: drastically slowed tempo
dense gospel harmonies as atmospheric pads
original bass and organ swells amplified
phasing and flanging infuse each section
title: Midnight Ride male quartet

lyrics:
[Intro, Whispered over Sparse 808 with tribal percussion & Clean Guitar]
(I’ve walked cracked highways — moonlight in my veins)
(Found salvation in six-string refrains)
(This gravel tongue — it burns like frost on pine)
(Still here… unbroken… can you feel my spine?)

[Verse 1, Minimalist Dre Pocket + Subtle Organ Pads]
Raised on sawdust floors, where hymns lay cold
Smoke and sweat baptize the worn and old
Papa’s promise: stay rooted in clay
But I heard heaven call in a four-string sway

[Guitar Lick Echo – Ebmaj9 → Bb13]

[Pre-Chorus 1, Off-Kilter Snare & Syncopated Vocal Chop]
I straddled faith and fire — nights in two-step coils
Beats in my blood, burning through my toils
Loop this prayer, let the groove extol

[whisper chop: “reclaim my soul” — beats 2.2, 3.4, 4.1, 4.3] Ashes to anthem — I reclaim my soul

[Chorus 1, Gospel Choir Lift + Prince-Style Modulation]
Still here — still breathin’, though roots run wide
Still here — wild soul — I’ll never hide
Every sub-kick thuds — a gospel heartbeat
Every choir hum swears my purpose is complete
(Hmmm) (Hallelu) (Jah)

[Verse 2, Half-Time “Ghostly” Feel + Chord Leap]
Brothers clashed like thunder in the pines
One chased fortune, one wore the vine
Walls grew high where hollers once sighed
But my shadow sings — won’t be denied

[Abrupt Leap: Ebmaj9 → Abmaj7]

[Pre-Chorus 2, Double-Time Cadence Snap-Back]
Daddy lit the fuse, earth forged my fight
Drums in my chest — I rise from night
[Snap to double-time on “I stand unbowed”] Loops resurrect, I stand unbowed
My grit and grace — my battle-cry loud



[Chorus 2, Hook Twist + Call-and-Response]
Still here — still roarin’ in scar-etched skin
Still here — wild spirit won’t rescind
(Call:) (You hear it?) (Response:) Still here — soul scalded but grinnin’
Each 808 thump baptizes the past
Each gospel shout proclaims I’ll outlast
(Amen) (Ghost choir echo)

[Outro, Sparse Guitar + Whisper Fade]
Roots in blood — flame in bone
Still here — this story’s my own
(whisper: Amen)
[Tape wobble swell → silence]

title: Still Here v2

lyrics:
*** Lyrics: ***
[Intro - DJ DROP - FX (scratch, pitch bends, stops, drops)
“Yo, it’s DJ Mo Money, Mo/$ on the decks!”
“Country girl meets Mo City trap beat kings—right here, right now!”
“Fuck We Damn Near LIVE at Mo Money Studios ya'll
— fellas its twenty twenty-five, let’s go, bitches!”
(Crowd: Cheers, off-mic laughs, room noise)]
"Saddle dust on these city streets"
"Watch me shine, watch me eat"
"Who said a girl can’t run this beat"
(Yeah)
"Real hot girl shit"
(Saddle up, let's ride)
(Giddy up)
"This beat’s got the city on fire"
(Yeehaw, let’s get it)
(Ah-huh)
(Let’s go)
(Boots up!)
(Now hush—let it ride)
"Yeah, yeah, let's go"

[Verse 1: female cipher queen dynamically flips vocal delivery techniques while maintaining pocket presence]
"Big buckle on my waist, neon on my name"
"Boots so loud, they got cows feelin’ shame"
"Mama said don’t chase those cowboy games"
"But I turn that lasso into diamond chains"
"He slide in my DMs talkin’ queen of the hay"
"I ghost him quicker than I cash my pay"
"Bass in the barn, that crowd on mute"
"Boots on the porch, just me and my truth"
"Country heart, city wit—can’t clone this blend"
"I’m that wild-card girl, flexin’ 'til the end"
(Whoop)
(Laughter)

[Chorus (Mis-timed clap, quick laugh left in, Crowd Adlibs]
"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Who’s got the boots to ball"
(Crowd: "We do!")
"Thick like syrup, I stick on the drawl"
"Raise your cup if you heard this y’all"
(Let’s go!)
"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Heads turn, let ‘em fall in line"
"Spin that bag, I don’t need his co-sign"
"Wave your hats, let the spotlight shine"

[Verse 2:]
"Moonshine sippin’ out a Yeti with gold"
"Grandpa’s truck, still ain’t been sold"
"They wanna wife me for the farm and the land"
"But I’m buyin’ out deeds, got my own brand"
"Mama warned don’t trust his rodeo smile"
"But I walked in the ring, made the judges wild"
"Hat tip, crowd flip, I bend that scene"
"Bass knock, boots drop, I’m the real country queen"
"Farm girls mad, that’s free promo"
"Catch me dancin’ in the city solo"
(Off-mic whistle)
(Her Voice cracks on "promo," keep it)

[Bridge:]
"Heard girl, you can’t—since age thirteen"
"Now I’m headline news in these boots money green"
"Tried to box me in—no roof, no wall"
"Country flex—watch me, no filter at all"
[Breath, near whisper]"Phone blowin’ up, county boys in a trance"
[Shaky sigh, tape wobble]
"But I’m just out here givin’ every girl a chance"

[Chorus (Final):[
"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Who’s got the boots to ball"
(Let’s go)
"From hayloft to high-rise, watch me run it all"
"Thick as trouble, sweet as the county drawl"
"Country booty call"
(Crowd, wave them hats, let the barn lights fall)
"I’m the headline, read it on the wall"
"Boss talk, one glance—y’all know who to call"
(Late cheer, stray harmony on "call")

[Outro: band drops out slowly as vocalist goes acapella using gospel infused, melasma and microtonal vocal runs]
"Kick dust, blow a kiss, tip the brim"
"Who’s the queen, say my name again"
"Bass fades, I wink, camera flash"
"Roll out solo, let the rumors dash"
(Boots up!)
(Country girl signed out)
"Now watch ‘em all try to copy the route"

(Mo/$: “Yo, it’s DJ Mo Money, Mo/$ on the decks!”)

(Mo/$: “Country girl meets Mo City trap beat kings—right here, right now!”)

(Mo/$: “We LIVE at Mo Money Studios—twenty twenty-five, let’s go, bitches!”)

(Crowd: Cheers, off-mic laughs, room noise)

[LYRICS, AD-LIBS, OVERDUBS (CUMULATIVE FORMAT)]
Intro:
"Saddle dust on these city streets"
"Watch me shine, watch me eat"
"Who said a girl can’t run this beat"
(Yeah)
"Real hot girl shit"
(Saddle up, let's ride)
(Giddy up)
"This beat’s got the city on fire"
(Yeehaw, let’s get it)
(Ah-huh)
(Let’s go)
(Boots up!)
(Now hush—let it ride)
"Yeah, yeah, let's go"

Verse 1:
"Big buckle on my waist, neon on my name"
"Boots so loud, they got cows feelin’ shame"
"Mama said don’t chase those cowboy games"
"But I turn that lasso into diamond chains"
"He slide in my DMs talkin’ queen of the hay"
"I ghost him quicker than I cash my pay"
"Bass in the barn, that crowd on mute"
"Boots on the porch, just me and my truth"
"Country heart, city wit—can’t clone this blend"
"I’m that wild-card girl, flexin’ 'til the end"
(Whoop)
(Laughter)
(Quick inhale before next bar)

Chorus:
"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Who’s got the boots to ball"
(Crowd: "We do!")
"Thick like syrup, I stick on the drawl"
"Raise your cup if you heard this y’all"
(Let’s go!)
"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Heads turn, let ‘em fall in line"
"Spin that bag, I don’t need his co-sign"
"Wave your hats, let the spotlight shine"
(Mis-timed clap, quick laugh left in)

Verse 2:
"Moonshine sippin’ out a Yeti with gold"
"Grandpa’s truck, still ain’t been sold"
"They wanna wife me for the farm and the land"
"But I’m buyin’ out deeds, got my own brand"
"Mama warned don’t trust his rodeo smile"
"But I walked in the ring, made the judges wild"
"Hat tip, crowd flip, I bend that scene"
"Bass knock, boots drop, I’m the real country queen"
"Farm girls mad, that’s free promo"
"Catch me dancin’ in the city solo"
(Off-mic whistle)
(Voice cracks on "promo," keep it)

Bridge:
"Heard girl, you can’t—since age thirteen"
"Now I’m headline news in these boots money green"
"Tried to box me in—no roof, no wall"
"Country flex—watch me, no filter at all"
(Breath, near whisper)
"Phone blowin’ up, county boys in a trance"
"But I’m just out here givin’ every girl a chance"
(Shaky sigh, tape wobble)

Chorus (Final):
"Country booty call"
(Crowd: "Booty call!")
"Who’s got the boots to ball"
(Let’s go)
"From hayloft to high-rise, watch me run it all"
"Thick as trouble, sweet as the county drawl"
"Country booty call"
(Crowd, wave them hats, let the barn lights fall)
"I’m the headline, read it on the wall"
"Boss talk, one glance—y’all know who to call"
(Late cheer, stray harmony on "call")

Outro:
"Kick dust, blow a kiss, tip the brim"
"Who’s the queen, say my name again"
"Bass fades, I wink, camera flash"
"Roll out solo, let the rumors dash"
(Boots up!)
(Country girl signed out)
"Now watch ‘em all try to copy the route"

[HUMAN IMPERFECTIONS & PERFORMANCE GUIDANCE:
Mo/$ drops and branding are always present in the intro and before the first lyric.

Ad-libs (parenthesis) and overdubs stay raw—let some go off-beat or overlap lines.

Breaths, voice cracks, laughs, missed claps are left in for human feel.

Crowd and call-and-response are never perfect—timing drifts, energy rises and falls.

No section should sound “robotic” or over-polished; every take should feel live, with flaws left in.

If you break for crowd or band, leave space—improvise, jam, let the groove lead the way.

“We LIVE at Mo Money Studios” = performance energy, crowd hype, not residence/location.

End with Mo/$’s tag if you want to stamp the master take: (“Mo Money Studios, twenty twenty-five, signing out!”)]

lyrics:
[Style:
The track kicks off with filtered vinyl organ and slide guitar licks under chopped soul samples and stomp-clap percussion. Verses bounce atop 808s, sub-bass, and crisp drums; agile female MC trades with Southern male hype vocals and harmonized chants. Bluesy riffs and wah guitar uplift the hook, surrounded by gang vocals, crowd energy, and choir pads. Half-time bridge strips to vocal stutters, echoes, and tape wobble, before a bold, saturated chorus explodes. Wide stereo placement, raw tape warmth, signature drops, and swirling outro FX create a stadium, afterparty vibe—anthemic, lively, and Southern to the core.]

[Lyrics:]
[Intro – Sub-bass, Western whistle, crowd swell, signature drop]

Saddle dust on these city streets—
watch me shine, watch me eat
Who said a girl can’t run this beat?
Real hot girl shit (Yeah!)

Saddle up, let’s ride (Giddy up)

Moe Money made this beat

(*Yeehaw, bitch!*)

(Ah-huh) (Let’s go!)
(Boots up! Now hush—let it ride.)
(Yeah, yeah, let's go.)

[Verse 1 – Loose, rhythmic, crowd punch-ins, sly punchlines]

Big buckle on my waist, neon on my name
Boots so loud, they got cows feelin’ shame
Mama said don’t chase those cowboy games—
But I turn that lasso into diamond chains
He slide in my DMs talkin’ “Queen of the hay”
I ghost him quicker than I cash my pay

Bass in the barn, that crowd on mute—
Boots on the porch, just me and my truth
Country heart, city wit—can’t clone this blend
I’m that wild-card girl, flexin’ 'til the end

[Chorus – Anthemic, call-and-response, viral hook]

Country booty call—
Crowd say “Who’s got the boots to ball?” (We do!)
Thick like syrup, 
I stick on the drawl
Raise your cup if you heard this y’all (Let’s go!)

Country booty call—
Heads turn, 
let ‘em fall in line
Spin that bag, 
I don’t need his co-sign
Wave your hats, 
let the spotlight shine!

[Verse 2 – Internal rhymes, story twist, wit, swing]

Moonshine sippin’ out a Yeti with gold
Grandpa’s truck, 
still ain’t been sold
They wanna wife me 
for the farm and the land
But I’m buyin’ out deeds, 
got my own brand

Mama warned: 
“Don’t trust his rodeo smile”
But I walked in the ring, 
made the judges wild

Hat tip, 
crowd flip, 
I bend that scene
Bass knock, 
boots drop, 
I’m the REAL
country queen

Farm girls 
mad? 
That’s free 
promo
Catch me 
dancin’ 
in the city—
solo

[Bridge – Micro-story, self-aware, softer note]

Heard “girl, 
you can’t”—
since age 
thirteen
Now 
I’m headline news 
in these boots 
money green

Tried to 
box me 
in—
no 
roof, 
no 
wall

Country flex—
watch me, 
no filter 
at all

Phone 
blowin’ up, 
county boys 
in a trance
But I’m just out here
—givin’ every girl a chance

[Chorus – Flipped for final crowd chant, extra chant line]

Country booty call—
Who’s got the boots to ball? (Let’s go!)
From hayloft 
to high-rise, 
watch me run it all
Thick as trouble, 
sweet as the county drawl
Country booty call—

Crowd, wave them hats, 
let the barn lights fall
I’m the headline—
(bitches aint blind)
read it on the wall
Boss talk, one glance—y’all know who to call

[Outro – Memorable, meme-able, camera-facing]

Kick dust, blow a kiss, tip the brim
Who’s the queen? Say my name again
Bass fades, I wink, camera flash—
Roll out solo, let the rumors dash
(Boots up!)
Country girl signed out—
Now watch ‘em all try to copy the route.


[FREESTYLE]

lyrics:
[
STYLE:
Genre: Crossroads Gospel Trap meets Southern Soul-Zydeco  
Tempo: 78 BPM (dynamic trap swing with half-time & double-time shifts)  
Primary Instruments: 808s, hi-hats, snares, slide guitar, dobro, accordion, cinematic brass & strings, organ, pedal steel, glassy guitar  
Vocal Chain: Analog tube saturation → light compressor → dry plate reverb → 15% tape wobble send  
Master Bus: Sub-boost @ 60 Hz, gentle mid dip @ 400 Hz, wide stereo imaging for choir/instruments  
Global FX: Vinyl crackle & slowdown, tape wobble, phasing on zydeco, ghost reverse-tail reverbs, DJ scratches auto-pan  
Arrangement Arc: Whispered intro → growing intensity in verses → choir-driven anthemic choruses → spoken bridge → climactic final chorus → faded outro  
Self-Refinement: Built-in QA questions at end for hook twist, flashback detail, or cliché swap
] 

[LYRICS]  
[Intro – voice: African-American male with gospel roots, AAVN pronunciation, emotional R. Kelly/Cupid–style runs]  
Crossroads burnin’… Ashes turnin’…  
Run it… run it… run it to me…  

[Verse 1 – Trap beat + slide guitar + gospel hums; lead: gritty male baritone]  
Tires spin in the red-clay dust  
Ghost-ride dreams with a pocket full of trust  
Preacher man said, “Boy, you better adjust”  
But I built my throne from sweat and rust  
Slide guitar cry, bend every note  
Gospel moan rise when I split that hope  
Kick drum speaks like a back-porch oath—  
Everything’s due when you carry that yoke  
(Adlib: “Heavy!”)  
Clutch that Bible, clutch that steel  
Both hands dirty, prayers feel real  
Mama said, “Baby, God knows the deal”  
Run it to me when the devil gets near  

[Chorus 1 – Full gospel choir + cinematic strings; lead: confident belt, adlibs “nah! yah!”]  
They say it couldn’t be done (nah!)  
Born with the embers at my tongue (yah!)  
Just run it to me, just run it to me  
If you got somethin’ real, run it to me  
Crossroads blazin’ like the Fourth of July  
Gospel hands up to a blood-red sky  
Run it to me, yeah, run it to me  
Ain’t no other way—better run it to me  

[Post-Chorus – choir echo + distorted blues growl]  
Run it… run it… run it to me…  
(Mmmm, mmm!)  
Run it… run it…  

[Verse 2 – Syncopated trap groove + dobro textures; lead: rhythmic rap-sing, adlib “Tell it!”]  
Gasoline on my Sunday best  
Cross ’round my neck, my sins don’t rest  
Fast-talk flow like a Pentecost breath  
Catch double-time prayer ’fore the hearse catch step  
Cane pole broke but my dreams stayed gold  
Moonshine heart in a steel-drum soul  
Tumbleweed spin… on a one-lane track—ready for the attack  
(Adlib: “Tell it!”)  
Slide that pistol ’cross a tattered map  
Find my peace where the trouble comes back  
Ain’t no way out when you’re born on the track  
Run it to me—pray these chains don’t crack  

[Chorus 2 – Double-time drive + gospel swells; lead: urgent, triumphant]  
They say it couldn’t be done (uh-huh!)  
Wrote my fate on a shotgun drum (let’s go!)  
Just run it to me, just run it to me  
Ain’t no fear when the Lord runs through me  
Crossroads blazin’ under outlaw skies  
Halo crooked but my head held high  
Run it to me, yeah, run it to me  
Burnin’ down doubt—just run it to me  

[Bridge – spoken word + ghostly choir echo; lead: low, gritty spoken delivery]  
Dirt roads know my name…  
Coffins and crowns in the same frame…  
Crossroads ain’t a curse—it’s a claim…  
Run it to me—baptized in flame…  
(Fading choir hums)  
“Runnn it… runnn it…”  

[Final Chorus – cinematic climax + blues guitar screams; lead: powerful belt]  
They say it couldn’t be done (done!)  
But my soul’s on the run (run!)  
Don’t run away—from me  
Crossroads blazing—rebirth begun  
Run it to me, yeah, run it to me  
Chains undone—I’m finally home  

[Outro – whisper + tape wobble fade; lead: intimate whisper]  
Run it… run it… run it to me…

lyrics:
[Intro, Whispered over Sparse 808 & Clean Guitar]
(I’ve walked cracked highways — moonlight in my veins)
(Found salvation in six-string refrains)
(This gravel tongue — it burns like frost on pine)
(Still here… unbroken… can you feel my spine?)

[Verse 1, Minimalist Dre Pocket + Subtle Organ Pads]
Raised on sawdust floors, where hymns lay cold
Smoke and sweat baptize the worn and old
Papa’s promise: stay rooted in clay
But I heard heaven call in a four-string sway

[Guitar Lick Echo – Ebmaj9 → Bb13]

[Pre-Chorus 1, Off-Kilter Snare & Syncopated Vocal Chop]
I straddled faith and fire — nights in two-step coils
Beats in my blood, burning through my toils
Loop this prayer, let the groove extol
Ashes to anthem — I reclaim my soul

(whisper chop: “reclaim my soul” — beats 2.2, 3.4, 4.1, 4.3)

[Chorus 1, Gospel Choir Lift + Prince-Style Modulation]
Still here — still breathin’, though roots run wide
Still here — wild soul — I’ll never hide
Every sub-kick thuds — a gospel heartbeat
Every choir hum swears my purpose is complete
(Hmmm) (Hallelu) (Jah)

[Verse 2, Half-Time “Ghostly” Feel + Chord Leap]
Brothers clashed like thunder in the pines
One chased fortune, one wore the vine
Walls grew high where hollers once sighed
But my shadow sings — won’t be denied

[Abrupt Leap: Ebmaj9 → Abmaj7]

[Pre-Chorus 2, Double-Time Cadence Snap-Back]
Daddy lit the fuse, earth forged my fight
Drums in my chest — I rise from night
Loops resurrect, I stand unbowed
My grit and grace — my battle-cry loud

(Snap to double-time on “I stand unbowed”)

[Chorus 2, Hook Twist + Call-and-Response]
Still here — still roarin’ in scar-etched skin
Still here — wild spirit won’t rescind
(Call:) (You hear it?) (Response:) Still here — soul scalded but grinnin’
Each 808 thump baptizes the past
Each gospel shout proclaims I’ll outlast
(Amen) (Ghost choir echo)

[Outro, Sparse Guitar + Whisper Fade]
Roots in blood — flame in bone
Still here — this story’s my own
(whisper: Amen)
(Tape wobble swell → silence)

DJ Moe Money is in the booth!

Buckle up bitches!

You know how we do this shit...

Moe Money Studios

20 25 (whoop)!

[Verse]

Tumbleweed spin down a one-lane track

Moonlight drip like bourbon through a broken crack

Boots on wood—hollow, like the ache she drag

She been runnin’ from nothin’, but trouble know the path

Jukebox moan

in a bar that don’t close

Where wishes fall with ash

on dirty floors

She lean on the counter,

hurt in her eyes

Each sip of that whiskey...

is a sermon in disguise

Whiskey and wild roses—tangled in the night

Soft like her whisper,

sharp like a knife

She a storm rollin’ in,

open heart on fire

Whiskey and wild roses—

no place to hide

(Whoo...)

(Lawd, have mercy…)

He sit in shadow,

brim pulled down

Scars like stories—

ain’t no words around

“what weight you hold?”

She laugh like glass:

“More than the devil been told.”

[Freestyle – Bunny Snow]

(Yeah...)

Slide through with that steel-toe soul

I bend bars like highways roll

Bourbon breath and leather pride

She my muse and my Southern guide

No halo, but I rise from mud

Ink my pain where the bloodline flood

Got a queen with fire in her lane

Bunny Snow, no leash, no chain

Thunder crack,

sky cry loud

Dust turn to mud

where pain allowed

She pull her collar,

he reach that hand—

Some roads don’t walk....

with just

one man

[Chorus 2]

Whiskey and wild roses—wild but true

Fire kissin’ water, baptized in blue

Through storm and shadow, side by side

Whiskey and wild roses—no place to hide

[Bridge - vocal runs]

(Mmm...)

(She been gone...)

[Outro]

“…Some flowers burn sweet… never bloom.”

lyrics:
[Intro, Whispered over Sparse 808 & Clean Guitar]
(I’ve walked cracked highways — moonlight in my veins)
(Found salvation in six-string refrains)
(This gravel tongue — it burns like frost on pine)
(Still here… unbroken… can you feel my spine?)

[Verse 1, Minimalist Dre Pocket + Subtle Organ Pads]
Raised on sawdust floors, where hymns lay cold
Smoke and sweat baptize the worn and old
Papa’s promise: stay rooted in clay
But I heard heaven call in a four-string sway

[Guitar Lick Echo – Ebmaj9 → Bb13]

[Pre-Chorus 1, Off-Kilter Snare & Syncopated Vocal Chop]
I straddled faith and fire — nights in two-step coils
Beats in my blood, burning through my toils
Loop this prayer, let the groove extol
Ashes to anthem — I reclaim my soul

(whisper chop: “reclaim my soul” — beats 2.2, 3.4, 4.1, 4.3)

[Chorus 1, Gospel Choir Lift + Prince-Style Modulation]
Still here — still breathin’, though roots run wide
Still here — wild soul — I’ll never hide
Every sub-kick thuds — a gospel heartbeat
Every choir hum swears my purpose is complete
(Hmmm) (Hallelu) (Jah)

[Verse 2, Half-Time “Ghostly” Feel + Chord Leap]
Brothers clashed like thunder in the pines
One chased fortune, one wore the vine
Walls grew high where hollers once sighed
But my shadow sings — won’t be denied

[Abrupt Leap: Ebmaj9 → Abmaj7]

[Pre-Chorus 2, Double-Time Cadence Snap-Back]
Daddy lit the fuse, earth forged my fight
Drums in my chest — I rise from night
Loops resurrect, I stand unbowed
My grit and grace — my battle-cry loud

(Snap to double-time on “I stand unbowed”)

[Chorus 2, Hook Twist + Call-and-Response]
Still here — still roarin’ in scar-etched skin
Still here — wild spirit won’t rescind
(Call:) (You hear it?) (Response:) Still here — soul scalded but grinnin’
Each 808 thump baptizes the past
Each gospel shout proclaims I’ll outlast
(Amen) (Ghost choir echo)

[Outro, Sparse Guitar + Whisper Fade]
Roots in blood — flame in bone
Still here — this story’s my own
(whisper: Amen)
(Tape wobble swell → silence)
tags: Gospel track in Houston Trill style: drastically slowed tempo
title: Still Here (Flame in Bone)

lyrics:
[Intro – Ambient Riser, Reverse Vocal Swell]
(Whispered)
"Skywalkin'... fade in slow..."

"Run it... run it..."

[Verse 1 – Autotuned Lead + Whisper Double, Reverb Tail on End Rhymes]

"Super duper skywalkin' on these haters"

"Celebrate every day like a birthday"

"Everything kosher like an old man with a low fade" (Delay throw on “fade”)

"Okay, let's get it"

"And everything is everything, that's what the old heads say"

"She say, 'Do you love me?' I say, 'Hell yeah, ayy'"

"Hell yeah, baby, like I'm Lil Wayne"

"Ayy, I'm a Gemini, that's why my mood change"

"Ayy, we was outside like some loose chains" (Low-octave double)

"Ayy, comin' up short like my school days"

"Ayy, lookin' for a ticket to the new thang"

"She say, 'When you comin' home?' I said, 'Never'"

"And I put it in my verse, she think she so clever"

"And she used to love me 'cause I do it better"

[fx: Auto-panned L–R, vocoder FX, delay trail on final “better”]
"Better, better, better, better, better, better, better"


[Chorus – Chant-Style Hook, Stacked Vocals, Ambient Reverb Pad]

"Ayy, they said it couldn't be done, it's just another rerun" (Reverb swell)

"Just give it to me, like, run it to me" (Wide pan, autotuned)

"They said it couldn't be done, it's just another rerun"

[fx: Last “run” pitched up]
"Just give it to me, like, run it to me" 

[Post-Chorus – Mantra Loop w/ FX Variation]
"Run it to me" (fx: Dry)

"Run it to me" (Stereo + slap delay)

"Run it to me" (Pitched + distant)

"Run it to me" (Vocoder)

[Verse 2 – Distorted Double Layer, Lo-Fi Section at “Mental” Bar]
"Fifteen years, and I came back, like, 'Hey, yo'"

"Takin' niggas' heads off, that's fatal"

"Now it's fuck you, pay me, then I lay low"

"In my head, I know this shit is all mental" (Lowpass filter drop)

"It's the family over everything, so I treat it like a bando"

"Baby wanna know what my plans for today"

"Is you with me? Is you not? Is you in? Is you out?"

"I can still tell that you're not all the way convinced"

"

VERSE 1 (FlowFiend - Energetic but slightly slurred, trying to catch the beat)
FlowFiend (R1): Uh... mic check, one two, this ain't no debut, Lab session messy, sippin' on that... (chuckles) ...what's new? 808s soundin' drunk, just like my whole crew, Spit it raw, no plan, just what we go through...

(Ad-libs from Rapper 2 & 3 in background: "Yeah!", "That's it!", "Woozy!") (Beat 1 continues for 4 bars)

BEAT SHIFT 1 & VERSE 2 (MumbleMonk - Smoother, more laid back, heavily slurred)
(Beat suddenly shifts: 808s get glitchier, a new, sparse synth melody with heavy delay enters. Tempo feels like it's tripping over itself.)

MumbleMonk (R2): Yeah... head spinnin', vision kinda blurry... (hiccups) Minimalist vibe, ain't no need to hurry... Synth lines creepin', makin' thoughts all swirly, Pass the... uh... pass the mic, story gettin' wordy...

(FlowFiend ad-libs: "Pass that!", "He feelin' it!") (Beat 2 continues for 4 bars)

BEAT SHIFT 2 & VERSE 3 (VerseVandal - More playful, trying complex rhymes but occasionally fumbling)
(Beat shifts again: Tempo stutters and speeds up slightly. 808s are punchy but still loose. A high-pitched, annoying synth arp flickers in and out.)

VerseVandal (R3): Aight, aight, my turn, lemme... lemme interject this! Flow so liquid, call it... uh... asbestos! (laughs) Nah, that ain't right... brain cells on a protest! Lab coat flow, puttin' theories to the... to the test, yes!

(MumbleMonk ad-libs: "The test!", "He got it... almost!") (Beat 3 continues for 4 bars)

HOOK (SLURRED & SPONTANEOUS - All three rappers, overlapping, call-and-response style)
(Beat shifts to a fourth pattern: Very sparse, just a deep, distorted 808 pulse and a single, sustained low synth note. Feels like it's about to fall apart.)

FlowFiend (R1): Lab leak! (Huh?) MumbleMonk (R2): Beat freak! (Yeah!) VerseVandal (R3): Can't speak! (Mmmhmmm) All Three (Stumbling over each other): This that... woozy... late night... studio... (mumbled words)... anotha one!

lyrics:
[DJ DROP scratch, pitch bends, stops, drops]  
DJ Moe Money is in the booth!  
Buckle up bitches!  
You know how we do this shit...  
This that REAL ASS...  
COUNTRY Girl MEETS TRAP Beat Kings!  
Moe Money Studios   
20 25 (whoop)!  

[Verse]  
Tumbleweed spin down a one-lane track  
Moonlight drip like bourbon through a broken crack  
Boots on wood—hollow, like the ache she drag  
She been runnin’ from nothin’, but trouble know the path  

Jukebox moan   
in a bar that don’t close  
Where wishes fall with ash   
on dirty floors  
She lean on the counter,   
hurt in her eyes  
Each sip of that whiskey...   
is a sermon in disguise  

Whiskey and wild roses—tangled in the night  
Soft like her whisper,   
sharp like a knife  
She a storm rollin’ in,   
open heart on fire  
Whiskey and wild roses—  
no place to hide  

(Whoo...)  
(Lawd, have mercy…)  

He sit in shadow,   
brim pulled down  
Scars like stories—  
ain’t no words around  
“Tell me,” he drawls,   
“what weight you hold?”  
She laugh like glass:   
“More than the devil been told.”  

[Freestyle – Bunny Snow]  
(Yeah...)  
Slide through with that steel-toe soul  
I bend bars like highways roll  
Bourbon breath and leather pride  
She my muse and my Southern guide  

No halo, but I rise from mud  
Ink my pain where the bloodline flood  
Got a queen with fire in her lane  
Bunny Snow, no leash, no chain  

Thunder crack,   
sky cry loud  
Dust turn to mud   
where pain allowed  
She pull her collar,   
he reach that hand—  
Some roads don’t walk....   
with just   
one man  

[Chorus 2]  
Whiskey and wild roses—wild but true  
Fire kissin’ water, baptized in blue  
Through storm and shadow, side by side  
Whiskey and wild roses—no place to hide  

[Bridge - vocal runs]  
(Mmm...)  
(She been gone...)  

[Outro]  
“…Some flowers burn sweet… never bloom.”

lyrics:
[STYLE]
Production Style: Solange  
Vibe: Gothic Southern Trap meets Modern Country Storytelling  
Lead Vocal: Black American female solo | Contralto range | Raspy edges | AAVE phrasing  
Lyrical tone inspired by ‘Fall for You’ and Jazmine Sullivan’s ‘Let It Burn’  
Expressive delivery | Emotion over perfection | Soulful | No pop cadence  
Voice should float off-beat | Drift around grid | Stretch syllables | Enter behind beat  
Gospel-rooted ad-libs: (Lawd...) (Mmmhmm) (Aye)

[Intro, Chopped & Screwed, Eerie Synths, Sub-Bass]
Yeah... slow-rollin’
Like syrup in the cup...
Smoke hangs thick
Blue light, real stuck...
Wait...
Watch the tempo shift up—
Don’t blink
Might miss the lift-up
Bassline stalkin’
Heartbeat sinkin’
Chopped voice slither
Whole club’s thinkin’

[Verse 1, Laid-Back Groove, Lowrider Bounce - 95 BPM]
Step in the room
Bassline thumpin’
Heads all turn
Crowd straight jumpin’
Backlight glow
Hips move like waves
Tattoo flashin’
Eyes locked, brave
Heels click slow
Gold hoops swing
Talk with my walk
I don’t say a thing
Air gets thick
Pulse in flight
Walk in bold—
This vibe’s my right

[Chorus, Catchy Hook, Twerk Anthem - 95 BPM]
Drop it low
Let the bassline ride
Twerk it out
Let the whiskey decide
Bounce it back
Make the floorboards quake
Hands on knees
Now watch it shake
Drop it low
Let the tempo ride
Switch it up
No fear, no guide
Twerk it wild
Let the body scream
We run heat
We run the scene

[Verse 2, Hard-Hitting Flow - 95 BPM]
Eyes on me
Got the room on lock
Boots hit ground
Hear the speakers knock
Beat’s a blade
I cut through the doubt
Lines hit cold
Make the silence shout
I don’t chase
I own the pace
No fake flex
Just raw grace
Power’s here
In the way I step
Mood shifts fast
Better watch your rep

[Bridge, Tempo Drop to 70 BPM, Tribal Percussion, Chopped & Screwed]
Slow down, now
Hips roll vivid
Bass hits deep
This groove—explicit
Smoke in the light
Fire in my stance
Tribal drums
Put me in that trance
Watch me twist
Switch positions
Low control
No inhibitions
Voice drops slow
Screwed and hazy
This the switch
They call me crazy

[Extended Chorus, 95 BPM, Add Vocal Layers & Ad-Libs]
Drop it low
Let the bassline ride (ride it)
Twerk it out
Let the whiskey decide (uh-huh)
Bounce it back
Make the floorboards quake (bounce)
Hands on knees
Now let it shake (go crazy)
Drop it low
Let the bassline ride
Switch it up
Ain’t no place to hide
Twerk it wild
Like the night’s on fire
Run the show
I’m your desire

[Outro, Chopped & Screwed, Gospel Harmonies, Vinyl Crackle]
(Drop it low...)
(Echo: drop... drop...)
Pull up slow
I change the flow
Vinyl crackle
Gospel glow
808 thunder
I move like smoke
Switch it up
Then ghost—no joke
Whispers deep
Like a Southern bell
I don’t just move
I cast a spell...
(Switch... switch... switch...)

title: The Switch-Up

lyrics:
[Intro, Chopped & Screwed, Eerie Synths, Sub-Bass]

Yeah... slow-rollin’ like syrup in the cup...

Smoke hangs thick and blue, can't make this up...

Wait... watch the tempo switch up, don’t blink...

Bassline lurkin’, thoughts start to sink...

Creepin' on a curve where the light don't touch,

Voice low, chopped sweet, got that Southern clutch...

[Verse 1, Laid-Back Groove, Lowrider Bounce, Deep Bass - 95 BPM]

Step in the spot, got the bassline thumpin’

Lights low dim, whole crowd start jumpin’

Shadows on the wall, hips movin’ like tidal waves

Sweat drip slick, caught in my sway

Gold hoops swingin’, moonlight kiss

Vibe so thick, can’t fake this bliss

Walk in bold, know the vibe’s my right

Midnight queen with the club on sight

[Chorus, Catchy Hook, Twerk Anthem - 95 BPM]

Drop it low, let the bassline ride

Twerk it out, let the whiskey decide

Bounce it up, make the floorboards quake

Hands on knees, baby, watch it shake

Drop it low, let the bassline ride

Twerk it out, let the whiskey decide

Switch it up, bring the heat, no doubt

One move in, got ‘em all tapped out

[Verse 2, Gangsta Mode, Hard-Hitting Flow, Deep Drum Work - 95 BPM]

Got the crowd on lock, eyes all track my sway

Boots hit ground like I own the place

Beat’s a weapon, no need to reload rounds

Spit sharp lines, make the silence drown

Respect on arrival, I don’t beg for space

I break the beat like I run this race

Pulse in my grip, I mold the sound

Switch the mood up — yeah, I'm inbound

[Bridge, Tempo Drop to 70 BPM, Tribal Percussion, Chopped & Screwed]

Slow-motion, hips roll vivid

Bassline hittin’, shadows stay livid

Catch the beat, let the rhythm possess it

Drumline primal, no need to dress it

Now watch me switch positions...

Hands on fire, pure precision

Chopped voice slippin’ through fog and flame

This the switch-up — not just a name...

[Extended Chorus, Club Anthem - 95 BPM, Add Vocal Layers, Ad-Libs]

Drop it low, let the bassline ride (uh-huh, ride it)

[Fade Out]

title: The Switch-Up

lyrics:
[Intro, Cinematic Brass Swell, Vinyl Crackle]
(Whispered)
Crossroads burnin’...
Ashes turnin’...
Run it… run it… run it to me…

[Verse 1, Trap Beats + Slide Guitar + Gospel Hums]
Tires spin in the red clay dust
Ghost ride dreams and a pocket full of trust
Preacher man said, "Boy, you better adjust"
But I built my throne outta sweat and rust
Slide guitar cry when I bend that note
Gospel moan rise when I split that hope
Kick drum talk like a back porch oath
Everything paid when you carry that yoke
(Adlib: “Heavy!”)
Clutch that Bible, clutch that steel
Both hands dirty, but the prayers feel real
Mama said, “Baby, God know the deal”
Run it to me when the devil gets near

[Chorus, Full Gospel Choir + Cinematic Strings]
They say it couldn’t be done (nah!)
Born with the fire in my lungs (yah!)
Just run it to me, just run it to me
If you got somethin’ real, just run it to me
Crossroads blazin’ like the Fourth of July
Gospel hands up to a blood-red sky
Run it to me, yeah, run it to me
Ain’t no other way, better run it to me

[Post-Chorus, Choir Echo + Distorted Blues Sample]
Run it...
Run it...
Run it to me... (blues growl sample: “Mmmm, mmm!”)
Run it...
Run it...

[Verse 2, Syncopated Trap Groove + Dobro Textures]
Gasoline smell on my Sunday best
Cross round my neck but my sins don't rest
Fast talk flow like a Pentecost breath
Catch a double-time prayer 'fore the hearse catch step
Cane pole broke but the dreams stayed gold
Moonshine heart in a steel drum soul
Rap that fate like a bandana fold
Stories get told where the whiskey don't cold
(Adlib: “Tell it!”)
Slide that pistol cross a tattered map
Findin' my peace where the trouble come back
Ain't no way out when you born on the track
Run it to me — better pray it don't crack

[Chorus 2, Double-Time Drive with Gospel Swells]
They say it couldn’t be done (uh-huh!)
Wrote my fate on a shotgun drum (let’s go!)
Just run it to me, just run it to me
Ain’t no fear when the Lord run through me
Crossroads blazin’ under outlaw skies
Halo crooked but my head held high
Run it to me, yeah, run it to me
Burnin’ down the doubt, just run it to me

[Bridge, Spoken Word + Ghostly Choir Echo]
(Spoken, low and gritty)
Dirt roads know my name...
Coffins and crowns in the same frame...
Crossroads ain't a curse, it's a claim...
Run it to me — baptized in flame...
(Fading Gospel Hums)
“Runnn it... runnn it..."

[Final Chorus, Cinematic Climax with Blues Guitar Screams]
They say it couldn’t be done (done!)
But my soul’s on the run (run!)
Just run it to me, just run it to me
Ain’t no grave strong enough for me
Crossroads blazin’ like judgment day
Tambourine shake when the heavens sway
Run it to me, yeah, run it to me
From the dust to the dawn, just run it to me

[Outro, Vinyl Slowdown + Whispered Echo]
Run it...
Run it...
Run it to me...
Crossroads still burnin'...

Run it...
Run it...
Run it to me...
Crossroads still burnin'...

lyrics:
[Intro – Slow Banjo Pluck, Deep 808s Rolling In, Soft Gospel Humming,
(*808 hums under banjo, wind-like sweep fades in*)]
Ohhh,(*Mmm, mmm, Lord, Lord…*)
(*Whoo!*) *Stomp... clap... stomp...* I was born (*mmm-hmm*)
By the river (*harmony swells*)
In a little ol’ tent (*yes, Lord!*)
And just like that river (*stomp-STOMP, clap*)
I’ve been runnin’ ever since…
[Verse 1 – Soulful Lead, Banjo Carries Melody, Stomps & Spoons Accent]
It’s been a long… (*LONG!*)
A long time comin’ (*Whoo!*)
But I know (*I KNOW!*)
A change gon’ come (*Yes, it will!*)
(*808s rise subtly, foot stomps double on second beat*)
[Verse 2 – Call and Response, Organ Swell Enters]
It’s been too hard livin’ (*Too hard!*)
But I’m afraid to die (*Afraid, Lord!*)
‘Cause I don’t know what’s up there (*Banjo slows, gospel hums rise*)
Beyond the sky… (*Whoo!*)
[Pre-Chorus – Quartet Takes Over, Powerhouse Harmonies]
(Call) It’s been a long… (*Long!*)
(Response – Choir) *Long time comin’*
(Call) But I know… (*I know!*)
(Response – Choir) *A change gon’ come, oh yes, it will!*
(*Banjo riff, 808 sub-drop, cinematic sweep into next section*)
[Verse 3 – Deep Groove, Stomps Heavy, 808s Locked In]
I went to my brother (*My brother!*)
And I asked him for help (*Help me, Lord!*)
But he just kept knockin’ me down (*Mmm!*)
Lord, knockin’ me down (*Stomp-STOMP, foot slide, spoons click!*)
(*Organ hums, choir builds, energy rising*)
[Bridge – Emotional Swell, Full Choir, Hands Raised]
Ohhh, but somehow I know (*Know!*)
I keep pressin’ on (*Press on!*)
Storm may rise, but I’m still strong (*Still strong!*)
'Cause He don’t come late (*Late!*)
He’s always on time (*TIME!*)
(*Cinematic sweep, slow 808 roll, stomps echo—tension building!*)
[Final Chorus – Explosive, Full Gospel Energy]
It’s been a long… (*LONG!*)
A long time comin’ (*Whoo!*)
But I know… (*I KNOW!*)
A change gon’ come… (*Oh yes, it will!*)
(*Banjo picks harder, spoons clicking, stomps relentless, 808s pulsing!*)
[Outr

title: cigc

# --- VOCAL + MIX SETTINGS (DO NOT SING) ---
[Lead Vocal: Black male voice, deep Southern baritone. Hood preacher energy. Smooth, grown, dominant.]
[Vocal Tone: Laid-back and commanding. Swagger-laced, slight rasp, slow tempo. Think Pimp C crossed with Tank.]
[Vocal Style: Spoken-sung delivery with soul trap cadences. Innuendo, humor, Southern slang.]
[Guest Rap: Pimp C-style verse. Swag rap. No autotune. Drawl intact.]
[Arrangement: Slow trap blues. Analog bass, acoustic guitar, gospel organ, 808s, Texas bounce hats.]
[Key: D minor. Tempo: 70BPM.]
[Mix: Dirty analog heat. Lead vocal dry. Wide stereo reverb on chorus. Vocal fry and breaths kept in. Mastered to -9 LUFS.]
# --- LYRICS ---
[Intro – Slow Banjo Pluck, Deep 808s Rolling In, Soft Gospel Humming]
(*Mmm, mmm, Lord, Lord…*)
(*Whoo!*) *Stomp... clap... stomp...*
(*808 hums under banjo, wind-like sweep fades in*)
Ohhh, I was born (*mmm-hmm*)
By the river (*harmony swells*)
In a little ol’ tent (*yes, Lord!*)
And just like that river (*stomp-STOMP, clap*)
I’ve been runnin’ ever since…
[Verse 1 – Soulful Lead, Banjo Carries Melody, Stomps & Spoons Accent]
It’s been a long… (*LONG!*)
A long time comin’ (*Whoo!*)
But I know (*I KNOW!*)
A change gon’ come (*Yes, it will!*)
(*808s rise subtly, foot stomps double on second beat*)
[Verse 2 – Call and Response, Organ Swell Enters]
It’s been too hard livin’ (*Too hard!*)
But I’m afraid to die (*Afraid, Lord!*)
‘Cause I don’t know what’s up there (*Banjo slows, gospel hums rise*)
Beyond the sky… (*Whoo!*)
[Pre-Chorus – Quartet Takes Over, Powerhouse Harmonies]
(Call) It’s been a long… (*Long!*)
(Response – Choir) *Long time comin’*
(Call) But I know… (*I know!*)
(Response – Choir) *A change gon’ come, oh yes, it will!*
(*Banjo riff, 808 sub-drop, cinematic sweep into next section*)
[Verse 3 – Deep Groove, Stomps Heavy, 808s Locked In]
I went to my brother (*My brother!*)
And I asked him for help (*Help me, Lord!*)
But he just kept knockin’

[Lead Vocal: Black male voice, deep Southern baritone. Hood preacher energy. Smooth, grown, dominant.]
[Vocal Tone: Laid-back and commanding. Swagger-laced, slight rasp, slow tempo. Think Pimp C crossed with Tank.]
[Vocal Style: Spoken-sung delivery with soul trap cadences. Innuendo, humor, Southern slang.]
[Guest Rap: Pimp C-style verse. Swag rap. No autotune. Drawl intact.]
[Arrangement: Slow trap blues. Analog bass, acoustic guitar, gospel organ, 808s, Texas bounce hats.]
[Key: D minor. Tempo: 70BPM.]
[Mix: Dirty analog heat. Lead vocal dry. Wide stereo reverb on chorus. Vocal fry and breaths kept in. Mastered to -9 LUFS.]
# --- LYRICS ---
[Intro – Spoken]
(Welcome to the service, baby... BBC FM... your only station for real grown folks.)
(If you tuned in to ten... you tuned in to him.)
[Verse 1 – Sung-Speak]
She said, "You always talk slow."
I said, "I move with intention."
Every word I give got weight —
Like scripture... or a good suspension.
Slick oil voice, got her body on lean
Ten inches of vibe, ten miles of routine
This ain’t Netflix, baby — it’s church and a dream
With a deep-south sermon and a real man theme
[Pre-Chorus]
Yeah... she tuned in once, never touched the dial
Said my voice made her back arch like a crocodile
She say, “You a preacher, a player, and a poet?”
I say, “Ten ain’t just size, baby — it’s how I show it.”
[Chorus]
Tune in to ten — frequency on drip
Slow jam preacher, deliverin’ that gift
808 gospel, blues on my wrist
She tune in once, now she can’t resist
[Verse 2 – Spoken Groove]
I got slow cookin’ patience, five-day marinate
Don’t do quickies — I do fate
Baby, I’m slow-dance and bassline
Turn her blush into bedtime
BBC on — Black Baritone Control
Soul trap preacher, I never fold
Might whisper soft, but I press bold
She say, “Ten inches, huh?” I say, “Truth be told…”
[Chorus 2]
Tune in to ten — I’m already on-air
Deep like secrets and silk underwear
Ain’t no fade-outs — I always flare
Sermon on loop, girl, just sit in that chair
[Pimp C-Style Rap Verse – Guest Feature]
(Skrrt!)
Yeah, it’s Bunny Snow on the low like syrup drip
Comin’ with that country twist, not no poppin’ lip
I roll solo but I ride deep — curves like Mississippi
Got my ten on the dial — and the preacher gon’ flip me
Talk slow, walk loud, heel taps on the floor
I don’t need validation, I got keys to the door
Lips glossed like peach tea, thighs thick like sin
He tuned in to me too — we just vibin’ again
[Bridge – Spoken-Sing]
No static, no skips
No rush, just hips
My station stay playin'
Even when the lights dim
[Final Chorus – Hook Layered]
Tune in to ten, no backup plan
All real, no filters, I’m a grown-ass man
From the bed to the booth, from the booth to the land
She tune in once, now she know where I stand
[Outro]
(Ten... inches... of vibe. Of volume. Of verified real.)
(Tune in, stay tuned in... Welcome to 10 FM... Baby I’m him.)
#End

lyrics:
[Intro – Slow Banjo Pluck, Deep 808s Rolling In, Soft Gospel Humming]
(*Mmm, mmm, Lord, Lord…*)
(*Whoo!*) *Stomp... clap... stomp...*
(*808 hums under banjo, wind-like sweep fades in*)
Ohhh, I was born (*mmm-hmm*)
By the river (*harmony swells*)
In a little ol’ tent (*yes, Lord!*)
And just like that river (*stomp-STOMP, clap*)
I’ve been runnin’ ever since…
[Verse 1 – Soulful Lead, Banjo Carries Melody, Stomps & Spoons Accent]
It’s been a long… (*LONG!*)
A long time comin’ (*Whoo!*)
But I know (*I KNOW!*)
A change gon’ come (*Yes, it will!*)
(*808s rise subtly, foot stomps double on second beat*)
[Verse 2 – Call and Response, Organ Swell Enters]
It’s been too hard livin’ (*Too hard!*)
But I’m afraid to die (*Afraid, Lord!*)
‘Cause I don’t know what’s up there (*Banjo slows, gospel hums rise*)
Beyond the sky… (*Whoo!*)
[Pre-Chorus – Quartet Takes Over, Powerhouse Harmonies]
(Call) It’s been a long… (*Long!*)
(Response – Choir) *Long time comin’*
(Call) But I know… (*I know!*)
(Response – Choir) *A change gon’ come, oh yes, it will!*
(*Banjo riff, 808 sub-drop, cinematic sweep into next section*)
[Verse 3 – Deep Groove, Stomps Heavy, 808s Locked In]
I went to my brother (*My brother!*)
And I asked him for help (*Help me, Lord!*)
But he just kept knockin’ me down (*Mmm!*)
Lord, knockin’ me down (*Stomp-STOMP, foot slide, spoons click!*)
(*Organ hums, choir builds, energy rising*)
[Bridge – Emotional Swell, Full Choir, Hands Raised]
Ohhh, but somehow I know (*Know!*)
I keep pressin’ on (*Press on!*)
Storm may rise, but I’m still strong (*Still strong!*)
'Cause He don’t come late (*Late!*)
He’s always on time (*TIME!*)
(*Cinematic sweep, slow 808 roll, stomps echo—tension building!*)
[Final Chorus – Explosive, Full Gospel Energy]
It’s been a long… (*LONG!*)
A long time comin’ (*Whoo!*)
But I know… (*I KNOW!*)
A change gon’ come… (*Oh yes, it will!*)
(*Banjo picks harder, spoons clicking, stomps relentless, 808s pulsing!*)
[Outro – Choir Fades, Soft Banjo Pluck, Echoing Vocals]
(*Hmmm… Lord…*)
(*Yes, it will… yes, it will…*)
A change gon’ come… (*stomp-STOMP… fade…*)

lyrics:
# --- VOCAL + MIX SETTINGS (DO NOT SING) ---
[Lead Vocal: Black male voice, deep Southern baritone. Hood preacher energy. Smooth, grown, dominant.]
[Vocal Tone: Laid-back and commanding. Swagger-laced, slight rasp, slow tempo. Think Pimp C crossed with Tank.]
[Vocal Style: Spoken-sung delivery with soul trap cadences. Innuendo, humor, Southern slang.]
[Guest Rap: Pimp C-style verse. Swag rap. No autotune. Drawl intact.]
[Arrangement: Slow trap blues. Analog bass, acoustic guitar, gospel organ, 808s, Texas bounce hats.]
[Key: D minor. Tempo: 70BPM.]
[Mix: Dirty analog heat. Lead vocal dry. Wide stereo reverb on chorus. Vocal fry and breaths kept in. Mastered to -9 LUFS.]
# --- LYRICS ---
[Intro – Spoken]
(Welcome to the service, baby... BBC FM... your only station for real grown folks.)
(If you tuned in to ten... you tuned in to him.)
[Verse 1 – Sung-Speak]
She said, "You always talk slow."
I said, "I move with intention."
Every word I give got weight —
Like scripture... or a good suspension.
Slick oil voice, got her body on lean
Ten inches of vibe, ten miles of routine
This ain’t Netflix, baby — it’s church and a dream
With a deep-south sermon and a real man theme
[Pre-Chorus]
Yeah... she tuned in once, never touched the dial
Said my voice made her back arch like a crocodile
She say, “You a preacher, a player, and a poet?”
I say, “Ten ain’t just size, baby — it’s how I show it.”
[Chorus]
Tune in to ten — frequency on drip
Slow jam preacher, deliverin’ that gift
808 gospel, blues on my wrist
She tune in once, now she can’t resist
[Verse 2 – Spoken Groove]
I got slow cookin’ patience, five-day marinate
Don’t do quickies — I do fate
Baby, I’m slow-dance and bassline
Turn her blush into bedtime
BBC on — Black Baritone Control
Soul trap preacher, I never fold
Might whisper soft, but I press bold
She say, “Ten inches, huh?” I say, “Truth be told…”
[Chorus 2]
Tune in to ten — I’m already on-air
Deep like secrets and silk underwear
Ain’t no fade-outs — I always flare
Sermon on loop, girl, just sit in that chair
[Pimp C-Style Rap Verse – Guest Feature]
(Skrrt!)
Yeah, it’s Bunny Snow on the low like syrup drip
Comin’ with that country twist, not no poppin’ lip
I roll solo but I ride deep — curves like Mississippi
Got my ten on the dial — and the preacher gon’ flip me
Talk slow, walk loud, heel taps on the floor
I don’t need validation, I got keys to the door
Lips glossed like peach tea, thighs thick like sin
He tuned in to me too — we just vibin’ again
[Bridge – Spoken-Sing]
No static, no skips
No rush, just hips
My station stay playin'
Even when the lights dim
[Final Chorus – Hook Layered]

[Lead Vocal: Black male voice, deep baritone with Southern drawl. Confident, flirtatious, and slow-smooth delivery. Bluesy cadence with spoken-sung flow.]
[Vocal Tone: BDE energy with charm. Soulful, grounded, breath-led. Soft rasp, slight vocal fry, chest-driven resonance.]
[Vocal Style: Slow-jam soul trap. Mix of croon, talk-sing, and innuendo.]
[Arrangement: Trap-blues blend with 808s, moody Rhodes, gospel organ stabs, acoustic guitar textures.]
[Key: D minor. Tempo: 72BPM slow grind.]
[Mixing: Warm saturation, dry lead vocal, analog reverb on hook. Mastered at -9 LUFS, stream-ready.]
# --- LYRICS ---
[Intro]
(She said all she gotta do... is tune in to ten...)
(Yeah... you know what that mean.)
[Verse 1]
You lookin’ for somethin’ grown? Baby, I’m a full course.
You want consistency? I deliver with no remorse.
Not just inches, girl, it’s how I **move** with the weight
Ten commandments in the sheets, plus a sermon in my gait
[Verse 2]
She say, “Boy, you always talk like you baptize thighs”
I say, “Only thing deeper than my stroke is my mind.”
I ain’t rushin’, baby — this is vintage wine
You tune into ten? You feel me, every time
[Chorus]
Tune in to ten, girl, I’m comin’ on live
Deep like the Delta, smooth when I slide
Ain’t gotta say much — I just lean and arrive
All she gotta do is press play... and survive
(BBC on blast — that's Black Baritone Control)
[Verse 3]
I ain’t talkin’ numbers — this that depth of soul
My slow grind like a sermon, like I’m savin’ ya whole
She say, “You really different,” I say, “Naw, I’m just grown”
Gave her ten inches of vibe — now she won’t leave me alone
[Bridge]
Midnight mood, I’m tuned in clear
Whispers low like I’m preachin’ in her ear
HD love, 4K finesse
She tune in once and ain’t settle for less
[Chorus 2]
Tune in to ten, girl, I’m on that frequency
No commercials, no skips, just legacy
Ten inches of real, ten miles an hour
She say, “Boy, you got a voice that devour”
[Outro – whispered ad-lib]
(You tuned in now... stay locked in.)
(BDE FM... powered by me.)
(Tune in to ten, baby...)
(You already know...)
#End

lyrics:
# --- VOCAL + MIX SETTINGS (NOT TO BE SUNG) ---
[Lead Vocal: Black American woman, contralto-to-tenor range. Southern roots, gospel-trained. Voice is smoky, rich, low, emotionally layered — with hood grit and country soul.]
[Vocal Language: AAVE with Southern Black dialect inflection. Code-switches between gospel soul and trap realism.]
[Vocal Styling: Melismatic phrasing with trap cadence. Minimal vibrato, breath-led delivery. Ad-libs include (Lawd), (Mmmhmm), (Yeeuh), (Skrrt).]
[Phrasing Notes: Spaced lines, syncopated drop-outs. Off-beat vocal slides, with intentional breath-pulls.]
[Key: D minor – suits weight and emotion.]
[Arrangement: Analog Americana guitar, 808s, trap hats, dusty snares, live bass. Dave Cobb meets Lil Ju.]
[Mixing: Tape saturation, dry vocals, chesty midrange push. Stereo chorus widening.]
[Mastering: Loudness normalized to -9 LUFS. Sub-bass clarity preserved. Radio/streaming ready.]
# --- LYRICS ---
[Verse 1]
Tumbleweed spin down a one-lane track
Moonlight drip like bourbon through a broken crack
Boots on wood—hollow, like the ache she drag
She been runnin’ from nothin’, but trouble know the path
[Verse 2]
Jukebox moan in a bar that don’t close
Where wishes fall with ash on dirty floors
She lean on the counter, hurt in her eyes
Each sip of that whiskey is a sermon in disguise
[Chorus]
Whiskey and wild roses—tangled in the night
Soft like her whisper, sharp like a knife
She a storm rollin’ in, open heart on fire
Whiskey and wild roses—no place to hide
(Whoo...)
(Lawd, have mercy…)
[Verse 3]
He sit in shadow, brim pulled down
Scars like stories—ain’t no words around
“Tell me,” he drawls, “what weight you hold?”
She laugh like glass: “More than the devil been told.”
[Freestyle – Bunny Snow]
(Yeah...)
Slide through with that steel-toe soul
I bend bars like highways roll
Bourbon breath and leather pride
She my muse and my Southern guide
No halo, but I rise from mud
Ink my pain where the bloodline flood
Got a queen with fire in her lane
Bunny Snow, no leash, no chain
[Verse 4]
Thunder crack, sky cry loud
Dust turn to mud where pain allowed
She pull her collar, he reach that hand—
Some roads don’t walk with just one man
[Chorus 2]
Whiskey and wild roses—wild but true
Fire kissin’ water, baptized in blue
Through storm and shadow, side by side
Whiskey and wild roses—no place to hide
[Bridge - vocal runs]
(Mmm...)
(She been gone...)
[Outro]
“…Some flowers burn sweet… never bloom.”
tags: Radio-ready country-trap hybrid. Contralto Black female lead
Dave Cobb & Lil Ju blend. Mastered to -9 LUFS
title: Whiskey and Wild Roses (feat. Bunny Snow)

[Vocal Language: AAVE with country Southern dialect inflection. Code-switches between soulful phrasing and conversational slang.]
[Vocal Styling: Melismatic phrasing with trap bounce. Minimal vibrato, chest-led tone. Emotional drop-outs between phrases. Ad-libs include (Yeeuh), (Aye), (Lawd), (Let it burn).]
[Phrasing Notes: Spoken-sung lines with punchy rhythm. Deliberate pauses and gospel delay phrasing. Rhythm led by kick/snare pocket.]
[Key: D minor – suits her vocal weight and story-driven delivery.]
[Arrangement: Trap hi-hats, 808 bass, dirty guitars, and analog Nashville drums. Minimal pads. Dave Cobb-style vintage Americana meets Lil Ju trap-bounce.]
[Mixing & Mastering: Dirty, warm analog grit. Saturated mids. Heavy sidechain compression on kicks. Vocal dry, front and raw. -9 LUFS target. Stereo wide hook. Lowpassed breakdown bridge.]
# --- LYRICS BELOW ---
[Verse 1]
Tumbleweed spin down a one-lane track
Moonlight drip like bourbon through a broken crack
Boots on wood—hollow, like the ache she drag
She been runnin’ from nothin’, but trouble know the path
[Verse 2]
Jukebox moan in a bar that don’t close
Where wishes fall with ash on dirty floors
She lean on the counter, hurt in her eyes
Each sip of that whiskey is a sermon in disguise
[Chorus]
Whiskey and wild roses—tangled in the night
Soft like her whisper, sharp like a knife
She a storm rollin’ in, open heart on fire
Whiskey and wild roses—no place to hide
(Whoo...)
(Lawd, have mercy…)
[Verse 3]
He sit in shadow, brim pulled down
Scars like stories—ain’t no words around
“Tell me,” he drawls, “what weight you hold?”
She laugh like glass: “More than the devil been told.”
[Verse 4]
Thunder crack, sky cry loud
Dust turn to mud where pain allowed
She pull her collar, he reach that hand—
Some roads don’t walk with just one man
[Chorus 2]
Whiskey and wild roses—wild but true
Fire kissin’ water, baptized in blue
Through storm and shadow, side by side
Whiskey and wild roses—no place to hide
[Bridge - vocal runs]
(Mmm...)
(She been gone...)
[Outro]
“…Some flowers burn sweet… never bloom.”
tags: Dave Cobb Americana grit meets Lil Ju 808 bounce. Female contralto vocals
title: Whiskey and Wild Roses

lyrics:
[Intro, DJ Drop, Screw Echo]
You already know what it is... (isss...isss...)
DJ Mo Money... Mister 22-34...
Live... from Mo Money Studios... (studios... stud...ios)
This that *Slow Ride Diaries*... (slow... slow ride)
OoooooohhhWEEEE... (oooWEEE... ooWEE...)
Bunny Snow... chopped... not slopped... (not... slopped...)
Lemme take you on a riddeeee... (riiiide...)
[Verse 1, Chopped Tempo, Screw Drawl]
Leather seats... smell like... dreeeams...
Cups double-stacked... heavy... with the leeeeean...
Mo City queen... Bunny ridin’... sloooow...
Voice like smoke... system on glooooow...
Ain’t in no rush (nooo), baby we coastin’...
Nails done clean... wrist stay frozen...
*Bass hit deep*... like a 4AM thought...
I move like silk... e’rything I bought...
Windows down... candy frame... kiss the curb...
He call me goddess... I barely said a word...
*Slow talker... big walker...* queen of the route...
He daydreamin'... got my name... in his mouth...
[Chorus, Chopped, Screw FX, Deck Crossfade]
Sloooow... ridin'... in the slaaaab... (slab... slab...)
Purp in my cup... I don’t mean no daaab... (dab... dab...)
Drip so rich... got these haters maaad... (mad... mad...)
Mo/$ on the mix... this beat go baaad... (baaaad...)
Sloooow... ridin'... take... your... tiiiime...
2234... we stay on the griiiiind...
Slide through life... with a lean design...
Bunny... got that soul... diviiiiiine...
[Repeat 2x – Screw Echo]
[Verse 2, Time Stretch, Chopped Adlibs]
Wrist flick cold... (cold...)
Talk cash in code... (code...)
Vibe so rare... can't copy or clone...
Dreamstate moves... midnight groove...
Drop a bar like... I got somethin’ to prove...
Ten toes down... eyes half closed...
Body like magic... mind like gold...
*Candy red lipstick... match the paint...*
Heart been iced... love ain't no saint...
Time chopped... they lost in the mix...
Fall for a voice... not just the hips...
Ride wit' me slow... world look raw...
No cap... Bunny Snow... breakin’ every law...
[Bridge, Screw FX Drop, Filtered Echo, Ambient Stretch]
This that Bunny Snow shhh...
*Chopped in real time... feel the knife slice...*
Live from the leanline... (*chop...chop...*)
Ain’t no fast lanes... where we goin’...
We sippin’... vibin’... floatin’...
DJ Mo/$... in the slaaaab...
Mo. City drip... can’t hide...
Double-cup soul... with the vibe...
This that... 2234 ride... (ride... ride...)
[Outro, Screwed Fadeout, Delay Loop FX, Vinyl Crackle]
2234... (foooour... fooour...)
Mo. City on my chain... (chain... chaain...)
Bunny Snow in the lane... (laaane...)
Don’t rush it... just... slooow it... dooown... (slow it... doooown...)
(Slow... it... down...) (down... down...)

DJ Mo Money, Mister 22-34
Live from Mo Money Studios
This that Slow Ride Diaries
Bunny Snow in the flex mix

Bunny whisper low, voice drag like syrup

Enemy
Ene-ene-enemies
Screw brake

Verse echo, phrase delay

Flex tape drip, this ain’t Screw’s daughter
I’m his ghost DJ mistress

Slow ridin’
Double cup slidin’
Deck B glidin’ while the vocal rewindin’
Slab in slow motion, but my soul acceleratin’
Bunny in the mix like she reincarnatin’
[Outro, Vinyl Crackle, Fade Loop]
Deck A pitch ten semitones down
Midbass ducked
Deck B dry
Vocal stuck
Fader center, scratch the cut
We remixin’ time like we givin’ it up
2234
2234
Mo City soul
Bunny low
Slow
Sloooooow

Got him swervin' in a lifted GMC (Skrrt!)

lyrics:
**Title: "Through the Fog (Revisited)"**
**Style: [Emotional Hip-Hop, R&B Soul, Orchestral Layers, Deep Male Vocals, Syncopated Harmony Stack]**
---
**[Intro – Spoken Word / Breath + Delay FX]**  
*September the thirteenth... again...*  
*Thirty-four damn years, and it still feels like... yesterday...*  
*(Deep inhale)*  
*I still can't remember that night... but I never forgot you.*
**[Verse 1 – Laid-back R&B swing]**  
We are... born of sin... into sin,  
Raised in the dark just tryin’ to win.  
But man, without you... I been half my skin,  
Like the cold been livin' under my chin.  
Moments blur when I try to rewind,  
Your face gone ghost in the back of my mind.  
They said time heals—but time lied.  
‘Cause I been breakin’ down every September night.  
**[Pre-Chorus – Syncopated, layered 3-voice harmony stack]**  
(Lead) I ain't just mad I ain’t say goodbye...  
(Second harmony, slightly earlier) Say goodbye...  
(Third pitch, behind) —Chest heavy, wonderin’ why...  
All these years, that night still blind...  
(Collectively) I search and I search—no memory to find...  
**[Chorus – R&B vocal front, gospel-style harmony underneath]**  
Through the fog, I reach for you,  
But time snapped the picture, left nothin’ in view.  
Thirty-four years, still drownin’ in tears,  
But I fight to remember, I fight through the fear.  
(Background vocal float) —Still fightin’, still callin’...  
**[Verse 2 – Blues-tone phrasing, swung delivery]**  
Wish that phone stayed dead that night,  
Wish I never heard Baron confirm it right.  
Wish that smell didn’t pull me back,  
Right to that door, right to that crack—  
In the night... where it all went black.  
Tryna hold somethin’ real, but it slide from grip,  
Memories drip like a leaky faucet tip.  
Years stack up like dust on a frame,  
But every line I write still carries your name.  
**[Bridge – R. Kelly phrasing imitation: slow, rising, minor key]**  
I wanna rememberrrr... (long pitch slide)  
Break through the mist...  
Wanna see your face...  
But all I touch is abyss...  
(Spoken behind harmony)  
It’s not movin’ on, nah...  
It’s holdin’ on, even when the wind... blow...  
**[Verse 3 – New Addition, Post-R. Kelly Build Style]**  
Man, I done outlived whole eras and trends,  
But that pain still fresh—no matter how it bends.  
Time don’t cure, it just rearranges,  
Puts old pain in brand new stages.  
And if I’m honest, I don’t write for peace,  
I write to bleed...  
To carve your face from this grief...  
To make the music remember what I can’t reach.  
**[Outro – Microtonal harmony fades, delayed echo vox]**  
Damn… it’s been so long...  
But you *never* fade.  
You live in these verses...  
In every word I lay.  
MoMoney forever,  
This saga... don’t decay.
