title: Through the Fog (Revisited)

lyrics:
[Intro, Vinyl Dust, Thunder Cracks]
Take your time, son...
It’s easy to get in — damn near impossible to get out.
They called me O.G. like it was a badge,
But that name?
That name was a funeral song in disguise.
You ain’t never met the devil
‘til he gave you money *and* a reason not to go home.
[Verse 1, Preacher Flow, Organ Pads]
They say I ruined every Christmas.
Twenty-two times I shoulda stayed gone.
But they called me.
And I came.
Was any of it real?
Or was I just useful
When things got ugly and girls went missin’?
There’s only two sides in the game:
Pimps and dealers.
And I was both.
Until I chose out.
Walked away —
‘Cause I got daughters now.
And every woman?
She somebody’s baby girl.
Somebody’s momma.
[Verse 2, Whisper Falsetto, Trap Kick Creeps In]
Got a call from my wife’s best friend.
Said her goddaughter got caught in the Texas flood.
Ain’t seen her in six years —
Last time I did, her folks took me in like kin.
Fed me. Housed me.
Called me ‘son’ when I had none of my own.
But my wife?
She told me “That girl chose that life.”
Still — her momma called me direct.
And when a mother calls?
You answer.
[Bridge, Dragged Vocals, Thunder Rolls]
So I strap up...
Slide them colors back on.
Knowing I just reopened Pandora’s Box.
A billion-dollar beast I tried to bury.
I stop at the same gas station from back in ’99.
And a woman behind me says a name I ain’t heard
Since I was sixteen
And too dumb to run.
[Breakdown, Minimal Beat, Ghost Choir]
That name...
And now I gotta choose.
Because stepping in?
That means I adopt her.
AND her momma.
Ain’t no halfway protection.
You don’t dabble in resurrection.
You baptize or you burn.
[Outro, Organ Swell, Vinyl Crackle]
I remember when I got her and her brother that old Dell computer.
They cried.
Said I gave them hope.
And now she standin’ here...
Beautiful. Unguarded. But not yet spoiled.
And I know —
If I step in?
I’m not just protecting her from the streets.
I’m protecting *me*
From the man I used to be.
But I already opened the door.
Already saw her eyes.
And damn…
I think I already did it.
Again.

lyrics:
[Production Notes:
This version opens with angry female spoken word over dry, muted kick — no melody, just breath and bitterness.
As the verse unfolds, a raw Southern Black choir enters with disharmonized minor chord echoes.
Snare arrives like a heartbeat breaking free.
Instruments only enter as accents — organ drone, sub bass, chopped fx appear only after vocal climax.
Emotion > Perfection. Tension is the glue.]
[Intro – Spoken Word, Dry Kick Only]
(dry muted kick: 4-count loop)
Lead (sharp, pissed):
"I ain’t scared of you.
You walk like a king, but you creep like a coward.
Say my name all low — say it loud.
DEATH.
You can’t have me."
(pause. breath. inhale like thunder.)
"Not today."
[Verse 1 – Spoken-Sing Hybrid, Dry Kick + Snare Enters Slowly]
"I felt you behind me —
Boots in my kitchen, breath on my bed.
You think I ain't seen you?
You BEEN in my head."
"Mama said light a candle.
Daddy said pour a drink.
I just closed my eyes and prayed
that I don’t overthink."
(snare hits once — ghost echo trail)
"You don’t knock loud —
You just stand there.
But I hear you anyway.
You want me scared?"
[Choir Enters – Minor Harmony Echoes, Imperfect and Raw]
*(Choir hum enters in minor; not tight, just thick)
Choir (response, low):
“Not today…”
Lead (sharp): “I SAID NOT TODAY.”
Choir (rising): “You can’t have her…”
Lead (building): “YOU DON’T OWN THIS BREATH.”
[Bridge – Beat Build, Organ Enters, Choir Swells]
(organ enters under, low and dirty)
(snare now steady, kick thickens)
Lead:
"I still got breath.
I still got fight.
You circle me daily,
But you won’t win tonight."
(Choir builds into a wall — wailing minor chords over lead’s major scale phrasing)
[Final Chorus – Full Layer, Tension Peaking]
Lead (full belt):
"O DEATH — I WON’T KNEEL!
I still breathe DEEP!
My soul ain’t clean —
But it ain’t YOURS to KEEP!"
Choir (off-key echo, swelling):
“Not yours… not yours… not yours…”
(sub bass rumbles under the choir. final organ chord holds.)
[Outro – Fade on Breath + Organ Ring]
Lead (half-whispered):
"You didn’t write my name.
So you don’t get to end it."
(beat stops. organ fades. breath lingers.)
title: Not Today

Boots in my kitchen, breath on my bed.
You think I ain't seen you?
You BEEN in my head."
"Mama said light a candle.
Daddy said pour a drink.
I just closed my eyes and prayed
that I don’t overthink."
(snare hits once — ghost echo trail)
"You don’t knock loud —
You just stand there.
But I hear you anyway.
You want me scared?"
[Choir Enters – Minor Harmony Echoes, Imperfect and Raw]
*(Choir hum enters in minor; not tight, just thick)
Choir (response, low):
“Not today…”
Lead (sharp): “I SAID NOT TODAY.”
Choir (rising): “You can’t have her…”
Lead (building): “YOU DON’T OWN THIS BREATH.”
[Bridge – Beat Build, Organ Enters, Choir Swells]
(organ enters under, low and dirty)
(snare now steady, kick thickens)
Lead:
"I still got breath.
I still got fight.
You circle me daily,
But you won’t win tonight."
(Choir builds into a wall — wailing minor chords over lead’s major scale phrasing)
[Final Chorus – Full Layer, Tension Peaking]
Lead (full belt):
"O DEATH — I WON’T KNEEL!
I still breathe DEEP!
My soul ain’t clean —
But it ain’t YOURS to KEEP!"
Choir (off-key echo, swelling):
“Not yours… not yours… not yours…”
(sub bass rumbles under the choir. final organ chord holds.)
[Outro – Fade on Breath + Organ Ring]
Lead (half-whispered):
"You didn’t write my name.
So you don’t get to end it."
(beat stops. organ fades. breath lingers.)
title: Not Today

Tumbleweed spin down a one-lane track,  
Moonlight drip like bourbon through a broken crack.  
Boots on wood—hollow, like the ache she drag,  
Duckin' the past, but trouble know the track.
[Verse 2] [Music: Low fiddle subtle entry, soft trap hats, organ pads behind] [Vocal: Bluesy phrase, grit]
Jukebox moan in a bar that don’t close,  
Where wishes fall with ash on dirty floors.  
She lean on the counter, hurt in her eyes,  
Every shot of whiskey preachin' truths she hide.
[Chorus] [Music: 808 full, strong gospel harms, slide prominent] [Vocal: Power delivery, reverb, harms support]
Whiskey and wild roses—tangled in the night,  
Soft like her whisper, sharp like a knife.  
She a storm rollin’ in, open heart on fire,  
Whiskey and wild roses—no place to hide.
[Adlib: Whoo... (fry, offbeat echo)] [Adlib: Lawd, have mercy… (spoken, low, cracked)]
[Verse 3] [Music: Slide/shamisen trade licks, beat maintains] [Vocal: Conversational drawl, breath audible]
He sit in shadow, brim pulled down,  
Scars like stories—ain’t no words around.  
“Tell me,” he drawls, “what weight you hold?”  
She laugh like glass: “More than the devil been told.”

Thunder crack, sky cry loud,  
Dust turn to mud, where her pain touched ground.  
She pull her collar, he reach that hand—  
This kinda darkness take more than one man.

Whiskey and wild roses—wild but true,  
Fire kissin’ water, baptized in blue.  
Through storm and shadow, side by side,  
Whiskey and wild roses—no place to hide.
[Adlib: Mmm... (microtonal hum)] [Adlib: She been gone... (off-beat, ingressive whisper)]
[Bridge] [Music: Cinematic slow, 808 thin/filter, banjo echo wide, slide mimics vocal bend w/ harm] [Vocal: Floating phrase, short delay trail, ambient] [Atmosphere: Spacey, reflective]
[Outro] [Music: Ambient slide, whistle over pad, tape hiss up, rain fade] [Atmosphere: Fading, unresolved] [Final shamisen pluck echo/decay] [Soft breath trail] [Spoken: “…Some flowers burn sweet… never bloom.” (whispered late, heavy fry)]

lyrics:
[Intro, slide guitar, shamisen plucks, ambient gospel pad, vinyl crackle, slow 808]
(Wind hums… fingers slide wood… whistle register in the distance… ingressive breath)
[Soul Prophet – Verse 1, laid-back drawl, slow bounce pocket]
Yeah...
Hunnid-proof sins in a brown bag prayer,
Told that girl, “Keep walkin’, devil still there.”
Smoke got a sermon, sip got a truth,
Pain like a preacher that don’t pass the roof.
She lean in the light like a jukebox ghost,
Glass in her voice when she say that toast:
“To every man that left, and every night I bled—
I ain’t drinkin’ to forget. I’m drinkin’ what they said.”
Slide strum moan when the moon come in,
Shamisen cry like a blade on skin.
I seen that hurt, I done poured that fire—
Some roses bloom wild, some bloom in the mire.
[Chorus Fragment – Gospel Female Vocal (sampled, chopped)]
*Whiskey and wild roses… no place to—*
*—hide...* (echoes off)
[Memphis Rasp Queen – Verse 2, behind-the-beat raspy tone, vocal fry adlibs]
(Frrt… ayy b*tch...)
Mud on my boots, breath smell like smoke,
Tears in my bra, but I still won’t choke.
Came from a place where the prayers go broke,
And the choir gone hum when the preacher provoke.
Knock if you want, I don’t flinch no mo’
I was raised where the pain don’t knock—it blow.
Lil’ girl with a knife and a Sunday dress,
Turned grown off heartbreak and a welfare check.
Y’all talk love—I talk loss,
My verses? Bruises with a gloss.
Ask me how I’m doin’? *Sh*t, I’m breathin’.*
Soul still cracked, but my foot still leanin’.
[Chorus – Dual Line Trade-Off, Half-Time Flow]
(Soul Prophet):
Whiskey and wild roses—
(Rasp Queen):
Scars where the thorn exposes—
(Soul Prophet):
Runnin’ from the rain with the bottle uncapped—
(Rasp Queen):
Heart so loud it made the thunder clap—
[Final Section: Fast-Paced Rap-Sing Circle]
[Tempo Shift: 78 → 95 BPM]
(Soul Prophet):
See her eyes? That’s gospel cracked.
(Rasp Queen):
And my voice? That’s pain talkin’ back.
(Soul Prophet
title: Whiskey & WR

title: Tek These Chains 2

lyrics:

(I’m tired of runnin’)
(I’m tired of runnin’)
Dem shadows nuh sleep, dem crawl, dem bite
Mi call pon God, but Him silent tonight
[Verse 1, Male Voice, Dancehall Flow]
Mi walk wid a limp—nah physical, nah
Is grief in mi spine, soul wearin’ a scar
Mi holdin’ a brother who... didn’t move, didn’t speak
Cold tears pon mi hand, him breath growin’ weak
Mi trust dem wid blood, dem tek mi breath
Mi fight fi dem life, dem left mi fi death
Mi eyes dem dry but mi heart still floodin’
Mi mind full a war but mi face say nothin’
[Pre-Chorus, Female Voice, Gospel Harmony]
Thirty years in di silence, thirty in di dark
Mi smile in pictures, but mi soul fall apart
Mi can't fake joy, mi can't wear this mask
Mi only ask one ting—mi only have one ask
[Chorus, Male & Female Voices, Emotional Gospel Burst]
Tek these chains offa mi
Mi cyah breathe inna prison of memory
You say loyalty, but it was mockery
Mi give yuh mi soul, now mi waan mi piece
Tek these chains offa mi
[Verse 2, Female Voice, Bluegrass Melody Layered]
Mi dance in di fire, mi love through di crash
Yuh tek mi calm, leave mi with ash
Mi hold yuh pain while mi own was deep
Yuh lie pon mi chest while mi cry in mi sleep
Mi see yuh hands, but dem cold like stone
Yuh say mi safe, but mi always alone
Yuh tek a man who fight fi freedom n’ life

[Bridge, Harmonized, Gospel Choir]
(Tek, tek, tek it away)
Every nightmare, every scream mi hide
(Chains, chains, break away)
Mi tired of fear mi cya confide
[Chorus, Full Harmony, Driving Percussion]
Tek these chains offa mi
Mi cyah live when mi locked in grief
Yuh seh love, but it was trickery
Mi give yuh mi soul, now mi waan mi peace
Tek these chains offa mi
[Break, Patois Chant, Sparse Banjo + Kick Drum]
Mi cyah fake smiles no more
Mi spirit raw, mi nah ignore
Mi hear dem voices inna mi sleep
Beggin’ mi soul fi one release
[Outro, Whispered + Soaring Femal

title: Tek These Chains

lyrics:
[Intro, slide guitar, shamisen plucks, ambient gospel pad, vinyl crackle, slow 808]
(Wind hums… fingers slide wood… whistle register in the distance… ingressive breath)

[Soul Prophet – Verse 1, laid-back drawl, slow bounce pocket]
Yeah...
Hunnid-proof sins in a brown bag prayer,
Told that girl, “Keep walkin’, devil still there.”
Smoke got a sermon, sip got a truth,
Pain like a preacher that don’t pass the roof.  

She lean in the light like a jukebox ghost,
Glass in her voice when she say that toast:
“To every man that left, and every night I bled—
I ain’t drinkin’ to forget. I’m drinkin’ what they said.”

Slide strum moan when the moon come in,
Shamisen cry like a blade on skin.
I seen that hurt, I done poured that fire—
Some roses bloom wild, some bloom in the mire.

[Chorus Fragment – Gospel Female Vocal (sampled, chopped)]
*Whiskey and wild roses… no place to—*
*—hide...* (echoes off)

[Memphis Rasp Queen – Verse 2, behind-the-beat raspy tone, vocal fry adlibs]
(Frrt… ayy b*tch...)
Mud on my boots, breath smell like smoke,
Tears in my bra, but I still won’t choke.
Came from a place where the prayers go broke,
And the choir gone hum when the preacher provoke.

Knock if you want, I don’t flinch no mo’
I was raised where the pain don’t knock—it blow.
Lil’ girl with a knife and a Sunday dress,
Turned grown off heartbreak and a welfare check.

Y’all talk love—I talk loss,
My verses? Bruises with a gloss.
Ask me how I’m doin’? *Sh*t, I’m breathin’.*
Soul still cracked, but my foot still leanin’.

[Chorus – Dual Line Trade-Off, Half-Time Flow]
(Soul Prophet):
Whiskey and wild roses—
(Rasp Queen):
Scars where the thorn exposes—
(Soul Prophet):
Runnin’ from the rain with the bottle uncapped—
(Rasp Queen):
Heart so loud it made the thunder clap—

[Final Section: Fast-Paced Rap-Sing Circle]
[Tempo Shift: 78 → 95 BPM]
(Soul Prophet):
See her eyes? That’s gospel cracked.
(Rasp Queen):
And my voice? That’s pain talkin’ back.

(Soul Prophet):
Syrup in the glass, sins in the rear—
(Rasp Queen):
Truth in my throat, and the end feel near.

(Soul Prophet):
Walk through flames, my boots still holy—
(Rasp Queen):
Roses in my grip, and the blade move slowly.

(Soul Prophet):
Fade into the night, voice like a hymn—
(Rasp Queen):
Grin in the dark, where the hope go dim.

(Both – overlap):
Whiskey... and wild... roooooses...
(*one long harmony held, layered with pitch drops + breath trails*)

[Outro – Reprise the Spoken Line (dual delivery)]
(Soul Prophet, whisper):
“Some flowers burn sweet…”
(Rasp Queen, rasped fry):
“…never bloom.”

[Thunder fades. Whistle lingers. Shamisen pluck. Silence.]

lyrics:
[Verse]
Raised in the dirt, now my roots run deep,
Came for the feast, now the wolves won’t sleep.
Steel fangs flash when the game gets grim,
Cash on my mind, blood drip from the brim.

[Chorus]
Fangs out sharp, cut the dark, I’m a beast,
Chain heavy like the weight of the feast.
Hunt in the shadows, stalk through the night,
Step to the throne, better move, take flight.

[Verse 2]
Grind like gears, ribs touch from the hustle,
Split the whole game like a deck when you shuffle.
Stone cold path leads straight to the loot,
Spit on the crown, dressed sick like a suit.

[Bridge]
Hollow tips breeze when you speak my name,
Born in the fire, can’t fake my flame.
South code runnin', deep veins of the bayou,
You freeze up, boy, that’s a nobody I knew.

[Chorus]
Fangs out sharp, cut the dark, I’m a beast,
Chain heavy like the weight of the feast.
Hunt in the shadows, stalk through the night,
Step to the throne, better move, take flight.

[Verse 3]
Swamp water soul, venom in the verbs,
Every bar hit, leave ya head disturbed.
Roll with the pack, ain't no lone wolf here,
Got the growl so loud, make the prey disappear.

lyrics:

Drums hittin' harder than a steel-toe boot,
Grime on my grind, yet my pockets bear fruit.
Steppin' through the swamp with a venomous charm,
Snakes try to hiss, but I keep my chain warm.

[Chorus]
Chain clangin', heavy as the words I spit,
Cash talk dirty; my hustle too legit.
Deep in the pocket where the snare drum sit,
Every word a bullet, every bar gon' hit.

[Verse 2]
Bassline stomp like it's doin' construction,
Blueprint sharp; never need instructions.
Big dog's bark while the lil' ones tremble,
Beat like a beast; call it heavy instrumental.

[Bridge]
Staccato delivery: sniper with precision,
Every kick-snare like I made an incision.
Heart full of fire, hands full of ambition,
Every hook sharp while the haters keep wishin'.

[Chorus]
Chain clangin', heavy as the words I spit,
Cash talk dirty; my hustle too legit.
Deep in the pocket where the snare drum sit,
Every word a bullet, every bar gon' hit.

[Verse 3]
Aggression in my tone, baritone thick grind,
Write my own throne, never spoke through a pipeline.
Climbing out the pit where the heat got grimy,
Even shadows fear how the glow stay blinding.

lyrics:
[Intro, slide guitar lead, banjo plucks, ambient textures, sub bass fade-in]  
(Faint vinyl crackle… slow banjo rolls echo… slide guitar bends with reverb trail)  
[Spoken Word, male southern baritone, whispered tone]  
"Backroads and broken wings… that’s how we learned to fly."

[Verse 1, slow trap groove, trap hats, lo-fi snare]  
Mud on my boots, soul in my chest,  
Kept my demons in drive, never gave 'em rest.  
Moonshine dreams in a hollowed-out flask,  
bassline low, let the memories pass.  

[Pre-Chorus, ambient build, fiddle enters, soft pads]  
(Whistle wind, tires hum, sub bass glide)  
Smoke in the mirror, voices in the pine.  
Old ghosts ride with me every time.  
Crickets sing while the 808s slide—  
This ain’t bounce, this is moonshine glide.

[Chorus, soulful hook, layered harmonies, fiddle counter-melody]  
Moonshine wing—carry me home,  
Out past the pain where the wild things roam.  
Glide through the dusk where the lost hearts hide,  
No need to run when the rhythm gon' ride.  

(Moonshine wing…) – [soft echo fx]  
(Let it glide…) – [vocal harmony layer, panned wide]

[Bridge, slide guitar solo, banjo finger rolls, reversed guitar fx]  
[Slide Guitar Lead: expressive bends, slow phrasing, SRV-style delivery]  
[Banjo syncs with trap hats, rhythm builds tension]  
[Fiddle drones, soft ambient tail lingers]

[Outro, tape hiss fade, no drums]  
[Spoken Whisper, dry tone]  
“…We all bounce once. But some of us… slide forever.”  
(Slide guitar swell fades into silence, vinyl crackle trails out)
title: Moonshine Wing

lyrics:
[Intro, Whispered Female Vocal, Strip Club Ambience, Deep Sub-Bass, Ambient Guitar Slides]
"...slow like syrup, baby…"
"drippin' on ya mind…"
"strippin’… sippin’…"
"not just for the tips tonight…"

[Verse 1, Texas Trill Cadence, Banjo Pulse, 808 Groove]
"Boots muddy, voice deep, moves like scripture in heat"
"Preach in heels, baptize ‘em under this beat"
"Grandma said I got heaven in me"
"I turn that fire into currency"

"Twerk like truth, bassline confession"
"Southern drawl in the smoke’s progression"
"Talkin’ tongues, rhinestones on skin"
"They want the sin—I sing salvation in"

[Pre-Chorus, Slide Guitar, Syncopated Drawl, Deep Sub Kicks]
"Beat stutters like a broken vow"
"Grace in my hips, holy somehow"
"This pole my altar, rhythm divine"
"Even in glitter, the Lord still shine"

[Chorus, Hook-Driven Female Vocal, Gospel Harmony, Dirty South Kick]
"Strippin’ & Sippin’—I’m the voice of the flame"
"Southern girl swingin’, baptized in my name"
"Strippin’ & Sippin’—soul in my drawl"
"This is a woman’s rise, not her fall"

[Verse 2, Flow Switch, Whisper Layers, Banjo + Trap Groove]
"Glitter hides pain, tips cover grace"
"Eyes on the body, but I run this place"
"My halo's bent, my roots run deep"
"Southern truth that don’t lose sleep"

[Pre-Chorus 2, Microtonal Echoes, Minimal Texture]
"God still hears when the speaker moans"
"Drawl on the mic, I carve it in stone"
"Call it sin, but it’s how I breathe"
"Strippin’ the past so I can believe"

[Bridge, Gospel Explosion, AI Vocal Tripling, Harmonic Chaos]
(Lead Female Vocal - Bluesy Southern Wail)
"I don’t need savin’—just room to scream"
"Angel in heels, dancin’ through the dream"

(Gospel Choir - Auto-Tuned + Glitched)
"Girl, you got fire — don’t need no crown"
"Southern queen, don’t lay that spirit down"

(Lead Whisper - Southern Intonation)
"I bend, I break, I bless, I sway"
"Voice of a woman who prayed her way"

[Final Chorus, Female Southern Lead, Gospel Build, Trap Sub Drop]
"Strippin’ & Sippin’—drawl in the dark"
"Swingin’ redemption with every spark"
"Strippin’ & Sippin’—soul-fed flame"
"A Southern girl singin’ her own damn name"

[Outro, Whispered Female Vocal, Vinyl Crackle, Lush Pad]
"Voice in the dark…"
"grace in decay…"
"ain’t no shame when a woman prays her way…"

lyrics:
**[Verse 1: The Sin of Vanity]**  
Granny said vanity’s a sin,  
Granddaddy warned, “New faces every day.”  
Beauty’s fleeting in neon lights—  
Ancient wisdom echoes in empty halls.  
Faded portraits and whispered regrets,  
Telling us the price of keeping up appearances.  
**[Chorus: Foxy’s on a Friday]**  
Foxy’s on a Friday night,  
Where dollars rain and dreams take flight.  
Club lights shimmer on hopeful eyes,  
A brief high that fades at dawn.  
The glitz, the glamour, shadowed by truth,  
A fleeting spark in the midnight groove.  
**[Verse 2: The Transformation]**  
She once wore aprons with whispered wishes,  
Declaring, “I’ve got bigger plans.”  
But when the cash spoke louder than dreams,  
The lure of the spotlight pulled her in.  
Every step’s a trade-off,  
Surrendering innocence for a taste of escape.  
**[Bridge: Time Passes]**  
Years spin like records on a dusty shelf,  
The stage grows heavy with time.  
Fifteen years later, the mirror shows  
A tired soul with a still-burning fire.  
Her daughter steps in—a silent promise,  
A cycle of struggle carved in the night.  
**[Final Verse: The Weight of Three Decades]**  
They say fine liquor deepens with time,  
Bottle me up—I’m vintage in every rhyme.  
A thousand gallons of memories in neon blaze,  
Three decades chasing dreams on that stage.  
No pension, just scars turned gold,  
Each sip a chapter in a legend retold.  
**[Outro: Pole Dancer Olympics]**

lyrics:
**Title: "Smokestack América" (Cumbia-Blues Overdrive Remix)**
**Style: [Cumbia Blues Fusion, Overdriven Guitars, Percussion-Driven, Swampy Groove]**
---
### **[🔥 Intro – DJ Drop & Performer Shoutouts]**  
🎤 *"You already KNOW what it is! Cumbia meets the blues, overdrive in the mix! Let’s gooo! DJ [Name] on the track!"* 🔥  
🎤 *"Shoutout to [Lead Vocalist], [Guitarist], [Percussion Crew], and [Harmonica Legend] holdin’ it DOWN!"*  
*(Swampy slide guitar bends, deep cumbia percussion—**boom boom, taka-taka!**)*  
*(Harmonica wails—raw & dirty, then the **full groove drops!** 🎶🔥)*  
### **[Verse 1 – Bluesy Growl Meets Cumbia Flow]**  
Ohhh, beautifúl for spácious skíes,  
For wáves of gólden grain…  
For májestic móuntains rísing high,  
Above the fruited pláin…  
*(Guitar hits a **dirty lick**—wah pedal crying, harmonica echoes in the back 🎸🔥)*  
### **[Chorus – Howlin’ Call & Response]**  
🎶 *Ohhh Américaaa!* (Mi tierra sí!)  
🎶 *God shed His grace on thee!* (Divina sí!)  
🎶 *And crown thy good with brotherhood,*  
🎶 *From sea to shining sea!*  
*(🎶 Guitar **slides up** the neck—harmonica screams—cumbia bass keeps rolling! 🔥🔥🔥)*  
### **[Verse 2 – Full Swamp Boogie]**  
Ohhh, tell me now can you hear that sound?  
The train comin’ slow, rollin’ underground…  
From the Delta swamps to the border towns,  
Let that rhythm shake the ground!  
*(Cumbia drums go full tilt, bass bouncing, **guitar distorts hard**—the past & future colliding!)*  
### **[Bridge – Percussion & Guitar Battle]**  
*(Drums solo—timbales and congas trading hits, **THEN BOOM—guitar explodes in!**)*  
*(Slide guitar howls, harmonica wails, drums POUNDING, cumbia groove still stomping!)*  
### **[🔥 Outro – DJ Drop & Final Shoutouts]**  
🎤 *"And THAT’S how we do it! [Lead Singer] on the VOX, [Guitarist] rippin’ it up, [Percussion Squad] bringing that fuego, [Harmonica King] tearin’ it down! DJ [Name] out—Cumbia and Blues LIVES ON!"* 🎶🔥  
*(Guitar feedback hums, harmonica lingers, percussion plays **to the end**—then everything fades like a ghostly train into the night… 🚂🔥)*

Male Vocalist:
You and me, we made a vow,
For better or for worse.
Can’t believe you let me down,
But the truth, oh, how it hurts.

Male Vocalist:
I see the storm clouds rollin’ in,
But can we dance in the rain again?

**CHORUS (Heavy bass drop, hypnotic hook repeats for max engagement, stacked vocals added)
Group Vocals (chant-style, layered with pitched-down ad-libs):
Can you stand it? (Ayy!)
Can you stand it? (Woo!)
Drop that, shake that,
Bounce it, break that!
(808s hit HARD, twerk-ready tempo locks in, synths pulse with club energy)
**VERSE 2 (High-energy, confident female rap verse, speed-switch flow)
Female Rapper (bold, rapid-fire flow, speed-switching technique added):
Body like a problem, boy, solve that quick!
Stack real thick, got ‘em throwin’ them bricks!
Drip stay cold, but the way I drop heat,
Hips don’t lie, make ‘em weak in the knees!
(Speed switch-up starts)
Throw that back, put the money where ya mouth is,
Slow whine, then I hit ‘em with a bounce flip!
Never been a rookie, all-star when I play,
Boss moves only, make ‘em rain all day!
(808 slides hit, beat breathes for a moment before chopping down)
**BREAKDOWN (Chop & Screw section – Beat slows down, deep vocal FX, call-and-response added)
(Vocals warped, reverb-drenched... low, slowed voice repeats)
DJ MoMoney: "Sloooow it doooown.... Now bring it BACK!"
Call & Response (Crowd Chant)
Male Vocalist: "Tell me, can you stand it?"
Crowd: "Can you stand it?"
Male Vocalist: "Love’s like a storm, can you take it?"
Crowd: "Can you take it?"
(Beat slams back in, high energy resumes)
**FINAL CHORUS (Max energy, extended hook for DJs, final bass explosion!)
Group Vocals (hypnotic chant, stacked layers):
Can you stand it? (Ayy!)
Can you stand it? (Woo!)
Drop that, shake that,
Bounce it, break that!
(Beat rides out, twerk tempo stays locked, club energy remains high)
**OUTRO (808 & acapella strip-back, remix-ready ending)
DJ MoMoney: "That’s how you do it! Queens only! If you ain’t bringin’ that energy, STAY HOME!"
(Final 808 hit, female rapper ad-libs, club sounds drift into the night...)

lyrics:
[Intro – Percussion Ritual Awakens]
(Deep conga thumps, distant metallic clangs, syncopated hi-hats slicing through space…)
(A synth drone hums—low, ominous… like something is waking up.)
(Then—BOOM!—a bass hit that warps time, pulling us into the void.)
[Verse 1 – Funky, Spoken Flow, Glitched Vocal Doubles]
Black cat crossed my left-hand side,
Mirror cracked—now my luck gone blind.
Walked under ladders, threw salt at my feet,
Still feel the devil tappin’ that beat.
(Tap-tap!) – Heard a whisper in the wind…
(Clap-clap!) – Streetlights flicker again…
(Boom!) – If the rhythm feel off,
Better watch where you step—better count that cost!
[Pre-Chorus – Polyrhythmic Build, Gospel Harmonies Layered with Auto-Tune]
(Hushed voices chant, layered in eerie harmony…)
*(Signs… omens… flickers… echoes…)*
(Rhythm bends, time stretches—then collapses into a brutal drum break.)
[Chorus – Gang Vocals, Heavy Groove, Industrial Brass Stabs]
Ohhh—Signs & omens, fate untold,
Rhythm don’t lie, let the drums take hold.
Ohhh—Shadows movin’, whispers low,
If the beat feel wrong—better let it go!
[Verse 2 – Percussion-Led Melody, Vocal Glitch Edits]
Throw the bones, read the lines,
Card flip twice, now the clock rewinds.
Luck ain’t real, but the feeling is strong,
And if the drums keep knockin’, you been warned too long.
(Beat stutters, warps, distorts… like the timeline is cracking…)
(Abrupt stop. Silence.)
[Percussion Breakdown – Chaos & Rebirth]
(*Silence… then a single clap.*)
(*Then another.*)
(A whirlwind of drums erupts—traditional, electronic, organic—all colliding in rhythmic madness.)
(Snares snap in odd time, 808s distort, the groove feels dangerous.)
[Bridge – Chant-Style Call & Response, Vocals Layered with Digital Artifacts]
(Rimshot!) – Did you see that sign?
(Tambourine shake!) – Was it just your mind?
(808 Drop!) – Can’t change fate,
So just keep in time!
[False Climax – Build, Collapse, Reassemble]
(A soaring synth rises—like we’re about to hit the ultimate drop—then…)
(*Nothing.* A vacuum of sound.)
(A breath. A whisper.)
Then—EXPLOSION! Full band, full groove, everything too big, too raw, too overwhelming.
The rhythm is alive. It’s devouring time itself.
[Outro – Sonic Dissolution, Distant Echoes]
(The drums begin to deconstruct. Layers fall away, one by one…)
(Claps and foot stomps fade into reverb-laden oblivion…)
(Whispers intertwine, time distorts one last time, and then—)
(*Silence.*)

lyrics:
[Intro, Chopped & Screwed Vocals, Sub-Bass Drones, 808s slide in, drums swing with a half-time groove)]
*(Ohhh ohhh… slow it down… yeah yeah… let it ride…)*
[Verse 1, Blues-Trap Flow, Swung Hi-Hats, Trill Bounce, (Vocal effect: Slightly slowed and reverbed on key words)]
Mud on my boots, sweat on my collar  
Echoes of history weigh down the holler  
Mama sang hymns while the wolves were howlin’  
Devil in the bottle, angels still prowlin’  
[Pre-Chorus, Chopped & Screwed Hook Layered with Soulful Harmonies, (Swaaay… with me… swaaay… with me… yeah yeah)]
Chained to the sins of the ones before  
Down here, love and pain go to war  
[Chorus, Dirty South 808 Drop, Soulful Horns on the Upbeat, (BIG DROP – 808s hit, horns swing in, vocals stay raw & commanding)]
**Southbound soul, can’t break free**  
**Storm still runs in the veins of me**  
**Mississippi moon, light my way**  
**I’m a shadow in the heat of yesterday**  
[Post-Chorus, Chopped & Screwed Echo, Reverse Hi-Hats]
(Southbound… souuul… yeah yeah…)  
[Verse 2, Faster Flow, More Percussion, Blues Guitar Licks Weaving In, (Vocal effect: Slight stutter effect on certain syllables for bounce)]
Footsteps haunt every street I roam  
Midnight train got a preacher’s tone  
Sins in the soil, sweat in the bone  
Buried deep where the roots have grown  
[Bridge, Beat Switch, Instrumental Break, Ethereal Pad Sounds]
(Wait—let it breathe) **(808s drop out, eerie pads float in, vocals spaced out)**  
Winds hum hymns where the graves still speak  
Ain’t no chains but we still ain’t free  
[Final Chorus, Full Trill Remix Energy, Overlapping Chopped Vocal Layers]
🔥 **(Beat returns heavier, all elements stacked for max energy)**  
**Southbound soul, can’t break free**  
**Storm still runs in the veins of me**  
**Delta dreams, rise like flames**  
**Burnin’ high, but never tamed**  
[Outro, Chopped & Screwed Fade-Out, Reversed Blues Guitar Riff]
*(Southbound… slow it down… souuul… yeah yeah… let it ride… let it ride…)*

lyrics:
**Title: "Never Forgiving You"**
**Style: [Bluegrass, Gospel Quartet, Cinematic 808s, Syncopated Bounce]**
---
### **[Intro – Gospel Quartet, A Cappella Harmony]**
*(Ohhh… they say let go… but I can’t… I won’t…)*
*(I touch shadows… but they don’t fade… no…)*
### **[Verse 1 – Spoken Flow, Cold & Heavy]**
I don’t understand… how they expect me… to…
Am I really… supposed to be able… to…
Forget and forget? (I say it like that.)
Because I’m never forgiving you.
When the smell of that place…
Puts me right to that moment…
My body’s here, but my mind still frozen…
Like a ghost that can’t move on…
### **[Pre-Chorus – Female Lead, Gospel Harmony]**
*(Ohhh… tell me how… tell me why…)*
*(Do I drown or survive…?)*
*(They say time will heal my pain…)*
*(But the scars still say your name…)*
### **[Chorus – Gospel + 808s Drop]**
The roses I touch,
Magical it must… be.
They say of you,
I think too much… see.
### **[Verse 2 – Drill Flow + Off-Grid Swing]**
Bipolar swings like a pendulum blade,
Some days I shine, some days I fade.
Some days I fight, some days I cave,
Got scars on my soul that I can’t erase.
Whiskey in my cup, demons in my chest,
Prayin’ to a God that I second-guess.
Tryna stay clean, but the past won’t rest,
Every step I take, I feel possessed.
### **[Bridge – Slow Down, Gospel Harmonies]**
*(Take my hand... lead me home...)*
*(Break these chains... I can’t go alone...)*
*(Tell me there’s more, tell me there’s light...)*
*(Tell me my past won’t take my life...)*
### **[Verse 3 – The Breaking Point]**
I see your face in the dark when I sleep,
I hear your voice when the silence runs deep.
They say "move on," they say "let it be,"
But how can I heal when it’s still in me?
This ain't revenge—this is truth, this is proof,
This is the rage that they bottled in youth.
If they want silence, they won't get their way,
I touch shadows, but I **won’t** fade away.
### **[Outro – Gospel A Cappella + 808s Fade]**
*(Forget and forget…

Syrup in my cup, candy paint drippin’
808 deep like the slab still tippin’

(Second Rapper)
I got that slow grind, talk that talk
Pimp C spirit, let the bassline walk
Pop my trunk, let the neon glow

Fifth wheel recline while we slide away

808, le-e-e-e-e-e-e-t it breathe
Texas trill, it’s in my D-N-A, best believe

Candy drippin’, paint still glow
Swing to the side, let the top fold low

Southside, Northside, we ride the same
Boys talk down, but they know the name
Syrup in my veins, H-Town be the truth
Talk slow, move smart, still break the booth

We ridin’ dirty, trunk steady knockin’
Slow flow, wood grain, we ain’t stoppin’
Syrup in my cup, candy paint drippin’
808 deep like the slab still tippin’
(DJ Fading Out, Screw-Style Echo)
Talk slow… sip slow… let that bass breathe…
We out, boy… H-Town forever…

lyrics:
(DJ Hype Voice)
Yo, welcome to Moe Money Studios lab tonight
[DJ BREAKDOWN SCRATH]
whole body tippin', fat line sniffin
—beat’s shiftin, purp we sippin',
—raw, real, and *live*. Let’s ride!
(Yeah...yeah...uh...)
(Ay, pass that—nah, lemme go first... bet...)
[Verse 1, Upbeat Flow, First Beat Shift]
(First Rapper - Doubled Vocals)
Man, I’m *live* in this liquid haze
Words snap when the beat go phase
Four-bar flip—new sound, new craze
808 swang but my flow stay laced
Low-end rumble, heart beats tight
Sip slow but my mind take flight
Beat just jumped—had to shift my stance
Every loop feel like a second chance
[Freestyle Exchange, Back-and-Forth Verses]
(Second Rapper - Tripled Vocals)
Yo, feel the pulse—yeah, it’s ridin’ now
(Third Rapper)
Shift the gears, let’s slide it down!
(First Rapper)
Let the lab speak—pure sound, no filler
(Second Rapper)
Raw and uncut—real spit, no filter!
[Verse 2, Grittier Flow, Second Beat Shift]
(Second Rapper - Doubled Vocals)
I step through the bass, let the sound collapse
Mixing wordplay with a hazy relapse
Each bar a switch—now the drums hit back
Every beat another *live* soundtrack
Studio lights flash, bottle tilt slow
Rhythm in my bloodstream, words just glow
They say, “Damn, how you spit like that?”
Man, it’s just the lab—ain’t no time to hold back
[Bridge, Slowed-Down Breakdown - Minimalist Synths, Slurred Hooks]
(Chopped & Screwed, Slurred Hook)
Oooh… shift—listen... echoes of the lab, our souls in sync...
Every pause tells a story—we let it all spill...
Voices melt, 808s dip, ride this wave... slow sip...
Flipped up, flipped down, don’t trip...
[Verse 3, Final Rapper, High Energy, Third Beat Shift]
(Third Rapper - Doubled Vocals)
Step up—I’m the spark when the room goes dim
My words cut deep, erratic but grim
808 stumble but my flow still swim
Swerve to the left, then lock it back in
We ridin’ these shifts like chaos on a limb
Off the dome, let the madness begin
Energy raw, every take, every spin
We ain’t write this—just

lyrics:
[Intro: Slow Build, Soulful Harmonies]
*(Soft Rhodes keys, distant organ swells, deep bass humming, and a gentle brushed snare as the choir hums in harmony.)*
[Lead:]
Ohhh, you gotta get ready now… (mmm-hmm)  
Ohhh, no man knows the day or the hour…  
[Verse 1]  
Get your house in order, oh do it today  
Get your house in order, oh do it right away  
For Jesus is coming, no man knows where or when  
Get your house in order, for He’s coming back again  
[Chorus: Call and Response]  
**(Lead:)** Get your house in order... *(Choir echoes: In order!)*  
**(Lead:)** Oh, don’t wait too late... *(Choir echoes: Don’t wait!)*  
For Jesus is coming... *(Choir: Coming!)*  
He's coming back again  
*(Soft instrumental break – bluesy guitar and organ swells as the choir hums in harmony.)*  
[Verse 2]  
There’s earthquakes, hurricanes, famines, and disease  
Can’t you hear the Lord is callin’?  
You better take heed...  
So many homeless, lost out in the cold  
But my God’s got mansions  
More precious than gold  
[Chorus: Repeat]  
Get your house in order, oh do it today  
Get your house in order, oh do it right away  
For Jesus is coming, no man knows where or when  
Get your house in order, for He’s coming back again  
[Bridge: Soft Breakdown – Transition Begins]  
*(The music softens, Rhodes and bass pulsing gently, as the lead starts to testify.)*  
[Lead:]  
Ohh, but there’s something, something about His name...  
*(Choir hums in agreement, warm harmonies swelling.)*  
*(Rhodes swells, drums build lightly, leading into the next movement…)*  
[Transition – “Something About the Name Jesus”]  
*(Organ swells, deepening bass, light hi-hats as the choir takes the lead.)*  
[Chorus: Something About the Name Jesus]  
Something about the name Jesus,  
Something about the name Jesus,  
It is the sweetest name I know...  
Oh, how I love the name Jesus,  
Oh, how I love the name Jesus,  
It is the sweetest name I know...  
[Call and Response: Intensifying Worship]  
*(Lead with passion, choir responding powerfully.)*

lyrics:
(DJ Hype Voice)
Yo, welcome to Moe Money Studios lab tonight—beat’s shiftin, purp we sippin',
whole body tippin', fat line sniffin—raw, real, and *live*. Let’s ride!
(Yeah...yeah...uh...)
(Ay, pass that—nah, lemme go first... bet...)
[Verse 1, Upbeat Flow, First Beat Shift]
(First Rapper - Doubled Vocals)
Man, I’m *live* in this liquid haze
Words snap when the beat go phase
Four-bar flip—new sound, new craze
808 swang but my flow stay laced
Low-end rumble, heart beats tight
Sip slow but my mind take flight
Beat just jumped—had to shift my stance
Every loop feel like a second chance
[Freestyle Exchange, Back-and-Forth Verses]
(Second Rapper - Tripled Vocals)
Yo, feel the pulse—yeah, it’s ridin’ now
(Third Rapper)
Shift the gears, let’s slide it down!
(First Rapper)
Let the lab speak—pure sound, no filler
(Second Rapper)
Raw and uncut—real spit, no filter!
[Verse 2, Grittier Flow, Second Beat Shift]
(Second Rapper - Doubled Vocals)
I step through the bass, let the sound collapse
Mixing wordplay with a hazy relapse
Each bar a switch—now the drums hit back
Every beat another *live* soundtrack
Studio lights flash, bottle tilt slow
Rhythm in my bloodstream, words just glow
They say, “Damn, how you spit like that?”
Man, it’s just the lab—ain’t no time to hold back
[Bridge, Slowed-Down Breakdown - Minimalist Synths, Slurred Hooks]
(Chopped & Screwed, Slurred Hook)
Oooh… shift—listen... echoes of the lab, our souls in sync...
Every pause tells a story—we let it all spill...
Voices melt, 808s dip, ride this wave... slow sip...
Flipped up, flipped down, don’t trip...
[Verse 3, Final Rapper, High Energy, Third Beat Shift]
(Third Rapper - Doubled Vocals)
Step up—I’m the spark when the room goes dim
My words cut deep, erratic but grim
808 stumble but my flow still swim
Swerve to the left, then lock it back in
We ridin’ these shifts like chaos on a limb
Off the dome, let the madness begin
Energy raw, every take, every spin
We ain’t write this—just

(DJ Hype Voice)
Yo, welcome to the lab tonight—beat’s shifting, hearts are lifting!
Sloppy 808s, minimal synth vibes—raw, real, and *live*. Let’s ride!
(Yeah...yeah...uh...)
(Ay, pass that—nah, lemme go first... bet...)
[Verse 1, Upbeat Flow, First Beat Shift]
(First Rapper - Doubled Vocals)
Man, I’m *live* in this liquid haze
Words snap when the beat go phase
Four-bar flip—new sound, new craze
808 swang but my flow stay laced
Low-end rumble, heart beats tight
Sip slow but my mind take flight
Beat just jumped—had to shift my stance
Every loop feel like a second chance
[Freestyle Exchange, Back-and-Forth Verses]
(Second Rapper - Tripled Vocals)
Yo, feel the pulse—yeah, it’s ridin’ now
(Third Rapper)
Shift the gears, let’s slide it down!
(First Rapper)
Let the lab speak—pure sound, no filler
(Second Rapper)
Raw and uncut—real spit, no filter!
[Verse 2, Grittier Flow, Second Beat Shift]
(Second Rapper - Doubled Vocals)
I step through the bass, let the sound collapse
Mixing wordplay with a hazy relapse
Each bar a switch—now the drums hit back
Every beat another *live* soundtrack
Studio lights flash, bottle tilt slow
Rhythm in my bloodstream, words just glow
They say, “Damn, how you spit like that?”
Man, it’s just the lab—ain’t no time to hold back
[Bridge, Slowed-Down Breakdown - Minimalist Synths, Slurred Hooks]
(Chopped & Screwed, Slurred Hook)
Oooh… shift—listen... echoes of the lab, our souls in sync...
Every pause tells a story—we let it all spill...
Voices melt, 808s dip, ride this wave... slow sip...
Flipped up, flipped down, don’t trip...
[Verse 3, Final Rapper, High Energy, Third Beat Shift]
(Third Rapper - Doubled Vocals)
Step up—I’m the spark when the room goes dim
My words cut deep, erratic but grim
808 stumble but my flow still swim
Swerve to the left, then lock it back in
We ridin’ these shifts like chaos on a limb
Off the dome, let the madness begin
Energy raw, every take, every spin
We ain’t write this—just

lyrics:
[Verse 1 – The Cut Comes]
Ain’t no gold watch, ain’t no thank you speech,
Told me ‘times have changed’ while they changed my seat,
Yeah, I saw it comin’, but it still cut deep,
Girl, you gotta leave—baby girl, take your feet.
[Chorus]
Let’s host the Pole Dancer Olympics, see who really got the juice,
Let’s line up all the rookies, show ‘em how to wear these shoes.
[Verse 2 – The Good Times]
Started off servin’, said it wasn’t my thing,
But money talk sweet when your pockets feel pain,
One song, two songs, and the world went dim,
I bit the apple, let the venom sink in.
[Chorus – Repeats]
Let’s host the Pole Dancer Olympics, see who really got the juice,
Let’s line up all the rookies, show ‘em how to wear these shoes.
[Verse 3 – The Bitter Fall]
Seen my baby girl dancin’ where I used to stand,
Same songs, same moves, same thirsty hands,
She don’t see the bruises hid beneath my tan,
But she’ll learn like I did, it’s a part of the plan.
[Bridge]
Oh, it’s a long way down when you climb too high,
The stage lights fade, but the bills still bite.
[Verse 4 – The Realization]
She got my daughter’s face, she got my mama’s name,
Standin’ on that same old stage,
Foxys’ still got the same champagne,
Same men, same money, same damn game.
[Final Line – Defiant Ending]
The game don’t stop, but I’m callin’ the bluff.
title: Pole Dancer Olympics (Defiant Version)

lyrics:
[Intro: Slow Build, Soulful Harmonies]
*(Soft Rhodes keys, distant organ swells, deep bass humming, and a gentle brushed snare as the choir hums in harmony.)*
[Lead:]
Ohhh, you gotta get ready now… (mmm-hmm)  
Ohhh, no man knows the day or the hour…  
[Verse 1]  
Get your house in order, oh do it today  
Get your house in order, oh do it right away  
For Jesus is coming, no man knows where or when  
Get your house in order, for He’s coming back again  
[Chorus: Call and Response]  
**(Lead:)** Get your house in order... *(Choir echoes: In order!)*  
**(Lead:)** Oh, don’t wait too late... *(Choir echoes: Don’t wait!)*  
For Jesus is coming... *(Choir: Coming!)*  
He's coming back again  
*(Soft instrumental break – bluesy guitar and organ swells as the choir hums in harmony.)*  
[Verse 2]  
There’s earthquakes, hurricanes, famines, and disease  
Can’t you hear the Lord is callin’?  
You better take heed...  
So many homeless, lost out in the cold  
But my God’s got mansions  
More precious than gold  
[Chorus: Repeat]  
Get your house in order, oh do it today  
Get your house in order, oh do it right away  
For Jesus is coming, no man knows where or when  
Get your house in order, for He’s coming back again  
[Bridge: Soft Breakdown – Transition Begins]  
*(The music softens, Rhodes and bass pulsing gently, as the lead starts to testify.)*  
[Lead:]  
Ohh, but there’s something, something about His name...  
*(Choir hums in agreement, warm harmonies swelling.)*  
*(Rhodes swells, drums build lightly, leading into the next movement…)*  
[Transition – “Something About the Name Jesus”]  
*(Organ swells, deepening bass, light hi-hats as the choir takes the lead.)*  
[Chorus: Something About the Name Jesus]  
Something about the name Jesus,  
Something about the name Jesus,  
It is the sweetest name I know...  
Oh, how I love the name Jesus,  
Oh, how I love the name Jesus,  
It is the sweetest name I know...  
[Call and Response: Intensifying Worship]  
*(Lead with passion, choir responding powerfully.)*  
[Lead:] Some say it’s like fire shut up in my bones…  
[Choir:] Fire in my bones!  
[Lead:] Oh, the Holy Ghost is moving, I can feel it strong…  
[Choir:] He won’t leave us alone!  
*(Drums pick up slightly, adding energy to the moment.)*  
[Chorus Repeat: Full Power]  
Something about the name Jesus,  
Something about the name Jesus,  
It is the sweetest name I know…  
*(Music slows again, returning to the original theme.)*  
[Outro: Returning to "House in Order"]  
*(Soft Rhodes, deep bass, and light drum taps as the energy comes back down.)*  
Get your house in order, oh do it today…  
Get your house in order, oh don’t delay…  
*(Lead whispers, choir softly echoing: “For He’s coming… back… again…”)

lyrics:
**[Verse 1: The Sin of Vanity]**  
Granny said vanity’s a sin,  
Granddaddy warned, “New faces every day.”  
Beauty’s fleeting in neon lights—  
Ancient wisdom echoes in empty halls.  
Faded portraits and whispered regrets,  
Telling us the price of keeping up appearances.  
**[Chorus: Foxy’s on a Friday]**  
Foxy’s on a Friday night,  
Where dollars rain and dreams take flight.

lyrics:
[Verse]
Heels click-clackin' on the floor so worn
Lights dim low like a Sunday morn
Mirror cracked but I see it plain
The stage ain't mine no more to reign
[Verse 2]
They said girl your prime's long passed
Reality came
Got my drink and a task
Packing dreams in a counterfeit bag
Future whispers but the past still drags
[Chorus]
End of the shift the curtain falls slow
Neon burns out like a truth I know
Time don't dance and it ain't kind
Left alone with just my grind
[Verse 3]
I saw it comin' like the sunset fades
Each move harder but the song still plays
Manager's smile been a dagger too sharp
Every glance like a warning in the dark
[Bridge]
These four walls seen my highs and lows
Glitter don't stick but respect it grows
Age caught me slippin'
Caught me in the game
But I walk out steady
Head high just the same
[Verse 4]
Last steps on a floor I made my own
To another chapter
I journey unknown
A life unspun like records rewind
No regrets ‘cause the grind rewrote my mind

lyrics:
[Intro, UGK-Style Trill Beat, Slow-Burn Synths, DJ Shout-Out]
(DJ Shout-Out, H-Town Drawl)
Ayy, we ridin' dirty in the lab, boy—
Syrup slow, bass low, let the trunk deploy—
808s hit like Texas heat, swang and bang—
Let’s talk that talk, boy, spit that game—
[Verse 1, Laid-Back Southern Drawl, 808 Riding Deep]
(First Rapper)
I’m *live* in the booth, like I came from the cut
Mixin’ rhymes with the drank, got the Styrofoam stuck
Candy paint drip, watch it shine in the sun
Houston in my blood, rep the Third Coast, son
Trunk pop slow when the bassline drop
Talk that trill, we don’t talk to the cops
808 stumble, but the flow stay tight
Swing to the left, let the fifth wheel bite
[Hook, H-Town Trill Chant, Heavy Reverb]
(All Rappers - Doubled Vocals)
We ridin’ dirty, trunk steady knockin’
Slow flow, wood grain, we ain’t stoppin’
Syrup in my cup, candy paint drippin’
808 deep like the slab still tippin’
[Verse 2, Gritty UGK-Style Flow, Trill Energy]
(Second Rapper)
I got that slow grind, talk that talk
Pimp C spirit, let the bassline walk
Pop my trunk, let the neon glow
Third Coast Kings, let the drank just flow
H-Town roots, boy, this ain't for play
Fifth wheel recline while we slide away
You talk too fast, slow it down, don’t trip
Let the beat ride while I lean and sip
[Bridge, Chopped & Screwed, Hypnotic Vibe]
(Hook Slowed Down, DJ Screw Effect)
Truuuuunk steady kno-o-o-o-ckin’
Slooooow flow, wood gra-a-a-a-in droppin’
808, le-e-e-e-e-e-e-t it breathe
Texas trill, it’s in my D-N-A, best believe
[Verse 3, Final Rapper, High Energy, Trunk-Rattling Bass]
(Third Rapper)
Candy drippin’, paint still glow
Swing to the side, let the top fold low
All black fit, but the grill stay gold
Old-school game, but the story stay told
Southside, Northside, we ride the same
Boys talk down, but they know the name
Syrup in my veins, H-Town be the truth
Talk slow, move smart, still break the booth
[Final Hook & Outro, Layered Vocals, Chopped Adlibs]
(All Rappers)
We ridin’ dirty, trunk steady knockin’
Slow flow, wood grain, we ain’t stoppin’
Syrup in my cup, candy paint drippin’
808 deep like the slab still tippin’
(DJ Fading Out, Screw-Style Echo)
Talk slow… sip slow… let that bass breathe…
We out, boy… H-Town forever…
---
✅ **UGK/H-Town Beat Locked In** – Real Texas trill, heavy 808 swing, syrupy flow.
✅ **Corrected Pronunciation** – “Live” now sounds like “give.”
✅ **Trill Slang & Southern Energy** – Candy paint, syrup talk, trunk poppin’ vibes.
✅ **Bass Balanced** – 808s slap without killing the vocals.
✅ **Chopped & Screwed Section** – Authentic H-Town influence.
---
🔥 Now generating the REAL **H-Town** version… 🎶🚀

(DJ grabs the mic as the beat flips every 4 bars—808s wobble, synths drift)
[DJ]
“Yo, welcome to the lab tonight—beat’s shifting, hearts are lifting!
Sloppy 808s, minimal synth vibes—raw, real, and live. Let’s ride!”
(A brief pause as the beat shifts abruptly; the atmosphere crackles with raw energy.)
[Verse 1 – Rapper 1, Beat Shift]
Man, I’m lost in this liquid haze,
Words slur like smoke in a daze,
Fourth-bar flip—new sound, new phase,
I ride each shift while the lab explodes in waves.
(Adlib: “Ayy, yeah…”) 
The 808’s sloppy, my tongue’s in freefall,
I spit raw truth that stumbles and crawls,
In this modern lab, no script at all—
Just a spark in the chaos where our voices brawl.
[Back-and-Forth Freestyle Exchange]
(Beat shifts again, rappers trade lines in spontaneous energy)
[Rapper 1]
“Yo, feel the pulse on every beat—can you ride it?”
[Rapper 2]
“Ride it like a wave, shifting while we slide, man!”
[Rapper 3]
“Let the lab speak—each verse builds off the other, raw and unrefined!”
[Rapper 1]
“Every 4 bars, a new spark ignites…”
[Rapper 2]
“…and our slurred hooks echo through the night!”
[Rapper 3]
“True, no rehearsed lines—just spontaneous insight!”
(They share a collective, hiccuped laugh and a series of adlibs: “Yeah—uh, whoa, right!”)
[Verse 2 – Rapper 2, Beat Shift]
I float through these beats in a dazed trance,
Mixing wordplay with a hazy, stumbling dance,
Each bar a shift—a lab-induced chance,
To flip raw emotion like a drunken advance.
(Adlib: “Mmm, yeah!”)
My lines blur together, a freestyle confession,
Synths and 808s fuel this raw obsession,
In our modern lab, we break every suggestion—
No pattern, just passion in every expression.
[Verse 3 – Rapper 3, Beat Shift]
Step up—I’m the spark when the room goes dim,
My words drip slow, erratic yet grim,
Beat flipping every moment, my flow’s on a whim,
We’re riding these shifts like chaos on a limb.
(Adlib: “Word!” “Aye, aye!”)
In this raw session, our voices intertwine,
Slurred hooks, live adlibs—they form the design,
Each spontaneous verse a shot of the divine,
Lit by the lab’s unpredictable shine.
[Bridge – Spontaneous Breakdown]
(Beat softens, 808s throb, synth drifts in and out. The rappers mumble fragmented adlibs, barely holding onto clear words.)
Oooh… shift—listen...
Echoes of the lab, our souls in sync…
(Adlibs: “Hah,” “Shh…” “Bring it back.”)
Every pause tells a story—we let it all spill.
[Final Hook & Outro – All Rappers]
(Beat builds one last time, each 4-bar flip amplifying energy. The three voices stack together in a raw, slurred chant.)
Bounce it, shift it—raw from the core,
808s sloppin’, we crave nothing more.
Live, unscripted—our night’s untamed lore,
In this lab, our freestyle forever roars.
(Layered adlibs: “Yeah, whoa!” “Keep it live!” “That’s it…”) 
(As the final hook echoes, the beat slowly fades into a minimalist synth pulse and a lingering 808 boom—leaving the lab echoing with raw creative energy.)

title: Lab Chronicles

lyrics:
[Verse]
Flask bubbling under neon fumes,
Mic in hand, cooking up new tunes,
Lab coat dripped out, sharp as harpoons,
Bass hit sloppy, cracked from the wombs.
[Bridge]
Smoke in the air, circuits fight the hiss,
Alchemy of sound, every beat’s a twist,
Synths whisper secrets, edge of abyss,
Lab rats dance once the snares persist.
[Chorus]
Welcome to the session, where science collides,
808s trippin’, minimal vibes,
Blueprints scattered, no song survives,
This the rawest mix cooked where chaos thrives.
[Verse 2]
Splatter of drums, echoes down the halls,
Factory of rhythm, bouncing off walls,
Synths snake the night, distorted calls,
Engineer mad, deleting all flaws.
[Bridge]
Timelines fracture when the pitch bends low,
Floors crack open, the basslines grow,
Lab-grown chaos, nowhere to go,
Build it up sloppy, let the pressure flow.
[Chorus]
Welcome to the session, where science collides,
808s trippin’, minimal vibes,
Blueprints scattered, no song survives,
This the rawest mix cooked where chaos thrives.
title: Lab Experiment

lyrics:
[Intro: Chopped & Screwed, Eerie Synths, Deep Sub-Bass]
Yeah... driftin’ like midnight whispers in secrets spilled,
Smoke curls in neon dusk as rhythm morphs—each pulse fulfilled.
Sub-bass murmurs trace our urban saga, every beat a tale untold;
The flow flips script with raw authority, embracing change bold.
[Verse 1: Laid-Back Groove, Lowrider Bounce - 95 BPM]
Step in with urban swagger—gold dreams clash with gritty truth,
A wrist shines with ambition; every stride charts destiny’s route.
Shadows carve silent verses on the streets beneath a deep bass line,
Vintage soul fuses with modern hustle, blending past with the divine.
Every bar punches life’s contrasts—vivid, raw, and unrefined,
An anthem of survival where authenticity’s echo is enshrined.
[Chorus: Euphoric Anthem, Tactile Bounce - 95 BPM]
Drop it low—let the bass carve pathways within the urban night,
Twerk to the pulse where raw vibes meet polished synth light.
Feel evolution surge, every switch-up rewriting our lore;
Uniting timeless energy with futuristic beats at its core.
[Verse 2: Reflective Grit, Street Narratives - 95 BPM]
City lights frame defiant tales and legacies whispered slow,
Rhythmic declarations fuse modern fire with wisdom’s glow.
When the mic ignites, every heart finds its own tempo in the fray;
Words become weapons of truth in a relentless, soulful sway.
Each line shapes destiny, transmuting past into tomorrow’s call,
A blueprint of raw ambition where hope and grit conquer all.
[Bridge: Slow Tempo, Chopped & Screwed, Gospel Undertones - 70 BPM]
(Yeah... ease down—let hidden layers slowly arise...)
Time liquefies; every note morphs into reflective, echoing art,
Deep bass unites with fractured harmonies—soul and spirit never apart.
A metamorphosis in motion, every shift redefines the urban decree;
The switch-up becomes pure liberation, an artistic journey set free.
[Extended Chorus: Club Anthem, Uplifting Bounce - 95 BPM]
Drop it low—allow the bass to narrate untold truths with fire,
tags: urban grit with eerie synths; chopped & screwed
title: The Switch-Up v3

lyrics:
[Intro, Chopped & Screwed, Eerie Synths, Sub-Bass]
Yeah... slow-rollin’ like syrup in the cup...
Smoke hangs thick and blue, what’s up...
Bassline creepin’, heartbeats sync...
Wait... watch the tempo switch up, don’t blink...
[Verse 1, Laid-Back Groove, Lowrider Bounce, Deep Bass - 95 BPM]
Step in the spot, got the bassline thumpin’
Gold on my wrist, whole squad stay stuntin’
Shadows on the wall, hips move like tidal waves
Rhythm in my veins, got ‘em caught up in the sway
Sip slow, but the vibe stay lethal
Eyes on me, yeah, I see through people
Walk in bold, know the vibe's my right
Drip too clean, yeah, the crown sit tight
[Chorus, Catchy Hook, Twerk Anthem - 95 BPM]
Drop it low, let the bassline ride
Twerk it out, let the whiskey decide
Bounce it up, make ‘em feel that heat
Move too slick, got ‘em stuck on repeat
Drop it low, yeah, the bass go deep
Twerk it out, let it rock, don’t sleep
808’s knock, keep the pressure alive
Now watch me switch-up, switch-up, thrive
[Verse 2, Gangsta Mode, Hard-Hitting Flow, Deep Drum Work - 95 BPM]
Got the crowd on lock, eyes all track my sway
Step too strong, they don’t know what to say
Beat’s a weapon, no need to reload rounds
When I touch the mic, whole city shut down
Flick of the wrist, yeah, the vibe stay raw
Talk that talk, but they know who in charge
Respect on arrival, no need to lay it down
They move when I move, I ain't playin’ around
[Bridge, Tempo Cut to 70 BPM, Twerk Breakdown, Chopped & Screwed]
(Yeah... slow it... down...)
Slow-motion, hips roll vivid
Bassline hittin’, shadows stay livid
Catch the beat, let the rhythm possess it
Now watch me switch positions...
Tribal drums in the dark, move with precision
Sweat drips down, body locked in the vision
Hearts keep time, but the pulse stay twisted
Now watch the switch-up hit different...
[Extended Chorus, Club Anthem - 95 BPM]
Drop it low, let the bassline ride
Twerk it out, let the whiskey decide
Bounce it up, make ‘em feel that heat
Move too slick, got ‘em stuck on repeat
Drop it low, yeah, the bass go deep
Twerk it out, let it rock, don’t sleep
808’s knock, keep the pressure alive
Now watch me switch-up, switch-up, thrive
[Outro, Chopped & Screwed, Gospel Harmonies, Vinyl Crackle]
(Ahh yeah... we switchin' it up...)
Drop it low, drop it low...
Every time I pull up, I’m changin’ the flow...
Ain’t no one in the game that be doin’ it like us...
808 fades... bass still buzz...

lyrics:
[Intro (Atmospheric Build-Up)]
"Yeah... slow-rollin’ like syrup in the cup...
Bass hittin’ low, make the speakers erupt...
Lights flashin’ bright, shadows movin’ in sync...
Wait... watch the tempo switch up, don’t blink..."
[Verse 1 (Club Bounce, Flirty Flow)]
"Step in the spot, got the bassline thumpin’,
808s hittin’, got the whole crowd jumpin’.
Shadows on the wall, hips movin’ like waves,
Sip slow, let the rhythm misbehave.
Lights low, but the energy high,
Booty poppin’ left-right, catchin’ the eye.
Two shots in, now the vibe’s just right,
Let the DJ spin, keep the party alive tonight."
[Chorus (Catchy Hook, Twerk Anthem)]
"Drop it low, let the bassline ride,
Bounce it up, let the rhythm collide.
Shake it fast, let the shadows slide,
Twerk it out, let the whiskey decide.
Drop it low—hips roll, make the club ignite,
Bounce it up—lights flash, keep the vibe tight.
Shake it fast—bass hits, let the groove excite,
Twerk it out—this the anthem for the night."
[Verse 2 (Seductive Energy, Bass-Heavy)]
"Uh, got the crowd on lock, they don’t stop, they sway,
Booty poppin’ in the spotlight, makin’ it pay.
Heavy bass drops, got the floor vibratin’,
Shadows movin’ fast, no time for hesitatin’.
Hunnid rounds of rhythm, ain’t no reload sound,
They ain’t messin’ with the vibe, we don’t play that clown.
Money on the table, better lay that down,
If you talkin’ ‘bout the queen, better weigh that crown."
[Outro (Fade-Out, Seductive Whisper)]
"Yeahhh...
Drop it low, drop it low...
Every time I pull up, I’m changin’ the flow...
Drop it low, drop it low...
Ain’t no one in the game that be doin’ it like us..."
[Bridge (Tempo Cut, Twerk Breakdown)]
"Slow-motion, hips roll vivid,
Bassline hittin’, shadows stay livid.
Catch the beat, let the rhythm transmit it,
Now watch me switch positions..."
[Extended Chorus (Club Anthem)]
"Drop it low, let the bassline ride,
Bounce it up, let the rhythm collide.
Shake it fast, let the shadows slide,
Twerk it out, let the whiskey decide.
Drop it low—hips roll, make the club ignite,
Bounce it up—lights flash, keep the vibe tight.
Shake it fast—bass hits, let the groove excite,
Twerk it out—this the anthem for the night."

**[Bridge (Tempo Cut, Twerk Breakdown)]**  
"Slow-motion, hips roll vivid,  
Bassline hittin’, shadows stay livid.  
Catch the beat, let the rhythm transmit it,  
Now watch me *switch positions*..."  
---

"Drop it low, let the bassline ride,

Bounce it up—lights flash, keep the vibe tight.

title:  
"The Switch-Up"  
style:  
"Boom Bap x 808 Heavy with Gritty Female Flow, Dynamic Tempo Shifts, Tribal Percussion, and Chopped & Screwed Effects."  
gpts:  
"lyrics"  
[Intro: (Chopped & Screwed, Slow-Drip Drawl, Eerie Synths, Sub-Bass)]  
"Yeah... slow-rollin’ like syrup in the cup..."  
(Deep pitch-down ad-libs)  
"Voice deep, but the flow still cut..."  
"Texas lean with a Brooklyn strut..."  
"Wait... watch the tempo switch up..."  
[Verse 1: (Laid-Back Groove, Smooth Flow, Lowrider Bounce, Deep Bass)]  
"Rollin’ through the city, got that old-school vibe,  
Lowrider creepin’, let the bass just glide.  
Chronic in the air, I ain't stressin’ the time,  
Take a sip, let the world unwind."  
[Pre-Chorus: (Beat Intensifies, Triplet Cadence, Tribal Percussion)]  
"Uh, tempo risin’, let the snare hit harder,  
808 thumpin’, now the flow drip lava.  
Pulse in the rhythm like a heart transplant,  
Switch gears quick—y’all ain’t ready for the dance."  
[Chorus: (Double-Time Switch, Heavy 808s, Chopped Vocals)]  
"Switch it up, flip it, pivot on a dime,  
One verse smooth, next one, outta line.  
Let the chop screw, bring it back, rewind,  
Y’all ain’t seen a style flip this divine."  
[Verse 2: (Gangsta Mode, Hard-Hitting Flow, Deep Drum Work)]  
"Uh, got the wolves outside, they don’t bark, they bite,  
Got the beam on sight, I don’t fight, I ignite.  
Heavyweight talk, got the rings, got the stripes,  
I ain’t takin’ no advice ‘less it double my price."  
[Bridge: (Chopped & Screwed, Tempo Cut to 70 BPM, Eerie Synths)]  
"Slow-motion, vision so vivid,  
See the snakes in the grass, yeah, they all timid.  
Catch ‘em slippin’ like a transmission,  
Now watch me *switch positions*..."  
[Outro: (Gospel Harmonies, Distorted Blues Vocals, Vinyl Crackle)]  
"Yeahhh...  
Switch it up, switch it up...  
Every time I pull up, I’m changin’ the cut...  
Switch it up, switch it up...  
Ain’t no one in the game that be doin’ it like us..."

lyrics:
[Intro: (Lazy Guitar Loop, Screw-Down Ad-Libs, Vinyl Crackle)]  
"Mmm...yeah...  
Ayy, pass that back one time...  
Sip slow, don't spill it now...  
Shadows long out here...yeah..."  
[Verse 1: (Slow-Drawl Delivery, Space Between Bars)]  
"Man, sat in this circle, just tryna exhale,  
Got my name in my chest but my past in my lap still.  
Preacher man told me, 'Let the good Lord save ya,'  
But my hands too dirty, my mind too tangled.  
Ayy, back then, back roads, backseat sermons,  
Momma in the kitchen with a hymn still burnin'.  
Me? I took the long way, jukebox lessons,  
Blues on repeat, couldn’t hear no blessin’."  
[Pre-Chorus: (808s Creep In, Ghostly Echoes, Slurred Delivery)]  
"Mmm, whiskey and shadows, I know ‘em well,  
Every shot I pour got a story to tell.  
Pain in my veins, weight in my chest,  
But the devil can’t dance if I never say yes."  
[Chorus: (Laid-Back Drawl, Chopped Screw Ad-Libs, Bass Swings)]  
"Still here—still floatin’ through the smoke,  
Still here—every sip keep my ghosts real close.  
Mmm, let the bass ride, let the pain slide,  
Still got scars, but I wear ‘em with pride."  
[Verse 2: (Deep Twang, Beat Breathes)]  
"Look, two brothers, two roads, two lost names,  
One ran fast, one stayed, both felt flames.  
Me? I took the backstreets, jukes and gin,  
Learned more from a barstool than a sermon did.  
Talk slow but I think too quick,  
Every step I take got a past that sticks.  
Can’t pray it away, can’t drink it clean,  
So I write these verses like a war in between."  
[Bridge: (Bass and Light Guitar, Raw Delivery)]  
"Let it breathe...let it breathe...  
Mmm, I see my granddaddy’s ghost in the glass,  
I hear them sirens hum when I ride too fast.  
Tell me where the truth live, ‘cause I lost my map,  
But the blues still whisper when the night get black."  
[Outro: (Gospel Blues Harmony, Vinyl Crackle)]  
"Mmm...yeah...  
Shadows long out here...  
Ayy, pass that back one time...  
Sip slow...don’t spill it now..."

lyrics:
[Intro (Chopped & Screwed, Slow-Drip Drawl)]
"Yeah... slow-rollin’ like syrup in the cup...  
Voice deep, but the flow still cut...  
Texas lean with a Brooklyn strut...  
Wait... watch the tempo switch up..."
[Verse 1 (Laid-back Groove, Snoop Dogg Vibe)]
"Rollin’ through the city, got that old-school vibe,  
Lowrider creepin’, let the bass just glide.  
Chronic in the air, I ain't stressin’ the time,  
Take a sip, let the world unwind.  
I move like a don, silk robe in the breeze,  
Grown-man talk, ain't no rushin’ the steez.  
Two fingers up for the ones who believe,  
Started from the dirt, now we plantin’ them trees."
[Chorus (Double-Time Switch, Heavy 808s)]
"Switch it up, flip it, pivot on a dime,  
One verse smooth, next one, outta line.  
Let the chop screw, bring it back, rewind,  
Y’all ain’t seen a style flip this divine.  
Switch it up—slow flow, then I hit ‘em with the heat,  
Switch it up—laid-back, then I ride on the beat.  
Switch it up—trap drums, then I kill ‘em with the speech,  
Switch it up—flow sick, this a lyrical feat."
[Verse 2 (Gangsta Mode, Heavy Drum Work, 50 Cent Energy)]
"Uh, got the wolves outside, they don’t bark, they bite,  
Got the beam on sight, I don’t fight, I ignite.  
Heavyweight talk, got the rings, got the stripes,  
I ain’t takin’ no advice ‘less it double my price.  
Hunnid round drums, ain't no reload sound,  
They ain't messin’ with the squad, we don’t play that clown.  
Money on the table, better lay that down,  
If you talkin’ ‘bout the king, better weigh that crown."
[Outro (Gospel Blues Infusion)]
"Yeahhh...  
Switch it up, switch it up...  
Every time I pull up, I’m changin’ the cut...  
Switch it up, switch it up...  
Ain’t no one in the game that be doin’ it like us..."
[Pre-Chorus (Beat Intensifies, Triplet Cadence)]
"Uh, tempo risin’, let the snare hit harder,  
808 thumpin’, now the flow drip lava.  
Pulse in the rhythm like a heart transplant,  
Switch gears quick—y’all ain’t ready for the dance."
[Bridge (Chopped & Screwed, Tempo Cut to 70 BPM)]
"Slow-motion, vision so vivid,  
See the snakes in the grass, yeah, they all timid.  
Catch ‘em slippin’ like a transmission,  
Now watch me *switch positions*..."
[Verse 3 (Fire Spit Mode, Freestyle Vibes, Kendrick Lamar / Eminem Influence)]
"They ain't wanna see me spaz on a beat,  
Now they backin’ up, tryna fast retreat.  
I’m a beast when I feast on a track, unleashed,  
I could snap in a second, let the cypher repeat.  
Every bar like a loaded round,  
Click-clack, pen scratch, let ‘em know the sound.  
I ain’t even write this down,  
Freestyle off the dome, still burn ‘em to the ground."
tags: Old-School Boom Bap x Percussion-Driven Trap

"Yeah... slow-rollin’ like syrup in the cup...  
Voice deep, but the flow still cut...  
Texas lean with a Brooklyn strut...  
Wait... watch the tempo switch up..."

"Rollin’ through the city, got that old-school vibe,

Take a sip, let the world unwind.

Two fingers up for the ones who believe,  
Started from the dirt, now we plantin’ them trees."

One verse smooth, next one, outta line.  
Let the chop screw, bring it back, rewind,  
Y’all ain’t seen a style flip this divine.  
  
Switch it up—slow flow, then I hit ‘em with the heat,  
Switch it up—laid-back, then I ride on the beat.  
Switch it up—trap drums, then I kill ‘em with the speech,  
Switch it up—flow sick, this a lyrical feat."

"Uh, got the wolves outside, they don’t bark, they bite,

lyrics:
title:
"Whiskey, Shadows, Wounds (Southern Drip Freestyle)"
style:
"Southern-fried storytelling meets slow-rolling funk bass, deep drawl delivery, blues-soaked loops, chopped & slowed vocal textures."
gpts:
"lyrics"
[Intro: Atmospheric Build-Up]
(Soulful, lazy guitar loop, screw-down ad-libs, vinyl crackle)
(mumbling) Mmm...yeah...
Ayy, pass that back one time...
Sip slow, don't spill it now...
Shadows long out here...yeah...
[Verse 1: Loose, conversational flow, space between bars]
(Slow-drawl delivery, beat pulls back, room for breath)
Man, sat in this circle, just tryna exhale,  
Got my name in my chest but my past in my lap still.  
Preacher man told me, “Let the good Lord save ya,”  
But my hands too dirty, my mind too tangled.  
Ayy, back then, back roads, backseat sermons,  
Momma in the kitchen with a hymn still burnin'.  
Me? I took the long way, jukebox lessons,  
Blues on repeat, couldn’t hear no blessin’.  
[Pre-Chorus 1: 808s creep in, ghostly echoes, slurred delivery]
(Chopped & stretched ad-libs, deep bass hum, distant organ notes)  
Mmm, whiskey and shadows, I know ‘em well,  
Every shot I pour got a story to tell.  
Pain in my veins, weight in my chest,  
But the devil can’t dance if I never say yes.  
[Chorus 1: Laid-back drawl, chopped screw ad-libs]
(Bass swings, vocal stretched, like it’s sinking into the groove)  
Still here—still floatin’ through the smoke,  
Still here—every sip keep my ghosts real close.  
Mmm, let the bass ride, let the pain slide,  
Still got scars, but I wear ‘em with pride.  
[Verse 2: More space, letting the beat breathe, deep twang in voice]
(Blues guitar bends, deep bass groove sits low in the pocket)  
Look, two brothers, two roads, two lost names,  
One ran fast, one stayed, both felt flames.  
Me? I took the backstreets, jukes and gin,  
Learned more from a barstool than a sermon did.  
Talk slow but I think too quick,  
Every step I take got a past that sticks.  
Can’t pray it away, can’t drink it clean,

lyrics:
[Intro: Atmospheric Build-Up (Soulful, lazy guitar loop, chopped & slowed ad-libs, 808 rumble)]
"Yeah, gather ‘round now... Let’s bring it. Shadows long tonight... Mmm."
[Verse 1: Southern Flow with UK Drill Influence]
Yo, I’m battle-born, steel spine, I bend shadows like strings,
Wrote my story with pain; ink drips where the devil sings.
Baptized in a bar fight, blessings in whiskey clouds,
Take your shots, I don’t flinch—boy, my scars wear loud.
A voice for the lost—preach it like I walked through fire,
Outlaw gospel anthems fuel my empire.
Steel-toe stomps on these cypher rounds, I break ground,
Country grit, drill bounce, watch ‘em all bow down.
[Pre-Chorus: Tension Building with Gospel Echoes (Pedal steel swells, 808s creep in, choir harmonies hum)]
"Mm, whiskey and shadows, I bear 'em proud,
The stories I carry could bury this crowd."
Pain-stained pages, but I read ‘em all,
While they stumble on their rise, I still stand tall.
[Chorus: Anthemic Explosion with Driving 808s (Bass thumps, harmonica accents, soaring vocals)]
Still here—wearin’ legends on my name,
Still here—this cypher ain’t no game.
Raise that mic, let the ghosts ride,
Still got wounds, but my pride won’t slide.
[Verse 2: Aggressive Callout with Cinematic Imagery]
You came to play chess with a king, but you left your crown,
I cut sharper than banjos strummin’ in a ghost town.
Southern Gothic vibes—pews and neon lights,
My sermons serve both saints and heathens alike.
I talk in deep cuts, lyrical knives swing low,
Break your spirit like bridges under rivers I flow.
While you rehearse fake tales, I bled for my lines,
I’m the outlaw’s truth; your gimmicks get left behind.
[Bridge: Stripped-Down Vulnerability (Minimalist beat, whispered delivery, raw tension)]
Let it breathe... these wounds ain’t tales I borrowed,
I walked the dirt roads lit by flames of sorrow.
A whiskey glass shakes with the weight of regrets,
But these shadows I wear—they’re as real as it gets.

lyrics:
[Intro: Atmospheric Build-Up
(Soulful, lazy guitar loop, screw-down ad-libs, vinyl crackle)
(mumbling)] Mmm...yeah...
Ayy, pass that back one time...
Sip slow, don't spill it now...
Shadows long out here...yeah...

[Verse 1: Loose, conversational flow, space between bars
(Slow-drawl delivery, beat pulls back, room for breath)]
Man, sat in this circle, just tryna exhale,  
Got my name in my chest but my past in my lap still.  
Preacher man told me, “Let the good Lord save ya,”  
But my hands too dirty, my mind too tangled.  
Ayy, back then, back roads, backseat sermons,  
Momma in the kitchen with a hymn still burnin'.  
Me? I took the long way, jukebox lessons,  
Blues on repeat, couldn’t hear no blessin’.  

[Pre-Chorus 1: 808s creep in, ghostly echoes, slurred delivery
(Chopped & stretched ad-libs, deep bass hum, distant organ notes)]  
Mmm, whiskey and shadows, I know ‘em well,  
Every shot I pour got a story to tell.  
Pain in my veins, weight in my chest,  
But the devil can’t dance if I never say yes.  

[Chorus 1: Laid-back drawl, chopped screw ad-libs
(Bass swings, vocal stretched, like it’s sinking into the groove)]
Still here—still floatin’ through the smoke,  
Still here—every sip keep my ghosts real close.  
Mmm, let the bass ride, let the pain slide,  
Still got scars, but I wear ‘em with pride.  

[Verse 2: More space, letting the beat breathe, deep twang in voice
(Blues guitar bends, deep bass groove sits low in the pocket)]  
Look, two brothers, two roads, two lost names,  
One ran fast, one stayed, both felt flames.  
Me? I took the backstreets, jukes and gin,  
Learned more from a barstool than a sermon did.  
Talk slow but I think too quick,  
Every step I take got a past that sticks.  
Can’t pray it away, can’t drink it clean,  
So I write these verses like a war in between.  

[Pre-Chorus 2: Beat slows, blues guitar wails, almost spoken word
(Sparse drum hits, tape delay on vocal, slight distortion)]  
Ayy, whiskey and shadows, I know ‘em well

lyrics:
[Introduction (Spoken over gospel hums, faint 808 pulse)]
"I’ve carried shadows from pews to juke joints,
From silence to screams. This is my rhythm,
My voice. I’m still here, and so are you."
[Verse 1 (Whisper register over muted acoustic strums)]
Sat on a pew where the hymns ran deep,
But shadows outside never let me sleep.
Mama prayed louder than I could sing,
But I found my voice where the blues did ring.
[Pre-Chorus 1 (808s fade in, soft gospel harmonies)]
I walked between prayers and empty glass,
Each rhythm pulling me back to the past.
The loops, the beats—they keep me awake,
But the fire they spark is too strong to break.
[Chorus 1 (Counter-tenor melody swells, 808s thump)]
Still here—still breathing, though the fear runs deep.
Still here—every scar’s a story I need to keep.
Every 808 pounds the weight in my chest,
Every gospel hum sings me closer to rest.
[Verse 2 (Muted blues piano loop, reflective tone)]
Two brothers walked roads I couldn’t take,
One carried fire, the other a shadow’s weight.
Time built walls where love used to be,
Now I’m screaming through rhythms to set me free.
[Pre-Chorus 2 (Drill percussion builds into tight groove)]
The church gave me hymns, the streets gave me fight,
Now every drumbeat pulls me into the light.
The loops repeat, but I’m stronger now,
This voice and rhythm my truth to allow.
[Chorus 2 (Choir rises, counter-tenor adlibs)]
Still here—still breathing, though the nights don’t end.
Still here—every loop pulls me to begin again.
Every beat digs roots in the dirt of my past,
Every drum’s a promise: this voice will last.
[Bridge (Spoken whisper layered over stripped percussion)]
The pews taught me silence, the blues taught me pain,
The gospel taught me how to sing through the rain.
Now these 808s remind me to stand tall—
This rhythm’s my armor. I’ll break every wall.
[Chorus 3 (Explosive layers, anthem-like delivery)]
Still here—still fighting, still lighting my way.
Still here—every note’s a step to a brighter day.
Every beat digs roots, every voice finds its flame,
Every story comes alive when we sing our name.
[Outro (Soft gospel choir fades with spoken line)]
"I’m still here, and so are you.
We rise, one voice, one rhythm, one truth."
[Extended Verse: Triumph Over Shadows] (Rhythmic banjo melody, bluesy electric guitar licks, subtle bass groove, gospel echoes in the background) "The pews whispered fears I couldn’t drown, But shadows retreated as my roots took ground. Every rhythm rewrites the scars I knew, This song’s my proof—my dawn broke through."
[Extended Pre-Chorus: Rising Spirit] (Gospel harmonies swell, polyrhythmic percussion tightens, pedal steel crescendos, cinematic strings emerge) "The loops, the beats, pull me higher still, A choir within me singing, ‘I will, I will.’"
[Extended Chorus: Anthem of Resilience] (Full gospel choir, driving 808s, banjo & fiddle interplay, cinematic string swells, thunderous bass drop) "Still here—this voice is louder, my light won’t fade. Still here—building bridges where shadows once laid. This rhythm’s my heart, this beat’s my truth, Every voice rising proves we're living proof."
[Outro: Resolute Fade-Out] (Fading gospel hums, atmospheric pedal steel, whisper register returns) "And as the echoes fade, one thing rings clear: We rise as one, bound by rhythm—still here."

lyrics:
[Intro: Atmospheric Build-Up]
(Pedal steel swells, muted banjo strums, whispered hook over deep 808 rumble, deep male vocals)
*"Every scar hides a shadow…"* (echoes into silence)
(UK drill hi-hats creep in, 808s pulse beneath gospel hums)

[Verse 1: Narrative & Groove]
(Smoky male vocals, rhythmic banjo picking, subtle harmonica fills, deep bass groove)
Mama told me, "Watch the road, son, shadows move at night."
Granddaddy hummed those hymns, kept the firelight bright.
I got ghosts in my rearview, dust on my name,
808s shake my chest, but the pain stay the same.

[Pre-Chorus: Tension Build]
(Gospel harmonies swell, fiddle slides in, layered percussion builds, pedal steel textures)
Bloodlines run deep like the roots of a song,
Every prayer and every bottle keep me holdin’ on.
(Beat drops, vocal slide into hook)

[Chorus: Anthemic Explosion]
(Rich, deep male powerhouse vocals, driving 808s, explosive UK drill percussion, pedal steel sweeps)
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
Tearing at the pieces I’ve buried inside.
Banjo cuts through bass like lightning at night,
Every beat’s redemption, every drum’s my fight.
(*Gospel echoes: "Hold on, hold on…"*)

[Verse 2: Emotional Depth]
(UK drill bounce, sub-bass heavy groove, vocal glitch accents, rhythmic banjo undercurrent)
Ran from my past, but it still caught up,
Lines they drew couldn’t hold me up.
Two roads—one paved, one dirt and dust,
But the rhythm of my soul never lost my trust.

[Pre-Chorus: Dynamic Rhythms]
(Polyrhythmic percussion, harmonies rising, fiddle licks tighten, banjo riffing)
From juke joints to the steeple’s glow,
The gospel in my blood, the 808s know.

[Chorus: Powerhouse Hook Returns]
(Layers deepen, male gospel harmonies, intensity peaks, bluesy pedal steel fills)
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
Tearing at the pieces I’ve buried inside.
808s roll like thunder through the midnight rain,
Every note’s a battle, every chorus my name.

[Bridge: Stripped-Down Vulnerability]
(Pedal steel, harmonica, raw male acapella harmonies, minimal percussion)
They drew their lines in the dust and sand,
But my voice don’t break, and my feet still stand.
(Beat drop builds back up, layered gospel hums)

[Breakdown: Confessional Moment]
(Bluesy harmonica, light acoustic guitar, whispered delivery, deep bass undertone)
Mmm... let it breathe... let it breathe...
Pain ain't nothin’ but a song you ain't done singin’ yet...

[Extended Chorus: Climactic Drive]
(Everything hits—full male gospel choir, 808s peak, banjo & fiddle duel, thunderous bass drop)
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
Tearing at the pieces I’ve buried inside.
Every hymn, every beat, every line, every fight,
We rise up louder—we blaze through the night.

[Outro: Ghostly Fade-Out]
(Fading gospel echoes, pedal steel hums, decaying 808 pulse, harmonica drifting into silence)
("Still here... still here...")
tags: Country Trap / UK Drill Fusion / Gospel Soul Infused Extended Club Edition
