lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sat down in a circle, first time in years,
Just me, my name, and a flood of tears.
Choked on the words as my story spilled,
Each bottle drained couldn’t keep it still.

[Pre-Chorus 1 (Trap hi-hats, deep 808s slide in)]
Country roads in my mind, haunted and cracked,
With the weight of those whispers pulling me back.

[Chorus 1 (Gospel-infused harmonies, bass-heavy drop)]
Whiskey and shadows, the ghosts in my veins,
Truth’s in the trigger, but so is the pain.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
Every memory cuts deeper than the one before.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
Trying to heal but running from what’s inside.

[Verse 2 (Twanging guitar loop, punchy 808s)]
Raised in pews where hymns ran deep,
Sunday mornings taught a soul to keep.
But the bassline hit, and the rhythm spoke,
Now the past’s still callin’, but I choose the notes.

[Pre-Chorus 2 (Drill percussion kicks in, vocal layering)]
County lines in my blood, city beats in my breath,
Two worlds collide when I take a step.

[Chorus 2 (Huge bass drop, layered synths)]
Whiskey and shadows, the ghosts in my veins,
Truth’s in the trigger, but change takes the pain.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
But I ain’t who I was—I don’t flinch no more.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
Falling apart, but learning to fight.

[Bridge (Trap beat breakdown, airy gospel echoes)]
Turn the volume up—let it rise, let it shake,
Turn the pain into rhythm, let the bass vibrate.
Soulful cries meet the rhythm’s fire,
Healing through beats that take me higher.

[Chorus 3 (Club-ready energy, explosive beat)]
Whiskey and shadows, but I own my name,
Truth’s in the trigger, but so is the change.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
But I stand taller than I did before.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
But now I walk through the fire with open eyes.

[Outro (Echoed ad-libs, pulsing 808s fade out)]
Country winds and city lights collide,
I ain’t whole yet...
...but I ain’t afraid.

(Counter-tenor hums softly over stripped-back piano chords as strings fade to silence.)

lyrics:
[Intro (Screw-down vocal ad-libs, blues guitar licks, slow 808 roll-in)]
Mmm...yeah... shadows long out here... sip slow... let it ride...

[Verse 1 (Laid-back flow, deep 808s, chopped guitar loop)]
Sat down in a circle, first time in years,
Just me, my name, and a flood of tears.
Choked on the words as my story spilled,
Each bottle drained couldn’t keep it still.

[Pre-Chorus 1 (Syrupy hi-hats, organ keys, vocal chop, ghostly echoes)]
Country roads in my mind, haunted and cracked,
With the weight of those whispers pulling me back.

[Chorus 1 (Laid-back, melodic hook, heavy bass knock, reverb-soaked harmonies)]
Whiskey and shadows, the ghosts in my veins,
Truth’s in the trigger, but so is the pain.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
Every memory cuts deeper than the one before.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
Trying to heal but running from what’s inside.

[Verse 2 (Deep, UGK-style storytelling, slow head-nod groove, spaced-out ad-libs)]
Raised in pews where hymns ran deep,
Sunday mornings taught a soul to keep.
But the bassline hit, and the rhythm spoke,
Now the past’s still callin’, but I choose the notes.

[Pre-Chorus 2 (Southern gospel hums, thick bass groove, slowed-down echoes)]
County lines in my blood, city beats in my breath,
Two worlds collide when I take a step.

[Chorus 2 (Soulful hook, classic H-Town vibe, syrup-drenched ad-libs, chopped vocal loops)]
Whiskey and shadows, the ghosts in my veins,
Truth’s in the trigger, but change takes the pain.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
But I ain’t who I was—I don’t flinch no more.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
Falling apart, but learning to fight.

[Bridge (Texas screw-down breakdown, deep reverb, guitar cries, 808 stutters)]
Turn the beat low—let it ride, let it shake,
Let the pain drip slow like that fifth that I take.
Soul still heavy, but the rhythm don’t lie,
Bassline preachin’ while the ghosts walk by.

[Chorus 3 (Chopped & screwed elements, thick bassline, live band energy, electric piano runs)]
Whiskey and shadows, but I own my name,
Truth’s in the trigger, but so is the change.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
But I stand taller than I did before.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
But now I walk through the fire with open eyes.

[Outro (Echoed ad-libs, bluesy guitar licks, slow fade-out, layered murmurs)]
Country roads and city lights collide,
I ain’t whole yet...
...but I ain’t afraid.
Mmm...yeah... let it breathe... sip slow...

lyrics:
[Introduction (Spoken over gospel hums, faint 808 pulse)]
"I’ve carried shadows from pews to juke joints,
From silence to screams. This is my rhythm,
My voice. I’m still here, and so are you."

[Verse 1 (Whisper register over muted acoustic strums)]
Sat on a pew where the hymns ran deep,
But shadows outside never let me sleep.
Mama prayed louder than I could sing,
But I found my voice where the blues did ring.

[Pre-Chorus 1 (808s fade in, soft gospel harmonies)]
I walked between prayers and empty glass,
Each rhythm pulling me back to the past.
The loops, the beats—they keep me awake,
But the fire they spark is too strong to break.

[Chorus 1 (Counter-tenor melody swells, 808s thump)]
Still here—still breathing, though the fear runs deep.
Still here—every scar’s a story I need to keep.
Every 808 pounds the weight in my chest,
Every gospel hum sings me closer to rest.

[Verse 2 (Muted blues piano loop, reflective tone)]
Two brothers walked roads I couldn’t take,
One carried fire, the other a shadow’s weight.
Time built walls where love used to be,
Now I’m screaming through rhythms to set me free.

[Pre-Chorus 2 (Drill percussion builds into tight groove)]
The church gave me hymns, the streets gave me fight,
Now every drumbeat pulls me into the light.
The loops repeat, but I’m stronger now,
This voice and rhythm my truth to allow.

[Chorus 2 (Choir rises, counter-tenor adlibs)]
Still here—still breathing, though the nights don’t end.
Still here—every loop pulls me to begin again.
Every beat digs roots in the dirt of my past,
Every drum’s a promise: this voice will last.

[Bridge (Spoken whisper layered over stripped percussion)]
The pews taught me silence, the blues taught me pain,
The gospel taught me how to sing through the rain.
Now these 808s remind me to stand tall—
This rhythm’s my armor. I’ll break every wall.

[Chorus 3 (Explosive layers, anthem-like delivery)]
Still here—still fighting, still lighting my way.
Still here—every note’s a step to a brighter day.
Every beat digs roots, every voice finds its flame,
Every story comes alive when we sing our name.

[Outro (Soft gospel choir fades with spoken line)]
"I’m still here, and so are you.
We rise, one voice, one rhythm, one truth."

title: Still Here

lyrics:
[Introduction (Spoken, over low drum pulse)]
"I’ve carried shadows from places I can’t name.
The pews, the silence, the spaces where my brothers should’ve been.
This is for the ones who carry it all and keep going."

[Verse 1 (Spoken with rising intensity, hand drum beat)]
The pews were hard, the hymns ran deep,
Sunday mornings taught a soul to keep.
But the silence after was louder than the choir,
And the weight of the words never lifted higher.
I sat there, a child, with hands too small
To hold the fear that came when the shadows called.

[Chorus 1 (Melodic chanting with floor toms and low bass hits)]
Still here—still breathing, though I’m split in two.
Still here—every scar tells the story of truth.
Every drumbeat pulls me through the night,
Every echo says, "Stand and fight."

[Verse 2 (Rhythmic speech with syncopated drum patterns)]
My brothers walked their own roads, far from mine.
One was my hero, the other my shadow in time.
But the years built walls we never tore down,
And now I’m here, alone in this town.
I filled out forms, wrote down my ghosts,
But the words felt hollow, like I’d already lost.

[Pre-Chorus (Trap hi-hats with faint echo of acoustic notes)]
The church taught me to pray, but the prayers don’t land.
I’m reaching for something I don’t understand.

[Chorus 2 (Melodic chanting, bass grows with vocal layers)]
Still here—still breathing, though the weight’s so cruel.
Still here—every scream carves a rhythm through the room.
Every drumbeat shakes the ghosts to light,
Every shadow learns to fight.

[Bridge (Layered vocal harmonies, stripped-back percussion)]
Speak it loud, speak it raw,
Every crack, every flaw.
The rhythm doesn’t judge the words—
It just holds them.
Here in the beat,
Here in the air.
Your pain is seen.
Your voice is bare.

[Chorus 3 (Explosive drums, emotional vocal release)]
Still here—we are fire; the scars are the proof.
Still here—we are rhythm, the oldest of truths.
Every drumbeat sets the soul alight,
Every voice becomes the fight.

[Outro (Faint drum echoes, spoken softly)]
"I’m still here, and so are you.
We rise together,
Even if we start alone."

title: Still Here

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sat down in a circle, first time in years,
Just me, my name, and a flood of tears.
Choked on the words as my story spilled,
Each bottle drained couldn’t keep it still.

[Pre-Chorus 1 (Fast-attack 808s kick in)]
Country roads in my mind, haunted and cracked,
With the weight of those whispers pulling me back.

[Chorus 1 (Anthemic, layered vocals)]
Whiskey and shadows, the ghosts in my veins,
Truth’s in the trigger, but so is the pain.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
Every memory cuts deeper than the one before.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
Trying to heal but running from what’s inside.

[Verse 2 (Fretless bass slides, groovy swing rhythm)]
Raised in pews where hymns ran deep,
Sunday mornings taught a soul to keep.
But the bassline hit, and the rhythm spoke,
Now the past’s still callin’, but I choose the notes.

[Pre-Chorus 2 (808s tighten, high hats build)]
County lines in my blood, city beats in my breath,
Two worlds collide when I take a step.

[Chorus 2 (Heavy bass drop)]
Whiskey and shadows, the ghosts in my veins,
Truth’s in the trigger, but change takes the pain.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
But I ain’t who I was—I don’t flinch no more.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
Falling apart, but learning to fight.

[Bridge (Trap beat breakdown, synth riffs)]
Bring the beat in—let it rise, let it grow,
Blend the pain with the groove, let the story flow.
Soulful cries meet the rhythm’s fire,
Healing through beats that lift me higher.

[Chorus 3 (Ad-lib vocals, massive club energy)]
Whiskey and shadows, but I own my name,
Truth’s in the trigger, but so is the change.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
But I stand taller than I did before.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
But now I walk through the fire with open eyes.

[Outro (Echoed ad-libs, pulsing 808s fade out)]
Country winds and city lights collide,
I ain’t whole yet...
...but I ain’t afraid.

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sat down in a circle, first time in years,
Just me, my name, and a flood of tears.
Choked on the words as my story spilled,
Each bottle drained couldn’t keep it still.

[Pre-Chorus 1]
Country roads in my mind, haunted and cracked,
With the weight of those whispers pulling me back.

[Chorus 1]
Whiskey and shadows, the ghosts in my veins,
Truth’s in the trigger, but so is the pain.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
Every memory cuts deeper than the one before.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
Trying to heal but running from what’s inside.

[Verse 2]
Raised in pews where hymns ran deep,
Sunday mornings taught a soul to keep.
But the bassline hit, and the rhythm spoke,
Now the past’s still callin’, but I choose the notes.

[Pre-Chorus 2]
County lines in my blood, city beats in my breath,
Two worlds collide when I take a step.

[Chorus 2]
Whiskey and shadows, the ghosts in my veins,
Truth’s in the trigger, but change takes the pain.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
But I ain’t who I was—I don’t flinch no more.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
Falling apart, but learning to fight.

[Bridge]
Bring the beat in—let it rise, let it grow!
Blend the pain with the groove, let the story flow.
Soulful cries meet a trap beat’s fire,
Healing through rhythms that lift me higher.

[Chorus 3]
Whiskey and shadows, but I own my name,
Truth’s in the trigger, but so is the change.
I hear the past rap its knuckles on the door,
But I stand taller than I did before.
Oh, whiskey, shadows, and wounds I hide,
But now I walk through the fire with open eyes.

[Outro]
Country winds and city lights collide,
I ain’t whole yet…
…but I ain't afraid.

lyrics:
[Intro, Bare Vocals, Hummed Harmonies, Distant Baritone Lead]  
(All hum in harmony, deep and resonant: Hmm-mmm, Lord, Lord… why won’t You take this weight?)  
(Baritone solo, spoken with ache):  
Ohhh Lord… I been runnin’… but it’s still there… still there...  
(Harmony swells: Ooohhh… Lord, still there…)
[Verse 1, Lead Baritone, Tenor Call-and-Response]  
Baritone (solo):  
🎶 Woke up shakin’ in the middle of the night 🎶  
(First Tenor & Bass respond: Mmm-mmm, here it come, here it come…)
🎶 Saw Your face in the bottle, but it still ain’t right 🎶  
(Second Tenor echoes: No, no, no… it ain’t right…)
🎶 I hear the shots in my head like a drum 🎶  
(Bass with low hums: Boom, boom, boom…)
🎶 Ain’t no war outside, but inside, it don’t stop 🎶  
(Full harmony swells: Nooo, Lord, it don’t stop…)
[Pre-Chorus, Layered Harmonies, Slow Stomps & Snaps]  
🎶 I tell myself, “Boy, you just need some sleep” 🎶  
(Second Tenor responds softly: Mmm-hmm, go to sleep, go to sleep…)
🎶 But the past got a key to the lock on me 🎶  
(Full harmony builds: Ooohhh, it got me tight!)
[Chorus, Full Harmony, Stomps & Claps]  
🎶 Three years of denial, thirty in the dark 🎶  
(Bass echoes: Thirty in the dark…)
🎶 Every love I lost left a hole in my heart 🎶  
(First Tenor responds: Ohhh, my heart…)
🎶 I say I’m fine, but that’s a lie I keep 🎶  
🎶 I run, I drink, but the ghosts don’t leave 🎶  
(Clapping rhythm: Clap-clap-CLAP clap clap…)
[Post-Chorus, Gospel Swell, Tenor Wails]  
(First Tenor soaring ad-lib):  
(Ohhh, shame don’t let me go…)
(Baritone echoes softly):  
(Ohhh, fear don’t let me grow…)
[Verse 2, Bass-Driven Groove, Tenor Ad-Libs]  
Second Tenor (solo):  
🎶 Hands shake, don’t know if it’s fear or the drink 🎶  
(Bass hums deeply: Mmm, heavy hands, heavy hands…)
🎶 Every mirror got eyes, don’t wanna see what they think 🎶  
(Baritone calls out: Nooo, Lord, don’t make me look…)
🎶 I hear ‘em whisper when I walk through town 🎶  
(Full group responds: That’s him, that’s him… lost it all, lost it all…)
🎶 Used to wear my name proud, now I keep my head down 🎶  
(Harmony swells: Mmm, shame, shame, shame…)
[Bridge, Stripped-Back Harmonies, Call-and-Response]  
🎶 They said, “You need help” 🎶  
(First Tenor responds gently: Nooo, not me…)
🎶 But the truth is a fire burnin’ underneath 🎶  
(Second Tenor and Bass respond together: Ohhh, it burns, it burns!)
[Chorus, Full Choir, Handclaps & Stomps Intensified]  
🎶 Three years of denial, thirty in the dark 🎶  
(Bass repeats: Thirty in the dark…)
🎶 Every love I lost left a hole in my heart 🎶  
(Tenors echo: My heart, my heart…)
🎶 I say I’m fine, but that’s a lie I keep 🎶  
🎶 I run, I drink, but the ghosts don’t leave 🎶  
(Clapping rhythm: Clap-clap-CLAP clap clap…)
[Outro, Fading Harmonies, Soulful Swells]  
(Baritone hums the melody, raw and low)
(First Tenor, soft and pleading):  
🎶 Maybe I ain’t alone in this long midnight ride 🎶  
(All fade into hums: Hmm-mmm, Lord, Lord… can You hear me now?)
title: Three Years of Denial

🎶 Left di heart I loved behind, turned mi back 🎶  
🎶 Built dis wall, but it breaks wit’ every track 🎶  
(Female ad-libs shimmer: “Oooohhh… wit’ every track…")  
🎶 Heavy heart, heavier mind, guilt press pon mi 🎶  
🎶 Mi pray fi peace, but it still cyan’t find mi 🎶  
🎶 Bass and strings collide, life sound offbeat 🎶  
🎶 Tek dis weight, Lord—I just waan mi relief 🎶  
  
[BRIDGE – Stripped Back, Emotional Strings Swell]  
Lead Female Vocalist (melodic and haunting):  
🎶 Yuh tink strength makes yuh free, but yuh chained inside 🎶

Male Vocalist 2 (spoken, hushed):  
Lord… hear mi callin'… I’m tired of runnin'.  
Let di music free mi soul.  
(Strings slide upward, chimes echo faintly, tension builds.)  
  
[FINAL CHORUS – Peak Energy, Full Instrumentation]

🎶 Thirty years in the silence, thirty in the dark 🎶  
(Bassline thunders, strings dancing through the boom bap rhythm)

🎶 Lord, I’m beggin’—tek these chains offa mi! 🎶  
Female Vocalists (soaring harmonies):  
🎶 Oooooohhh… tek these chains, Lord 🎶  
(Rhythms push into overdrive—808s drop one final time.)  
  
[OUTRO – Strings Fade, Bass Hums, Vocals Whisper]  
(Bluegrass strings pluck softly, echoing like an unresolved thought.)  
(Male vocals hum low: Hmm-mmm… hmm-mmm…)
Female Vocalist (barely audible):  
🎶 Maybe free ain’t somethin’ yuh find… 🎶  
🎶 Maybe free is leavin’ di chains behind… 🎶  
(Fades out on a haunting bass hum.)

lyrics:
[Intro, Bare Vocals, Hummed Harmonies, Distant Baritone Lead]  
(All hum in harmony, deep and resonant: Hmm-mmm, Lord, Lord… why won’t You take this weight?)  
(Baritone solo, spoken with ache):  
Ohhh Lord… I been runnin’… but it’s still there… still there...  
(Harmony swells: Ooohhh… Lord, still there…)
[Verse 1, Lead Baritone, Tenor Call-and-Response]  
Baritone (solo):  
🎶 Woke up shakin’ in the middle of the night 🎶  
(First Tenor & Bass respond: Mmm-mmm, here it come, here it come…)
🎶 Saw Your face in the bottle, but it still ain’t right 🎶  
(Second Tenor echoes: No, no, no… it ain’t right…)
🎶 I hear the shots in my head like a drum 🎶  
(Bass with low hums: Boom, boom, boom…)
🎶 Ain’t no war outside, but inside, it don’t stop 🎶  
(Full harmony swells: Nooo, Lord, it don’t stop…)
[Pre-Chorus, Layered Harmonies, Slow Stomps & Snaps]  
🎶 I tell myself, “Boy, you just need some sleep” 🎶  
(Second Tenor responds softly: Mmm-hmm, go to sleep, go to sleep…)
🎶 But the past got a key to the lock on me 🎶  
(Full harmony builds: Ooohhh, it got me tight!)
[Chorus, Full Harmony, Stomps & Claps]  
🎶 Three years of denial, thirty in the dark 🎶  
(Bass echoes: Thirty in the dark…)
🎶 Every love I lost left a hole in my heart 🎶  
(First Tenor responds: Ohhh, my heart…)
🎶 I say I’m fine, but that’s a lie I keep 🎶  
🎶 I run, I drink, but the ghosts don’t leave 🎶  
(Clapping rhythm: Clap-clap-CLAP clap clap…)
[Post-Chorus, Gospel Swell, Tenor Wails]  
(First Tenor soaring ad-lib):  
(Ohhh, shame don’t let me go…)
(Baritone echoes softly):  
(Ohhh, fear don’t let me grow…)
[Verse 2, Bass-Driven Groove, Tenor Ad-Libs]  
Second Tenor (solo):  
🎶 Hands shake, don’t know if it’s fear or the drink 🎶  
(Bass hums deeply: Mmm, heavy hands, heavy hands…)
🎶 Every mirror got eyes, don’t wanna see what they think 🎶  
(Baritone calls out: Nooo, Lord, don’t make me look…)
🎶 I hear ‘em whisper when I walk through town 🎶  
(Full group responds: That’s him, that’s him… lost it all, lost it all…)
🎶 Used to wear my name proud, now I keep my head down 🎶  
(Harmony swells: Mmm, shame, shame, shame…)
[Bridge, Stripped-Back Harmonies, Call-and-Response]  
🎶 They said, “You need help” 🎶  
(First Tenor responds gently: Nooo, not me…)
🎶 But the truth is a fire burnin’ underneath 🎶  
(Second Tenor and Bass respond together: Ohhh, it burns, it burns!)
[Chorus, Full Choir, Handclaps & Stomps Intensified]  
🎶 Three years of denial, thirty in the dark 🎶  
(Bass repeats: Thirty in the dark…)
🎶 Every love I lost left a hole in my heart 🎶  
(Tenors echo: My heart, my heart…)
🎶 I say I’m fine, but that’s a lie I keep 🎶  
🎶 I run, I drink, but the ghosts don’t leave 🎶  
(Clapping rhythm: Clap-clap-CLAP clap clap…)
[Outro, Fading Harmonies, Soulful Swells]  
(Baritone hums the melody, raw and low)
(First Tenor, soft and pleading):  
🎶 Maybe I ain’t alone in this long midnight ride 🎶  
(All fade into hums: Hmm-mmm, Lord, Lord… can You hear me now?)

(All hum in harmony, deep and resonant: Hmm-mm, hmm-mm)
Baritone Solo (spoken):
Oh Lord… Thirty years runnin’, and now I’m here, callin’ on You…
(Harmony swells: Ooohhh… Callin’ on You…)
[Verse 1 – Baritone Lead, Full Harmony on Key Lines]
Baritone (solo):
They said I was blind, but I thought they were fools,
(First Tenor & Bass hum: Mm-hmm…)
I buried my pride in a box of my rules.
(Second Tenor & Baritone: My rules… oh my rules…)
Now I see the wreckage, can’t turn back in time,
(All harmonize: Oooohhh, Lord…)
Lord, was it me that destroyed what was mine?
(All singers echo soft harmony: What was mine… ooooh…)
[Pre-Chorus – Call and Response]
Lead (Baritone):
I told myself I was fine, I could drink it away,
Response (All):
But You can’t drown the truth when it’s beggin’ to stay.
Lead (Baritone):
They said I was broken, I laughed in their face—
Response (All):
Oh, Lord, am I too far gone to find grace?
(Harmony swells: Grace… Grace… Mercy… Grace…)
[Chorus – Full Harmony, Syncopated Gospel Clap]
Lead (First Tenor):
Three decades of denial, a life built on lies,
Second Tenor & Bass (echo):
Ohhhh, lies…
Lead (First Tenor):
Can You hear me now, Lord, as I finally cry?
Baritone & Bass (deep echo):
Lord, hear him cry…
Full Group:
Am I too far gone, or will You answer me, please?
(Clapping syncopation: Clap-clap-CLAP clap clap…)
First Tenor & Second Tenor (high):
Every scar tells a story, Lord, I’m down on my knees…
[Post-Chorus – Layered Harmonies and Syncopation]
(Low hum continues as Lead soars with ad-libs over harmonies)
First Tenor (soaring):
(Ohhh, I’m callin’, I’m callin’ You…)
Response (All):
(Ohhh, don’t turn away… don’t turn away…)
Bass (spoken):
I’m here now, Lord… Show me the way.
[Verse 2 – Second Tenor Lead with Layered Responses]
Second Tenor (solo):
My little girl’s laughter, it haunts me at night,
(Baritone echoes softly: Ooooh, at night…)
And my son’s empty chair at his football fight.
(First Tenor & Second Tenor: Oooo

title: test

lyrics:
[Intro, Smoky male vocals, Distant honky-tonk piano]
(Hmm-mm, hmm-mm)
Thirty years runnin', never lookin' back
Now I see the wreckage in the rearview black
[Verse 1, Raw storytelling, Sparse 808s]
I was built like a fortress, steel in my veins
Did my time, earned my stripes, never showin’ the pain
But the nights get colder, and the scars don’t fade
I keep runnin' from the ghost of the wars I made
[Pre-Chorus, Gospel harmonies, Swelling organ, Extended to 6 bars]
I told myself I was fine, I could drink it away
But the ghosts in my shadow got somethin’ to say
Tried to bury my past, but the truth don’t sleep
Every howl in the night feels like wolves at my feet
[Chorus, Smoky female lead, Punchy 808s, UK drill percussion]
Three years of denial, thirty in the dark
Tried to drown the fire, but it left a mark
Can’t run from the truth, it’s a dog that bites
Every scar got a story, every wrong got a price
[Post-Chorus, Gospel harmonies, Echoed ad-libs]
(Ohhh, can’t run, can’t hide)
(Ohhh, Lord knows I tried)
[Verse 2, Honky-tonk piano, Swinging beat]
I can smell the whiskey, hear the shots in my sleep
Medals on the dresser, but they don’t mean peace
Doctor says “Son, you got a storm in your head”
But I fight like hell just to live when I'm close to the edge
[Bridge, Melodic female ad-libs, Stripped-back 808s]
Can I fix what’s broken? Or am I too far gone?
If I call out for mercy, will someone hold on?
Every sinner’s got a prayer buried deep inside
But I’ve lived in the dark so long, I forgot the light
[Chorus, Full band, Intensified percussion]
Three years of denial, thirty in the dark
Tried to drown the fire, but it left a mark
Can’t run from the truth, it’s a dog that bites
Every scar got a story, every wrong got a price
[Outro, Fading gospel harmonies, Distant honky-tonk piano with light ad-libs]
(Hmm-mm, hmm-mm)
Maybe help ain’t weakness, maybe pain ain’t pride
Maybe I ain’t alone in this long midnight ride

lyrics:
[Intro: Hollow Bass, Distant Bar Sounds, Slide Guitar]
(Whispered, smoky female lead)
"Neon flickers, and the jukebox cries,
Whiskey whispers—ain’t nothin’ but lies.
Ooooh, jus’ you & me…"
(Ambient cough, slight distortion. Steel guitar bends low. Kick drum lags unevenly, like a fragile heartbeat.)
[Verse 1: Sparse Kick, Boom Bap 808s, Slide Guitar]
(Raw, conversational female vocal, slightly slurred like a midnight confession)
"She slid a twenty cross the stage last night,
Said, ‘Dance, baby, dance,’ like she owned my fight.
Mama vanished when I was ten,
Neon lights became my next of kin."
(Mid-bass 808 rolls; hi-hats lightly glitch, matching the tension.)
"I grip that pole, all my prayers gone cold,
Swirling in smoke, truths untold.
Hands take what they can, hearts never stay,
But this bottle? It numbs my yesterdays."
[Pre-Chorus: Haunted Harmonies, Twang Guitar, Sub-Bass]
(Smoky female lead, hushed intensity, layered with ethereal female backing harmonies)
"Granny’s voice still breaks my haze,
‘Lawd, don’t you forget your ways.’
But I’m drownin’—"
(Sub-bass swells, building anticipation for the hook.)
[Chorus: All-Female Gospel Choir, Boom Bap Rhythm, Honky-Tonk Piano]
(Lead female vocal—raspy, aching belt. Female choir swells subtly in the background.)
"Jus’ you & me, on this hardwood stage,
Dollar bills fall, but they don’t buy change.
Whiskey talks sweet, but it don’t set me free,
Still I sip, still I spin—Lord, just let me be."
(Steel guitar echoes distant sorrow.)
[Verse 2: Boom Bap Drums, Lyrical Flow, Dynamic Builds]
(Emotional and gritty, smoky female lead, harmonized by ghostly female whispers)
"Smoke swirls thick, their stares cut deep,
Rings stay on while their promises creep.
Granny’s hymn still haunts my ears,
‘Child, don’t you drown in your fears.’"
(808s pulse erratically, reflecting unease.)
"Eyes shut tight, red neon blurs,
Smile fake as the hands that stir.
Grippin’ the pole, same shadows invade,
Am I redeemed, or just betrayed?"
[Breakdown: Minimal Gospel Swell, Hollow Percussion, Vocal Ad-lib]
(Handclaps echo in the void; smoky female voice, soft and raw, with an eerie, hymn-like cadence.)
"Callin’ me home—oh, sweet mercy!
Through smoke and sins where no one’s free…"
(Steel guitar cries faintly; sub-bass pulses like a heartbeat.)
[Chorus Reprise: Dynamic Layers, Emotional Peak]
(Lead female vocal dominates; all-female gospel choir becomes more prominent.)
"Jus’ you & me, on this hardwood stage,
Dollar bills fall, but they don’t buy change.
Whiskey talks sweet, but it don’t set me free,
Still I sip, still I spin—Lord, just let me be."
(Melodic percussion glitches off-grid, creating tension before resolving.)
[Outro: Fading Slide Guitar, Vinyl Crackle]
(Smoky female lead whispers her final confession, barely audible, like a fading memory.)
"Ooooh… have mercy on me…
It’s jus’ you & me."
(Bar sounds fade into silence; steel guitar lingers like a ghost in the dark.)
tags: Country Trap infused with O.G. Boom Bap (Melodic Percussion: UK Drill + Heavy 808s—mid-bass
title: Strippin' & Sippin': Jus' You & Me

lyrics:
[Intro: Haunting Slide Guitar, Distant Bar Sounds, Reversed Beat Stutter]
(Whispered, close to the mic, breathy)
"Neon flickers, bottles clinkin’...
Past still lingers, whiskey drinkin’…
Ooooh, jus’ you & me…"
(A slow steel guitar bend melts into off-grid trap hi-hats.)
[Verse 1: Sparse Kick, Deep Bass Swells, Laid-Back Flow]
"Granny prayed, 'Child, hold fast,'
But the devil’s got hands in a shotgun blast.
Mama's ghost sittin’ front row pew,
She left me scars, but she told me the truth."
(Beat glitches slightly, then snaps back on an unexpected hi-hat fill.)
"Whiskey don’t talk, but it knows my sins,
And I swear them ghosts start talkin’ again.
Neon halos, smoke like choirs,
Where the jukebox hums over burned-out liars."
(808s slam in staggered, off-grid patterns as harmonies swell.)
[Chorus: Gospel Choir, 4-on-the-Floor Stomp, Dirty Slide Guitar]
"Jus’ you & me, in this long goodbye,
Whiskey burns, but it keeps me high.
Say the words, let the darkness decree,
That love ain’t cheap, and it sure ain’t free."
(Kick drum hits late, then snaps back ahead of the downbeat—intentionally off-balance but hard-hitting.)
[Verse 2: Twangy Guitar Riffs + Rolling Hi-Hats, Unpredictable Drum Fills]
"Smoke curls slow where the juke joint hums,
Last call blues and forgotten ones.
Granny’s hymn cut through my haze,
‘Lawd, child, don’t you lose your ways.’"
(Drums swerve between triplet traps and half-time stutters, adding uneven momentum.)
"My heels stomp time in a battle of sins,
Dancin’ with the devil, but the floor give in.
Jukebox skippin’, can’t find the groove,
Neon buzzin’ out the song we knew."
[Bridge: A Capella Gospel Moment, Handclaps + Sub-Bass Rumble]
(The beat completely drops out, leaving only handclaps and deep hums.)
"Granny’s voice keeps callin’ me home,
Through sins and smoke where the lost still roam.
A light shines bright, won’t let me go—
A hymn of hope from so long ago."
(Bass swells in slow, seismic pulses, mimicking a heartbeat before the drop.)
[Chorus Reprise: Full Choir Belts, Hard-Hitting 808s, Unstable Hi-Hat Rolls]
"Jus’ you & me, in this fight to survive,
Whiskey burns, but it keeps me alive.
Speak the truth, let the neon decree,
That my soul’s worth more than the chains they see."
(Beat collapses into a swirl of hi-hats, then resets into a massive drop of distorted 808s and steel guitar feedback.)
[Outro: Haunting Steel Guitar, Whispered Vocal Layers, Fading Vinyl Crackle]
"Ooooh… have mercy on me…
It’s jus’ you & me."
(A lone steel guitar bends over distant bar sounds, fading into reverberated whispers, breathy vocal textures, and a vinyl crackle that slowly disintegrates.)

- [Off-Kilter Kick Pattern], [Rimshot Delays], [Unexpected Cymbal Accents]

- [Big Finish]

- *Mmmm… Take my hand… lead me… home…*

🎤 **Final whisper:**  
- *Yes… it… will…*

lyrics:
[Intro] (Whispered, over soft slide guitar and ambient bar sounds)
"Neon lights, whiskey glass,
Smoke rolls thick like my preacher’s past…
It’s jus’ you & me."
[Verse 1] (Low, smoky vocals, light piano, and minimal percussion)
"Granny prayed, 'Child, don’t stray,'
But the devil danced where the neon swayed.
Mama’s absence cut deep inside,
Whiskey and lies fill the pain I hide."
(Background harmonies swell slightly, building tension.)
"Hallelujah hands never saved my soul,
But echoes linger where the bottles roll."
[Chorus] (Powerful, full band sound, emotional high-point)
"Jus’ you & me, where the shadows collide,
Whiskey burns, but it fuels my pride.
Say the words, let the darkness decree,
That love ain’t cheap, and it ain’t for me."
[Verse 2] (Stronger beat, twangy guitar, 808s drop in)
"Smoke-filled rooms where the juke joint hums,
Lost dreams scatter like broken drums.
Granny’s hum cuts through my haze,
‘Lawd, child, don’t you lose your ways.’"
[Bridge] (Stripped-down, acapella moment with soft handclaps)
"Granny’s voice, an anchor to ground,
In seas of sin where I’m halfway drowned.
A prayer lingers, soft yet strong—
A hymn for a soul who wandered too long."
[Chorus Reprise] (Explosive vocal belts, full gospel choir joins in)
"Jus’ you & me, where the shadows collide,
Whiskey burns, but it fuels my pride.
Say the words, let the neon decree,
That my soul’s worth more than the chains they see."
[Outro] (Haunting slide guitar, fading whisper, atmospheric reverb)
"Ooooh… have mercy on me…
It’s jus’ you & me."
title: Strippin' & Sippin': Jus' You & Me

lyrics:
### TITLE: Stand the Rain (Twerk Remix)  
**STYLE:** Trap, Club Banger, High-Energy Female Anthem, Heavy 808s, Hypnotic Hooks, Chop & Screw Breakdowns  
### INTRO *(DJ drop, filtered vocal tease, 808s creeping in...)*  
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Ayo! This one for the ladies! Boss chicks only! Drop it low, let’s GO!"_  
_(808s rumble, synths swirl, chopped vocals echo... beat builds in)_  
### VERSE 1 *(Smooth R&B melody, trap bounce groove)*  
**Male Vocalist:**  
_You and me, we made a vow,_  
_For better or for worse._  
_Can’t believe you let me down,_  
_But the truth, oh, how it hurts._  
_(Hi-hats roll in, deep bass thumps, crowd chants start)_  
### PRE-CHORUS *(Energy builds, percussive claps, stuttered vocal layers)*  
**Male Vocalist:**  
_I see the storm clouds rollin’ in,_  
_But can we dance in the rain again?_  
_(Vocal echoes, synth risers, tension builds... beat about to DROP)_  
### CHORUS *(Heavy bass drop, hypnotic hook repeats for max engagement)*  
**Group Vocals (chant-style):**  
_Can you stand it? (Ayy!)_  
_Can you stand it? (Woo!)_  
_Drop that, shake that,_  
_Bounce it, break that!_  
_(808s hit HARD, twerk-ready tempo locks in, synths pulse with club energy)_  
### VERSE 2 *(High-energy, confident female rap verse)*  
**Female Rapper (bold, rapid-fire flow):**  
_Body like a problem, boy, solve that quick!_  
_Stack real thick, got ‘em throwin’ them bricks!_  
_Drip stay cold, but the way I drop heat,_  
_Hips don’t lie, make ‘em weak in the knees!_  
_Throw that back, put the money where ya mouth is,_  
_Slow whine, then I hit ‘em with a bounce flip!_  
_Never been a rookie, all-star when I play,_  
_Boss moves only, make ‘em rain all day!_  
_(808 slides hit, beat breathes for a moment before chopping down)_  
### BRIDGE *(Chop & Screw section – Beat slows down, deep vocal FX)*  
_(Vocals warped, reverb-drenched... low, slowed voice repeats)_  
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Sloooow it doooown.... Now bring it BACK!"_  
_(Beat slams back in, high energy resumes)_  
### FINAL CHORUS *(Max energy, final bass explosion!)*  
**Group Vocals (hypnotic chant, stacked layers):**  
_Can you stand it? (Ayy!)_  
_Can you stand it? (Woo!)_  
_Drop that, shake that,_  
_Bounce it, break that!_  
_(Beat rides out, twerk tempo stays locked, club energy remains high)_  
### OUTRO *(DJ outro, crowd hype callouts, ad-lib fade out)*  
**DJ MoMoney:** _"That’s how you do it! Queens only! If you ain’t bringin’ that energy, STAY HOME!"_  
_(808s fade, female rapper ad-libs, club sounds drift into the night...)_

**STYLE:** Trap, Club Banger, High-Energy Female Anthem, Heavy 808s, Hypnotic Hooks, Chop & Screw Breakdowns  
### INTRO *(DJ drop, filtered vocal tease, 808s creeping in...)*  
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Ayo! This one for the ladies! Boss chicks only! Drop it low, let’s GO!"_  
_(808s rumble, synths swirl, chopped vocals echo... beat builds in)_  
### VERSE 1 *(Smooth R&B melody, trap bounce groove)*  
**Male Vocalist:**  
_You and me, we made a vow,_  
_For better or for worse._  
_Can’t believe you let me down,_  
_But the truth, oh, how it hurts._  
_(Hi-hats roll in, deep bass thumps, crowd chants start)_  
### PRE-CHORUS *(Energy builds, percussive claps, stuttered vocal layers)*  
**Male Vocalist:**  
_I see the storm clouds rollin’ in,_  
_But can we dance in the rain again?_  
_(Vocal echoes, synth risers, tension builds... beat about to DROP)_  
### CHORUS *(Heavy bass drop, hypnotic hook repeats for max engagement)*  
**Group Vocals (chant-style):**  
_Can you stand it? (Ayy!)_  
_Can you stand it? (Woo!)_  
_Drop that, shake that,_  
_Bounce it, break that!_  
_(808s hit HARD, twerk-ready tempo locks in, synths pulse with club energy)_  
### VERSE 2 *(High-energy, confident female rap verse)*  
**Female Rapper (bold, rapid-fire flow):**  
_Body like a problem, boy, solve that quick!_  
_Stack real thick, got ‘em throwin’ them bricks!_  
_Drip stay cold, but the way I drop heat,_  
_Hips don’t lie, make ‘em weak in the knees!_  
_Throw that back, put the money where ya mouth is,_  
_Slow whine, then I hit ‘em with a bounce flip!_  
_Never been a rookie, all-star when I play,_  
_Boss moves only, make ‘em rain all day!_  
_(808 slides hit, beat breathes for a moment before chopping down)_  
### BRIDGE *(Chop & Screw section – Beat slows down, deep vocal FX)*  
_(Vocals warped, reverb-drenched... low, slowed voice repeats)_  
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Sloooow it doooown.... Now bring it BACK!"_  
_(Beat slams back in, high energy resumes)_  
### FINAL CHORUS *(Max energy, final bass explosion!)*  
**Group Vocals (hypnotic chant, stacked layers):**  
_Can you stand it? (Ayy!)_  
_Can you stand it? (Woo!)_  
_Drop that, shake that,_  
_Bounce it, break that!_  
_(Beat rides out, twerk tempo stays locked, club energy remains high)_  
### OUTRO *(DJ outro, crowd hype callouts, ad-lib fade out)*  
**DJ MoMoney:** _"That’s how you do it! Queens only! If you ain’t bringin’ that energy, STAY HOME!"_  
_(808s fade, female rapper ad-libs, club sounds drift into the night...)_

lyrics:
### TITLE: Can You Stand the Rain (Extended Club Country-Funk Remix)
**STYLE:** Funk-infused R&B, Country-Soul, Club Remix
### INTRO *(DJ drop, atmospheric pads, funk guitar licks building energy...)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Ayo, welcome to the late-night groove! We mixin’ that funk, that country, and that soul! Let’s go!"_
_(Live bass slaps, pedal steel glides, wah guitars flicker, deep 808 pulse builds...)_
### VERSE 1 *(Smooth R&B phrasing, soulful storytelling, country harmonies)*
**Male Vocalist:**
_You and me, we made a vow,_  
_For better or for worse._  
_Can’t believe you let me down,_  
_But the truth, oh, how it hurts._  
_(Drums kick in, groove sets the tone)_  
### PRE-CHORUS *(Funk intensifies, guitar and organ swell in energy)*
**Male Vocalist:**
_I see the storm clouds rollin’ in,_  
_But can we dance in the rain again?_  
_(Horns build tension, harmonies stack, beat swells before exploding into the chorus)_  
### CHORUS *(Full-band explosion, gospel harmonies, punchy drums)*
**Group Vocals:**
_Can you stand the rain?_  
_When the night gets cold, will you stay the same?_  
_Some love comes easy, some love needs pain,_  
_But tell me, can you stand the rain?_  
_(Pedal steel glides, deep funk bass grooves, horns stab in rhythm)_  
### VERSE 2 *(Country storytelling meets bluesy runs, dynamic call-and-response)*
**Male Vocalist:**
_Tried to hold on, tried to believe,_  
_But your heart got restless, now I can see._  
_You ran for cover when the skies got grey,_  
_Would’ve danced forever, but you walked away._  
_(Funk breakdown—bass solo, guitar riff interplay, percussive claps keep energy up)_  
### BRIDGE *(Extended instrumental, horns and organ solos, groove lock-in)*
**Female Vocalist (gospel-infused, powerful):**
_Ohhhhh, baby can’t you see?_  
_Storms will come, but love runs deep!_  
_(Band builds tension, drums roll into breakdown section)_  
### BREAKDOWN *(Stripped-down groove, DJ callouts, live-band jam feel)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Hold up, hold up! We takin’ this one to the dancefloor—country funk style!"_
_(Bass grooves, percussion breaks, crowd claps, live call-and-response between vocals and horns)_  
### FINAL CHORUS *(Key change, massive energy surge, call-and-response harmonies soar)*
**Group Vocals:**
_Can you stand the rain?_  
_When the night gets cold, will you stay the same?_  
_Some love comes easy, some love needs pain,_  
_But tell me, can you stand the rain?_  
_(Big brass finale, pedal steel weaves through, live funk groove keeps rolling)_  
### OUTRO *(Jam session, band fades out organically, DJ sends off the crowd)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"That’s how we do it—soul, country, funk, all in one! Keep that vibe alive, ‘cause real love stands the storm!"_
_(Band grooves out, horns swell, organ fades into deep bass resonance...)_

**STYLE:** Funk-infused R&B, Country-Soul, Club Remix
### INTRO *(DJ drop, atmospheric pads, funk guitar licks building energy...)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Ayo, welcome to the late-night groove! We mixin’ that funk, that country, and that soul! Let’s go!"_
_(Live bass slaps in, pedal steel slides, wah guitars flicker, deep 808 pulse builds...)_
### VERSE 1 *(Smooth R&B phrasing, soulful storytelling, country harmonies)*
**Male Vocalist:**
_You and me, we made a vow,_  
_For better or for worse._  
_Can’t believe you let me down,_  
_But the truth, oh, how it hurts._  
_(Drums kick in, groove sets the tone)_  
### PRE-CHORUS *(Funk intensifies, guitar and organ swell in energy)*
**Male Vocalist:**
_I see the storm clouds rollin’ in,_  
_But can we dance in the rain again?_  
_(Horns build tension, harmonies stack, beat swells before exploding into the chorus)_  
### CHORUS *(Full-band explosion, gospel harmonies, punchy drums)*
**Group Vocals:**
_Can you stand the rain?_  
_When the night gets cold, will you stay the same?_  
_Some love comes easy, some love needs pain,_  
_But tell me, can you stand the rain?_  
_(Pedal steel glides, deep funk bass grooves, horns stab in rhythm)_  
### VERSE 2 *(Country storytelling meets bluesy runs, dynamic call-and-response)*
**Male Vocalist:**
_Tried to hold on, tried to believe,_  
_But your heart got restless, now I can see._  
_You ran for cover when the skies got grey,_  
_Would’ve danced forever, but you walked away._  
_(Funk breakdown—bass solo, guitar riff interplay, percussive claps keep energy up)_  
### BRIDGE *(Extended instrumental, horns and organ solos, groove lock-in)*
**Female Vocalist (gospel-infused, powerful):**
_Ohhhhh, baby can’t you see?_  
_Storms will come, but love runs deep!_  
_(Band builds tension, drums roll into breakdown section)_  
### BREAKDOWN *(Stripped-down groove, DJ callouts, live-band jam feel)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Hold up, hold up! We takin’ this one to the dancefloor—country funk style!"_
_(Bass grooves, percussion breaks, crowd claps, live call-and-response between vocals and horns)_  
### FINAL CHORUS *(Key change, massive energy surge, call-and-response harmonies soar)*
**Group Vocals:**
_Can you stand the rain?_  
_When the night gets cold, will you stay the same?_  
_Some love comes easy, some love needs pain,_  
_But tell me, can you stand the rain?_  
_(Big brass finale, pedal steel weaves through, live funk groove keeps rolling)_  
### OUTRO *(Jam session, band fades out organically, DJ sends off the crowd)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"That’s how we do it—soul, country, funk, all in one! Keep that vibe alive, ‘cause real love stands the storm!"_
_(Band grooves out, horns swell, organ fades into deep bass resonance...)_

lyrics:
[Intro – DJ Drop, Percussion Rolls In]  
(*DJ voice, vinyl crackle*)  
🎤 **"Y’all feel that bass? Nah, you FEEL that bass! 808 GODDESS in the building!"**  
(*Conga roll, 808s warming up, breath sounds*)  
💰 **Mid-bass hummin’, deep bass drumming, sub low dropping—body feel something…**  
[Verse 1 – 16 Bars, Laid-Back Groove]  
🎤 **808 knockin’ like it’s tryna bust the door down,**  
🎤 **Bass hit so deep, shake the floor now,**  
🎤 **Tribal with the drumline, body in control now,**  
🎤 **Percussion talkin’ louder than these lames in my phone now.**  
🔥 **Step light, but the bag heavy,**  
🔥 **808 sittin’ thick like a black Chevy,**  
🔥 **I don’t chase, I attract, let the stacks get me,**  
🔥 **Mid-bass hummin’ like a threat, don’t test me.**  
[Pre-Chorus – 4 Bars, Percussion Breakdown]  
🎤 **Rimshot tap, bassline crack—**  
🎤 **Snare roll up, 808 slap—**  
🎤 **Mid-bass knock, sub low drop—**  
🎤 **Let the kick drum TALK.**  
[Chorus – 8 Bars, Hypnotic Chant]  
🔥 *808 GODDESS, BASSLINE QUEEN!* (*Let’s go!*)  
🔥 *NO SYNTHS, JUST DRUMS—FEEL THAT STEEZ!* (*Uh!*)  
🔥 *MIDBASS KICK, MAKE YA HEARTBEAT SKIP!* (*Boom!*)  
🔥 *SUB LOW DROP, MAKE YA SOUL GET LIT!* (*Whoo!*)  
(*Repeat Hook [x2] with chant-style call & response*)  
[Breakdown – Chop & Screw, Tempo Drops]  
(*Deep, distorted voice, DJ scratch effect*)  
💰 **808s TALKIN’, SHHHH… LISTEN CLOSE…**  
💰 **MID-BASS HUMMIN’ LIKE A MURDER NOTE…**  
💰 **PERCUSSION RUNNIN’ LIKE A HEARTBEAT CODE…**  
💰 **SUB LOW DROPPIN’ LIKE AN EARTHQUAKE ZONE…**  
(*Drums fade into final hook*)  
[Outro – DJ Drop, Spoken Word]  
🎤 **"No melodies. No gimmicks. Just pressure."**  
(*Beat fades into deep 808 pulse*)
title: 808 GODDESS

lyrics:
[Intro – DJ Drop, Vinyl Crackle Effect]  
(*DJ voice*)  
🎤 **"From the grind to the shine—Hustle & Heels in the building!"**  
(*Beat builds, bass creeps in*)  
💰 **No sleep, no crew—grind is mine, grind is mine...**  
💰 **Lights off, rent due—what a time, what a time...**  
[Verse 1 – 16 Bars, Laid-back Flow]  
🎤 **Came to the city, duffle bag full of dreams,**  
🎤 **They ain't see the hustle, just the curves and the jeans,**  
🎤 **Told ‘em I ain’t built for the game—yeah, right,**  
🎤 **Now my name on the list, club packin’ every night.**  
🔥 **Landlord callin’, money tight like a corset,**  
🔥 **Had to lace the heels up, turn the pain into a paycheck,**  
🔥 **Ain't no prince, ain't no rescue—just a mindset,**  
🔥 **Now they cuttin’ me a side check!**  
[Pre-Chorus – 4 Bars, Tension Build]  
🎤 **Mirror, mirror, what they see?** (*What?*)  
🎤 **Not my hustle, just double-Ds!** (*Damn!*)  
🎤 **Not my hunger, just hips and knees,**  
🎤 **They ‘bout to learn what pressure means.**  
[Chorus – 8 Bars, Heavy 808s]  
🔥 *Hustle and heels, cash in the air!* (*Throw it up!*)  
🔥 *Do what I gotta, don’t need a prayer!* (*Nah!*)  
🔥 *Flip it, stack it, get outta there!* (*Go!*)  
🔥 *Queen with a crown, they wasn’t prepared!* (*Bow down!*)  
(*Repeat Chorus [x2] with added vocal layering for energy boost*)  
[Verse 3 – Speed Rap, Triple Word Rhymes Per Phrase]  
💨 **Boss moves, top views, never gon’ lose,**  
💨 **Penthouse, no doubts, cash got clues,**  
💨 **Big checks, invest, flip that soon,**  
💨 **New deals, high heels, glow like moons.**  
🔥 **Fast lane, campaign, never no shame,**  
🔥 **Champagne, big gains, racks insane,**  
🔥 **Two steps, no debts, money on deck,**  
🔥 **Outwork, net worth, all due respect!**  
[Breakdown – Chop & Screw, Slow Tempo Drop]  
(*Deep, distorted voice*)  
💰 **MONEY MOVE, LIGHTS STAY ON...**  
💰 **EVICTION NOTICE GONE...**  
💰 **NOW MY NAME RINGS STRONG...**  
💰 **HUSTLE GAME TOO LONG...**  
(*808 fade out, haunting echo of “too long…”)  
[Outro – Vinyl Crackle Effect, Spoken Word]  
(*Soft, confident tone*)  
🎤 **"Boss moves only. No exceptions… Run me my blessings."**  
(*Beat fades into deep bass hum*)

lyrics:
[Intro, Soulful Horns, Delta Blues Vocals]
(Ohhh ohhh, yeah yeah)
Headin’ down that dirt road, baby
Soul’s as heavy as the Georgia clay
[Verse 1, Southern Roots, Ethnic Percussion]
Cotton fields and church bells ring
Mama’s tears in every hymn she sings
Dusty boots, can’t shake the past
But these roots, they grow too deep, too fast
[Chorus, Soulful Horns, Trap Beats, Power Vocals]
Southbound soul, can’t break free
Got a storm rollin’ deep inside of me
Mississippi moon, light my way
I’m a shadow in the heat of yesterday
[Verse 2, Blues Vocals, Ethnic Percussion]
Footsteps haunt the night’s parade
Whiskey ghosts in the cool, dark shade
Fires burn, the river speaks
Her waters hold my hidden grief
[Pre-Chorus, Harmonic Surprise, Delta Blues Vocals]
(Sway with me, sway with me, yeah yeah)
We dance with pain, we fight the chains
But down here, love still remains
[Chorus, Soulful Horns, Trap Beats, Power Vocals]
Southbound soul, can’t break free
Got a storm rollin’ deep inside of me
Mississippi moon, light my way
I’m a shadow in the heat of yesterday
[Bridge, Instrumental Break, Percussion Solo]
(Drums hit hard, blues guitar weeps)
[Melodic Horn Build, Ascending Progression]
Ooooh, ooooh—
[Final Chorus, Full Arrangement, Gospel Choir Backing]
Southbound soul, can’t break free
Storm rollin’ deep, it’s a part of me
Delta dreams, rise like flames
Burnin’ high, but never tamed
[Outro, Quiet Arrangement, Echoing Vocals]
(Southbound… soul… yeah, yeah…)

lyrics:
[Intro, DJ Drop x2, Hypnotic Bounce]  
(*DJ Voice, Reverb Effect*)  
🎤 **"Ladies, if you stackin' and strappin’, let ‘em know!"** 🎤  
(*Beat builds, 808s creeping in*)  
(*Low, sultry whisper*)  
Ooooh... yeah, yeah...  
💰 Racks on racks, I count that twice, (*double it!*)  
💰 Ass so fat, break that ice... (*woo!*)  
[Verse 1, 16 Bars, Laid-Back Confidence → Mid-Verse Tempo Switch to Double-Time]  
They talk about the body, but they never see the hustle, (*Facts!*)  
Two-a-days in the gym, I don't do this just for fun though, (*Nah!*)  
Stack it up, send it back to Momma like a boss,  
Lil’ bro need them kicks, big sis cuttin’ checks, no loss.  
(*808s punch harder, hi-hats rolling faster—tempo shift!*)  
Ayy, don’t get it twisted, this ain’t charity,  
Whole squad lit, independent, that's a rarity, (*Too rare!*)  
Twerk a lil’ somethin’, then invest it in some equity,  
Body on a milli, but my mind worth the treasury.  
(*Beat drops—808s BOOM, vocals layered, aggressive overdubs*)  
🔥 **Yeah, they see the curves, but they don’t see the math** (*Ayy!*)  
💸 **Countin’ up this paper while I’m sittin’ in the back** (*Big racks!*)  
💸 **Whole club jump when they hear this track** (*Turn up!*)  
💸 **If you hatin’, you can watch while I double that stack** (*BIG FACTS!*)  
[Hook, 8 Bars, Club Chant, Stacked Vocals]  
🔥 *STACKED & STRAPPED, ALL THIS CASH* (*whoo!*)  
🔥 *MAKE IT RAIN, THROW IT BACK* (*let’s go!*)  
🔥 *OWN MY SH*T, I AIN’T ASKED* (*nope!*)  
🔥 *GOT THAT BAG, GOT THAT RACK* (*BIG RACKS!*)  
[Breakdown, Chop & Screw, Slow Tempo Drop]  
(*Deep, distorted voice, DJ scratch effect*)  
💰 **MONEY TALK, MONEY MOVE...** (*screwed vocal effect*)  
💰 **WORK TOO HARD, CAN’T LOSE...** (*echo*)  
💰 **LOOK TOO GOOD, GOT ‘EM FROZE...** (*f-f-froze!*)  
💰 **STACK, STACK, STACK, THEN GOOOOO...** (*GO!*)  
[Final Hook, Gospel Explosion, Chant Vocals]  
🔥 *STACKED & STRAPPED, ALL THIS CASH* (*whoo!*)  
🔥 *MAKE IT RAIN, THROW IT BACK* (*let’s go!*)  
🔥 *OWN MY SH*T, I AIN’T ASKED* (*nope!*)  
🔥 *GOT THAT BAG, GOT THAT RACK* (*BIG RACKS!*)  
[Outro, DJ Drop, Vinyl Crackle Effect, Spoken Word]  
(*Sultry, confident tone*)  
**"Look too good to be stressin’... Got the whole world second-guessin’..."**  
**"Boss moves only, no exceptions... Now run me my blessings..."**  
(*Beat fades, echoes of “run me my blessings”*)

lyrics:
[Intro, DJ Drop, Percussion Rolls In]  
(*DJ voice, vinyl crackle*)  
🎤 **"Ayy, this that old-school slap—808 GODDESS in the building!"** 🎤  
(*Conga roll, 808s warming up, heavy breath sounds*)  
(*Spoken, gritty voice*)  
Yeah… uh-huh…  
No synths, no gimmicks, just **rhythm and bass**…  
Let’s go.  
[Verse 1, 16 Bars, Laid-Back Bouncy Flow]  
808 knockin’ like it’s tryna bust the door down, (*Boom!*)  
Bass hit so deep, shake the floor now, (*Whoo!*)  
Tribal with the drumline, body in control now,  
Percussion talkin’ louder than these lames in my phone now. (*Bye!*)  
Step light, but the bag heavy, (*Uh!*)  
808 sittin’ thick like a black Chevy, (*Skrrt!*)  
I don’t chase, I attract, let the stacks get me,  
Mid-bass hummin’ like a threat, don’t test me. (*Rrrrah!*)  
Break it down like—(*808 solo, percussive shuffle*)  
Yeah, break it down like—(*808 roll, reverb kicks in*)  
Sound waves hit different when the lows this mean,  
Whole club hypnotized, let the rhythm just breathe… (*Shhh…*)  
[Hook, 8 Bars, Chant Energy, Percussion-Driven]  
🔥 *808 GODDESS, BASSLINE QUEEN* (*Let’s go!*)  
🔥 *NO SYNTHS, JUST DRUMS—FEEL THAT STEEZ* (*Uh!*)  
🔥 *MIDBASE KICK, MAKE YA HEARTBEAT SKIP* (*Boom!*)  
🔥 *SUB LOW DROP, MAKE YA SOUL GET LIT* (*Whoo!*)  
[Breakdown, Chopped & Screwed, 808s Take Over]  
(*Deep, distorted voice*)  
💰 **808s TALKIN’, SHHHH… LISTEN CLOSE…** (*Screwed vocal effect*)  
💰 **MID-BASE HUMMIN’ LIKE A MURDER NOTE…** (*BOOM!*)  
💰 **PERCUSSION RUNNIN’ LIKE A HEARTBEAT CODE…** (*BA-BOOM!*)  
💰 **SUB LOW DROPPIN’ LIKE AN EARTHQUAKE ZONE…** (*WHOOSH!*)  
[Outro, DJ Drop, Vinyl Crackle Effect, Spoken Word]  
(*Sultry, confident tone, reverb applied*)  
🎤 **"No melodies, no gimmicks… just pressure."**  
🎤 **"808s, percussion, and pure energy… That’s how we move."**  
🎤 **"Now let that bassline ride out…"**  
(*Beat fades, echoes of “808 GODDESS” slow down like a vinyl spin-down*)

lyrics:
[Intro, Slow-Drip Drawl, Chopped & Screwed]
(*Deep, slowed vocal effect*)  
Yeah, yeah...  
Tryna make it out the city but the city got me twisted...  
(*Record scratch, tempo shifts up*)  
Lights off, rent due, gotta make a quick decision...  
[Verse 1, Laid-back Groove]  
Came to the city, dreams packed in a carry-on,  
Told ‘em I could spit but they stared at the silicone,  
"She too fine, she ain’t grime, she ain’t built for the throne,"  
Had to show ‘em that my bars cut deeper than cologne.  
[Beat Switch, 808 Hits Harder]  
Ayy, bill collectors talkin’ reckless on my line,  
Landlord say I got ‘til Friday—then it’s time,  
Ain’t no savior, gotta save my own shine,  
So I lace up the heels, make the dollar signs climb.  
[Pre-Chorus, Triplet Flow, Tension Build]  
Mirror, mirror, tell me what they see,  
Not my struggle—just the double-Ds,  
Not the hunger—just the hips and knees,  
But they ‘bout to learn what pressure mean.  
[Chorus, Peak Energy, Heavy 808s]  
🔥 *Hustle and heels, cash in the air* 🔥  
🔥 *Do what I gotta, don’t need a prayer* 🔥  
🔥 *Flip it, stack it, get outta there* 🔥  
🔥 *A queen with a crown, they wasn’t prepared* 🔥  
[Chop & Screw Breakdown, Slow Tempo Drop]  
(*Deep, distorted voice*)  
Sloooow...  
💰 Money come, money go...  
💰 Dancin’ for a bankroll...  
💰 But the real flex is self-control...  
[Verse 2, Double-Time Switch]  
Now they lookin’ like, "Damn, she can flow for real?"  
Didn’t need a cosign, didn’t sign no deals,  
All this talk ‘bout my body, but my mind pay bills,  
Now they streamin’ my songs, now they beggin’ for feels.  
[Bridge, Beat Drops to Half-Time, Cinematic Strings]  
Tryna judge me? Man, you never walked my shoes,  
Did what I had to, I ain't never had to choose,  
Survival ain't pretty, but you do what you do,  
And when the light hit right, even scars look smooth.  
[Final Chorus, Gospel Explosion, Vocal Stacks]  
🔥 *Hustle and heels, cash in the air* 🔥  
🔥 *Do what I gotta, don’t need a prayer* 🔥  
🔥 *Flip it, stack it, get outta there* 🔥  
🔥 *A queen with a crown, they wasn’t prepared* 🔥  
[Outro, Spoken Word, Vinyl Crackle Effect]  
(*Soft, breathy delivery*)  
One night turn to two,  
Two nights turn to moves,  
Moves turn to checks,  
Now who really made the news?  
(*Beat fades out, echoes of “who really made the news?”*)

[Intro, Chopped & Screwed, Slow-Drip Drawl]
*(Pitch-down effect, eerie synths swelling in the background)*  
Yeah... slow-rollin’ like syrup in the cup...  
Voice deep, but the flow still cut...  
Texas lean with a Brooklyn strut...  
Wait... watch the tempo switch up...  
[Verse 1, Laid-back Groove, Snoop Dogg Vibe]  
Rollin’ through the city, got that old-school vibe  
Lowrider creepin’, let the bass just glide  
Chronic in the air, I ain't stressin’ the time  
Take a sip, let the world unwind  
I move like a don, silk robe in the breeze  
Grown-man talk, ain't no rushin’ the steez  
Two fingers up for the ones who believe  
Started from the dirt, now we plantin’ them trees  
[Pre-Chorus, Beat Intensifies, Triplet Cadence]  
Uh, tempo risin’, let the snare hit harder  
808 thumpin’, now the flow drip lava  
Pulse in the rhythm like a heart transplant  
Switch gears quick—y’all ain’t ready for the dance  
[Chorus, Double-Time Switch, Heavy 808s]  
Switch it up, flip it, pivot on a dime  
One verse smooth, next one, outta line  
Let the chop screw, bring it back, rewind  
Y’all ain’t seen a style flip this divine  
Switch it up—slow flow, then I hit ‘em with the heat  
Switch it up—laid-back, then I ride on the beat  
Switch it up—trap drums, then I kill ‘em with the speech  
Switch it up—flow sick, this a lyrical feat  
[Verse 2, Gangsta Mode, 50 Cent Energy]  
Uh, got the wolves outside, they don’t bark, they bite  
Got the beam on sight, I don’t fight, I ignite  
Heavyweight talk, got the rings, got the stripes  
I ain’t takin’ no advice ‘less it double my price  
Hunnid round drums, ain't no reload sound  
They ain't messin’ with the squad, we don’t play that clown  
Money on the table, better lay that down  
If you talkin’ ‘bout the king, better weigh that crown  
[Bridge, Chopped & Screwed, Tempo Cut to 70 BPM]  
*(Vocals warped, deep echoes, eerie synths fade in)*  
Slow-motion, vision so vivid  
See the snakes in the grass, yeah, they all timid  
Catch ‘em slippin’ like a transmission  
Now watch me *switch positions*...  
[Verse 3, Fire Spit Mode, Freestyle Vibes, Eminem/Kendrick Lamar Style]  
They ain't wanna see me spaz on a beat  
Now they backin’ up, tryna fast retreat  
I’m a beast when I feast on a track, unleashed  
I could snap in a second, let the cypher repeat  
Every bar like a loaded round  
Click-clack, pen scratch, let ‘em know the sound  
I ain’t even write this down  
Freestyle off the dome, still burn ‘em to the ground  
[Outro, Gospel Harmonies, Distorted Blues Vocals]  
*(Layered soulful harmonies, raw and unfiltered)*  
Yeahhh...  
Switch it up, switch it up...  
Every time I pull up, I’m changin’ the cut...  
Switch it up, switch it up...  
Ain’t no one in the game that be doin’ it like us...

title: The Switch-Up

lyrics:
[Intro, Hypnotic Bounce]  
(*Low, sultry whisper*)  
Ooooh... yeah, yeah...  
💰 Racks on racks, I count that twice,  
💰 Ass so fat, break that ice...  
[Verse 1, Laid-Back Confidence]  
They talk about the body, but they never see the hustle,  
Two-a-days in the gym, I don't do this just for fun though,  
Stack it up, send it back to Momma like a boss,  
Lil’ bro need them kicks, big sis cuttin’ checks, no loss.  
[Beat Switch, Bass Gets Grittier]  
Ayy, don’t get it twisted, this ain’t charity,  
Whole squad lit, independent, that's a rarity,  
Twerk a lil’ somethin’, then invest it in some equity,  
Body on a milli, but my mind worth the treasury.  
[Pre-Chorus, Tension Builds, Triplet Flow]  
💋 Legs tight, waist right, we don’t do no free rides,  
💋 Bands pop, heads drop, money rain from sky high,  
💋 Own this, own that, ain’t no shame, just straight facts,  
💋 Flip a dollar, make it back—now tell ‘em where my queens at?!  
[Chorus, Peak Energy, Heavy 808s]  
🔥 *STACKED & STRAPPED, ALL THIS CASH* 🔥  
🔥 *MAKE IT RAIN, THROW IT BACK* 🔥  
🔥 *OWN MY SH*T, I AIN’T ASKED* 🔥  
🔥 *GOT THAT BAG, GOT THAT RACK* 🔥  
[Chop & Screw Breakdown, Slow Tempo Drop]  
(*Deep, distorted voice*)  
💰 MONEY TALK, MONEY MOVE...  
💰 WORK TOO HARD, CAN’T LOSE...  
💰 LOOK TOO GOOD, GOT ‘EM FROZE...  
💰 STACK, STACK, STACK, THEN GOOOOO...  
[Verse 2, Double-Time Flow, Straight Fire]  
Got ‘em stuck when I walk through,  
Pressure so thick need a whole new view,  
Say it’s "just a**" but they copy what I do,  
‘Cause the hustle been elite and the money come through.  
[Bridge, Beat Drops to Half-Time, Cinematic Strings]  
Tryna judge me? Man, you never walked my heels,  
Had to learn the game quick, had to learn to keep it real,  
Ain't nobody handed s***, I been out here payin' bills,  
And when I step up in the club, whole city know the drill.  
[Final Chorus, Gospel Explosion, Chant Vocals]  
🔥 *STACKED & STRAPPED, ALL THIS CASH* 🔥  
🔥 *MAKE IT RAIN, THROW IT BACK* 🔥  
🔥 *OWN MY SH*T, I AIN’T ASKED* 🔥  
🔥 *GOT THAT BAG, GOT THAT RACK* 🔥  
[Outro, Vinyl Crackle Effect, Spoken Word]  
(*Sultry, confident tone*)  
Look too good to be stressin’,  
Got the whole world second-guessin’,  
Boss moves only, no exceptions,  
Now run me my blessings...  
(*Beat fades, echoes of “run me my blessings”*)

title: STACKED & STRAPPED

lyrics:
[Intro, Slow-Drip Drawl, Chopped & Screwed]
(*Deep, slowed vocal effect*)  
Yeah, yeah...  
Tryna make it out the city but the city got me twisted...  
(*Record scratch, tempo shifts up*)  
Lights off, rent due, gotta make a quick decision...  
[Verse 1, Laid-back Groove]  
Came to the city, dreams packed in a carry-on,  
Told ‘em I could spit but they stared at the silicone,  
"She too fine, she ain’t grime, she ain’t built for the throne,"  
Had to show ‘em that my bars cut deeper than cologne.  
[Beat Switch, 808 Hits Harder]  
Ayy, bill collectors talkin’ reckless on my line,  
Landlord say I got ‘til Friday—then it’s time,  
Ain’t no savior, gotta save my own shine,  
So I lace up the heels, make the dollar signs climb.  
[Pre-Chorus, Triplet Flow, Tension Build]  
Mirror, mirror, tell me what they see,  
Not my struggle—just the double-Ds,  
Not the hunger—just the hips and knees,  
But they ‘bout to learn what pressure mean.  
[Chorus, Peak Energy, Heavy 808s]  
🔥 *Hustle and heels, cash in the air* 🔥  
🔥 *Do what I gotta, don’t need a prayer* 🔥  
🔥 *Flip it, stack it, get outta there* 🔥  
🔥 *A queen with a crown, they wasn’t prepared* 🔥  
[Chop & Screw Breakdown, Slow Tempo Drop]  
(*Deep, distorted voice*)  
Sloooow...  
💰 Money come, money go...  
💰 Dancin’ for a bankroll...  
💰 But the real flex is self-control...  
[Verse 2, Double-Time Switch]  
Now they lookin’ like, "Damn, she can flow for real?"  
Didn’t need a cosign, didn’t sign no deals,  
All this talk ‘bout my body, but my mind pay bills,  
Now they streamin’ my songs, now they beggin’ for feels.  
[Bridge, Beat Drops to Half-Time, Cinematic Strings]  
Tryna judge me? Man, you never walked my shoes,  
Did what I had to, I ain't never had to choose,  
Survival ain't pretty, but you do what you do,  
And when the light hit right, even scars look smooth.  
[Final Chorus, Gospel Explosion, Vocal Stacks]  
🔥 *Hustle and heels, cash in the air* 🔥  
🔥 *Do what I gotta, don’t need a prayer* 🔥  
🔥 *Flip it, stack it, get outta there* 🔥  
🔥 *A queen with a crown, they wasn’t prepared* 🔥  
[Outro, Spoken Word, Vinyl Crackle Effect]  
(*Soft, breathy delivery*)  
One night turn to two,  
Two nights turn to moves,  
Moves turn to checks,  
Now who really made the news?  
(*Beat fades out, echoes of “who really made the news?”*)

### TITLE: Twerk for the Bag  
**STYLE:** Strip-club anthem, bass-heavy hip-hop, dancehall fusion, twerk-ready beats  
### INTRO *(DJ drop, crowd noise, bass buildup...)*  
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Yo! We got the baddest girls in the building!"_  
_"Who takin’ home the bag tonight?!"_  
_(Beat drops – heavy 808s, crowd cheers, strip club energy takes over)_  
### CHORUS *(Big bass, hypnotic bounce, female harmonies in background)*  
**Male Vocalist (gritty, commanding):**  
_She twerk for the bag,_  
_Make it clap, make it splash._  
_Booty move like magic,_  
_Make a broke boy panic._  
**Female Harmonies (layered, teasing):**  
_Oooooohhh, throw that cash..._  
_Bounce it fast, shake that ass!_  
### VERSE 1 *(Deep bassline, high-energy trap flow)*  
**Male Vocalist:**  
_High heels, nails did, waist real tiny,_

lyrics:
[Intro, DJ Drop x2, Hypnotic Bounce]  
(*DJ Voice, Reverb Effect*)  
🎤 **"Ladies, if you stackin' and strappin’, let ‘em know!"** 🎤  
(*Beat builds, 808s creeping in*)  
(*Low, sultry whisper*)  
Ooooh... yeah, yeah...  
💰 Racks on racks, I count that twice, (*double it!*)  
💰 Ass so fat, break that ice... (*woo!*)  
[Verse 1, 16 Bars, Laid-Back Confidence → Mid-Verse Tempo Switch to Double-Time]  
They talk about the body, but they never see the hustle, (*Facts!*)  
Two-a-days in the gym, I don't do this just for fun though, (*Nah!*)  
Stack it up, send it back to Momma like a boss,  
Lil’ bro need them kicks, big sis cuttin’ checks, no loss.  
(*808s punch harder, hi-hats rolling faster—tempo shift!*)  
Ayy, don’t get it twisted, this ain’t charity,  
Whole squad lit, independent, that's a rarity, (*Too rare!*)  
Twerk a lil’ somethin’, then invest it in some equity,  
Body on a milli, but my mind worth the treasury.  
(*Beat drops—808s BOOM, vocals layered, aggressive overdubs*)  
🔥 **Yeah, they see the curves, but they don’t see the math** (*Ayy!*)  
💸 **Countin’ up this paper while I’m sittin’ in the back** (*Big racks!*)  
💸 **Whole club jump when they hear this track** (*Turn up!*)  
💸 **If you hatin’, you can watch while I double that stack** (*BIG FACTS!*)  
[Hook, 8 Bars, Club Chant, Stacked Vocals]  
🔥 *STACKED & STRAPPED, ALL THIS CASH* (*whoo!*)  
🔥 *MAKE IT RAIN, THROW IT BACK* (*let’s go!*)  
🔥 *OWN MY SH*T, I AIN’T ASKED* (*nope!*)  
🔥 *GOT THAT BAG, GOT THAT RACK* (*BIG RACKS!*)  
[Breakdown, Chop & Screw, Slow Tempo Drop]  
(*Deep, distorted voice, DJ scratch effect*)  
💰 **MONEY TALK, MONEY MOVE...** (*screwed vocal effect*)  
💰 **WORK TOO HARD, CAN’T LOSE...** (*echo*)  
💰 **LOOK TOO GOOD, GOT ‘EM FROZE...** (*f-f-froze!*)  
💰 **STACK, STACK, STACK, THEN GOOOOO...** (*GO!*)  
[Final Hook, Gospel Explosion, Chant Vocals]  
🔥 *STACKED & STRAPPED, ALL THIS CASH* (*whoo!*)  
🔥 *MAKE IT RAIN, THROW IT BACK* (*let’s go!*)  
🔥 *OWN MY SH*T, I AIN’T ASKED* (*nope!*)  
🔥 *GOT THAT BAG, GOT THAT RACK* (*BIG RACKS!*)  
[Outro, DJ Drop, Vinyl Crackle Effect, Spoken Word]  
(*Sultry, confident tone*)  
**"Look too good to be stressin’... Got the whole world second-guessin’..."**  
**"Boss moves only, no exceptions... Now run me my blessings..."**  
(*Beat fades, echoes of “run me my blessings”*)
[Intro, DJ Drop, Percussion Rolls In]
(*DJ voice, vinyl crackle*)
🎤 **"Ayy, this that old-school slap—808 GODDESS in the building!"** 🎤
(*Conga roll, 808s warming up, heavy breath sounds*)
(*Spoken, gritty voice*)
Yeah… uh-huh…
No synths, no gimmicks, just **rhythm and bass**…
Let’s go.
[Verse 1, 16 Bars, Laid-Back Bouncy Flow]
808 knockin’ like it’s tryna bust the door down, (*Boom!*)
Bass hit so deep, shake the floor now, (*Whoo!*)
Tribal with the drumline, body in control now,
Percussion talkin’ louder than these lames in my phone now. (*Bye!*)
Step light, but the bag heavy, (*Uh!*)
808 sittin’ thick like a black Chevy, (*Skrrt!*)
I don’t chase, I attract, let the stacks get me,
Mid-bass hummin’ like a threat, don’t test me. (*Rrrrah!*)
Break it down like—(*808 solo, percussive shuffle*)
Yeah, break it down like—(*808 roll, reverb kicks in*)
Sound waves hit different when the lows this mean,
Whole club hypnotized, let the rhythm just breathe… (*Shhh…*)
[Hook, 8 Bars, Chant Energy, Percussion-Driven]
🔥 *808 GODDESS, BASSLINE QUEEN* (*Let’s go!*)
🔥 *NO SYNTHS, JUST DRUMS—FEEL THAT STEEZ* (*Uh!*)
🔥 *MIDBASS KICK, MAKE YA HEARTBEAT SKIP* (*Boom!*)
🔥 *SUB LOW DROP, MAKE YA SOUL GET LIT* (*Whoo!*)
[Breakdown, Chopped & Screwed, 808s Take Over]
(*Deep, distorted voice*)
💰 **808s TALKIN’, SHHHH… LISTEN CLOSE…** (*Screwed vocal effect*)
💰 **MID-BASS HUMMIN’ LIKE A MURDER NOTE…** (*BOOM!*)
💰 **PERCUSSION RUNNIN’ LIKE A HEARTBEAT CODE…** (*BA-BOOM!*)
💰 **SUB LOW DROPPIN’ LIKE AN EARTHQUAKE ZONE…** (*WHOOSH!*)
[Outro, DJ Drop, Vinyl Crackle Effect, Spoken Word]
(*Sultry, confident tone, reverb applied*)
🎤 **"No melodies, no gimmicks… just pressure."**
🎤 **"808s, percussion, and pure energy… That’s how we move."**
🎤 **"Now let that bassline ride out…"**
(*Beat fades, echoes of “808 GODDESS” slow down like a vinyl spin-down*)

[Intro, DJ Drop x2, Hypnotic Bounce]  
(*DJ Voice, Reverb Effect*)  
🎤 **"Ladies, if you stackin' and strappin’, let ‘em know!"** 🎤  
(*Beat builds, 808s creeping in*)  
(*Low, sultry whisper*)  
Ooooh... yeah, yeah...  
💰 Racks on racks, I count that twice, (*double it!*)  
💰 Ass so fat, break that ice... (*woo!*)  
[Verse 1, 16 Bars, Laid-Back Confidence → Mid-Verse Tempo Switch to Double-Time]  
They talk about the body, but they never see the hustle, (*Facts!*)  
Two-a-days in the gym, I don't do this just for fun though, (*Nah!*)  
Stack it up, send it back to Momma like a boss,  
Lil’ bro need them kicks, big sis cuttin’ checks, no loss.  
(*808s punch harder, hi-hats rolling faster—tempo shift!*)  
Ayy, don’t get it twisted, this ain’t charity,  
Whole squad lit, independent, that's a rarity, (*Too rare!*)  
Twerk a lil’ somethin’, then invest it in some equity,  
Body on a milli, but my mind worth the treasury.  
(*Beat drops—808s BOOM, vocals layered, aggressive overdubs*)  
🔥 **Yeah, they see the curves, but they don’t see the math** (*Ayy!*)  
💸 **Countin’ up this paper while I’m sittin’ in the back** (*Big racks!*)  
💸 **Whole club jump when they hear this track** (*Turn up!*)  
💸 **If you hatin’, you can watch while I double that stack** (*BIG FACTS!*)  
[Hook, 8 Bars, Club Chant, Stacked Vocals]  
🔥 *STACKED & STRAPPED, ALL THIS CASH* (*whoo!*)  
🔥 *MAKE IT RAIN, THROW IT BACK* (*let’s go!*)  
🔥 *OWN MY SH*T, I AIN’T ASKED* (*nope!*)  
🔥 *GOT THAT BAG, GOT THAT RACK* (*BIG RACKS!*)  
[Breakdown, Chop & Screw, Slow Tempo Drop]  
(*Deep, distorted voice, DJ scratch effect*)  
💰 **MONEY TALK, MONEY MOVE...** (*screwed vocal effect*)  
💰 **WORK TOO HARD, CAN’T LOSE...** (*echo*)  
💰 **LOOK TOO GOOD, GOT ‘EM FROZE...** (*f-f-froze!*)  
💰 **STACK, STACK, STACK, THEN GOOOOO...** (*GO!*)  
[Final Hook, Gospel Explosion, Chant Vocals]  
🔥 *STACKED & STRAPPED, ALL THIS CASH* (*whoo!*)  
🔥 *MAKE IT RAIN, THROW IT BACK* (*let’s go!*)  
🔥 *OWN MY SH*T, I AIN’T ASKED* (*nope!*)  
🔥 *GOT THAT BAG, GOT THAT RACK* (*BIG RACKS!*)  
[Outro, DJ Drop, Vinyl Crackle Effect, Spoken Word]  
(*Sultry, confident tone*)  
**"Look too good to be stressin’... Got the whole world second-guessin’..."**  
**"Boss moves only, no exceptions... Now run me my blessings..."**  
(*Beat fades, echoes of “run me my blessings”*)

title: STACKED & STRAPPED

lyrics:
[Intro, DJ Drop, Percussion Rolls In]  
(*DJ voice, vinyl crackle*)  
🎤 **"Ayy, this that old-school slap—808 GODDESS in the building!"** 🎤  
(*Conga roll, 808s warming up, heavy breath sounds*)  
(*Spoken, gritty voice*)  
Yeah… uh-huh…  
No synths, no gimmicks, just **rhythm and bass**…  
Let’s go.  
[Verse 1, 16 Bars, Laid-Back Bouncy Flow]  
808 knockin’ like it’s tryna bust the door down, (*Boom!*)  
Bass hit so deep, shake the floor now, (*Whoo!*)  
Tribal with the drumline, body in control now,  
Percussion talkin’ louder than these lames in my phone now. (*Bye!*)  
Step light, but the bag heavy, (*Uh!*)  
808 sittin’ thick like a black Chevy, (*Skrrt!*)  
I don’t chase, I attract, let the stacks get me,  
Mid-bass hummin’ like a threat, don’t test me. (*Rrrrah!*)  
Break it down like—(*808 solo, percussive shuffle*)  
Yeah, break it down like—(*808 roll, reverb kicks in*)  
Sound waves hit different when the lows this mean,  
Whole club hypnotized, let the rhythm just breathe… (*Shhh…*)  
[Hook, 8 Bars, Chant Energy, Percussion-Driven]  
🔥 *808 GODDESS, BASSLINE QUEEN* (*Let’s go!*)  
🔥 *NO SYNTHS, JUST DRUMS—FEEL THAT STEEZ* (*Uh!*)  
🔥 *MIDBASS KICK, MAKE YA HEARTBEAT SKIP* (*Boom!*)  
🔥 *SUB LOW DROP, MAKE YA SOUL GET LIT* (*Whoo!*)  
[Breakdown, Chopped & Screwed, 808s Take Over]  
(*Deep, distorted voice*)  
💰 **808s TALKIN’, SHHHH… LISTEN CLOSE…** (*Screwed vocal effect*)  
💰 **MID-BASS HUMMIN’ LIKE A MURDER NOTE…** (*BOOM!*)  
💰 **PERCUSSION RUNNIN’ LIKE A HEARTBEAT CODE…** (*BA-BOOM!*)  
💰 **SUB LOW DROPPIN’ LIKE AN EARTHQUAKE ZONE…** (*WHOOSH!*)  
[Outro, DJ Drop, Vinyl Crackle Effect, Spoken Word]  
(*Sultry, confident tone, reverb applied*)  
🎤 **"No melodies, no gimmicks… just pressure."**  
🎤 **"808s, percussion, and pure energy… That’s how we move."**  
🎤 **"Now let that bassline ride out…"**  
(*Beat fades, echoes of “808 GODDESS” slow down like a vinyl spin-down*)

lyrics:
[Intro, DJ Drop x2, Hypnotic Bounce]  
(*DJ Voice, Reverb Effect*)  
🎤 **"Ladies, if you stackin' and strappin’, let ‘em know!"** 🎤  
(*Beat builds, 808s creeping in*)  
(*Low, sultry whisper*)  
Ooooh... yeah, yeah...  
💰 Racks on racks, I count that twice, (*double it!*)  
💰 Ass so fat, break that ice... (*woo!*)  
[Verse 1, 16 Bars, Laid-Back Confidence → Mid-Verse Tempo Switch to Double-Time]  
They talk about the body, but they never see the hustle, (*Facts!*)  
Two-a-days in the gym, I don't do this just for fun though, (*Nah!*)  
Stack it up, send it back to Momma like a boss,  
Lil’ bro need them kicks, big sis cuttin’ checks, no loss.  
(*808s punch harder, hi-hats rolling faster—tempo shift!*)  
Ayy, don’t get it twisted, this ain’t charity,  
Whole squad lit, independent, that's a rarity, (*Too rare!*)  
Twerk a lil’ somethin’, then invest it in some equity,  
Body on a milli, but my mind worth the treasury.  
(*Beat drops—808s BOOM, vocals layered, aggressive overdubs*)  
🔥 **Yeah, they see the curves, but they don’t see the math** (*Ayy!*)  
💸 **Countin’ up this paper while I’m sittin’ in the back** (*Big racks!*)  
💸 **Whole club jump when they hear this track** (*Turn up!*)  
💸 **If you hatin’, you can watch while I double that stack** (*BIG FACTS!*)  
[Hook, 8 Bars, Club Chant, Stacked Vocals]  
🔥 *STACKED & STRAPPED, ALL THIS CASH* (*whoo!*)  
🔥 *MAKE IT RAIN, THROW IT BACK* (*let’s go!*)  
🔥 *OWN MY SH*T, I AIN’T ASKED* (*nope!*)  
🔥 *GOT THAT BAG, GOT THAT RACK* (*BIG RACKS!*)  
[Breakdown, Chop & Screw, Slow Tempo Drop]  
(*Deep, distorted voice, DJ scratch effect*)  
💰 **MONEY TALK, MONEY MOVE...** (*screwed vocal effect*)  
💰 **WORK TOO HARD, CAN’T LOSE...** (*echo*)  
💰 **LOOK TOO GOOD, GOT ‘EM FROZE...** (*f-f-froze!*)  
💰 **STACK, STACK, STACK, THEN GOOOOO...** (*GO!*)  
[Final Hook, Gospel Explosion, Chant Vocals]  
🔥 *STACKED & STRAPPED, ALL THIS CASH* (*whoo!*)  
🔥 *MAKE IT RAIN, THROW IT BACK* (*let’s go!*)  
🔥 *OWN MY SH*T, I AIN’T ASKED* (*nope!*)  
🔥 *GOT THAT BAG, GOT THAT RACK* (*BIG RACKS!*)  
[Outro, DJ Drop, Vinyl Crackle Effect, Spoken Word]  
(*Sultry, confident tone*)  
**"Look too good to be stressin’... Got the whole world second-guessin’..."**  
**"Boss moves only, no exceptions... Now run me my blessings..."**  
(*Beat fades, echoes of “run me my blessings”*)

lyrics:
[Intro, Chopped & Screwed, Slow-Drip Drawl]
*(Pitch-down effect, eerie synths swelling in the background)*  
Yeah... slow-rollin’ like syrup in the cup...  
Voice deep, but the flow still cut...  
Texas lean with a Brooklyn strut...  
Wait... watch the tempo switch up...  
[Verse 1, Laid-back Groove, Snoop Dogg Vibe]  
Rollin’ through the city, got that old-school vibe  
Lowrider creepin’, let the bass just glide  
Chronic in the air, I ain't stressin’ the time  
Take a sip, let the world unwind  
I move like a don, silk robe in the breeze  
Grown-man talk, ain't no rushin’ the steez  
Two fingers up for the ones who believe  
Started from the dirt, now we plantin’ them trees  
[Pre-Chorus, Beat Intensifies, Triplet Cadence]  
Uh, tempo risin’, let the snare hit harder  
808 thumpin’, now the flow drip lava  
Pulse in the rhythm like a heart transplant  
Switch gears quick—y’all ain’t ready for the dance  
[Chorus, Double-Time Switch, Heavy 808s]  
Switch it up, flip it, pivot on a dime  
One verse smooth, next one, outta line  
Let the chop screw, bring it back, rewind  
Y’all ain’t seen a style flip this divine  
Switch it up—slow flow, then I hit ‘em with the heat  
Switch it up—laid-back, then I ride on the beat  
Switch it up—trap drums, then I kill ‘em with the speech  
Switch it up—flow sick, this a lyrical feat  
[Verse 2, Gangsta Mode, 50 Cent Energy]  
Uh, got the wolves outside, they don’t bark, they bite  
Got the beam on sight, I don’t fight, I ignite  
Heavyweight talk, got the rings, got the stripes  
I ain’t takin’ no advice ‘less it double my price  
Hunnid round drums, ain't no reload sound  
They ain't messin’ with the squad, we don’t play that clown  
Money on the table, better lay that down  
If you talkin’ ‘bout the king, better weigh that crown  
[Bridge, Chopped & Screwed, Tempo Cut to 70 BPM]  
*(Vocals warped, deep echoes, eerie synths fade in)*  
Slow-motion, vision so vivid  
See the snakes in the grass, yeah, they all timid  
Catch ‘em slippin’ like a transmission  
Now watch me *switch positions*...  
[Verse 3, Fire Spit Mode, Freestyle Vibes, Eminem/Kendrick Lamar Style]  
They ain't wanna see me spaz on a beat  
Now they backin’ up, tryna fast retreat  
I’m a beast when I feast on a track, unleashed  
I could snap in a second, let the cypher repeat  
Every bar like a loaded round  
Click-clack, pen scratch, let ‘em know the sound  
I ain’t even write this down  
Freestyle off the dome, still burn ‘em to the ground  
[Outro, Gospel Harmonies, Distorted Blues Vocals]  
*(Layered soulful harmonies, raw and unfiltered)*  
Yeahhh...  
Switch it up, switch it up...  
Every time I pull up, I’m changin’ the cut...  
Switch it up, switch it up...  
Ain’t no one in the game that be doin’ it like us...

lyrics:
### TITLE: Twerk for the Bag  
**STYLE:** Strip-club anthem, bass-heavy hip-hop, dancehall fusion, twerk-ready beats  
### INTRO *(DJ drop, crowd noise, bass buildup...)*  
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Yo! We got the baddest girls in the building!"_  
_"Who takin’ home the bag tonight?!"_  
_(Beat drops – heavy 808s, crowd cheers, strip club energy takes over)_  
### CHORUS *(Big bass, hypnotic bounce, female harmonies in background)*  
**Male Vocalist (gritty, commanding):**  
_She twerk for the bag,_  
_Make it clap, make it splash._  
_Booty move like magic,_  
_Make a broke boy panic._  
**Female Harmonies (layered, teasing):**  
_Oooooohhh, throw that cash..._  
_Bounce it fast, shake that ass!_  
### VERSE 1 *(Deep bassline, high-energy trap flow)*  
**Male Vocalist:**  
_High heels, nails did, waist real tiny,_  
_Booty sittin’ right, got the club lookin’ shiny._  
_Bounce it left, bounce it right, drop it low,_  
_Shorty in the finals, she gon’ take the gold!_  
_She don’t dance for free, make it rain on sight,_  
_Fifty racks in a bag, she gon’ work all night._  
_Bottle poppin’, ass droppin’, VIP packed,_  
_Twerk contest lit, who got the fattest stack?_  
_(Beat builds, crowd hypes up, DJ MoMoney shout out)_  
### CHORUS *(Drums hit harder, energy peaks, dollar bills falling!)*  
**Male Vocalist:**  
_She twerk for the bag,_  
_Make it clap, make it splash._  
_Booty move like magic,_  
_Make a broke boy panic._  
**Female Harmonies:**  
_Oooooohhh, throw that cash..._  
_Bounce it fast, shake that ass!_  
_(Synths swirl, deep kicks drive the momentum)_  
### VERSE 2 *(Faster bounce, club energy rising!)*  
**Male Vocalist:**  
_One cheek up, one cheek down,_  
_Baby make it roll, let me see that round._  
_She split, she flip, she got that drip,_  
_Bounce so hard, got ‘em losin’ they grip!_  
_Top five girls on the pole like pros,_  
_Big racks flyin’, throwin’ out bankrolls._  
_She ain’t gotta flex, she just make it known,_  
_Everybody in the club tryna take her home!_  
_(808s shake the room, beat cuts for dramatic pause before final drop...)_  
### BRIDGE *(Slow-motion twerk breakdown, deep bass rumbling)*  
**Female Vocalist (sultry, teasing):**  
_"You know you wanna throw that cash..."_  
_"But can you handle all this ass?"_  
**Male Vocalist:**  
_Damn girl, you the real MVP,_  
_Big body bouncin’ like a new Bentley!_  
_(Beat re-enters with **massive drop**, 808s explode, money counters SFX in background)_  
### FINAL CHORUS *(Biggest energy hit, everything peaks!)*  
**Male Vocalist:**  
_She twerk for the bag,_  
_Make it clap, make it splash._  
_Booty move like magic,_  
_Make a broke boy panic._  
**Female Harmonies:**  
_Oooooohhh, throw that cash..._  
_Bounce it fast, shake that ass!_  
_(Beat rides out, crowd cheers, DJ MoMoney hype shout... song fades out.)_
