lyrics:
### TITLE: Yuh Nuh Loyal
**STYLE:** Dancehall x Country Trap x UK Drill
### INTRO
*(Piano, eerie echoes, female harmonies humming softly)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Yo, DJ MoMoney inna di building! Run it!"_
**Female Vocalist:** _Oooooohhh... Yuh nuh loyal..._
_Oooooohhh... Nah stay loyal..._
**Rudeboi:** _Dem tink mi blind? Mi see di signs, mi feel di change..._
_Mi hear di whispers, mi see di rings..._
*(Bass rumbles in...)*
### CHORUS *(Drums drop, heavy bass, dancehall bounce kicks in)*
**Rudeboi:**
_Yuh seh mi crazy,_
_But gyal, mi done know wah yuh do._
_An when yuh call mi baby,_
_Mi know seh mi nuh di only yute!_
**Female Harmonies:** _Oooooohhh... Yuh nuh loyal..._
_Nuh loyal, nuh loyal... noooooo..._
### VERSE 1 *(Laid-back flow, blues guitar flickers in)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"DJ Mo/$!"_
**Rudeboi:**
_Fi months mi a watch yuh move so strange,_
_Tek man fi fool, gyal, dis a nuh game._
_Yuh tink mi blind? Yuh tink mi lame?_
_But mi smell him cologne pon yuh skin still remain!_
**Female Ad-libs:** _Mmmhmm... mi nuh wrong..._
### CHORUS *(Drill drums hit harder, intensity builds)*
**Rudeboi:**
_Yuh seh mi crazy,_
_But gyal mi done know wah yuh do._
_An when yuh call mi baby,_
_Mi know seh mi nuh di only yute!_
**Female Harmonies:** _Oooooohhh... Yuh nuh loyal..._
### VERSE 2 *(Faster flow, urgency increases, percussion stutters)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"DJ Mo/$!"_
**Rudeboi:**
_Gyal yuh outta reach,_
_Betrayal cut deep, mi cyaan bleach!_
_Heart deh pon lock, but yuh find new key,_
_Mi give yuh mi soul, now mi waan mi piece!_
**Female Ad-libs:** _Mmmhmm... mi know, mi know..._
### BRIDGE *(Beat slows, gospel harmonies swell, raw emotion takes over)*
**Female Vocalist:**
_Mi love yuh long time, mi give yuh all..._
_But mi cyaan fight fate, gyal, yuh heart turn small..._
**Rudeboi:**
_Gyal, mi cyaan believe,_
_Seh yuh do mi so,_
_Yuh seh mi mad,_
_But mi know, mi know!_
### FINAL CHORUS *(Maximum energy, big drop, full harmonies layered in)*
**Rudeboi:**
_Yuh seh mi crazy,_
_But gyal mi done know wah yuh do._
_An when yuh call mi baby,_
_Mi know seh mi nuh di only yute!_
**Female Harmonies:** _Oooooohhh... Yuh nuh loyal!_
_Nuh loyal, nuh loyal... noooooo!_
*(808s and drums drop out, eerie harmonies and piano linger...)*
### OUTRO *(Atmospheric fade, soft piano echoes out)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Big chune! DJ MoMoney, outta road!"_
**Rudeboi (whispers):**
_Gyal, mi see it all now..._
_All di lies, all di tricks..._
_But memba one ting..._
_Karma always find di wicked..._
*(Final piano riff, ghostly female hums fading into reverb... song fades to silence.)*

lyrics:
### TITLE: Yuh Nuh Loyal
**STYLE:** Dancehall x Country Trap x UK Drill
### INTRO
*(Piano, eerie echoes, female harmonies humming softly)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Yo, DJ MoMoney inna di building! Run it!"_
**Female Vocalist:** _Oooooohhh... Yuh nuh loyal..._
_Oooooohhh... Nah stay loyal..._
**Rudeboi:** _Dem tink mi blind? Mi see di signs, mi feel di change..._
_Mi hear di whispers, mi see di rings..._
*(Bass rumbles in...)*
### CHORUS *(Drums drop, heavy bass, dancehall bounce kicks in)*
**Rudeboi:**
_Yuh seh mi crazy,_
_But gyal, mi done know wah yuh do._
_An when yuh call mi baby,_
_Mi know seh mi nuh di only yute!_
**Female Harmonies:** _Oooooohhh... Yuh nuh loyal..._
_Nuh loyal, nuh loyal... noooooo..._
### VERSE 1 *(Laid-back flow, blues guitar flickers in)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"DJ Mo/$!"_
**Rudeboi:**
_Fi months mi a watch yuh move so strange,_
_Tek man fi fool, gyal, dis a nuh game._
_Yuh tink mi blind? Yuh tink mi lame?_
_But mi smell him cologne pon yuh skin still remain!_
**Female Ad-libs:** _Mmmhmm... mi nuh wrong..._
### CHORUS *(Drill drums hit harder, intensity builds)*
**Rudeboi:**
_Yuh seh mi crazy,_
_But gyal mi done know wah yuh do._
_An when yuh call mi baby,_
_Mi know seh mi nuh di only yute!_
**Female Harmonies:** _Oooooohhh... Yuh nuh loyal..._
### VERSE 2 *(Faster flow, urgency increases, percussion stutters)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"DJ Mo/$!"_
**Rudeboi:**
_Gyal yuh outta reach,_
_Betrayal cut deep, mi cyaan bleach!_
_Heart deh pon lock, but yuh find new key,_
_Mi give yuh mi soul, now mi waan mi piece!_
**Female Ad-libs:** _Mmmhmm... mi know, mi know..._
### BRIDGE *(Beat slows, gospel harmonies swell, raw emotion takes over)*
**Female Vocalist:**
_Mi love yuh long time, mi give yuh all..._
_But mi cyaan fight fate, gyal, yuh heart turn small..._
**Rudeboi:**
_Gyal, mi cyaan believe,_
_Seh yuh do mi so,_
_Yuh seh mi mad,_
_But mi know, mi know!_
### FINAL CHORUS *(Maximum energy, big drop, full harmonies layered in)*
**Rudeboi:**
_Yuh seh mi crazy,_
_But gyal mi done know wah yuh do._
_An when yuh call mi baby,_
_Mi know seh mi nuh di only yute!_
**Female Harmonies:** _Oooooohhh... Yuh nuh loyal!_
_Nuh loyal, nuh loyal... noooooo!_
*(808s and drums drop out, eerie harmonies and piano linger...)*
### OUTRO *(Atmospheric fade, soft piano echoes out)*
**DJ MoMoney:** _"Big chune! DJ MoMoney, outta road!"_
**Rudeboi (whispers):**
_Gyal, mi see it all now..._
_All di lies, all di tricks..._
_But memba one ting..._
_Karma always find di wicked..._
*(Final piano riff, ghostly female hums fading into reverb... song fades to silence.)*

lyrics:
[Intro] (Oooh, Lord... yeah yeah... mmm...) [Organ softly plays, handclaps echo slow, low brass hums]
[Verse] Dusty boots on the chapel floor, Heartache knocking at my door, Whiskey in a cracked glass, slow to sip, A preacher"s warning, but I let it slip.
[Verse 2] Neon flicker, the barroom’s glow, Lost souls follow where the shadows go, The jukebox moans like it knows my sins, Devil in the corner just grins and grins.
[Chorus] The flame runs wild, it don’t burn clean, A fire like mine tears through the seams, Ashes fall where love once stood, Burned my name deep in the wood.
[Verse 3] Her voice was softer than a summer wind, Pulled me closer, pulled me in, But her lies hit harder than a ten-pound chain, Now I"m digging ditches in the pouring rain.
[Bridge] (Oooh, Lord... yeah yeah... mmm...) Run, boy, run, the night ain’t kind, Leave that heartache far behind, Low brass hum while you carry that load, There’s no redemption down this road.

lyrics:
[Intro, Choir & Faith Evans]
*(Ohhh Lord, we call your name...)*
*(Save us from this pain... Amen...)*
[Verse 1 – Tupac]
We know you ain't a killa, so don’t push me,  
Soft-ass n***a round here whinin’ and shit,  
That’s why me, Big, and Em all smashed yo’ bitch.  
They said Pac was gone—nah, I been here watchin’,  
Seen the game turn corny, whole scene feel rotten.  
Ain’t no fear in my soul, just a page in my scripture,  
If I die tonight, paint my name in the picture.  
[Pre-Chorus – Faith Evans]
*(Ohhh, wash away my sins, Lord...)*  
*(Bring the lost ones home... Amen...)*  
[Chorus – Tupac & Faith Evans]
**Pac:** God, if you hear me, we been fightin’ for our souls,  
Ain’t no love in the game, just a grave full of ghosts.  
**Faith:** They don’t wanna see us rise, but the truth still shines,  
So I pray, so I pray, Lord, save us in time.  
[Verse 2 – Tupac]
Look, I had visions of my enemies droppin’ in silence,  
Now I watch ‘em clout chase, fake love for the violence.  
I seen Judas in the room, he was shakin’ my hand,  
But the snakes move quiet—had to change up the plan.  
I heard Big in a dream, said the beef gotta die,  
Told me real ones live on, only fake ones survive.  
I been speakin’ to my demons, they don’t talk, just cry,  
And the pain in my heart made a thug wanna try.  
[Bridge – Faith Evans & Choir]
*(If I fall, will you catch me? If I call, will you hear?)*  
*(I’ve been lost for so long, but my faith’s still near... Amen...)*  
[Verse 3 – Tupac]
Tell my people in the struggle, lift your hands up high,  
We ain't slaves to the system, we was made to defy.  
Every king gotta fall, every legend gon’ rise,  
So I walk through the storm with that fire in my eyes.  
No more fear, no more doubt, no more runnin’ from fate,  
If they put me in the dirt, know I’m breakin’ the gate.  
Heaven or Hell, I’ma speak for the real,  
And when the trumpets all sound, bet the lost ones heal.  
[Outro – Choir & Faith Evans]
*(Ohhh Lord, we call your name...)*  
*(Save us from this pain... Amen...)*

lyrics:
[Intro: Atmospheric Glitch & Miami Keys Opening] (Distorted female voice) Whisper to the shadows, let the truth unfold... (Male voice, layered glitch effect) History’s a preacher, sermons written in gold...
[Verse 1: Male Vocalist - Aggressive Flow] (Male Voice) Kingdoms crumble, shadows cast wide, Every ruler's mask cracks under time's tide. Echo chambers reverberate deceit’s guide, But truth’s a hurricane—nowhere to hide.
[Response - Female Vocalist, Melodic yet Fiery] (Female Voice) You preach to the darkness, but my light don’t fade, These streets ain’t safe, but I’m sharp like a blade. Every move, calculated, enemies outplayed, I bring fire to the sermon, set the cold night ablaze.
[Pre-Chorus: Call & Response Build-Up] (Male Voice - Spoken, Heavy Reverb) Hold your breath... the echoes call your name. (Female Voice - Spitfire Glitch Cadence) Nah, I’m stepping louder, not playing your game.
[Chorus: Duet - Intense, 808s Drop, Choir-Like Effect on Vocals] (Both) Preach it from the pulpit, speak that truth— Who’s holding the mantle? Who’s aiming to shoot? Past still haunts, but it sharpens the youth, Every scar’s a story, every shadow’s proof.
[Verse 2: Female Vocalist - Fast Cadence & Glitch] (Female Voice) Mirror shards on the throne, reflection's pain, Burning down altars, resetting the game. Digital pulses, the beat feels insane, King's sermon reloaded, nothing stays the same.
[Response - Male Vocalist: Gritty, Trap Cadence] (Male Voice) Click-clack, hear the echo of the barrel’s roar, History’s a cycle—war knocking at the door. Coronation's just a funeral in metaphor, Every crown’s heavy, drowning what it wore.
[Bridge: Slow, Haunting Miami Keys with Glitch Effects] (Both, Whispered Layers) What’s fate? Just echoes in the frame… What’s power? Just a ghost without a name...
[Final Chorus: Duet - Explosive Climax with Powerhouse Vocals] (Both) Preach it from the pulpit, speak that truth— Who’s holding the mantle? Who’s aiming to shoot? Shadows don’t lie
tags: Genre: Country Trap / UK Drill Fusion / Gospel Soul Infused Style: Extended Club Edition
title: Shadow Sermons v2.0

[Verse 1: Male Vocalist - Aggressive Flow] (Male Voice) Kingdoms crumble, shadows cast wide, Every ruler's mask cracks under time's tide. Echo chambers reverberate deceit’s guide, But truth’s a hurricane—nowhere to hide.
[Response - Female Vocalist, Melodic yet Fiery] (Female Voice) You preach to the darkness, but my light don’t fade, These streets ain’t safe, but I’m sharp like a blade. Every move, calculated, enemies outplayed, I bring fire to the sermon, set the cold night ablaze.
[Pre-Chorus: Call & Response Build-Up] (Male Voice - Spoken, Heavy Reverb) Hold your breath... the echoes call your name. (Female Voice - Spitfire Glitch Cadence) Nah, I’m stepping louder, not playing your game.
[Chorus: Duet - Intense, 808s Drop, Choir-Like Effect on Vocals] (Both) Preach it from the pulpit, speak that truth— Who’s holding the mantle? Who’s aiming to shoot? Past still haunts, but it sharpens the youth, Every scar’s a story, every shadow’s proof.
[Verse 2: Female Vocalist - Fast Cadence & Glitch] (Female Voice) Mirror shards on the throne, reflection's pain, Burning down altars, resetting the game. Digital pulses, the beat feels insane, King's sermon reloaded, nothing stays the same.
[Response - Male Vocalist: Gritty, Trap Cadence] (Male Voice) Click-clack, hear the echo of the barrel’s roar, History’s a cycle—war knocking at the door. Coronation's just a funeral in metaphor, Every crown’s heavy, drowning what it wore.
[Bridge: Slow, Haunting Miami Keys with Glitch Effects] (Both, Whispered Layers) What’s fate? Just echoes in the frame… What’s power? Just a ghost without a name...
[Final Chorus: Duet - Explosive Climax with Powerhouse Vocals] (Both) Preach it from the pulpit, speak that truth— Who’s holding the mantle? Who’s aiming to shoot? Shadows don’t lie

title: Shadow Sermons v2.0

lyrics:
[Intro, Smoky Whisper & Slide Guitar]
*(Yeah... it’s just you & me...)*
*Whiskey drippin’ off my lips...*
*Neon flicker on the stage...*
*They ain't never seen a sinner like me…*
[Verse 1, 16 Bars, female Laid-Back Flow]
Cash in my boot, pain in my chest
Henny and coke, drownin’ regrets
Mama said "baby, don't play with fire"
Now I’m stackin’ racks just to feel alive
Drums hit hard like a heartbreak call
808 boomin’ through the juke joint walls
I done seen saints turn to fiends overnight
Hallelujah hands in the same damn light
Whispers in the dark, voices in my head
Told myself, "girl, better count yo’ bread"
But the mirror don’t lie, I see my sins
Poppin’ champagne just to make amends
[Chorus, 8 Bars, male/female duet Gospel Harmonies]
Jus’ you & me, in the glow of the night
Money fallin’ but the pain feel right
Tell me lies, say you’ll never leave
But I know love ain't free, ain't free...  
[Verse 2, 16 Bars, female Hard-Hitting Flow]
Step through the smoke, heels click slow
Country twang in my accent low
Granny used to pray, told me walk straight
But I got lost on that broadway stage
Daddy long gone, Mama ain't call
Said she left town ‘fore I learned to crawl
Now I'm in the club with a fifth on me
Spillin’ old sins on a velvet seat
Liquor on my breath, tears in my cup
Devil at the bar sayin’ "turn it up"
But I hear Granny hum through the neon haze
“Lawd, child, don’t you lose yo' way”
[Breakdown, Stripped Back, Piano & Bass]
*(Breathe... slow it down... you hear that?)*
*Yeah, that’s the sound of mistakes we can’t take back…*
[Chorus, 8 Bars, male/female duet Full Gospel Power]
Jus’ you & me, in the glow of the night
Money fallin’ but the pain feel right
Tell me lies, say you’ll never leave
But I know love ain't free, ain't free...  
[Outro, Haunting Acapella, Gospel Choir Fading]
Oooooohhh…
*(Granny’s Voice, Echoing: “Lawd, child, don’t you drown…”)*

lyrics:
[Intro, Soft Piano, Distant Bar Sounds]
(Whispered)
*Neon lights flicker on the whiskey glass...*
*Smoke in the air like a preacher’s past…*
*Ooooh, jus’ you & me...*
[Verse 1, Sultry & Low]
Bare feet on a sawdust floor
Dollar bills rain but I needed more
Mama said, “Baby, don’t sell your soul”
But that lesson came too late, I know
[Pre-Chorus, Gospel Harmonies]
I been strippin’, I been sippin’
Chasin’ highs, Lord, I been slippin’
Mama left, Granny prayed
Told me, "Child, don’t fade away"
[Chorus, Power Ballad]
Jus’ you & me, in the dark of the night
Whiskey sweet, but the burn feel right
Tell me lies, say you’ll never leave
But I know love ain't free, ain't free...  
[Post-Chorus, Smoky Whisper]
*Ooooh, ain’t free…*
*Lord, have mercy on me…*
[Verse 2, Hard-Hitting 808s, Twangy Guitar]
Tennessee moon on a motel bed
Hollow dreams, voices in my head
Mama was gone, left me to learn
Some bridges light fast when they burn
[Bridge, Gospel Choir Enters]
(Grandmother’s Voice)
*Lawd, child, don’t you drown!*
*Heaven’s callin’—turn around!*
(Lead Vocalist, Crying Out)
But I’m too deep, the devil know my name
Took my sins, turned ‘em into fame
[Chorus, Full Power, High Belts]
Jus’ you & me, in the dark of the night
Whiskey sweet, but the burn feel right
Tell me lies, say you’ll never leave
But I know love ain't free, ain't free...
[Outro, Haunting Acapella, Soft Guitar]
Oooooohhh…
(A single gospel hum, fading)

*(Soft band harmonies: "Ohhh yeah")*
Sun’s barely up, but the babies are cryin’
I stretch every dollar, but Lord knows I’m lyin’
Got two jobs, no car, just my feet on the road
Bill collector knockin’, but I ain’t got what I owe
*(Band member: “Ain’t got nothin’ to give…”)*
[Pre-Chorus]
Mama won’t call, Daddy’s six feet down
And my ex is locked up, while the next one’s outbound
Preacher says “Pray,” but I don’t see no light
So I sing just to make it through one more night
[Chorus]
I got a triple-wide family in a single-wide home
Pullin’ double shifts, but the money’s all gone
Singin’ hallelujah through these payday loans
Tryin’ to keep from cryin’, Lord, I can’t do this alone
[Verse 2]
*(Band harmonizes: “Mmm, keep on runnin’”)*
Food stamps stretchin’ like the holes in my jeans
Kids need shoes, but I’m chasin’ old dreams
Used to raise my hands high in that old church pew
Now the only thing risin’ is the rent past due
*(Band member: “Oh, it’s overdue…”)*
[Pre-Chorus]
Mama won’t call, Daddy’s six feet down
And my ex is locked up, while the next one’s outbound
Preacher says “Pray,” but I don’t see no light
So I sing just to make it through one more night
[Chorus]
I got a triple-wide family in a single-wide home
Pullin’ double shifts, but the money’s all gone
Singin’ hallelujah through these payday loans
Tryin’ to keep from cryin’, Lord, I can’t do this alone
*(Band harmonies: “Nooo, I can’t do this alone…”)*
[Verse 3, Bar Scene – Live Performance Feel]
*(Band drops to just bass & soft snare, distant chatter in the background)*
Neon flickers, the mic hums low
Whiskey breath patrons slumped in the glow
Same old dive, same worn-out stage
Still chasin’ that dream, but the dream won’t stay
*(Band member: “Keep on singin’, girl…”)*
[Pre-Chorus]
Mama won’t call, Daddy’s six feet down
And my ex is locked up, while the next one’s outbound
Preacher says “Pray,” but I don’t see no light
So I sing just to make it through one more night
[Chorus, Big Instrumentatio

lyrics:
[Verse 1]

You said I was reckless, that I couldn't be trusted

Tore down my mind 'til the edges were rusted

You rewrote the truth, turned the mirror my way

Had me second-guessing every word that I’d say

[Pre-Chorus]

Every late-night call, every whispered fight

Every time you swore that you were right

But the cracks in the code started showing through

Now the only glitch in the system is you

[Chorus]

You built a mirror maze and threw me inside

Told me I was wrong, but you couldn't hide

Every word you threw, it was just a reflection

Your accusations were your own confession

(It was you all along)

[Verse 2]

You kept me in darkness, rewrote my whole script

Made me the villain while you played the victim

I chased all your ghosts, tried to silence the doubt

But you were the hacker tearing my world down

[Pre-Chorus]

Every stolen night, every hidden thread

Every time you swore it was in my head

But the mask you wore started to decay

Now the virus is you, and I'm walking away

[Chorus]

You built a mirror maze and threw me inside

Told me I was wrong, but you couldn't hide

Every word you threw, it was just a reflection

Your accusations were your own confession

(It was you all along)

[Bridge]

(Oh-oh-oh) Now I see the exploit, now I know the code

(Oh-oh-oh) You hid in the backdoor, but now it’s exposed

Your lies were the flaw, written out of sight

But I patched the system, and I’m done with the fight

[Chorus]

You built a mirror maze and threw me inside

Told me I was wrong, but you couldn't hide

Every word you threw, it was just a reflection

Your accusations were your own confession

(It was you all along)

[Outro]

You called me a liar, said I was to blame

But now I see through your twisted game

Zero-day confession, your mask fell away

And I’m not the one who got lost in the flames

lyrics:
**[Intro: Atmospheric Glitch & Miami Keys Opening]**  
*(Distorted female voice)* Whisper to the shadows, let the truth unfold...  
*(Male voice, layered glitch effect)* History’s a preacher, sermons written in gold...

**[Verse 1: Male Vocalist - Aggressive Flow]**  
(Male Voice)  
Kingdoms crumble, shadows cast wide,  
Every ruler's mask cracks under time's tide.  
Echo chambers reverberate deceit’s guide,  
But truth’s a hurricane—nowhere to hide.  

**[Response - Female Vocalist, Melodic yet Fiery]**  
(Female Voice)  
You preach to the darkness, but my light don’t fade,  
These streets ain’t safe, but I’m sharp like a blade.  
Every move, calculated, enemies outplayed,  
I bring fire to the sermon, set the cold night ablaze.  

**[Pre-Chorus: Call & Response Build-Up]**  
*(Male Voice - Spoken, Heavy Reverb)*  
Hold your breath... the echoes call your name.  
*(Female Voice - Spitfire Glitch Cadence)*  
Nah, I’m stepping louder, not playing your game.  

**[Chorus: Duet - Intense, 808s Drop, Choir-Like Effect on Vocals]**  
(Both)  
Preach it from the pulpit, speak that truth—  
Who’s holding the mantle? Who’s aiming to shoot?  
Past still haunts, but it sharpens the youth,  
Every scar’s a story, every shadow’s proof.  

**[Verse 2: Female Vocalist - Fast Cadence & Glitch]**  
(Female Voice)  
Mirror shards on the throne, reflection's pain,  
Burning down altars, resetting the game.  
Digital pulses, the beat feels insane,  
King's sermon reloaded, nothing stays the same.  

**[Response - Male Vocalist: Gritty, Trap Cadence]**  
(Male Voice)

lyrics:
[Intro – Chris Stapleton & Sam Smith] (Gritty blues guitar, distant organ, ghostly choirs...)

🎸 **Chris:** *"Been walkin’ through the fire, feel the ashes in my lungs... Every step, every scar, built me up but left me numb..."*

🎹 **Sam:** *"I was whole, then you broke me, left a shadow in my place... Now the echoes of your love cut like razors to my face..."*

[Verse 1 – Kendrick Lamar vs. Eminem] (Boom-bap drums under Kendrick, cinematic trap under Em, trading bars.)

🎤 **Kendrick:** *"Mama told me, whiskey kills, but pain don’t drown, it lingers still... Got demons knockin’ on my door, but I refuse to sign that deal... Ain’t no savior in this bottle, no redemption in that steel... But I know my worth, I rise again, they fear the man who heals!"*

🎤 **Eminem:** *"Tell me what it means when a love so pure leaves scars like this?! Shattered mirrors show me ghosts of what we had, but now it’s flipped! You was talkin’ ‘bout survival, I was talkin’ ‘bout revenge! Now I’m countin’ every cut you left, let me make it make some sense!"*

[Chorus – Chris & Sam (Call & Response)] (Choirs swell, gospel meets cinematic strings, trap drums build...)

🎸 **Chris:** *"I been FALLIN’! I been BLEEDIN’! But I ain’t givin’ up!"*
🎹 **Sam:** *"I was WHOLE, I was HEALED, but now I’m shattered into dust..."*
🎸 **Chris:** *"Tried to break me, tried to burn me, but I keep risin’ HIGH!"*
🎹 **Sam:** *"I can’t let go, can’t escape you, still your shadow’s in my mind..."*

[Verse 2 – Kendrick vs. Eminem] (808s heavier, electric guitars wail, tension builds...)

🎤 **Kendrick:** *"Ain’t no finish line in vengeance, ain’t no peace inside that grave... Tell me, homie, what’s the price of every soul that hate creates? I seen angels turn to devils, seen the lost ones lose their way... But the real ones learn to struggle, and the righteous learn to pray."*

🎤 **Eminem:** *"I ain’t never been the type to sit and pray, I’d rather fight! Took my heart and left it shattered, now I’m grinnin’ in the light! If I’m burnin’, I’ll ignite it! Let the flames consume my name! ’Cause the devil’s just an angel that decided not to break!"*

[Bridge – Sam & Chris, Soul Explosion] (Beat drops—just organ, guitar, and deep harmonies.)

🎹 **Sam:** *"If you love me, why’d you leave me in this darkness all alone?"*
🎸 **Chris:** *"Boy, you lost inside the fire, you forgot the way back home!"*
🎹 **Sam:** *"I was whole... then you broke me..."*
🎸 **Chris:** *"But you RISE... or you FALL..."*

[Final Chorus – All 4 Together, Explosive Climax] (Full band, cinematic drop, choirs, electric guitar screaming...)

🎸 **Chris:** *"I been FALLIN’! I been BLEEDIN’! But I ain’t givin’ up!"*
🎹 **Sam:** *"I was WHOLE, I was HEALED, but now I’m shattered into dust..."*
🎤 **Kendrick:** *"Lost it all, made it back, took my pain and turned it gold!"*
🎤 **Eminem:** *"Let it burn, let it break, out the ashes, take control!"*

(Final note—haunting, echoing, then silence...)

Tore down my mind 'til the edges were rusted

You rewrote the truth, turned the mirror my way

Had me second-guessing every word that I’d say

[Pre-Chorus]

Every late-night call, every whispered fight

Every time you swore that you were right

But the cracks in the code started showing through

Now the only glitch in the system is you

[Chorus]

You built a mirror maze and threw me inside

Told me I was wrong, but you couldn't hide

Every word you threw, it was just a reflection

Your accusations were your own confession

(It was you all along)

Made me the villain while you played the victim

I chased all your ghosts, tried to silence the doubt

But you were the hacker tearing my world down

[Pre-Chorus]

Every stolen night, every hidden thread

Every time you swore it was in my head

But the mask you wore started to decay

Now the virus is you, and I'm walking away

[Chorus]

You built a mirror maze and threw me inside

Told me I was wrong, but you couldn't hide

Every word you threw, it was just a reflection

Your accusations were your own confession

(It was you all along)

Your lies were the flaw, written out of sight

But I patched the system, and I’m done with the fight

[Chorus]

You built a mirror maze and threw me inside

Told me I was wrong, but you couldn't hide

Every word you threw, it was just a reflection

Your accusations were your own confession

(It was you all along)

[Outro]

You called me a liar, said I was to blame

But now I see through your twisted game

Zero-day confession, your mask fell away

And I’m not the one who got lost in the flames

title: Single-Wide Extended Mix

lyrics:
[Verse 3 – Bar Scene, Live Mic Feel] (Bass & soft snare, distant chatter, raw vocal reverb)
Neon flickers, the mic hums low
Whiskey breath patrons slumped in the glow
Same old dive, same worn-out stage
Still chasin’ that dream, but the dream won’t stay
(Band member: “Keep on singin’, girl…”)
[Pre-Chorus] (Raw, stripped-down vocal, audience murmurs fade out)
Mama won’t call, Daddy’s six feet down
And my ex is locked up, while the next one’s outbound
Preacher says “Pray,” but I don’t see no light
So I sing just to make it through one more night
[Chorus, Full Band Soars] (Big instrumental swells, harmonies peak, driving drums 🎶🔥)
I got a triple-wide family in a single-wide home
Pullin’ double shifts, but the money’s all gone
Singin’ hallelujah through these payday loans
Tryin’ to keep from cryin’, Lord, I can’t do this alone
(Band harmonies: “Nooo, I can’t do this alone…”)
[Bridge, Stripped Back] (Acoustic, wind sound in background, haunting harmony build-up 🎶)
Sunday morning, I hum an old hymn
The same one my grandma once sang to Him
Ain’t no choir, but the wind hums along
And for a moment, I don’t feel so gone
[Outro, Maximum Silence] (Instruments fade, voice isolated, then total silence.)
One day I’ll rise, one day I’ll be free
But ‘til then, Lord, just let me sing
(Absolute silence… then fade to black.)

lyrics:
[Verse 1]  
You said I was reckless, that I couldn't be trusted  
Tore down my mind 'til the edges were rusted  
You rewrote the truth, turned the mirror my way  
Had me second-guessing every word that I’d say  

[Pre-Chorus]  
Every late-night call, every whispered fight  
Every time you swore that you were right  
But the cracks in the code started showing through  
Now the only glitch in the system is you  

[Chorus]  
You built a mirror maze and threw me inside  
Told me I was wrong, but you couldn't hide  
Every word you threw, it was just a reflection  
Your accusations were your own confession  
(It was you all along)  

[Verse 2]  
You kept me in darkness, rewrote my whole script  
Made me the villain while you played the victim  
I chased all your ghosts, tried to silence the doubt  
But you were the hacker tearing my world down  

[Pre-Chorus]  
Every stolen night, every hidden thread  
Every time you swore it was in my head  
But the mask you wore started to decay  
Now the virus is you, and I'm walking away  

[Chorus]  
You built a mirror maze and threw me inside  
Told me I was wrong, but you couldn't hide  
Every word you threw, it was just a reflection  
Your accusations were your own confession  
(It was you all along)  

[Bridge]  
(Oh-oh-oh) Now I see the exploit, now I know the code  
(Oh-oh-oh) You hid in the backdoor, but now it’s exposed  
Your lies were the flaw, written out of sight  
But I patched the system, and I’m done with the fight  

[Chorus]  
You built a mirror maze and threw me inside  
Told me I was wrong, but you couldn't hide  
Every word you threw, it was just a reflection  
Your accusations were your own confession  
(It was you all along)  

[Outro]  
You called me a liar, said I was to blame  
But now I see through your twisted game  
Zero-day confession, your mask fell away  
And I’m not the one who got lost in the flames

"Let me explain," yeah, I’ve heard that before

Caught in 4K, no way out

(Oh-oh-oh) Damage control, twisting the plot  
(Oh-oh-oh) Crying for show, but I know it’s a fraud  
I gave you the keys, but you burned down the house

[Chorus]  
Caught in 4K, no way out  
Every lie you told is screaming loud  
Don’t you dare, don’t play dumb  
You’re just sorry ‘cause you got caught, not ‘cause you were wrong  

[Outro]  
Don’t tell me you love me—it don’t mean a thing  
Save your excuses, I’ve heard them on repeat  
Caught in 4K, case closed, I’m done  
You lost what you had, now you’re left with none

lyrics:

(*Moe Money*)

(*Bad Gyal*)
Talk tough? Betta walk dat line (*Step!*)
Dem gyal too fake, mi nuh watch dem shine (*Nah!*)
Real queens move like outlaw kind (*Cowboy UP!*)
Pull up pon di block, mek di place rewind (*Skrrt!*)

[Pre-Chorus – Catchy Melody, Build-Up]
(*Moe Money*)
Man a lion in di jungle, mi nuh need pack (*Nah!*)

Mi nuh follow hype, mi just lead that (*Boss!*)

[Chorus – Big Hook, Call & Response]
(*Moe Money say!*) Who real? (*We real!*)
Who fake? (*Dem fake!*)
Who talk? (*Dem talk!*)
Who brave? (*We brave!*)

(*Bad Gyal echoes*)
Who flex? (*Me flex!*)
Who next? (*No stress!*)
Who vex? (*Dem press!*)
Mi step? (*God bless!*)

(*Moe Money*)
Money talk loud, mi nuh chat too much (*Nah!*)

(*Bad Gyal*)
Dem nuh like when gyal move strong (*Hmph!*)
Mi nuh beg no pass, mi tek mi song (*Buss!*)

Mi a queen, mi nuh need no throne (*Real!*)

(*Moe Money say!*) Who real? (*We real!*)
Who fake? (*Dem fake!*)
Who talk? (*Dem talk!*)
Who brave? (*We brave!*)

(*Moe Money & Bad Gyal*)
We run di world, no stress, no fake (*Uh huh!*)

Big moves only, mi dun tell yuh straight (*Big steppa!*)

title: RUN DI WORLD (Standard Version)

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Walking down this lonesome road,  
Shadows creeping, stories untold.  
Tried to guide you, tried to pray,  
But the devil whispers, pulling you away.  

[Chorus]  
Can’t win, can’t fail,  
Trying to save my baby from the path to hell.  
Every tear, every fight,  
Still, you’re slipping into the night.  

[Verse 2]  
Saw the fire in your eyes,  
Burning bridges, cutting ties.  
I reach out, but you don’t see,  
You’re lost in a dream that don’t set you free.  

[Chorus]  
Can’t win, can’t fail,  
Trying to save my baby from the path to hell.  
Every tear, every fight,  
Still, you’re slipping into the night.  

[Bridge, Guitar Solo]  
(Slow bluesy licks, wailing notes)  
Ohhh, I won’t give up on you, no, no...  
But how do you save someone who don’t want to be saved?  

[Chorus]  
Can’t win, can’t fail,  
Trying to save my baby from the path to hell.  
Falling fast, losing light,  
But I’ll hold on, I’ll hold on tight.  

[Outro]  
Midnight calls, echo deep,  
Hope’s a fire I still keep.  
Maybe one day, you’ll turn around,  
Before the flames pull you down.

lyrics:
[OPENING – Atmospheric Band Warm-Up]
(*Soft organ swells, cymbal rolls, muted guitar licks… bass rumbles low… a deep inhale from the lead singer.*)

🎤 **Lead Vocalist (soft, emotional):**  
*Daddy I should've spent more time with you* (*Organ hums, soft snare ghost notes.*)

[Verse 1 – Soulful Build]  

The clock kept ticking but I never knew
How moments fade like whispers in the air
I was busy chasing dreams
Unaware
(*Bass locks in groove, hi-hats subtly stutter in triplets, guitar bends between lines.*)

[🔥 Groove Develops – Instrumental Layers In]  
- **Drums loosen up**—rimshots accentuate space.  
- **Guitar & Organ trade phrases**—Prince-style call-and-response.  
- **808s glide in the background**, adding warmth.  

🎤 **Lead Vocalist (powerful, stretching syllables):**  
*Through the storm (*Yeah!*) through the night (*Ohhh!*)… Lead me on (*Whoo!*), to the light!*  

[🔥 JAM SECTION – Call & Response, Bluesy Bends]  
- **Lead Guitar Solo 1** (*Slow, crying bends, B.B. King phrasing.*)  
- **Drummer builds intensity**—hi-hats open, kick drum shifts groove.  
- **Background vocals swell**, harmonizing deep.  

[🔥 TRANSITION TO “A CHANGE IS GONNA COME”]  
(*Band pulls back—just bass, soft organ, and hi-hats… then BOOM! Full band slams in!*)  

🎤 **Lead:** *A CHAAAANGE… GONNA COOOOOME!!!* (*Raw, stretched phrasing, Stapleton-style grit!*)  

[🔥 FINAL JAM – Unleashed Energy]  
- **Drums switch to halftime**, then DOUBLE-TIME!  
- **808s drop HARD**, deep cinematic impact.  
- **Guitar takes a final solo**—Skynyrd-style wailing bends.  
- **Organ surges, choir explodes!**  

🎤 **Full Choir Shout:**  
*Ohhhhhh, YES IT WIIIILL!!*  

[🎶 OUTRO – Soulful, Fade-Out Jam]  
(*Band fades down, organ lingers, bass slides… lead whispers:*)  
*Yes… it… will…*

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Daddy I should have stayed a while
Watched the dusk with you and shared a smile
Should've lingered near that old front door
But I hurried off like a thief to explore

[Verse 2]
Daddy I should've picked up the phone
When your name lit the screen and I was alone
A missed call feels like a ghost in the air
Now I'm chasing shadows of what was there

[Chorus]
Oh Daddy I can’t rewrite the wrongs
Should have heard your truth instead of their songs
The words from momma and grandma felt so true
But they buried something beautiful in you

[Verse 3]
Daddy I saw your quiet
Weathered hands
But never stopped to understand
The stories hidden in every line
I missed the chance to call them mine

[Bridge]
Daddy I let their whispers crawl
Building walls instead of hearing it all
Believed what they said
Let it weigh me down
Now I see the king beneath your crown

[Verse 4]
Daddy I carry your laugh in my chest
A bittersweet echo that will never rest
I write this tune with a tear and a pen
Hoping somehow I'll hear you again

lyrics:
[OPENING – Atmospheric Band Warm-Up]
(*Soft organ swells, cymbal rolls, muted guitar licks… bass rumbles low… a deep inhale from the lead singer.*)

🎤 **Lead Vocalist (soft, emotional):**  
*Mmmm… Precious Lord… take my hand…* (*Organ hums, soft snare ghost notes.*)

[Verse 1 – Soulful Build]  
**Lead:** *Lead me on, let me stand…*  
**Quartet Response:** *I'm tired, I'm weak, I'm loooorn…*  
(*Bass locks in groove, hi-hats subtly stutter in triplets, guitar bends between lines.*)

[🔥 Groove Develops – Instrumental Layers In]  
- **Drums loosen up**—rimshots accentuate space.  
- **Guitar & Organ trade phrases**—Prince-style call-and-response.  
- **808s glide in the background**, adding warmth.  

🎤 **Lead Vocalist (powerful, stretching syllables):**  
*Through the storm (*Yeah!*) through the night (*Ohhh!*)… Lead me on (*Whoo!*), to the light!*  

[🔥 JAM SECTION – Call & Response, Bluesy Bends]  
- **Lead Guitar Solo 1** (*Slow, crying bends, B.B. King phrasing.*)  
- **Drummer builds intensity**—hi-hats open, kick drum shifts groove.  
- **Background vocals swell**, harmonizing deep.  

[🔥 TRANSITION TO “A CHANGE IS GONNA COME”]  
(*Band pulls back—just bass, soft organ, and hi-hats… then BOOM! Full band slams in!*)  

🎤 **Lead:** *A CHAAAANGE… GONNA COOOOOME!!!* (*Raw, stretched phrasing, Stapleton-style grit!*)  

[🔥 FINAL JAM – Unleashed Energy]  
- **Drums switch to halftime**, then DOUBLE-TIME!  
- **808s drop HARD**, deep cinematic impact.  
- **Guitar takes a final solo**—Skynyrd-style wailing bends.  
- **Organ surges, choir explodes!**  

🎤 **Full Choir Shout:**  
*Ohhhhhh, YES IT WIIIILL!!*  

[🎶 OUTRO – Soulful, Fade-Out Jam]  
(*Band fades down, organ lingers, bass slides… lead whispers:*)  
*Yes… it… will…*
title: PRECIOUS LORD x A CHANGE IS GONNA COME (LEGENDARY JAM SESSION)

lyrics:
Intro, Fiddle, 808 Long Pulse, Six-Part Harmony]
(Ooooh yeahhh) 🎻
(Moe Money Studios, we back baby!)

[Verse 1, Lead Vocal, Soft Harmony Response]
(Lead 1): On a perfect day, I know that I can count on you
(Group Response): Count on youuuu~
(Lead 2): When that rain starts fallin’, tell me, will you pull me through?
(Group Response, Slow Build): Will youuuu?

[Pre-Chorus, Fingerpicked Ukulele, Upright Bass Groove]
(Lead 3, Soulful): ‘Cause I need somebody
(Lead 4, Echoing): I neeeed somebody
(Group, Stacked Harmonies): Who will stand by meeee~
Through the stormy weatherrr~
When it’s hard to seeee~

[Chorus, Fiddle Lead, 808 Rolls, Full Group Harmony]
(Lead 5): Can you stand the rain? 🌧️
(Group Response, Higher Register): Can you stand it babyyyy?
(Lead 6, Sustained): Storms will cooome, this we know for sureeee~
(Group, Soft & Warm): But can you stand the raaaaain?

[Verse 2, Drill Beat Kicks In, Call & Response]
(Lead 1): Love’s unconditional, but it ain’t always easy
(Group Response): No it ain’t, no it ain’t~
(Lead 2): I’ll be right here, long as you don’t leave me
(Group Response): Stay with meee~
(Lead 3, Emotional Fiddle Crying): Fiddle sings like my heaaart~
(Group, Soft Chords Underneath): Mmmhmmm~
(Lead 4): Stay with me darlin’, don’t tear us apart~

[Rap Verse, Hard-Hitting Flow, 808 Drops In]
(Beat strips down, heavy bass enters, flow switches up...)

(Rapper 1 - Aggressive, Tupac Energy)
Listen, I been runnin’ through the midnight
Dreams turn cold, see the frost in the streetlights
Lost in the motion, heart still frozen
Thinkin’ ‘bout love but the pain too potent

Shorty say she ridin’, but I know she hesitatin’
Promise me forever, now she whisperin’ she waitin’
Nah, I ain’t stupid, I been through it too many times
You love me, then you vanish, girl, I see through every line

(Rapper 2 - Fast Spitter, Eminem Style, Rapid Flow)
Why you tellin’ me to slow down?
Baby, I been movin’, I ain’t never put the phone down
Heart race, mind gone, every single time

lyrics:
[Intro, Soft Guitar Riff, Rhodes Floating]  
(Ohhh, yeah… just driftin’… just driftin’…)  
(Where do we go from here? Ooooh…)  

[Verse 1, Soft Vocals, Melodic Bassline]  
**(Lead 1):** Shadows in the hallway, I hear the echoes callin’ me  
**(Group Response):** Callin’ meee~  
**(Lead 2):** Love still lingers, but it fades like distant memories  
**(Group Response, Warm Harmony):** Oooh, tell me what we gon’ do~  

[Pre-Chorus, Rhodes Piano Glides, Stacked Harmonies]  
**(Lead 3, Soulful):** Is it just my mind runnin’ wild, thinkin’ ‘bout you late at night?  
**(Lead 4, Echoing):** Ooooh, late at night~  
**(Group, Gentle Build):** Drifting on a feeling, but I don’t know if it’s real~  

[Chorus, Full Harmony, Hypnotic Groove]  
**(Lead 5, Emotional):** Are we drifting in the dark? (Are we driftin’?)  
**(Group, Echoing, Warmly):** Ooooh, tell me where you are~  
**(Lead 6, Tender):** Love’s a dream I can’t escape, but I still keep holdin’ on~  
**(Group, Stretched Harmonies):** Holdin’ ooooon~  

[Verse 2, Smooth Rhodes & Laid-Back Beat]  
**(Lead 1):** Ain’t no place I’d rather be than right here next to you  
**(Group Response, Soft & Dreamy):** Next to youuuu~  
**(Lead 2):** But these shadows in my mind make it hard to see the truth  
**(Group, Light Harmonic Stack):** Mmmhmmm, tell me what we gon’ do?  

[Pre-Chorus, Guitar & Rhodes Floating, Soft Drum Build]  
**(Lead 3):** Is it just the moonlight playin’ tricks, makin’ me feel like this?  
**(Lead 4, Echoing):** Ooooh, feel like this~  
**(Group, Building Harmonies):** I keep holdin’ on, but I don’t know if it’s real~  

[Chorus, Soulful Stack, Lush Harmonies]  
**(Lead 5, Emotional):** Are we drifting in the dark? (Are we driftin’?)  
**(Group, Echoing, Warmly):** Ooooh, tell me where you are~  
**(Lead 6, Tender):** Love’s a dream I can’t escape, but I still keep holdin’ on~  
**(Group, Stretched Harmonies):** Holdin’ ooooon~  

[Bridge, Instrumental, Smooth Guitar Licks & Bass Groove]  
(Guitar solo, Rhodes floating, bassline breathing…)  
(Soft vocal ad-libs: Ooooh, yeah… still driftin’… still dreamin’…)  

[Outro, Fading into the Groove]  
**(Lead 3, Whispering):** Come on baby, let’s ride this wave~  
**(Group, Gentle & Warm):** Let the music take us hooooome~  
**(Lead 6, Emotional Send-Off):** Are we driftin’… in the daaaark?

lyrics:
[2 bars Introduction - Haunting Organ, Soft Gospel Choir Humming]

(*Deep Male Vocal Adlibs - "Mmm… yeah…"* Choir hums, slow, mournful.)

[Gospel Choir humming as Preacher speaks]

(**Preacher Speaks – Deep, Resonant Voice**)
"Through the fog, through the night…"
"Moonlight heavy, air so still,"
"Echoes whisper down the hill."

(*Choir hums, holding long, low notes—organ swells slightly*)

[Preacher Continues]
"We want to welcome each one of you…"
"You, by choosing to attend…"
"Well, we hope you're here for something special."

(*Pause, voice softens*)
"David William... and Christopher James."

(*Silence. Choir holds last hum—soft organ fades into groove...*)

[Verse 1 – Laid-back Groove, Blues Guitar, Subtle Percussion]
Born in sin, we walk that line,
Tryna find peace before our time.
Didn’t get to say goodbye,
Now I fight to keep you in my mind.

(*Pause—guitar lingers, breathes…*)

Some days it’s clear, some days it fades,
Some days I wonder if I was even there.
Grief ain’t gentle, it don’t play fair,
It comes in waves and leaves you bare.

[Pre-Chorus – Call & Response, Rising Choir Harmonies]
*(Ohhh, do you hear it? Do you feel it?)*
The night calls out, your voice so faint,
Lost in time, but love don’t break.

[Chorus – Full Band Swell, Deep Gospel Harmony]
Through the fog, I reach for you,
But time took the picture, left shadows in view.
Thirty-four years, still drowning in tears,
But I fight to remember, I fight through the fear.

[Verse 2 – Stripped Back Start, Soft Organ & Vocal Alone]
Wish that call never rang that night,
Wish the truth never hit that light.
(*Beat slowly fades back in…*)
Tryna hold on, tryna break through,
But memories slip like morning dew.

(*Choir hums low, preacher echoes softly: “Hold on, child…”)  

Was I too late, or was I too blind?
Did I trust the sun when the storm was behind?
Every road I didn’t take, every word I didn’t say,
Still follows me like ghosts in the rain.

[Bridge – Instrumental Breakdown, Handclaps, Foot Stomps]
(*Handclaps, stomp, stomp, stomp… choir hums low and deep*)

[Preacher-style Adlibs – Spoken, Emotional]
"Can I get a witness?" (*Mmm-hmm!*)
"Can I get a sign?" (*Yes, Lord!*)
"I hear the thunder, I see the light—"
"I know you’re with me here tonight!"

(*Choir builds—voices rise—music swells*)

[Final Chorus – Full Gospel Choir, Deep Bass, Soaring Organ + High Harmony]
Through the fog, I reach for you,
But time took the picture, left shadows in view.
Thirty-four years, still drowning in tears,
But I fight to remember, I fight through the fear.

(*One soaring, high harmony line carries above the choir*)

[Outro – Stripped Back, Soft Choir, Fading Slide Guitar]
(*Through the fog… through the night…*)
I touch ghosts, but I feel you near,
In the wind, in the rain, in the midnight air.

(*Music fades… last organ note lingers… silence.*)

(**Final Spoken Preacher Line, Soft & Low**)
"The past is mist… but love is light."

lyrics:
[Intro, Slow Blues Guitar, Organ & Background Harmonies]

(Mm-hmm… Oh, so now you wanna talk, huh?)

(Like you don’t know what this is…)

[Verse 1]

You say it was an accident, baby

Me callin’ at 2 AM

But I ain’t never butt-dialed no man

And I damn sure ain’t start now with you

Mmm, I **wanted** what I wanted

And you already knew

So don’t sit there actin’ brand new

[Pre-Chorus]

You talkin’ ‘bout more than just my **late-night call**

But baby, you was never hard to stall

If I hit you up, you **already knew**

You ain’t never turned me down, now tell the truth

[Chorus]

Ain’t no accident, baby

I knew just what I was doin’

When I hit your line

And told you that I’m pullin’ through, and

If it was just one time

Maybe you could play that game

But you **never once complained**

So now why you actin' strange?

[Verse 2]

Mmm, you say you wanna be

More than just a **good time**

But baby, when I needed more

Where the hell were you to find?

Ohhh, now you wanna talk about feelin’ used

Boy, don’t be confused

You was *right there* lovin’ **every little thing I do**

[Pre-Chorus]

You talkin’ ‘bout more than just my **late-night call**

But baby, you was never hard to stall

If I hit you up, you **already knew**

You ain’t never turned me down, now tell the truth

[Chorus]

Ain’t no accident, baby

I knew just what I was doin’

When I hit your line

And told you that I’m pullin’ through, and

If it was just one time

Maybe you could play that game

But you **never once complained**

So now why you actin' strange?

[Bridge, Sassy Spoken Interlude]

(Ahh, now you wanna act like a victim, huh?)

(Lemme remind you, sugar—**you answered that phone every time!**)

(You **ain’t** gotta like the game, baby, but you knew the rules…)

[Outro, Smooth Fade, Sassy Ad-libs]

(Ain’t no accident, baby… Mmm, you knew just what this was…)

(Don’t play confused now…)

(You love every second, huh?… Ohhh yeah, I know you do…)

lyrics:
[Intro – Warm Rhodes Keys, Soft Guitar Licks, Deep Drum Reverb]
🎤 (*"Dis one right here… dis one for di lovers… di midnight whispers… di souls dat feel… yeah…"*)  

🎶 (**Backup Singers - Soft, Harmonic Wailing**)  
*"Ooooohhhh… Ooooohhhh… yeahhh…"*  

🔥 (*Bass slides in, smooth and thick… Drums barely tapping, hi-hats sizzling… The band settles into a deep, sensual groove…*)  

[Part 1 – "Lay Your Head on My Pillow"]  
🎤 (*Slow, rich, dripping with passion*)  
Lay your head…  
Oooooonnnn mmmmyyyy piiilllooowww…  
Hollllld… your waaarm and ttteennnddeeerrr body…   
Ccllloooose to mmiiiiinnnne…  

🎶 (**Backup Singers - Soft Call & Response**)  
*"Ooooooohhhh… so close to miiiine…"*  

🎤 (*Voice gets deeper, heavier*)  
Let di night take we slow…  
Ain’t no rush, nah need fi go…  
Jus’ mi and yuh… di rhythm low…  

🎶 (**Backup Singers - Wailing in the background, melting into the groove**)  

[Part 2 – "Still in Love with You"]  
🔥 (*Guitar cries, organ swells… Drums hit just a little harder… Bassline gets deeper…*)  

🎤 (*Heartbreak and passion mixed in one*)  
Mi try… mi try fi move on…  
But mi know mi cyaah lie…  
Every breath mi take, mi still feel yuh love inside…  

🎶 (**Backup Singers - Strong Gospel Harmony**)  
*"Still in looooooove, still in loooooove with you…"*  

🎤 (*Raw, cracking voice*)  
Mi cyaah fight it…  
Mi cyaah hide it…  
Mi heart still beats… in time… wid yuh…  

🔥 **(Guitar Solo – Long, aching bends, crying notes… Like a voice calling out for love one last time)** 🔥  

[Part 3 – "For the Good Times"]  
(*Music softens… drums roll back to a whisper… organ hums like candlelight…*)  

🎤 (*Tender, almost a whisper, pulling the listener in close*)  
So baby… let’s jus’ hold on tight…  
No need fi cry, no need fi fight…  
Jus’… lay down…  
One last time…  
For di good times…  

🎶 (**Backup Singers - Deep, rich, gospel echoes**)  
*"For di goooood tiiiimes…"*  

🎤 (*Final, intimate plea… voice trembling, hanging in the air*)  
No need fi talk… nah need fi say…  
Jus’ let mi love yuh… one… last… time…  

🔥 **(Outro – Band fades into silence, just harmonies and a single guitar note hanging in the air… Crowd frozen in the moment… Then, a slow clap… a deep sigh… a night no one will forget.)** 🔥
title: Pillow Talk Medley (Soulful Emotive Live Version)

lyrics:
[Intro]
Ay-o kids, it's time to learn today,
We got letters here to help you play!
From A to Z, let’s get it, we ride,
West to the islands, alphabet worldwide!

[Verse 1]
A ay-yo apple, B bounce to the beat,
C cats be cool, dance in the street.
Diction on D, elephant on E,
F flip the script, F is for free!

[Chorus]
Step to the front, move to the side,
Letters in the house, let's take that ride.
A to the Z, let's jam, let's sing,
Everybody's got an alphabet bling!

[Verse 2]
G giggle gangsta, H happy vibe,
I ice so icy, J jump inside.
K kick that kung-fu, L lizard lounge,
M moving mountains, letters astound.

[Bridge]
Yeh mon, follow me, a simple decree,
N nice and neat, O ocean free.
P perfect popcorn, Q quiet queen,
R runnin' rhythms, know what I mean?

[Chorus]
Step to the front, move to the side,
Letters in the house, let's take that ride.
A to the Z, let's jam, let's sing,
Everybody's got an alphabet bling!

It rolled down the hill fast and into a tree
Now it’s an adventure that we sing with pure glee
[Bridge: Wheels on the Bus]
The wheels on the bus go round and round
Round and round round the whole playground
From the top of the hill to the valley so sound
The laughter of the kids goes up and around
[Chorus: She’ll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain]
She’ll be coming 'round the mountain when we cheer Hey hey

From lambs to meatballs buses to mountains high
We’ve traveled every road under an open sky

[Both, overlapping, full duet energy – this is THE moment]

title: Ain’t No Accident, Baby

lyrics:
[Intro, Ominous Strings, Deep 808s, Haunting Choir Sample]
(Whispers) Look close… see the cracks in the paint…
Every empire fades… every king’s fate’s the same…
[Verse 1, Relentless Multi-Syllabic Flow, Punchy Kicks, Layered Adlibs]
Shadow sermons, tabernacle burned in sermon ashes,
Urban atlas, maps are cracked, the paths are trapped in cursive scratches.
Murders lurkin’, pastors packin’, scriptures tatted, burdened factions,
Murder captions printed out like scripture chapters, purge is active.
[Cadence Switch-Up, Half-Time, Spoken Word]
Wait—breathe, (haah), streets like teeth they bite back,
Nightcaps, white stacks, contracts bleed on knife racks.
Life’s fact: what’s peace when war gon’ bring the price back?
Pipes clap, fate spin blocks, time lapse, light flash—
[Verse 2, Double-Time Cadence, Layered Wordplay, Heavy Hi-Hats]
Syllables ripple through riddles, I pivot the rhythm like digital visuals,
Criminals sit in the middle of cynical systems, residual rituals—
Generals click at the signal, it’s critical, minimal sentiment’s typical,
Interviews hint at the pinnacle, clinical cynics get stripped to the minerals—
[Pre-Chorus, Spoken Word, Dramatic Strings Rise]
Hold up—
These echoes in the corridors of kings ain’t accidental.
History don’t repeat, it just reloads and switches tempos…
[Chorus, Choir Swell, 808s Hit, Triplet Flow]
Preach from the pulpit, speak that truth—
Metal on the mantle, who gon’ shoot?
Echoes of the past still haunt my youth,
Every lost soul got a shadow too.
[Verse 3, Storytelling Mode, Gritty Boom-Bap Drums]
Click-clack, flashbacks, candlelight confessions,
Last laugh, mask cracked, stand-up right to heaven.
Trapped past, black mass, hands up—light the weapons,
Mantras whispered: “sin forgiven,”—fight the reverend.
[Bridge, Choir Break, Dramatic Pause, Orchestral Tension]
(Low echo) Every king’s fate’s the same…
(Gun click, silence)
(Breathes in)
[Final Chorus, Full Choir Swell, Max Impact]
Preach from the pulpit, speak that truth—
Metal on the mantle, who gon’ shoot?
Echoes of the past still haunt my youth,
Every lost soul got a shadow too.
[Outro, Beat Fades, Spoken Word Over Dark Keys]
What’s fate? Just a name in the ash…
What’s power? Just a throne built to crash…

lyrics:
[2 bars Introduction - Haunting Organ, Soft Gospel Choir Humming]
(*Deep Male Vocal Adlibs - "Mmm… yeah…"* Choir hums, slow, mournful.)
[Gospel Choir humming as Preacher speaks]
(**Preacher Speaks – Deep, Resonant Voice**)
"Through the fog, through the night…"
"Moonlight heavy, air so still,"
"Echoes whisper down the hill."
(*Choir hums, holding long, low notes—organ swells slightly*)
[Preacher Continues]
"We want to welcome each one of you…"
"You, by choosing to attend…"
"Well, we hope you're here for something special."
(*Pause, voice softens*)
"David William... and Christopher James."
(*Silence. Choir holds last hum—soft organ fades into groove...*)
[Verse 1 – Laid-back Groove, Blues Guitar, Subtle Percussion]
Born in sin, we walk that line,
Tryna find peace before our time.
Didn’t get to say goodbye,
Now I fight to keep you in my mind.
[Pre-Chorus – Call & Response, Rising Choir Harmonies]
*(Ohhh, do you hear it? Do you feel it?)*
The night calls out, your voice so faint,
Lost in time, but love don’t break.
[Chorus – Full Band Swell, Deep Gospel Harmony]
Through the fog, I reach for you,
But time took the picture, left shadows in view.
Twenty-five years, still drowning in tears,
But I fight to remember, I fight through the fear.
[Verse 2 – Swampy Rhythm, Slide Guitar, 808 Pulse]
Wish that call never rang that night,
Wish the truth never hit that light.
Tryna hold on, tryna break through,
But memories slip like morning dew.
[Bridge – Instrumental Breakdown, Handclaps, Foot Stomps]
(*Handclaps, stomp, stomp, stomp… choir hums low and deep*)
[Preacher-style Adlibs – Spoken, Emotional]
"Can I get a witness?" (*Mmm-hmm!*)
"Can I get a sign?" (*Yes, Lord!*)
"I hear the thunder, I see the light—"
"I know you’re with me here tonight!"
(*Choir builds—voices rise—music swells*)
[Final Chorus – Full Gospel Choir, Deep Bass, Soaring Organ]
Through the fog, I reach for you,
But time took the picture, left shadows in view.
Twenty-five years, still drowning in tears,
But I fight to remember, I fight through the fear.
[Outro – Stripped Back, Soft Choir, Fading Slide Guitar]
(*Through the fog… through the night…*)
I touch ghosts, but I feel you near,
In the wind, in the rain, in the midnight air.
(*Music fades… last organ note lingers… silence.*)

## **PART 2: "TEXAS TAKEOVER"**  
🔥 **Houston, San Antonio, Dallas, Austin—all crushed in one section** 🔥  

(*Big bass roll, sirens—Texas energy incoming*)  

---

### [**Houston Section – Trap & Chopped Flow, Heavy 808s**]  
(*Moe Money, slowed-down, chopped cadence*)  
Southside flex, paint drip wet (*Drip!*)  
808 boom, trunk set (*Boom!*)  
Big face stack, mi nuh bet (*Cash!*)  
Mi nuh tek loss, mi tek check (*Facts!*)  

(*Bad Gyal—switches to melodic Houston rap*)  
Pull up clean, candy frame (*Swing!*)  
Top drop low, switch lane (*Skrrt!*)  
Rude gyal talk, big flame (*Fiyah!*)  
Mi nuh tek L, mi claim (*Win!*)  

(*DJ Chops & Screws last bar—beat slows, reverb echoes out*)  

---

### [**San Antonio Section – Spanish Guitar, Accordion Stabs**]  
(*Guitarists switch—fast fingerpicked Latin-style intro*)  

(*Moe Money—smooth but grimy*)  
Papi say "más dinero" (*Stack it!*)  
Texas heat, no hablo (*Nah!*)  
Gyal move bad, she fuego (*Hot!*)  
Mi tek flight, no cielo (*Go!*)  

(*Bad Gyal—sings in Spanglish, smooth melody*)  
Báilame lento, mami (*Mami!*)  
Dímelo, dímelo, papi (*Papi!*)  
Move like a cartel gyal (*Woo!*)  
Outlaw, pero classy (*Ay!*)  

(*Drums roll—quick flamenco guitar solo—beat switch to Dallas honky-tonk shuffle*)  

---

### [**Dallas Section – Honky-Tonk Bassline, Twangy Guitar Bends**]  
(*Moe Money—Outlaw country growl*)  
Whiskey in my cup, steel toe boots (*Stomp!*)  
Lone Star livin’, big boy roots (*Texas!*)  
Outlaw step, mi nuh wear no suit (*Nah!*)  
Mi nuh sip lean, just whiskey proof (*Strong!*)  

(*Bad Gyal—raspy, country-blues flow*)  
Cowgirl hat, gold tooth grin (*Gleam!*)  
Rude gyal flex, top boy spin (*Spin!*)

Who run Texas? Bxtch, that’s me! (*Facts!*)  

(*Band hits stop—deep bass drop—organ swell in*)  

---
## **🔥 FINAL FESTIVAL FINISH 🔥**  
(*Band stops, silence—one last deep bass drop, smoke cannons fire*)  

💀 **"RUDEBWOI OUTLAW SOUND. NO COMPETITION."**

lyrics:
[Verse 3 – Trade-Off, Final Face-Off]

(*Moe Money*)  
One false move, now yuh name get call (*RIP!*)  
Street nuh loyal, it love see yuh fall (*Facts!*)  
Mi nuh slip, mi nuh slide, mi stand too tall (*Boss!*)  
Mi done pay mi dues, now mi tek it all (*Check!*)  

(*Bad Gyal*)  
Dem a talk, but dem nuh tek no risk (*Weak!*)  
Mi a boss, mi nuh move careless (*Nah!*)  
Stack mi racks, mi nuh play fi miss (*Count it!*)  
Real G move in silence, crisp (*Shh!*)  

(*Choir: "STAY WOKE!"*)  

[Bridge – Slow Ride, Heavy 808]  

(*Moe Money*)  
Mi nuh watch dem, mi focus pon mi lane (*Own it!*)  
Man a real outlaw, mi nuh play no game (*No joke!*)  
Roll wid di fire, mi nuh fear no pain (*Hot!*)  
Di kingdom rise when di warriors reign (*Facts!*)  

(*Bad Gyal*)  
Who dem? Dem nuh run mi time (*No way!*)  
Real Gyal step, mi climb mi climb (*Go up!*)  
Tek mi space, mi shine, mi shine (*Bright!*)  
Now mi see di signs, di world is mine (*Blessed!*)  

(*Choir: "RUN DI WORLD!"*)  

[Outro – Houston Slow Jam, Memphis Horns]  

(*Moe Money & Bad Gyal*)  
We run di world, no stress, no fake (*Uh huh!*)  
Mi nuh tek talk, mi just set mi fate (*Lock in!*)  
Money in hand, mi bless, mi great (*Facts!*)  
Big moves only, mi dun tell yuh straight (*Big steppa!*)  

(*Beat fades out, echoes of "RUN DI WORLD!"*)  

🔥 **Moe Money & Bad Gyal – World Domination!** 🔥

lyrics:
Tumbleweed rolls down a dusty old lane, Moonlight drips like bourbon through the pane. Her boots hit the planks, a hollow sound, She"s been running to nowhere, where trouble"s found.

[Verse 2] A jukebox hums in the corner bar, The kind of place where you wish on fallen stars. She leans on the counter, her past in her eyes, Every sip of that whiskey is a truth in disguise.

[Chorus] Whiskey and wild roses, tangled in the night, Soft like her whispers, sharp like a knife. She’s a storm rolling in, a heart open wide, Whiskey and wild roses, no place to hide.

[Verse 3] He’s sitting in shadow, hat brim low, A scar-crossed man with stories untold. “Tell me,” he drawls, “what weight you hold?” She just smiles, “More than the devil knows.”

[Verse 4] A crack of thunder, the air thick with rain, Dust turns to mud, washing heartache away. She pulls up her collar, he grabs her hand, Some roads ain’t made for walking alone in the sand.

[Chorus] Whiskey and wild roses, a tale untamed, Fire meets water, two hearts aflame. Through storms and shadows, side by side, Whiskey and wild roses, no place to hide.
title: Relentless Motion

lyrics:
[Verse]

Darlin', don’t you worry ‘bout the lines upon your face,

Every scar and story, they’re a map I can’t replace.

From the kitchen to the porch swing, where the sunsets paint the skies,

You’re the woman I’ve been dreamin’ of, still lightin’ up my nights.

[Verse 2]

Years have gone so quickly, two kids grew from our dreams,

The laughter and the struggle, the stitches in our seams.

Through the rain and all the heartbreak, you’ve stayed my steady grace,

I wouldn’t trade one second or a single thing you’ve faced.

[Chorus]

You don’t need to change a thing, you’re the song I love to sing,

With every flaw and freckle, girl, you’re everything to me.

No potions, pills, or ashes, no wish upon a star,

I’ve got everything I’ll ever need, right here in my arms.

[Verse 3]

In the quiet of the evening, when the world’s at peace at last,

You curl up beside me, and I’m taken to the past.

I see the girl you used to be, and the woman that you’ve grown,

Both versions just remind me, you’ll always be my home.

[Verse 4]

The way you run your fingers through the silver in my hair,

You’ve shown me what devotion is; your heart’s beyond compare.

The weight of years feels lighter with your hand inside of mine,

You’re my woman, my forever, till the very end of time.

[Chorus]

You don’t need to change a thing, you’re the song I love to sing,

With every flaw and freckle, girl, you’re everything to me.

No potions, pills, or ashes, no wish upon a star,

I’ve got everything I’ll ever need, right here in my arms.
title: She’s Perfect As She Is

lyrics:
[Verse]
Don't let the world come whisper schemes
A passing breeze with borrowed dreams
The stars align then drift apart
But truth still beats in the quiet heart

[Verse 2]
Shadows may dance without consent
Echoes of time we never spent
Even the new becomes the old
But love defies a tale untold

[Chorus]
Hold me close when the night falls hard
We’ll paint the sky with every scar
Promises keep a heart so bold
And shield the soul from biting cold

[Verse 3]
The mirror cracks but won’t reveal
The fleeting things we thought were real
The roses fade but oh
They teach
A beauty far beyond our reach

[Bridge]
Let chaos hum its crooked tune
I'll find my calm beneath the moon
No stolen dreams
No fractured plans
Just steady hope in trembling hands

[Chorus]
Hold me close when the night falls hard
We’ll paint the sky with every scar
Promises keep a heart so bold
And shield the soul from biting cold
title: Stages Unfold

lyrics:
[Verse]
Son she said while the sun sank low
Marriage isn’t just a fleeting show
It’s a vow carved deep in time
More than rhythms or a passing rhyme

[Verse 2]
You promise her forever rain or shine
Not just the pretty or the easy lines
Even when the years start to weigh
It’s love that holds through every day

[Chorus]
Don’t let the world come whisper schemes
A passing breeze with borrowed dreams
Even the new becomes the old
But promises keep a heart from cold

[Verse]
Son you’ll meet faces that glow with charm
But love’s a house built strong not alarm
Every layer makes it richer still
It’s sticking by when winds might chill

[Bridge]
The shine fades quick but truth stays strong
A love well-worn is where you belong
The grass may gleam on the other side
But nothing’s greener than loyal pride

[Chorus]
Don’t let the world come whisper schemes
A passing breeze with borrowed dreams
Even the new becomes the old
But promises keep a heart from cold
title: Forever Promised

lyrics:
[Verse]
I got triple wide dreams but a double wide would do
Five kids in a single wide crowds the whole crew
Rent's past due the fridge is running low
But we still find a way to let the love flow

[Chorus]
A little rust on the roof don’t block the sky
We make it work even when the well runs dry
Dreamin’ big while we’re holdin’ tight to the small
Triple wide dreams in a one-wide hall

[Verse 2]
Life ain't easy but it’s real as it gets
The AC’s broke but we ain’t sweatin’ regrets
Trailer park sunsets paint hopes so wide
We tuck in our dreams and take it all in stride

[Chorus]
A little rust on the roof don’t block the sky
We make it work even when the well runs dry
Dreamin’ big while we’re holdin’ tight to the small
Triple wide dreams in a one-wide hall

[Bridge]
It ain’t the square footage that measures our life
It’s the love that fits under this humble roof tonight
Cardboard walls can’t hold back our plans
And torn-up carpet won’t stop where we stand

[Chorus]
A little rust on the roof don’t block the sky
We make it work even when the well runs dry
Dreamin’ big while we’re holdin’ tight to the small
Triple wide dreams in a one-wide hall

lyrics:
[Verse]
She wakes up before the moon can hide
Five kids asleep
Dreams tangled inside
Two jobs waiting
Both cruel and bare
Her heart beats stronger than the load she'll bear

[Verse 2]
The car's broke down by the side of the street
Runs on prayer
The wheels
The repeat
One ex locked up
Fading in her past
But how long can this carousel of chaos last?

[Chorus]
Mama
Where does the sun go at night?
Why’s it always hiding
Stealing the light?
You carry the weight of what they left behind
Mama
You’re the north star we’ll always find

[Verse 3]
Daddy’s gone
His shadow’s grown thin
An old picture
Crumbled
Left in the bin
Grandma's there but she’s a ghost awake
Her absence louder than the calls she won’t take

[Bridge]
Her hands stained with toil
Her heart wears scars
Reaching for the heavens among fallen stars
But in her eyes there’s a story of steel
She’s broken but not beaten
That’s her deal

[Chorus]
Mama
Where does the sun go at night?
Why’s it always hiding
Stealing the light?
You carry the weight of what they left behind
Mama
You’re the north star we’ll always find
title: Mama, Where Does the Sun Go?

title: Single Wide Blues

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sun’s barely up, but the babies are cryin’
I stretch every dollar, but Lord knows I’m lyin’
Got two jobs, no car, just my feet on the road
Bill collector knockin’, but I ain’t got what I owe

[Pre-Chorus]
Mama won’t call, Daddy’s six feet down
And my ex is locked up, while the next one’s outbound
Preacher says “Pray,” but I don’t see no light
So I sing just to make it through one more night

[Chorus]
I got a triple-wide family in a single-wide home
Pullin’ double shifts, but the money’s all gone
Singin’ hallelujah through these payday loans
Tryin’ to keep from cryin’, Lord, I can’t do this alone

[Verse 2]
Food stamps stretchin’ like the holes in my jeans
Kids need shoes, but I’m chasin’ old dreams
Used to raise my hands high in that old church pew
Now the only thing risin’ is the rent past due

[Pre-Chorus]
Mama won’t call, Daddy’s six feet down
And my ex is locked up, while the next one’s outbound
Preacher says “Pray,” but I don’t see no light
So I sing just to make it through one more night

[Chorus]
I got a triple-wide family in a single-wide home
Pullin’ double shifts, but the money’s all gone
Singin’ hallelujah through these payday loans
Tryin’ to keep from cryin’, Lord, I can’t do this alone

[Bridge]
Sunday morning, I hum an old hymn
The same one my grandma once sang to Him
Ain’t no choir, but the wind hums along
And for a moment, I don’t feel so gone

[Outro]
One day I’ll rise, one day I’ll be free
But ‘til then, Lord, just let me sing

lyrics:
[INTRO - band warming up in background, crowd noise]
*(We wanna welcome ya'll out here to Mo Money Studios. Now we know the weather's bad and the band didn't make it...) (Deep Voice Male From DISTANCE)We'll play! *(Pause)

[Verse 1]
Tumbleweed rolls down a dusty old lane, Moonlight drips like bourbon through the pane. Her boots hit the planks, a hollow sound, She"s been running to nowhere, where trouble"s found.

[Verse 2] A jukebox hums in the corner bar, The kind of place where you wish on fallen stars. She leans on the counter, her past in her eyes, Every sip of that whiskey is a truth in disguise.

[Chorus] Whiskey and wild roses, tangled in the night, Soft like her whispers, sharp like a knife. She’s a storm rolling in, a heart open wide, Whiskey and wild roses, no place to hide.

[Verse 3] He’s sitting in shadow, hat brim low, A scar-crossed man with stories untold. “Tell me,” he drawls, “what weight you hold?” She just smiles, “More than the devil knows.”

[Breakdown]

[Verse 4] A crack of thunder, the air thick with rain, Dust turns to mud, washing heartache away. She pulls up her collar, he grabs her hand, Some roads ain’t made for walking alone in the sand.

[Chorus] Whiskey and wild roses, a tale untamed, Fire meets water, two hearts aflame. Through

lyrics:
Tumbleweed rolls down a dusty old lane, Moonlight drips like bourbon through the pane. Her boots hit the planks, a hollow sound, She"s been running to nowhere, where trouble"s found.

[Verse 2] A jukebox hums in the corner bar, The kind of place where you wish on fallen stars. She leans on the counter, her past in her eyes, Every sip of that whiskey is a truth in disguise.

[Chorus] Whiskey and wild roses, tangled in the night, Soft like her whispers, sharp like a knife. She’s a storm rolling in, a heart open wide, Whiskey and wild roses, no place to hide.

[Verse 3] He’s sitting in shadow, hat brim low, A scar-crossed man with stories untold. “Tell me,” he drawls, “what weight you hold?” She just smiles, “More than the devil knows.”

[Verse 4] A crack of thunder, the air thick with rain, Dust turns to mud, washing heartache away. She pulls up her collar, he grabs her hand, Some roads ain’t made for walking alone in the sand.

[Chorus] Whiskey and wild roses, a tale untamed, Fire meets water, two hearts aflame. Through storms and shadows, side by side, Whiskey and wild roses, no place to hide.

lyrics:
Tumbleweed rolls down a dusty old lane, Moonlight drips like bourbon through the pane. Her boots hit the planks, a hollow sound, She"s been running to nowhere, where trouble"s found.

[Verse 2] A jukebox hums in the corner bar, The kind of place where you wish on fallen stars. She leans on the counter, her past in her eyes, Every sip of that whiskey is a truth in disguise.

[Chorus] Whiskey and wild roses, tangled in the night, Soft like her whispers, sharp like a knife. She’s a storm rolling in, a heart open wide, Whiskey and wild roses, no place to hide.

[Verse 3] He’s sitting in shadow, hat brim low, A scar-crossed man with stories untold. “Tell me,” he drawls, “what weight you hold?” She just smiles, “More than the devil knows.”

[Verse 4] A crack of thunder, the air thick with rain, Dust turns to mud, washing heartache away. She pulls up her collar, he grabs her hand, Some roads ain’t made for walking alone in the sand.

[Chorus] Whiskey and wild roses, a tale untamed, Fire meets water, two hearts aflame. Through storms and shadows, side by side, Whiskey and wild roses, no place to hide.

lyrics:
[DJ DROP, Drunk ass hell singer off key]

Ya'll we lit up in here at MoMoney Studios.

Mo Money spent 2 hours getting everything ready for some V.I.P.'s....

Anyway boo... Let's go!

[Intro – Pure Percussion Groove]

(Kick, conga slaps, ghost-note snares, hi-hat shuffle—let the beat breathe!)

(Bass creeps in… the groove is hypnotic… then BOOM—drop into verse!)

[Verse 1 – Funky, Spoken Flow]

Black cat crossed my left-hand side,

Mirror cracked, now my luck gone blind.

Walked under ladders, threw salt at my feet,

Still feel the devil tappin’ that beat.

(Tap-tap!) – Heard a whisper in the wind…

(Clap-clap!) – Streetlights flicker again…

*(Boom!) – If the rhythm feel off,

Better watch where you step—better count that cost!

[Chorus – Gang Vocals, Heavy Groove]

Ohhh—Signs & omens, fate untold,

Rhythm don’t lie, let the drums take hold.

Ohhh—Shadows movin’, whispers low,

If the beat feel wrong—better let it go!

[Verse 2 – Percussion Leading Melody]

Throw the bones, read the lines,

Card flip twice, now the clock rewinds.

Luck ain’t real, but the feeling is strong,

And if the drums keep knockin’, you been warned too long.

(Pause…) Drum solo kicks in—FULL PERCUSSION BREAKDOWN! 🥁🔥

[Bridge – Chant-Style Call & Response]

(Rimshot!) – Did you see that sign?

(Tambourine shake!) – Was it just your mind?

(808 Drop!) – Can’t change fate,

So just keep in time!

[Outro – Drums Fade, Mystery Unsolved]

(No instruments—just claps, foot stomps, distant echoes… then silence.)

lyrics:
[Intro, Smoky Organ, Slow Handclaps, Deep Male Vocal Adlibs]
(Oooh, Lord… yeah yeah… mmm…)
Moonlight drippin’ through the pines,
Echoes callin’ from another time.
[Verse 1, Laid-back Groove, Swamp Blues Guitar]
Church pews creakin’, preacher’s late,
Sweat on his brow, hands of fate.
Whiskey breath and borrowed sins,
Tryna find where grace begins.
[Pre-Chorus, Call & Response, Gospel Choir, Rising Tension]
(Ohhh, do you hear it? Do you feel it?)
The river sings, the night ignites,
Lost souls pray in neon lights.
[Chorus, Full Band Kick-in, Powerful Gospel Vocals, Horn Stabs]
Take me down where the waters rise,
Wash my name from the sinners’ ties.
Midnight revival, hear that sound—
Chains break when the Spirit shouts!
[Verse 2, Delta Blues Shuffle, Ethnic Percussion]
Hound dogs howl at the lonely train,
Echoes shake that old windowpane.
Crossroads burn in the midnight air,
One last chance for a sinner’s prayer.
[Pre-Chorus, Harmonic Lift, Choir Swell]
(Ohhh, can you hear it? Can you feel it?)
The tambourine shakes, the roof lets go,
Testify with a thunder roll!
[Chorus, Full Band Kick-in, Soulful Belt, Organ Stabs]
Take me down where the waters rise,
Wash my name from the sinners’ ties.
Midnight revival, hear that sound—
Chains break when the Spirit shouts!
[Bridge, Instrumental Breakdown, Percussion Solo, Rising Horns]
(Handclaps, stomp, stomp, stomp…)
[Harmonic Build, Choir Swell, Preacher-style Adlibs]
Can I get a witness? (Mmm-hmm!)
Can I get a sign? (Yes, Lord!)
I hear the thunder, I see the light—
I know redemption’s close tonight!
[Final Chorus, Full Gospel Choir, Big Drum Hits, Electric Guitar Riff]
Take me down where the waters rise,
Wash my name from the sinners’ ties.
Midnight revival, hear that sound—
Chains break when the Spirit shouts!
[Outro, Stripped Back, Echoing Organ, Soft Choir]
(Oooh… yeah… revival’s callin’… midnight’s fallin’…)

lyrics:
[DJ DROP, Drunk ass hell singer off key]
Ya'll we lit up in here at MoMoney Studios. 
Mo Money spent 2 hours getting everything ready for some V.I.P.'s....
Anyway boo... Let's go!

[Intro – Pure Percussion Groove]
(Kick, conga slaps, ghost-note snares, hi-hat shuffle—let the beat breathe!)
(Bass creeps in… the groove is hypnotic… then BOOM—drop into verse!)

[Verse 1 – Funky, Spoken Flow]
Black cat crossed my left-hand side,
Mirror cracked, now my luck gone blind.
Walked under ladders, threw salt at my feet,
Still feel the devil tappin’ that beat.

(Tap-tap!) – Heard a whisper in the wind…
(Clap-clap!) – Streetlights flicker again…
*(Boom!) – If the rhythm feel off,
Better watch where you step—better count that cost!

[Chorus – Gang Vocals, Heavy Groove]
Ohhh—Signs & omens, fate untold,
Rhythm don’t lie, let the drums take hold.
Ohhh—Shadows movin’, whispers low,
If the beat feel wrong—better let it go!

[Verse 2 – Percussion Leading Melody]
Throw the bones, read the lines,
Card flip twice, now the clock rewinds.
Luck ain’t real, but the feeling is strong,
And if the drums keep knockin’, you been warned too long.

(Pause…) Drum solo kicks in—FULL PERCUSSION BREAKDOWN! 🥁🔥

[Bridge – Chant-Style Call & Response]
(Rimshot!) – Did you see that sign?
(Tambourine shake!) – Was it just your mind?
(808 Drop!) – Can’t change fate,
So just keep in time!

[Outro – Drums Fade, Mystery Unsolved]
(No instruments—just claps, foot stomps, distant echoes… then silence.)

lyrics:
[Intro – Soft Rhodes Keys, Warm Guitar, Deep Bass]
🎤 (*"Dis one… dis one is for di love we lost… di love we hold on to… yeah…"*)

🎶 (**Backup Singers - Soft, Gospel-infused Harmonies**)

Don’t look so sad… mi know it’s over…

🎶 *"For di goooood tiiiimes… hold mi one last tiiiime…"*

Mi cyaah change… di way dis story end…

No words… jus’ silence…

🎶 *"For di goooood tiiiimes… don’t let go just yet…"*
[Bridge – Instrumental, Guitar Weeps, Organ Swells]
🔥 (*Guitar solo – deep, crying bends… Rhodes keys shimmer…*) 🔥
[Verse 3 – Barely Above a Whisper, Intimate Feel]
Wheneva yuh need mi… mi still deh yah…

[Outro – Fade Out with Deep Harmonies]
🎶 *"For di goooood tiiiimes… mi still right here…"*
(*Band slows to silence… just voices floating in the air…*)

lyrics:
[Intro, Soft Rhodes & Bluesy Guitar]
(Ooooh, mmm… yeah… oh Lord… yeah yeah…)
[Verse 1, Lead Vocal]
I been walkin’ through the valley, feelin’ low, feelin’ tired
Carryin’ the weight of the world, oh my soul’s been tried
But I hear a voice callin’, through the night, through the gloom
Sayin’, "Come on in, child, come on the room"
[Backup Singers]
(Ohhh, come on the room…)
(Yeahhh, come on the room…)
[Verse 2, Lead Vocal]
Ain’t no sorrow too heavy, ain’t no pain too wide
Lay it down, let it go, leave your troubles outside
Oh, the light is burnin’, mercy’s callin’ you home
Take a step, take a breath, child, you’re never alone
[Backup Singers]
(Ohhh, come on the room…)
(Come on, come on…)
[Chorus, Full Harmony]
Come on the room, where the love runs deep
Where the arms stay open, where your soul finds peace
Ohhh, come on the room, let the healing start
Ain’t no chains gonna hold you, come and rest your heart
[Bluesy Guitar Solo, Rhodes Swells]
[Bridge, Lead & Backup Call-and-Response]
[Lead] I know you’re weary, been out in the cold…
[Backup] (Ohhh, come on the room…)
[Lead] I know you’re searchin’ for a hand to hold…
[Backup] (Yeahhh, come on the room…)
[Lead] Grace is waitin’, oh, can’t you see?
[Backup] (Mmm-hmmm, come on the room…)
[Lead] Just take one step, come and be free…
[Backup] (Ohhh, come on the room…)
[Chorus, Full Gospel Build]
Come on the room, where the love runs deep
Where the arms stay open, where your soul finds peace
Ohhh, come on the room, let the healing start
Ain’t no chains gonna hold you, come and rest your heart
[Outro, Intimate & Soft]
(Oooh, mmm… yeah… ohhh, come on… come on the room…)

🎤 (*"Dis one right here… dis one for di lovers… di midnight whispers… di souls dat feel… yeah…"*)

*"Ooooohhhh… Ooooohhhh… yeahhh…"*  
🔥 (*Bass slides in, smooth and thick… Drums barely tapping, hi-hats sizzling… The band settles into a deep, sensual groove…*)  
[Part 1 – "Lay Your Head on My Pillow"]  
🎤 (*Slow, rich, dripping with passion*)  
Lay your head…  
Oooooonnnn mmmmyyyy piiilllooowww…  
Hollllld… your waaarm and ttteennnddeeerrr body…   
Ccllloooose to mmiiiiinnnne…  
🎶 (**Backup Singers - Soft Call & Response**)  
*"Ooooooohhhh… so close to miiiine…"*  
🎤 (*Voice gets deeper, heavier*)  
Let di night take we slow…  
Ain’t no rush, nah need fi go…  
Jus’ mi and yuh… di rhythm low…  
🎶 (**Backup Singers - Wailing in the background, melting into the groove**)  
[Part 2 – "Still in Love with You"]  
🔥 (*Guitar cries, organ swells… Drums hit just a little harder… Bassline gets deeper…*)  
🎤 (*Heartbreak and passion mixed in one*)  
Mi try… mi try fi move on…  
But mi know mi cyaah lie…  
Every breath mi take, mi still feel yuh love inside…  
🎶 (**Backup Singers - Strong Gospel Harmony**)  
*"Still in looooooove, still in loooooove with you…"*  
🎤 (*Raw, cracking voice*)  
Mi cyaah fight it…  
Mi cyaah hide it…  
Mi heart still beats… in time… wid yuh…  
🔥 **(Guitar Solo – Long, aching bends, crying notes… Like a voice calling out for love one last time)** 🔥  
[Part 3 – "For the Good Times"]  
(*Music softens… drums roll back to a whisper… organ hums like candlelight…*)  
🎤 (*Tender, almost a whisper, pulling the listener in close*)  
So baby… let’s jus’ hold on tight…  
No need fi cry, no need fi fight…  
Jus’… lay down…  
One last time…  
For di good times…  
🎶 (**Backup Singers - Deep, rich, gospel echoes**)  
*"For di goooood tiiiimes…"*  
🎤 (*Final, intimate plea… voice trembling, hanging in the air*)  
No need fi talk… nah need fi say…  
Jus’ let mi love yuh… one… last… time…  
🔥 **(Outro – Band fades into silence, just harmonies and a single guitar note hanging in the air… Crowd frozen in the moment… Then, a slow clap… a deep sigh… a night no one will forget.)** 🔥
