Style: [Southern Rock, Slow Ballad, Spoken-Word Vocals, Emotional Quartet Harmonies, Intimate Live Show]
[Intro – Soft Piano, Light Guitar, Deep Drum Reverb]
🎤 ("Dis one… dis one is for di hearts dat been shattered… for di love we had… an' di love we lost… yeah…")
(Bass hums low… guitar swells in, slow and deep…)
[Part 1 – "How Can You Mend a Broken Heart"]
🎤 (Spoken, slow, raw… voice full of longing)
Mi cyaah believe… seh love just… fade away...
Mi memba di times… when yuh held mi close…
An' we whispered soft tings… inna di night air…
Yuh memba dat? (Pause) Yuh memba… mi?
(Backup Singers - Gentle, haunting harmonies)
🎶 "How… can you mend… a broken heart…?"
🎤 (Voice cracks, barely above a whisper)
Tell mi now… how mi fi heal mi soul?
Tell mi now… how mi fi love again?
(Guitar bends, organ swells, drum brushes soft… music barely holds on…)
[Part 2 – "Still in Love with You"]
🎤 (Voice drops to a low, smoky hush…)
Mi try… mi try fi move on…
Mi try fi find another love… but deep inside…
Mi know di truth… (long pause)
Mi still in love… wid yuh…
(Backup Singers - Gentle echoes)
🎶 "Still in love… still in love with you…"
(Lead vocal cracks, raw pain bleeding through)
Mi cyaah lie… mi cyaah hide…
Mi heart still beats… in time… wid yuh…
🔥 (Guitar Solo – Slow, aching bends, every note stretching out in pain) 🔥
(Drums come in heavier, deep kick drum thump… the band sways with it…)
[Part 3 – "For the Good Times"]
🎤 (Barely above a whisper, voice trembling)
Mi know seh dis love cyan't be di same…
Mi know seh di night cyaah last forever…
But baby… just one last time…
Hold mi close… jus'… for di good times…
(Backup Singers - Gospel-style echoes, slow and stretched)
🎶 "For… di gooooood tiiiimes…"
🎤 (Final plea, spoken slow and deep)
No need fi cry, no need fi fight…
Jus’… let mi love yuh… one… last… time…
🔥 (Outro – Band fades into silence, just a single guitar note hanging in the air… crowd silent, taking it in… then soft applause… a moment frozen in time.
title: Broken Love Medley (Live Jam Session)

lyrics:
[Intro – Live Crowd Cheers, Loose Drum Fill, Guitars Warmin’ Up]
(*Yo! Y’all ready? We gon’ tek it down by di rivah tonight!* 🎤🔥)
(🎸 *Guitar riff rolls in, bass thumpin’ steady…*)
[Verse 1 – Lead Vocal, Soft Backup Harmonies]
**(Lead)**
Mi cyaah tell yuh why mi love har so
All di crosses she put mi through
Tek mi cash, tek mi cigarette
But mi still cyaah lef’ her yet
**(Backup Singers - Harmonizing "Oooohhh, yeah yeah" 🎶)**
[Pre-Chorus – Quartet Adds More Power, Band Groovin’ Loose]
**(Lead)**
Mi waan fi know, can yuh tell mi?
Mi woulda love fi stay
**(Backup Singers – Full 4-Part Harmony)**   
🎶 *"Take him to the river, wash him down, wash him down…"*
[Chorus – Big, Anthemic, Everybody Joins In!]
**(Lead + Backup Singers in Call & Response)**  
🎶 **Lead:** *Tek mi to di rivah, drop mi inna watah*  
🎶 **Backup:** *Take him down, take him down now!*  
🎶 **Lead:** *Push mi in di rivah, dip mi in di watah*  
🎶 **Backup:** *Let di watah set him free!*  
[Bridge – Band Cuts Loose, Backup Goes Full Gospel]
🎤 (Lead) *Hug mi, squeeze mi, love mi, tease mi…*  
🎶 (Backup - Strong Gospel Harmony) *"Till he cyaah… till he cyaah… take no moooore!"*   
🔥 **(Guitar Solo – Wah Pedal Screamin’, Organ Swellin’)** 🔥  
[Verse 3 – Looser, Ad-Libs, Call & Response]
**(Lead)**  
Mi cyaah tell yuh why mi love yuh so  
All di troubles yuh put mi through  
Sixteen candle pon mi wall  
But mi a di biggest fool of dem all  
🎶 **(Backup – Harmonizing Softly)** *"Biggest fooool of them aaaaallll…"*  
[Final Chorus – Live Show Style, Crowd Sing-Along!]
🎶 **Lead & Backup Go Off Together!**  
Tek mi to di rivah, drop mi inna watah! (*Whoa-ohh-ohhh!*)  
Dip mi in di rivah, let di watah carry mi! (*Yeah, yeah, yeah!*)  
Wash mi down, wash mi down! (*One more time now!*)  
🔥 **(Outro – Band Jams, Lead & Backup Ad-Lib, Crowd Claps Along! 🎸🎤🎶)**  
(*"Yo, Kingston! Y’all feelin’ good tonight? Yeahhh!"*)

title: Tek Mi to di Rivah (Live Jam Session)

lyrics:
[Intro – Slow Bluesy Guitar, Organ Swelling, Crowd Murmuring]
🎤 (*"Dis one is for di lovers… di lost ones… di dreamers… yeah…"*)
(*Soft drum roll, bass slides in smooth, electric guitar sings...*)
[Part 1 – "How Can You Mend a Broken Heart" (Mellow & Soulful)]
**(Lead – Soft, Heartfelt)**  
Mi cyaah believe seh love just fade away  
Mi memba di times when we used to say  
Dat forever was ours… but now mi deh yah alone  
Tell mi now… how mi fi heal mi soul?  
**(Backup Singers – Soft Harmony)**  
🎶 *"Tell me now… how can a loser ever win?"*  
🎤 **(Lead - Passion Rising)**  
Mi waan fi know, mi waan fi see  
Mi cyaah find di pieces yuh tek from me  
Tell mi now… how mi fi mend dis heart?  
(*Guitar weeps, slow groove builds…*)  
[Part 2 – "Still in Love with You" (Gritty, Emotional Climax)]  
(*Drums kick in stronger, guitar growls… lead vocal grows raw*)  
🎤 **(Lead – Painful, Soul-Ripping)**  
Girl, mi try fi move on, mi try fi be strong  
But deep inside, mi know mi wrong  
Cah mi still deh yah… mi still in love with yuh  
🎶 **(Backup – Strong Quartet Harmonies)**  
*"Still in loooooove, still in loooooove…"*  
🎤 **(Lead - Ad-libbing, Emotional Guitar Swells)**  
Mi cyaah deny…  
Mi cyaah let go…  
Mi waan fi hold yuh one last time…  
🔥 **(Guitar Solo – Big, Crying Notes, Bending with Pain)** 🔥  
[Part 3 – "For the Good Times" (Smooth, Bittersweet Ending)]  
(*Music softens, keys & bass hold steady, lead voice low & tender…*)  
🎤 **(Lead – Reflective, Gentle)**  
So baby, let's jus' hold on tight  
No need fi fight, no need fi cry  
Let’s jus’ lay down…  
One last time…  
For di good times…  
🎶 **(Backup – Soft, Soulful Echoes)**  
*"For di goooood times…"*  
🎤 (*"Yeah… for di good times…"*)  
🔥 **(Outro – Band Softens, Guitar Plays One Last Crying Note… Crowd Cheering Softly in the Background)**

lyrics:
**Title: "America the Beautiful" (Cumbia Percussion Remix)**
**Style: [Cumbia, Percussion-Driven, Spanish Accent, Accordion & Bass Groove]**
---
### **[Intro – Percussion Takes the Lead]**  
*(Güiro scratches, timbales roll, deep conga hits… then the **rhythm drops!** 🥁🔥 The accordion hints at the melody, but the drums **carry the weight!**)*  
### **[Verse 1 – Smooth, Soulful Cumbia Swing]**  
Ohhh, beautifúl for spácious skíes,  
For wáves of gólden grain…  
For májestic móuntains rísing high,  
Above the fruited pláin…  
### **[Chorus – Big, Call & Response Style]**  
🎶 *¡Oh América!* (Mi tierra sí!)  
🎶 *God shed His grace on thee!* (Divina sí!)  
🎶 *And crown thy góod with brotherhoód,*  
🎶 *From sea to shíning sea!*  
*(🎶 **Accordion breakdown!** The rhythm never stops—bass syncopates with the percussion, the accordion floats in & out, the **drums stay king!** 🥁🔥)*  
### **[Verse 2 – Cumbia Groove Keeps Building]**  
Ohhh, beautifúl for dréams so bríght,  
That built this sacred land…  
For thóse who fáught, who gave their líves,  
With hárt and helping hánd…  
### **[Chorus – Even Bigger Energy!]**  
🎶 *¡Oh América!* (Mi tierra sí!)  
🎶 *God shed His grace on thee!* (Divina sí!)  
🎶 *And crown thy góod with brotherhoód,*  
🎶 *From sea to shíning sea!*  
### **[Bridge – Percussion Break, Pure Rhythm]**  
*(Güiro scratches fast—**Taka-taka!** Tambora hits, deep bass pulse—drums trade solos, letting **percussion tell the story!**)*  
### **[Outro – Let the Rhythm Ride]**  
*(Handclaps, bass rolling, accordion fading… percussion **leads the final groove** until it naturally fades out. 💃🏽🔥)*

lyrics:
**Title: "Never Forgiving You"**
**Style: [Bluegrass, Gospel Quartet, Cinematic 808s, Syncopated Bounce]**
---
### **[Intro – Gospel Quartet, A Cappella Harmony]**  
*(Ohhh… they say let go… but I can’t… I won’t…)*  
*(I touch shadows… but they don’t fade… no…)*  
### **[Verse 1 – Spoken Flow, Cold & Heavy]**  
I don’t understand… how they expect me… to…  
Am I really… supposed to be able… to…  
Forget and forget? (I say it like that.)  
Because I’m never forgiving you.   
When the smell of that place…  
Puts me right to that moment…  
My body’s here, but my mind still frozen…  
Like a ghost that can’t move on…  
### **[Pre-Chorus – Female Lead, Gospel Harmony]**  
*(Ohhh… tell me how… tell me why…)*  
*(Do I drown or survive…?)*  
*(They say time will heal my pain…)*  
*(But the scars still say your name…)*  
### **[Chorus – Gospel + 808s Drop]**  
The roses I touch,  
Magical it must… be.  
They say of you,  
I think too much… see.  
### **[Verse 2 – Drill Flow + Off-Grid Swing]**  
Bipolar swings like a pendulum blade,  
Some days I shine, some days I fade.  
Some days I fight, some days I cave,  
Got scars on my soul that I can’t erase.  
Whiskey in my cup, demons in my chest,  
Prayin’ to a God that I second-guess.  
Tryna stay clean, but the past won’t rest,  
Every step I take, I feel possessed.  
### **[Bridge – Slow Down, Gospel Harmonies]**  
*(Take my hand... lead me home...)*  
*(Break these chains... I can’t go alone...)*  
*(Tell me there’s more, tell me there’s light...)*  
*(Tell me my past won’t take my life...)*  
### **[Verse 3 – The Breaking Point]**  
I see your face in the dark when I sleep,  
I hear your voice when the silence runs deep.  
They say "move on," they say "let it be,"  
But how can I heal when it’s still in me?  
This ain't revenge—this is truth, this is proof,  
This is the rage that they bottled in youth.  
If they want silence, they won't get their way,  
I touch shadows, but I **won’t** fade away.  
### **[Outro – Gospel A Cappella + 808s Fade]**  
*(Forget and forget… I say it like that…)*  
*(But I’m never forgiving you… never forgiving you…)*  
*(Gone… gone… gone…)*

lyrics:
[Intro – Slow Banjo Pluck, Deep 808s Rolling In, Soft Gospel Humming]
(*Mmm, mmm, Lord, Lord…*)
(*Whoo!*) *Stomp... clap... stomp...*
(*808 hums under banjo, wind-like sweep fades in*)
Ohhh, I was born (*mmm-hmm*)
By the river (*harmony swells*)
In a little ol’ tent (*yes, Lord!*)
And just like that river (*stomp-STOMP, clap*)
I’ve been runnin’ ever since…
[Verse 1 – Soulful Lead, Banjo Carries Melody, Stomps & Spoons Accent]
It’s been a long… (*LONG!*)
A long time comin’ (*Whoo!*)
But I know (*I KNOW!*)
A change gon’ come (*Yes, it will!*)
(*808s rise subtly, foot stomps double on second beat*)
[Verse 2 – Call and Response, Organ Swell Enters]
It’s been too hard livin’ (*Too hard!*)
But I’m afraid to die (*Afraid, Lord!*)
‘Cause I don’t know what’s up there (*Banjo slows, gospel hums rise*)
Beyond the sky… (*Whoo!*)
[Pre-Chorus – Quartet Takes Over, Powerhouse Harmonies]
**(Call)** It’s been a long… (*Long!*)
**(Response – Choir)** *Long time comin’*
**(Call)** But I know… (*I know!*)
**(Response – Choir)** *A change gon’ come, oh yes, it will!*
(*Banjo riff, 808 sub-drop, cinematic sweep into next section*)
[Verse 3 – Deep Groove, Stomps Heavy, 808s Locked In]
I went to my brother (*My brother!*)
And I asked him for help (*Help me, Lord!*)
But he just kept knockin’ me down (*Mmm!*)
Lord, knockin’ me down (*Stomp-STOMP, foot slide, spoons click!*)
(*Organ hums, choir builds, energy rising*)
[Bridge – Emotional Swell, Full Choir, Hands Raised]
Ohhh, but somehow I know (*Know!*)
I keep pressin’ on (*Press on!*)
Storm may rise, but I’m still strong (*Still strong!*)
'Cause He don’t come late (*Late!*)
He’s always on time (*TIME!*)
(*Cinematic sweep, slow 808 roll, stomps echo—tension building!*)
[Final Chorus – Explosive, Full Gospel Energy]
It’s been a long… (*LONG!*)
A long time comin’ (*Whoo!*)
But I know… (*I KNOW!*)
A change gon’ come… (*Oh yes, it will!*)
(*Banjo picks harder, spoons clicking, stomps relentless, 808s pulsing!*)
[Outro – Choir Fades, Soft Banjo Pluck, Echoing Vocals]
(*Hmmm… Lord…*)
(*Yes, it will… yes, it will…*)
A change gon’ come… (*stomp-STOMP… fade…*)

lyrics:
[Intro – The Last Stand]
(*808s sweep deep, bagpipes cry, Miami keys float in, bassline bubbles*)
(*Buju-style gruff voice enters*)
(*Rudeboy Verse – Low, growling, emotional but defiant*)
🔥 "You know mi heart still beat fi you… but di street, it call mi name."
🔥 "Mi try fix di wrong, but you nuh hear mi pain."
🔥 "One more time… before you say goodbye…"
(*Lady Saw-style entrance, strong and unapologetic*)
💔 "Mi done wait fi too long, boy, mi cyaan stay blind."
💔 "You promise big tings, but yuh love move like crime."
💔 "You come wid sweet words, but mi nuh trust dat wine!"
(*BEAT DROPS – Westside Funk bassline, Dancehall skank, bagpipes hold melody*)
[Verse 1 – The Plea]
(*Rudeboy sings/gruff chants*)
**Before you say goodbye…**
**Please know how hard mi try…**
**To turn mi wrongs into right…**
**How mi can, if you nah open yuh eyes?"**
(*808s sweep, Miami keys dance, she responds—Queen stands firm*)
(*Rude Gyal Response – Confident, unshaken*)
💔 "Before mi walk away, mi done hear what yuh say."
💔 "Mi fairy tale dead, no dream fi save today."
💔 "Mi love was fire, but yuh cool it wit’ lies!"
💔 "One last touch? Boy, yuh outta time!"
(*BEAT PAUSES – Bagpipes & 808s reintroduce tension, Miami keys shimmer*)
[Pre-Chorus – The Breakdown]
(*Rudeboy, desperate but proud*)
🔥 "Mi say forever, but we done."
🔥 "You hold tight, mi hold gun."
🔥 "Mi sorry? Not enough."
🔥 "One chance? One lifetime…"
(*Lady Saw-style response, strong & final*)
💔 "Yuh words nah reach mi, boy mi nuh see it."
💔 "You never show mi love, now yuh beg pon street?"
💔 "One last kiss? Hmph—boy, yuh weak!"
(*BEAT DROPS HARD – Bassline slides, drums hit, bagpipes swell like a final war cry*)
[Chorus – The War of Hearts]
(*Both voices clash, tension high, call & response format*)
🔥 **(Rudeboy) One kiss before yuh say goodbye!**
💔 **(Rude Gyal) No kiss fi di fool who mek gyal cry!**
🔥 **(Rudeboy) Just one more, before mi lose mi mind!**
💔 **(Rude Gyal) Mi done pack mi bags, mi nah rewind!**
🔥 **(Rudeboy) If mi fall, gyal, yuh catch mi still?**
💔 **(Rude Gyal) Mi cyaan catch man who never keep it real!**
🔥 **(Rudeboy) Mi lost mi way, mi try fi heal!**
💔 **(Rude Gyal) One last kiss? Boy, dream fi feel!"
(*Beat rides out, bagpipes cry, Miami keys loop, heavy bass sweeps like heartbreak in slow motion…*)

lyrics:
**Title: "Through the Fog"**
**Style: [Soulful Bluegrass, Gospel Quartet Harmonies, Cinematic 808s, Polyrhythmic Percussion, Off-Grid Swing]**
---  
**[Intro, Haunting Organ, Soft Gospel Hum, Deep Male Vocal Adlibs]**  
(Mmm… yeah… through the fog, through the night…)  
Moonlight heavy, air so still,  
Echoes whisper down the hill.  
**[Verse 1, Laid-back Groove, Blues Guitar, Subtle Percussion]**  
Born in sin, we walk that line,  
Tryna find peace before our time.  
Didn’t get to say goodbye,  
Now I fight to keep you in my mind.  
**[Pre-Chorus, Call & Response, Rising Choir Harmonies]**  
(Ohhh, do you hear it? Do you feel it?)  
The night calls out, your voice so faint,  
Lost in time, but love don’t break.  
**[Chorus, Full Band Swell, Deep Gospel Harmony]**  
Through the fog, I reach for you,  
But time took the picture, left shadows in view.  
Twenty-five years, still drowning in tears,  
But I fight to remember, I fight through the fear.  
**[Verse 2, Swampy Rhythm, Slide Guitar, 808 Pulse]**  
Wish that call never rang that night,  
Wish the truth never hit that light.  
Tryna hold on, tryna break through,  
But memories slip like morning dew.  
**[Bridge, Instrumental Breakdown, Handclaps, Foot Stomps]**  
(Handclaps, stomp, stomp, stomp…)  
**[Harmonic Build, Choir Swell, Preacher-style Adlibs]**  
Can I get a witness? (Mmm-hmm!)  
Can I get a sign? (Yes, Lord!)  
I hear the thunder, I see the light—  
I know you’re with me here tonight!  
**[Final Chorus, Full Gospel Choir, Deep Bass, Soaring Organ]**  
Through the fog, I reach for you,  
But time took the picture, left shadows in view.  
Twenty-five years, still drowning in tears,  
But I fight to remember, I fight through the fear.  
**[Outro, Stripped Back, Soft Choir, Fading Slide Guitar]**  
(Through the fog… through the night…)  
I touch ghosts, but I feel you near,  
In the wind, in the rain, in the midnight air.

lyrics:
**Title: "Through the Fog"**
**Style: [Emotional Hip-Hop, Orchestral Elements, Deep Male Vocals]**
---
**[Verse 1]**  
We are... born of sin, into sin,  
From the start to the end, it’s a fight to win.  
But without you here, man, I ain't whole,  
Feels like a piece of me got lost in the cold.  
**[Pre-Chorus]**  
See, it's not just the fact I ain't say goodbye,  
It's the weight in my chest when I wonder why.  
Blocked out that night, it’s a void in my mind,  
And no matter how I search, ain't a memory to find.  
**[Chorus]**  
Through the fog, I reach for you,  
But time took the picture, left shadows in view.  
Twenty-five years, still drowning in tears,  
But I fight to remember, I fight through the fear.  
**[Verse 2]**  
Wish that call never rang in the dead of night,  
Wish I never heard Baron confirm it right.  
Wish I could hold onto something real,  
Not just echoes of the pain that I still feel.  
**[Bridge]**  
I wanna remember, wanna break through the mist,  
Wanna see your face instead of feeling this abyss.  
Ain't about moving on, ain't about letting go,  
It's about keeping you close, even when the winds blow.  
**[Outro]**  
Damn, it’s been so long, but you never fade,  
You live in these verses, in the words I lay.  
So I write this chapter, another for you,  
MoMoney forever, our saga stays true.
David. Chris. Altari. Royce. James. George. Annie. M.C. Minnie. Bertha. Ida. Deon. Geraldine. Suzzane. Wesley. Thaddeus. Mr. Scott. Tracey. Mr. Henry. Mr. White. Leslie.

**Style: [Emotional Hip-Hop, Orchestral Elements, Deep Male Vocals]**
---
**[Verse 1]**  
We are... born of sin, into sin,  
From the start to the end, it’s a fight to win.  
But without you here, man, I ain't whole,  
Feels like a piece of me got lost in the cold.  
**[Pre-Chorus]**  
See, it's not just the fact I ain't say goodbye,  
It's the weight in my chest when I wonder why.  
Blocked out that night, it’s a void in my mind,  
And no matter how I search, ain't a memory to find.  
**[Chorus]**  
Through the fog, I reach for you,  
But time took the picture, left shadows in view.  
Twenty-five years, still drowning in tears,  
But I fight to remember, I fight through the fear.  
**[Verse 2]**  
Wish that call never rang in the dead of night,  
Wish I never heard Baron confirm it right.  
Wish I could hold onto something real,  
Not just echoes of the pain that I still feel.  
**[Bridge]**  
I wanna remember, wanna break through the mist,  
Wanna see your face instead of feeling this abyss.  
Ain't about moving on, ain't about letting go,  
It's about keeping you close, even when the winds blow.  
**[Outro]**  
Damn, it’s been so long, but you never fade,  
You live in these verses, in the words I lay.  
So I write this chapter, another for you,  
MoMoney forever, our saga stays true.

lyrics:
[Seamless Transition from "On Time" – Banjo Rolls, Jug Bass, Swizz-Inspired Percussion Enters]
(*808 hums, airy sweep glides in—soft congas pan L/R, syncopated claps fill space*)
(*Snare rolls start ghosting in the background, like a breath before the drop*)
[Intro – Sparse Banjo, Off-Grid Hi-Hats, Syncopated Claps]
(*Hmmmm, mmm-hmm… Lord…*)
Ohhh, I was born (*tap-tap, pause—clap!*)
By the river (*rimshot lands slightly late, shakers flutter!*)
In a little ol’ tent (*boom-KAH… space… tap tap!*)
And just like that river (*hi-hat rolls, banjo lick accents!*)
I’ve been runnin’ ever since…
[Verse 1 – Deep 808 Groove, Off-Kilter Rimshots, Space Between Hits]
It’s been a long… (*LONG!*)
A long time comin’ (*Whoo!*)
But I know (*I KNOW!*)
A change gon’ come (*Yes, it will!*)
(*Hi-hats scatter in triplets, then cut out for space—808 slides carry the weight!*)
[Verse 2 – Percussion Layers In, Claps Shift, Polyrhythmic Grooves]
It’s been too hard livin’ (*snare rolls creep, kick lands just behind!*)
But I’m afraid to die (*syncopated congas answer back!*)
‘Cause I don’t know what’s up there (*banjo strum lands on the 2 & the 4, but percussion swings!*)
Beyond the sky… (*BOOM… hush… KAH!* Whoo!)
[Pre-Chorus – Stacked Gospel Harmonies, Tension Building]
**(Call)** It’s been a long… (*Long!*)
**(Response – Choir)** *Long time comin’*
**(Call)** But I know… (*I know!*)
**(Response – Choir)** *A change gon’ come, oh yes, it will!*
(*Rimshot builds, but the snare waits… waits… then SLAPS!* Whoo!)
[Verse 3 – Drums Hit Hard, 808s Glide, Unexpected Percussion Swaps]
I went to my brother (*Brother!*)
And I asked him for help (*Help me, Lord!*)
But he just kept knockin’ me down (*Mmm!*)
Lord, knockin’ me down (*BOOM… silence… STOMP-clap-CLAP!*)
(*Hi-hats cut out. The groove **breathes** before crashing back in!*)
[Bridge – Choir Takes Over, Snare Rolls Create Waves, Energy Rising]
Ohhh, but somehow I know (*Know!*)
I keep pressin’ on (*Press on!*)
Storm may rise, but I’m still strong (*Still strong!*)
'Cause He don’t come late (*Late!*)
He’s always on time (*TIME!*)
(*Banjo riff repeats behind vocal swells—then percussion **stops** before the final chorus drop!*)
[Final Chorus – Full Power, 808 Glide, Explosive Gospel Choir]
It’s been a long… (*LONG!*)
A long time comin’ (*Whoo!*)
But I know… (*I KNOW!*)
A change gon’ come… (*Oh yes, it will!*)
(*Kick lands heavy, rimshots scatter, congas go wild but never clutter!*)
[Outro – Space Returns, Harmonic Humming, Percussion Echoes & Fades]
(*Hmmm… Lord…*)
(*Yes, it will… yes, it will…*)
A change gon’ come… (*Boom… clap… hush… fade…*)
title: A CHANGE IS GONNA COME (BLUEGRASS x SWIZZ BEATZ DRUM SCIENCE)

lyrics:
[DJ Drop – Hyped Announcer, Beatbox Loop Fading In]
(*Whoo!*) “Ladies and gentlemen, gather ‘round! Y’all ready for some foot-stompin’, hand-clappin’, time-travelin’ truth? Let’s GO!”
(*Jug bass drop, banjo plucks in—stomp, stomp, clap!*)
[Intro – Slow Banjo Pluck, Jug Bass, Beatbox Kicks In]
(*Whoo!* *Clap, clap, stomp!*)
Ohhh, He’s on tiiiiime! (*Yeah!*)
Never too early, never too late, nah!
(*Whoo!* *Stomp!*)
[Verse 1 – Swingin’ Banjo, Stacked Harmonies]
Tick… tick… hold up, listen!
God don’t slip, He got precision.
Every delay got a purpose, child,
Every rough road still lead to miles!
You say He late? (*Nah!*) Don’t be fooled!
He just settin’ up a better move!
That mountain too big? That storm too loud?
Well, my God walkin’ on the waves right now! (*Whoo!*)
[Pre-Chorus – Quartet Harmony, Call and Response]
(Call) He’s an on-time God, oh yes, He is!
(Response – Quartet) *Yes, He is!*
(Call) Might not come when you want, but He right on His biz!
(Response – Quartet) *Right on His biz!*
[Chorus – Foot Stomp, Spoons, Hand Claps, Fast Banjo Picking]
Well, He don’t need no clock, no schedule, nah!
When He move, whole world gon’ stop, yeah!
Look at the time, look at the time,
My God step in, rewrite the line!
Never too late, never too soon,
Right on time like the sun and moon!
He don’t need no wristwatch, don’t need no countdown,
He just say the word— *breakthrough inbound!* (*Whoo!*)
[Verse 2 – Syncopated Flow, Double Foot Stomp on Second Beat]
(*Banjo riff hits—stomp, stomp-STOMP!*)
You think He’s slow? (*Nah!*) That’s misreadin’ the sign,
Every setback? (*Stomp!*) That’s a setup in disguise!
Devil start laughin’, thought he won (*Ha!*)
Till the stone rolled back, grave came undone!
Chains fell loose, sky turned bright,
Three days later? *Boom!* My King took flight! (*Yeah!*)
(*Banjo rolls faster—STOMP, stomp-STOMP!*)
Never too early, never too slow,
God got a plan much bigger than we know!
If He say *"move,"* then the ground gon’ quake,
If He say *"rise,"* then the sun gon’ wake!
[Bridge – Quartet Break, Low Jug Bass, Gospel Feel]
(He’s on tiiiiime) *Oh yes, He is!* 
(He’s on tiiiiime) *No second missed!* 
(He’s on tiiiiime) *When I call, He answer fast!* 
(He’s on tiiiiime) *Delay ain’t denial, the best come last!* 
[Outro – Soft Banjo Pluck, Echoing Stomps, Harmonic Humming]
(Tick… tick… God don’t miss.)
(Tick… tick… God don’t miss.)
Clock don’t stop, no, no… (*Whoo!*)
title: ON TIME (BLUEGRASS REVIVAL)

title: Nah Pass Me (Dancehall Revival Mix)

lyrics:
[DJ Drop 1]
(*Saloon Doors Swing Open – Spurs Jingle*)
🔥 **Moe Money & Bad Gyal** pon di riddim! Who bad? Who mash di dance?! 🔥

(*808s Slide, Bottleneck Guitar Riff, Snare Roll*)

[Intro, Dirty Blues Slide Guitar, Slow Groove]
(*Moe Money*)
Rodeo lights, boot dust rise (*Skrrt!*)
London to Houston, heat inside (*Hot!*)
Cowboy hat, gyal pon di side (*Ride!*)
Mi nuh flex soft, mi flex wid pride (*Big Moves!*)

(*Bad Gyal*)
Bull rope tight, mi grip dat fast (*Hold tight!*)
One wrong step, yuh might not last (*Boom!*)
Step too high, get left inna past (*Gone!*)
Mash up di show when mi touch di dance (*Yes!*)

(*Memphis Horn Stab – Choir Echo: "YEAH!")

[Verse 1 – Drill Groove Meets Outlaw Stomp]
(*Moe Money*)
Mi ride low, mi nuh play no game (*Never!*)
Grit in mi step, fire in mi vein (*Hot!*)
Ten toes down, mi nuh move insane (*Solid!*)
Mi make mi mark, dem cyaan erase mi name (*Boss!*)

(*Bad Gyal*)
Dem gyal chat tough, but mi walk too mean (*Step!*)
Mi nuh tek talk, mi step pon scene (*Loud!*)
H-Town flex wid a Kingston queen (*Bad!*)
Mash up di place, mek di whole town scream (*Boom!*)

(*Choir: "PREACH!"*)

[Chorus, Call & Response, Heavy 808 Swing]
(*Moe Money say!*) Who real? (*We real!*)
Who fake? (*Dem fake!*)
Who ride? (*We ride!*)
Who brave? (*We brave!*)

(*Bad Gyal echoes*)
Who flex? (*Me flex!*)
Who next? (*No stress!*)
Who vex? (*Dem press!*)
Mi step? (*God bless!*)

(*Beat Drop – 808s Glide, Honky-Tonk Piano Lick!*)

[Verse 2 – Southern Swagger, Bluesy Flow]

(*Moe Money*)
Whiskey sip, mi nuh lose control (*Nah!*)
Still run street like rodeo roll (*Giddy-up!*)
Big belt buckle, gyal grip tight hold (*Hold on!*)
Mi nuh fall off, mi just take more gold (*Rich!*)

(*Bad Gyal*)
Dem cyaan talk bad if dem nuh step hard (*Soft!*)
Mi walk like boss, mi nuh tek fraud (*Nah!*)
Country gyal bad in di whole damn yard (*Facts!*)
Mash up di mic, dem haffi applaud (*BOOM!*)

(*Choir: "RUN DI TING!"*)

[DJ Drop 2, Texas Energy]
(*Gunshot SFX*)
🔥 **Moe Money & Bad Gyal** pon di riddim! London to Houston, we outside! 🔥

[Verse 3 – Full Mashup, Dancehall x Outlaw Battle]

(*Moe Money*)
Mi nuh tek check, mi nuh tek disrespect (*Nah!*)
Street code strong, mi nuh deal wid regret (*Facts!*)

(*Bad Gyal*)
Mi tek big steps, mi nuh tip-toe ’round (*Never!*)
Mi mash di dance, mi shut it down (*Boom!*)

(*Choir: "STAY WOKE!"*)

[Final Chorus, Full-On Rodeo Anthem]

(*Moe Money say!*) Who real? (*We real!*)
Who fake? (*Dem fake!*)
Who ride? (*We ride!*)
Who brave? (*We brave!*)

(*Bad Gyal echoes*)
Who flex? (*Me flex!*)
Who next? (*No stress!*)
Who vex? (*Dem press!*)
Mi step? (*God bless!*)

(*Beat Drops – CHOIR, SLIDE GUITAR, MEMPHIS HORNS & 808s GO CRAZY!*)

[Outro, Blues Guitar & Choir Harmonies]

(*Moe Money*) Youth man, listen up, mi haffi talk…
(*Street code!*) Life a nuh sprint, dis a marathon walk…

(*Bad Gyal*)
Real queens rule, mi nuh beg, mi nuh plead…
Mi move silent, mi move wid speed…
(*Choir Fade Out: "Stay real… stay wise…"*)

*"Grandmama stepped inside that closet… just enough room for her to kneel."*  
*"She closed the door. And before she said a word, she took a deep breath…"*

🎤 *"And the more she called Him, the heavier it got… the louder she got…"*  

🎶 **(Grandmother – Building Intensity)**  
🎶 *Come on… in the room… Jesus is my doctor!*  
🎶 *(Choir response – Stronger, tambourine shakes harder.)*  

🎤 *"She rocked back and forth… hands lifted… tears falling…"*  

🎤 **(Preacher’s Voice Enters – Emotional, Testifying)**

lyrics:
[Intro – Deep Organ Drones, Slow Foot-Stomps, Blues Guitar Licks]  
🎤 *(Wind howls softly, organ hums low, distant thunder rumbles.)*  

🎤 **(Narrator – Deep, Reflective, Spoken Word)**  
*"It was the ‘70s. Deep in the South. No streetlights, no cell phones—just a long, dark road."*  

*"A family on their way down home… but the son, he was drivin’… lost control on that dirt road."*  

🎶 *(Soft choir hums… slow, eerie blues guitar rings out.)*  

🎤 *"Car spun out. Hit the ditch. Everybody made it out… ‘cept him."*  

🎤 *"They needed a doctor. But there was no doctor."*  
🎤 *"The only house for miles was across that road…"*  
🎤 *"A white family’s house."*  

🎤 *(A long pause. Heavy silence.)*  

🎤 **"And back then? Knockin’ on the wrong door could get you killed."**  
🎤 **"But what choice did they have?"**  

🎶 *(Deep bass hum. Slow, steady foot-stomps begin.)*  

🎤 *"So the whole family went. Together. Strength in numbers. Prayin’ they’d be met with mercy."*  

🎤 *"They knocked… A white woman answered."*  

🎤 **"She let ‘em in. Let ‘em use the phone. But the doctor?"**  
🎤 **"He was out on his rounds."**  

🎶 *(Organ swells… the choir hums a little louder.)*  

🎤 **"And then… Grandmama came."**  

🎤 *(Footsteps. Slow. Heavy. She walks up that road, step by step.)*  

🎤 *"She moved slow… but when she got there, she asked one thing."*  

🎶 *(Music pauses. Silence. Then—her voice cuts through.)*  

🎶 **(Grandmother’s Voice - Soft, but firm)** *"Ma’am… do you have a closet?"*  

🎤 *(A long pause. A white woman’s voice, confused.)*  
🎤 **"You can use the phone."**  

🎤 *(Grandmother shakes her head.)*  

🎶 **(Grandmother’s Voice - Stronger)** *"No, ma’am. I don’t need the phone."*  
*"I need to call my doctor… and I need to go to your closet."*  

🎤 *(Organ swells! The choir hums louder! Tension rises!)*  

🎤 **"And she walked in that closet… fell to her knees… and called on JESUS!"**  

🎶 **(Soft Choir Enters – Building… fades into Part 2… "The Prayer in the Closet")**

lyrics:
[Intro – Soulful Horns, Gospel Quartet Introduced]  
*(Ohhh ohhh, yeah yeah, mmm-hmm… Lordy, Lordy…)*  
*Headin’ down that dirt road, baby,*  
*Soul’s as heavy as the Georgia clay…* *(bass singer hums underneath, quartet harmonies swell in.)*  

[Verse 1 – Southern Roots, Gospel Quartet Backing]  
*(Low hums & gospel harmonies throughout—think Staples Singers meets The O’Jays.)*  
Cotton fields and church bells ring,  
Mama’s tears in every hymn she sings.  
Dusty boots, can’t shake the past,  
But these roots, they grow too deep, too fast.  

[Chorus – Gospel Quartet Call & Response + Trap Beats]  
🎶 **(Lead)** Southbound soul, can’t break free,  
🎶 **(Quartet)** Ohhh, roll on, roll on…  
🎶 **(Lead)** Got a storm rollin’ deep inside of me,  
🎶 **(Quartet)** Hold strong, hold strong…  
🎶 **(Lead)** Mississippi moon, light my way,  
🎶 **(Quartet)** Shine down, shine down…  
🎶 **(Lead)** I’m a shadow in the heat of yesterday.  

[Verse 2 – Blues Vocals, Gospel Quartet Adlibs]  
Footsteps haunt the night’s parade,  
Whiskey ghosts in the cool, dark shade.  
Fires burn, the river speaks,  
Her waters hold my hidden grief.  

[Pre-Chorus – Harmonic Surprise, A Cappella Gospel Moment]  
*(Music drops to just voices, claps, and a deep bass singer hum.)*  
(Sway with me, sway with me, yeah yeah)  
We dance with pain, we fight the chains,  
But down here, love still remains.  

[Bridge – Spoken Word Tribute to the Gospel Allstars, Then Explosion]  
*(Drums drop out—spoken moment over deep gospel hums.)*  
> "When I was a little boy, the music didn’t just come from the radio... it came from the voices of my family, singin’ in the church ‘til the walls shook. That same spirit—it still moves through me today..."  
> "I remember my grandmother used to say, when the world couldn't help... when the doctors couldn’t heal… when the weight got too heavy…"  

[Outro – "Come On In The Room" Gospel Quartet Closing]  
*(Music fades completely. A deep bass hum begins. The quartet starts soft, then swells.)*  
🎶 **(Lead Vocal - Soulful & Testifying)** *Come on... in the room... ohhhhhh*  
🎶 **(Quartet Response - Low & Strong)** *Come on... in the room... mmmhmm*  
🎶 **(Lead Vocal)** *Jesus is my doctor… writes out all my prescriptions…*  
🎶 **(Quartet)** *He gives me all my medicine… in the room…*  

[Transition Into "Midnight Revival"]  
*(Final note swells, fades into eerie organ intro of "Midnight Revival.")*  
*(Preacher’s voice echoes through the fade, leading directly into the next song.)*

Running from the truth I couldn't find.

lyrics:
[Intro, Slide Guitar, Distant Radio Static]  
*(Soft, whispered, like a confession over the airwaves)*  
Late shift, last call,  
One more voice against the wall...  
Hold tight, don’t fall,  
I hear you, I hear it all... *(static fades...)*  

[Verse 1, Fingerstyle Guitar, Ghostly 808 Murmurs]  
Somewhere out there, on a neon-lit line,  
A stranger holds a lifeline tight.  
A voice so steady in the darkest tide,  
Talkin’ down demons in the dead of night.  

*(Faint radio: “Can you hear me? Stay with me…")*  

[Pre-Chorus, Cinematic Strings Swell, Beat Creeps In]  
No medals, no headlines, no songs in their name,  
But they pull lost souls from the pouring rain.  
A whisper, a word, a spark in the cold,  
They don’t know your face, but they fight for your soul...  

[Chorus, Power Ballad, Gospel Call-and-Response]  
**(Lead Vocal)** Midnight lifeline, holdin’ the weight,  
**(Choir)** They don’t break or fade...  
**(Lead Vocal)** Of hearts on the edge, souls in the fray.  
**(Choir)** Keep the light, don’t turn away...  
**(Lead Vocal)** They don’t wear halos or crowns,  
**(Choir)** But they hold the lost before they drown...  

[Post-Chorus, GlitchPerc, Vocal Chops, Blues Guitar Licks]  
*(Tick, tick, tick—the clock don't wait...)*  
*(Mmm, one more night, one more fate...)*  

[Verse 2, Deep 808s, Storytelling Flow]  
She works the phones ‘til the break of dawn,  
Knows the battle’s never really gone.  
Soft voice, but she stands so tall,  
Catching broken souls before they fall.  

*(Glitch percussion intensifies, then suddenly drops out—silent tension.)*  

[Breakdown, Stripped Acoustic & Raw Vocals]  
_(Soft, near acapella)_  
_"Hey now, listen, you ain't alone..._  
_Breathe deep, I swear, you’re comin’ home...”_  

*(Operator voice: “Are you still with me?”... Silence… Then a breath—hope.)*  

[Bridge, Choir Harmonies, Rising Tension, Organ Swell]  
No one sees the tears they hide,  
Silent warriors, unsung guides.  
Carrying weight they’ll never claim,  
Yet they still pick up when we call their name...  

[Final Chorus, Full Band Explosion, Soulful Ad-Libs]  
**(Lead Vocal)** Midnight lifeline, holdin’ the weight,  
**(Choir)** They don’t break or fade...  
**(Lead Vocal)** Of hearts on the edge, souls in the fray.  
**(Choir)** Keep the light, don’t turn away...  
**(Lead Vocal)** They don’t wear halos or crowns,  
**(Choir)** But they hold the lost before they drown...  

*(Huge drum fill—then everything cuts out, leaving just vocals and organ.)*  

[Outro, Distant Radio Static, Fading Guitar]  
*(Soft, weary, but strong, like a breath after the storm.)*  
Late shift, last call,  
One more voice against the wall...  
Hold tight, don’t fall,  
I hear you, I hear it all... *(beep... voicemail ends... static fades.)*

lyrics:
[DJ Drop]

We at Moe Money Studios. Let’s Get It!
Lyrics
Verse 1

[Verse 1] I"m sorry for the nights I stayed too late, When the moon was high and the stars were faint. I wish I"d listened closer to your plight, Instead of chasing shadows in the night.

[Verse 2] I"m sorry for the times my words were cold, Couldn"t see the pain, stories left untold. If I could take it back, make it right, I"d hold you close and never let you fight.

Chorus
[Chorus] We were the heart of this small town, But I let you down, let you drown. If broken dreams could pave the way, I"d mend your heart and beg you to stay.

Breakdown
[BREAKDOWN]
[Verse 3] I"m sorry for the days I wasn"t there, Caught up in a world that didn"t care. Now I"m lost, searching for the past, Hoping we can find a love to last.

[Bridge] Maybe someday you"ll forgive, And see I"ve changed the way I live. We"ll build a new from all we know, Like wildflowers in the fields we sow.

[Verse 4] I"m sorry for the tears you had to shed, Lonely nights and an empty bed. Now I"m standing at your door, Praying for a chance, nothing more.
[REPEAT Pre-Chorus and Hook x2, then fade out].
We out!

*(DJ MoMoney aka Jaun Goodcox—Let’s Get It!)*

They never saw me comin’, shadows movin’ in the mist,

Came from the corners where the deals get locked,  
Now it’s private jets and the timepiece rocked.

Every bar like a chopper, leave a scar on sight.

Turned my losses into lessons, made the hustle my own.  

[Hook]
Empire’s risin’, city never sleeps,  
Turn my pain into gold, now we play for keeps.  
Stack it high, flip the script, let ‘em know we deep,  
Ain’t no love in these streets, but we run ‘em with heat.

Marble floors, leather seats, same hunger from the gutter,

Every strategy precision, got a kingdom to hold.  
They be watchin’ how I move, tryna study my steps,  
But the minute they copy, I be switchin’ the rep!

[Outro, Quiet Arrangement, Echoing Vocals] (Southbound… soul… yeah, yeah…)

[Intro, DJ Drop]
*(DJ MoMoney aka Jaun Goodcox: "Yo, this the throne, only kings survive!")*
*Orchestral horns swell, deep bass rumbles*

[Verse 1] *(16 Bars, Biggie-inspired flow)*

Streets cold, but my soul got a champion's gleam.
Gold links swing, still hungry like ‘94,
Every bar gourmet, every rhyme worth more.

*(DJ Drop: "Let’s get this money!")*

While my name spread global like hustlers with plugs.

Street gospel in my veins, let the choir walk.

[Pre-Hook] *(2 Bars)*
Pressure make diamonds, watch the throne shine,
Built this empire with a militant mind.

[Hook] *(8 Bars, Shyne-inspired grit)*
Started from the curb, now the top where we sit,
Every verse that we drop got 'em feelin’ the grit.
Heavy bass knock, got the whole block lit,
Kings in the making, yeah, we built for this.

[Verse 2] *(16 Bars, Tupac-inspired passion & bounce)*
Ghetto symphony, I orchestrate pain,
From the Ave to the burbs, they gon’ chant my name.
Came up from the bottom where the wolves don't sleep,
Now we pull strings like a grand motif.

*(DJ Drop: "This that real talk!")*

Revolution in the cadence, struggle in the tone,
Every line like a prophecy carved in stone.
Pac’s ambition with a hustler’s drive,
Play this loud when my spirit revive.
Machetes with the wordplay, sharp as a blade,
From the system to the kingdom, my dues been paid.

[Pre-Hook] *(2 Bars)*
Blood in the ink, every page got weight,
Too real to fade, we was born too great.

[Hook] *(8 Bars, Shyne-inspired grit)*
Started from the curb, now the top where we sit,
Every verse that we drop got 'em feelin’ the grit.
Heavy bass knock, got the whole block lit,
Kings in the making, yeah, we built for this.

*(DJ Drop: "Step up or step out!")*

*Rapper 1:*

Got ‘em gaspin’, I'm the detonator and the creator.

*Rapper 2:*
See the flicker in my eyes, hear the venom in my speech,
Got ‘em shook like they just heard the beast unleashed.

*Rapper 3:*
Every word ricochet, like a shot from the throne,
Carve my name in the game like a king made of stone.

*Rapper 1:*
Schemes complex like a chessboard set,
Every move premeditated, I'm collectin’ my debt.

*Rapper 2:*
Man, my flow got layers like a hustler's stash,
Triple entendre, they ain’t ready for the clash.

*Rapper 3:*
Runnin’ circles ‘round ‘em, got ‘em dizzy, they choke,
Rap game carnival, my bars ain't a joke.

*Rapper 1:*
Too high up, see the game from the sky,
While they fight for the throne, we just wave goodbye.

[Outro, DJ Drop]
*(DJ MoMoney aka Jaun Goodcox: "The throne ain't given, it's TAKEN!")*

title: Empire Cipher

lyrics:
[Intro, Spoken Word, Deep Southern Drawl, Echoing Organ]
(Yeah… midnight calls… spirit walks…)
Cypress leaves tremble, moonlight bleeds,
Crossroads hum like a whisperin’ breeze.
Footsteps crunchin’ on shattered beliefs,
Shadows stretch where the devil don’t sleep.

[Verse 1, Slow Burn Blues, Swampy Guitar, Rising Kick Drum]
Dust in my lungs, fire in my chest,
Preacher-man sweatin’, hands to the vest.
Bible in one hand, flask in the other,
We all just sinners, drownin’ each other.

[Flow Switch – Rapid-Fire, Double-Time Cadence, Choir Murmurs]
Ghosts in the alley got a price to pay,
Every footstep echoes judgment day.
Mama said mercy but the streets say rage,
Southbound soul in a rusted cage.

[Pre-Chorus, Half-Time Groove, Gospel Choir Call & Response]
(Do you hear it? Do you feel it?)
Tambourine shakes, hands raised high,
Testify where the lost ones cry.

[Chorus, Full Band Hit, Trap Hi-Hats, Organ Stabs]
Take me down where the waters rise,
Wash my name from the sinners’ ties.
Midnight revival, hear that sound—
Chains break when the Spirit shouts!

[Verse 2, Aggressive Blues-Rap, Heavy Percussion, 808 Sub Rumble]
Cadence on a pendulum, venom in the syllable,
Crossroads talkin’, every word biblical.
Hellfire twistin’ in the shape of a hymn,
Got angels hummin’ while the lights go dim.

[Triplet Flow Acceleration, Choir Fades to a Hum]
Tattered and battered, the sermons they scatter,
The devil stay lurkin’ but faith climbin’ ladders.
Fists in the dirt, got my knees in the mud,
This resurrection, it’s written in blood.

[Pre-Chorus, Harmonic Lift, Spoken-Word Whisper Builds to Shout]
(Ohhh, do you hear it? Do you feel it?)
Chains break like a cannon blast,
Storm rolls heavy but it won’t outlast.

[Chorus, Full Band Explosion, Call & Response, Choir Belts]
Take me down where the waters rise,
Wash my name from the sinners’ ties.
Midnight revival, hear that sound—
Chains break when the Spirit shouts!

[Bridge, Percussion Break, Handclaps, Rising Horns]
(Preacher adlibs)
"Can I get a witness?" (Mmm-hmm!)
"Can I get a sign?" (Yes, Lord!)
"I hear the thunder, I see the light—"
"I know redemption’s close tonight!"

[Final Chorus, Full Choir Swell, Trap Drums, Electric Guitar Riff]
Take me down where the waters rise,
Wash my name from the sinners’ ties.
Midnight revival, hear that sound—
Chains break when the Spirit shouts!

[Outro, Stripped Back, Echoing Organ, Soft Choir]
(Oooh… yeah… midnight’s fallin’… spirit’s callin’…)

(Yeah… midnight calls… spirit walks…)
Cypress leaves tremble, moonlight bleeds,
Crossroads hum like a whisperin’ breeze.
Footsteps crunchin’ on shattered beliefs,
Shadows stretch where the devil don’t sleep.

[Verse 1, Slow Burn Blues, Swampy Guitar, Rising Kick Drum]
Dust in my lungs, fire in my chest,
Preacher-man sweatin’, hands to the vest.
Bible in one hand, flask in the other,
We all just sinners, drownin’ each other.

[Flow Switch – Rapid-Fire, Double-Time Cadence, Choir Murmurs]
Ghosts in the alley got a price to pay,
Every footstep echoes judgment day.
Mama said mercy but the streets say rage,
Southbound soul in a rusted cage.

[Pre-Chorus, Half-Time Groove, Gospel Choir Call & Response]
(Do you hear it? Do you feel it?)
Tambourine shakes, hands raised high,
Testify where the lost ones cry.

[Chorus, Full Band Hit, Trap Hi-Hats, Organ Stabs]
Take me down where the waters rise,
Wash my name from the sinners’ ties.
Midnight revival, hear that sound—
Chains break when the Spirit shouts!

[Verse 2, Aggressive Blues-Rap, Heavy Percussion, 808 Sub Rumble]
Cadence on a pendulum, venom in the syllable,
Crossroads talkin’, every word biblical.
Hellfire twistin’ in the shape of a hymn,
Got angels hummin’ while the lights go dim.

[Triplet Flow Acceleration, Choir Fades to a Hum]
Tattered and battered, the sermons they scatter,
The devil stay lurkin’ but faith climbin’ ladders.
Fists in the dirt, got my knees in the mud,
This resurrection, it’s written in blood.

[Pre-Chorus, Harmonic Lift, Spoken-Word Whisper Builds to Shout]
(Ohhh, do you hear it? Do you feel it?)
Chains break like a cannon blast,
Storm rolls heavy but it won’t outlast.

[Chorus, Full Band Explosion, Call & Response, Choir Belts]
Take me down where the waters rise,
Wash my name from the sinners’ ties.
Midnight revival, hear that sound—
Chains break when the Spirit shouts!

[Bridge, Percussion Break, Handclaps, Rising Horns]
(Preacher adlibs)
"Can I get a witness?" (Mmm-hmm!)
"Can I get a sign?" (Yes, Lord!)
"I hear the thunder, I see the light—"
"I know redemption’s close tonight!"

[Final Chorus, Full Choir Swell, Trap Drums, Electric Guitar Riff]
Take me down where the waters rise,
Wash my name from the sinners’ ties.
Midnight revival, hear that sound—
Chains break when the Spirit shouts!

[Outro, Stripped Back, Echoing Organ, Soft Choir]
(Oooh… yeah… midnight’s fallin’… spirit’s callin’…)

lyrics:
[Intro, DJ Drop]
(DJ Moe Money in the building! Turn me up! Whoo!)
808 boomin’, yeah, that bass too thick
Shorty walk by, got ‘em losin’ they grip

[Verse 1]
Big body Benz but the waist real tight (tight)
Ain’t no jeans ever fittin’ me right (nah!)
Hips too wide, booty sittin’ on swole (whoo!)
Put me in a sundress, got ‘em losin’ control (ha!)
Yeah, he wanna grab it, but I make him work (work!)
Know I’m top-tier, gotta spin that purse (racks!)
This ain’t no free ride, boy, show respect (yeah)
I’m the type to break a bank and his neck (uh!)
Twerk to the left, shake to the right (go!)
Got ‘em hypnotized off this body, that’s light (yup)
Bollywood strings with a trap beat knockin’ (boom!)
DJ Moe Money, keep the whole club rockin’ (woo!)

[Pre-Chorus]
Ooooh, baby, what that booty like? (What?)
Wanna see me throw it, bet that money right (cash!)
Talkin’ big game, but can you handle mine? (Huh?)
Put it on ya, you gon’ lose ya mind (ha!)

[Hook/Chorus]
What dat booty like? (Bounce!)
What dat booty like? (Shake!)
Make it move left-right (Go!)
Make it move up-down (Whoa!)
What dat booty like? (Spin!)
What dat booty like? (Twerk!)
Turn around, let it clap!
Turn around, let it clap!

[Verse 2]
Lil waist, thick cake, sittin’ real nice (yeah)
Booty so big, make a grown man cry (damn!)
Yeah, he say he like ‘em thick, well, I’m **all of that** (all that!)
And if he talkin’ stupid, he ain’t callin’ back (bye!)
Buss it down, make it bounce, hands on knees (knees!)
Got ‘em beggin’ like “please, lemme get a tease” (nah!)
Boy, hush, break bread, I’m a real-life snack (yum!)
Body so cold, make ‘em spend that stack (racks!)
Twerk it to the left, now drop it down low (low)
If he ain't got bands, then the answer is no (nope!)
DJ Moe Money, turn it up, let's go! (whoo!)

[Bridge]
(Vocal chops: "What it do? What it do?")
(Drums fade, synths build up, then drop back in hard)
Move to the left, slide to the right
She got that body, she ride all night

[Outro, DJ Drop]
Still representing the moe

lyrics:
Lyrics: [Intro, Soulful Horns, Delta Blues Vocals] (Ohhh ohhh, yeah yeah) Headin’ down that dirt road, baby Soul’s as heavy as the Georgia clay

[Verse 1, Southern Roots, Ethnic Percussion] Cotton fields and church bells ring Mama’s tears in every hymn she sings Dusty boots, can’t shake the past But these roots, they grow too deep, too fast

[Chorus, Soulful Horns, Trap Beats, Power Vocals] Southbound soul, can’t break free Got a storm rollin’ deep inside of me Mississippi moon, light my way I’m a shadow in the heat of yesterday

[Verse 2, Blues Vocals, Ethnic Percussion] Footsteps haunt the night’s parade Whiskey ghosts in the cool, dark shade Fires burn, the river speaks Her waters hold my hidden grief

[Pre-Chorus, Harmonic Surprise, Delta Blues Vocals] (Sway with me, sway with me, yeah yeah) We dance with pain, we fight the chains But down here, love still remains

[Chorus, Soulful Horns, Trap Beats, Power Vocals] Southbound soul, can’t break free Got a storm rollin’ deep inside of me Mississippi moon, light my way I’m a shadow in the heat of yesterday

[Bridge, Instrumental Break, Percussion Solo] (Drums hit hard, blues guitar weeps) [Melodic Horn Build, Ascending Progression] Ooooh, ooooh—

[Final Chorus, Full Arrangement, Gospel Choir Backing] Southbound soul, can’t break free Storm rollin’ deep, it’s a part of me Delta dreams, rise like flames Burnin’ high, but never tamed

[Outro, Quiet Arrangement, Echoing Vocals] (Southbound… soul… yeah, yeah…)

Money talks, yeah, the bag got a story to tell  
I been dodgin’ all the feds, but I’m still raisin’ hell

[DJ Drop]

**(Ayy!) Gold chain heavy, flex on the scene**  
**(Let’s go!) Bad lil’ thing, waist so tight**

[Outro, DJ Drop]
**You already know what it is—DJ Moe Money signin’ off!**  
(Yeah, yeah—uh, racks, racks, racks!)

lyrics:
[Verse 1]

I'm sorry for the years I spent blind

Running from the truth I couldn't find

Kept it all inside, hidden away

Thought I could fight it, day by day

[Pre-Chorus]

But the nights were darker than I ever knew

And the pain inside, I never let through

[Chorus]

I'm sorry to my family, to my friends

For all the hurt I caused, for where it ends

I should have faced it, I should have tried

But I was lost, and I couldn't decide

Now I see the wreckage I've made

But I'm sorry, and I'm asking for grace

[Verse 2]

For the times I pushed you all away

When all I needed was someone to stay

I let the bottle numb the fight

And the voices in my head took flight

[Pre-Chorus]

I wasn’t strong enough to ask for help

I shut you out, kept it to myself

[Chorus]

I'm sorry to my family, to my friends

For all the hurt I caused, for where it ends

I should have faced it, I should have tried

But I was lost, and I couldn't decide

Now I see the wreckage I've made

But I'm sorry, and I'm asking for grace

[Bridge]

I was scared of what you might see

A man broken, but still trying to be free

I didn’t know how to heal this fight

But I’m here now, ready for the light

[Chorus]

I'm sorry to my family, to my friends

For all the hurt I caused, for where it ends

I should have faced it, I should have tried

But I was lost, and I couldn't decide

Now I see the wreckage I've made

But I'm sorry, and I'm asking for grace

[Outro]

I'm sorry, I'm sorry, for all that I've done

But I'm reaching out now, I’m not the same one

I’ll rebuild the trust I tore apart

With every step, I’ll start to heal my heart.

lyrics:
[Intro, Soulful Horns, Delta Blues Vocals]
(Ohhh ohhh, yeah yeah)
Headin’ down that dirt road, baby
Soul’s as heavy as the Georgia clay

[Verse 1, Southern Roots, Ethnic Percussion]
Cotton fields and church bells ring
Mama’s tears in every hymn she sings
Dusty boots, can’t shake the past
But these roots, they grow too deep, too fast

[Chorus, Soulful Horns, Trap Beats, Power Vocals]
Southbound soul, can’t break free
Got a storm rollin’ deep inside of me
Mississippi moon, light my way
I’m a shadow in the heat of yesterday

[Verse 2, Blues Vocals, Ethnic Percussion]
Footsteps haunt the night’s parade
Whiskey ghosts in the cool, dark shade
Fires burn, the river speaks
Her waters hold my hidden grief

[Pre-Chorus, Harmonic Surprise, Delta Blues Vocals]
(Sway with me, sway with me, yeah yeah)
We dance with pain, we fight the chains
But down here, love still remains

[Chorus, Soulful Horns, Trap Beats, Power Vocals]
Southbound soul, can’t break free
Got a storm rollin’ deep inside of me
Mississippi moon, light my way
I’m a shadow in the heat of yesterday

[Bridge, Instrumental Break, Percussion Solo]
(Drums hit hard, blues guitar weeps)
[Melodic Horn Build, Ascending Progression]
Ooooh, ooooh—

[Final Chorus, Full Arrangement, Gospel Choir Backing]
Southbound soul, can’t break free
Storm rollin’ deep, it’s a part of me
Delta dreams, rise like flames
Burnin’ high, but never tamed

[Outro, Quiet Arrangement, Echoing Vocals]
(Southbound… soul… yeah, yeah…)

lyrics:
[Intro, Ethnic flute, Ambient pads]
(Whispers of the wind)
(Ohh-ohh, ahh-ahh)
[Verse 1, Ethnic drum groove, Female Narrator]
The river flows where stories meet,
Under skies with endless heat.
Footsteps in the sand, lost time,
Echoes of life, the earth’s old rhyme.
[Pre-Chorus, Swelling synth, Harmonized chants]
Raise your hands to the sky,
Feel the ground, hear its cry.
[Chorus, Ethereal vocals, Layered percussion]
Echoes of the earth, calling through the night,
Dance to the rhythm of stars and light.
From mountain peaks to ocean tides,
We are one, forever tied.
[Interlude, Instrumental break, Electronic drops, Ethnic strings]
[Verse 2, Soaring flute, Electronic bass beat]
The earth speaks in every tree,
In whispers of the deep blue sea.
Guided by its ancient lore,
We find our way, forevermore.
[Bridge, Chanting choir, Rhythmic hand drums]
(Ahh ohh ohh) Listen close, the world will speak.
(Ahh ohh ohh) Voices strong, yet soft and meek.
(Ahh ohh ohh) Let the rhythm take your feet.
[Chorus, Ethereal vocals, Uplifting synth pads]
Echoes of the earth, calling through the night,
Dance to the rhythm of stars and light.
From mountain peaks to ocean tides,
We are one, forever tied.
[Outro, Ethnic percussion fade, Wind whispers]
(Ohh-ohh, ahh-ahh)
Echoes… fading into night.
